      module axi_dma_write
      	#(
      		parameter 		BURST_LEN 	= 8		,
      		parameter       ID_WIDTH  	= 4		,
      		parameter       DATA_WIDTH 	= 128	,
      		parameter       KEEP_WIDTH  = DATA_WIDTH / 8
      	)
      	(
      	input 				clk 			,    // Clock
      	input 				rst 			,    // Synchronous reset active high
      
      	//cmd interface
      	input       	 					cmd_valid		,
      	input 			[31:0] 				cmd_addr		,
      	input 			[31:0] 				cmd_len			,
      	input			[ID_WIDTH - 1:0]    cmd_id          ,
      	output reg  	    				cmd_ready		,
      
      	//trans data in
      	input 			[DATA_WIDTH - 1:0]  data_in      	,
      	input			[KEEP_WIDTH - 1:0]	data_in_keep	,
      	input         						data_in_valid	,
      	output reg                          data_in_last    ,
      	output        						data_in_ready	,
      
      	//axi w
      	output reg		[ID_WIDTH - 1:0]   			m_axi_awid   	,
      	output reg		[31:0]  					m_axi_awaddr 	,
      	output reg		[7:0]   					m_axi_awlen  	,
      	output 			[2:0]   					m_axi_awsize 	,
      	output 			[1:0]   					m_axi_awburst	,
      	output 		    	    					m_axi_awlock 	,
      	output 			[3:0]   					m_axi_awcache	,
      	output 			[2:0]   					m_axi_awprot	,
      	output reg		        					m_axi_awvalid	,
      	input  		 	        					m_axi_awready	,
      	output 			[DATA_WIDTH - 1:0] 			m_axi_wdata		,
      	output 			[KEEP_WIDTH - 1:0]  		m_axi_wstrb		,
      	output 			        					m_axi_wlast		,
      	output 			        					m_axi_wvalid	,
      	input  			        					m_axi_wready	,
      	input  			[ID_WIDTH - 1:0]   			m_axi_bid  		,
      	input  			[1:0]   					m_axi_bresp 	,
      	input  			        					m_axi_bvalid	,
      	output 			        					m_axi_bready
      
      );
      
      
      localparam AXI_BURST_SIZE = $clog2(KEEP_WIDTH); //log2(DATA_WIDTH / 8)
      
      // [WD 2026-09-18] transmit watchdog state
      reg        abort_r;
      reg [23:0] wd_cnt;
      wire       w_progress;
      wire       abort_done;
      
      wire [DATA_WIDTH - 1:0] 		t_m_axi_wdata;
      wire [KEEP_WIDTH - 1:0]  		t_m_axi_wstrb;
      wire         					t_m_axi_wlast;
      wire         					t_m_axi_wvalid;
      wire         					t_m_axi_wready;
      
      //common para
      assign m_axi_awsize 	= 		AXI_BURST_SIZE	;
      assign m_axi_awburst 	= 		2'b01			;
      assign m_axi_awlock 	= 		1'b0			;
      assign m_axi_awcache 	= 		4'b0011			;
      assign m_axi_awprot 	= 		3'b000			;
      
      
      wire [7:0] burst_len    ;
      wire [7:0] max_burst_len;
      
      //cmd
      reg [31:0] addr;
      reg [31:0] len;
      reg        trans;
      
      always @(posedge clk) begin
      	if((cmd_ready == 1'b1) && (cmd_valid == 1'b1))begin
      		addr <= cmd_addr;
      	end
      	else begin
      		if((m_axi_awvalid == 1'b1) && (m_axi_awready == 1'b1))begin
      			addr <= addr + ((m_axi_awlen + 1'b1) << AXI_BURST_SIZE);
      		end
      	end
      end
      
      always @(posedge clk) begin
      	if((cmd_ready == 1'b1) && (cmd_valid == 1'b1))begin
      		len <= cmd_len[31:AXI_BURST_SIZE] + (|cmd_len[AXI_BURST_SIZE - 1:0]);
      	end
      	else begin
      		if((m_axi_awvalid == 1'b1) && (m_axi_awready == 1'b1))begin
      			len <= len - (m_axi_awlen + 1'b1);
      		end
      		else if(abort_done == 1'b1)begin
      			len <= 32'd0;       // [WD]
      		end
      	end
      end
      always @(posedge clk)begin
      	if(rst == 1'b1)begin
      		trans <= 1'b0;
      	end
      	else begin
      		if((cmd_ready == 1'b1) && (cmd_valid == 1'b1))begin
      			trans <= 1'b1;
      		end
      		else begin
      			if((m_axi_bready == 1'b1) && (m_axi_bvalid == 1'b1) && (len == 32'd0))begin
      				trans <= 1'b0;
      			end
      			else if(abort_done == 1'b1)begin
      				trans <= 1'b0;      // [WD] release the stuck transaction
      			end
      		end
      	end
      end
      
      always @(posedge  clk)begin
      	if(rst == 1'b1)begin
      		cmd_ready <= 1'b0;
      	end
      	else begin
      		if(trans == 1'b0)begin
      			if((cmd_ready == 1'b1) && (cmd_valid == 1'b1))begin
      				cmd_ready <= 1'b0;
      			end
      			else begin
      				cmd_ready <= 1'b1;
      			end
      		end
      		else begin
      			cmd_ready <= 1'b0;
      		end
      	end
      end
      
      //aw
      
      reg burst_trans;
      assign burst_len     = len > BURST_LEN ? BURST_LEN : len;
      assign max_burst_len = (((addr & 12'hfff) + (burst_len << AXI_BURST_SIZE )) >> 12)  != 0 ? (13'h1000 - (addr & 12'hfff)) >> AXI_BURST_SIZE : burst_len;
      always@(posedge clk)begin
      	if(rst == 1'b1)begin
      		burst_trans <= 1'b0;
      	end
      	else begin
      		if((m_axi_awvalid == 1'b1) && (m_axi_awready == 1'b1))begin
      			burst_trans <= 1'b1;
      		end
      		else begin
      			// if((m_axi_wvalid == 1'b1) && (m_axi_wready == 1'b1) && (m_axi_wlast == 1'b1))begin
      			if((m_axi_bvalid == 1'b1) && (m_axi_bready == 1'b1))begin
      				burst_trans <= 1'b0;
      			end
      			else if(abort_done == 1'b1)begin
      				burst_trans <= 1'b0;   // [WD2] force-release; B may never arrive
      			end
      		end
      	end
      end
      always @(posedge clk)begin
      	if(rst == 1'b1)begin
      		m_axi_awvalid <= 1'b0;
      	end
      	else begin
      		if((m_axi_awvalid == 1'b1) && (m_axi_awready == 1'b1))begin
      			m_axi_awvalid <= 1'b0;
      		end
      		else begin
      			if((burst_trans == 1'b0) && (len != 32'd0) && (abort_r == 1'b0))begin
      				m_axi_awvalid <= 1'b1;
      			end
      		end
      	end
      end
      
      always @(posedge clk)begin
      	m_axi_awlen <= max_burst_len - 8'd1;
      end
      always @(posedge clk)begin
      	m_axi_awaddr <= addr;
      end
      always @(posedge clk) begin
      	if((cmd_ready == 1'b1) && (cmd_valid == 1'b1))begin
      		m_axi_awid <= cmd_id;
      	end
      end
      //w
      reg [7:0] act_burst_len;
      always@ (posedge clk)begin
      	if(rst == 1'b1)begin
      		act_burst_len <= 8'd0;
      	end
      	else begin
      		if((m_axi_awvalid == 1'b1) && (m_axi_awready == 1'b1))begin
      			act_burst_len <= m_axi_awlen + 8'd1;
      		end
      		else begin
      			if((t_m_axi_wvalid == 1'b1) && (t_m_axi_wready == 1'b1))begin
      				act_burst_len <= act_burst_len - 8'd1;
      			end
      		end
      	end
      end
      
      // [WD 2026-09-18] ------------------------------------------------------------------
      // The DVP stream can deliver fewer 128-bit beats than CAM_DATA_LEN (CDC FIFO
      // overflow drops pixels and cannot back-pressure the sensor). A frame's AXI
      // burst then never completes: trans sticks at 1, cmd_ready stays low and the
      // frame FSM deadlocks forever (measured: state=ADDR, axi_cnt=0, 0 frames).
      //
      // Recovery: if there is no W-beat progress for ~0.17 s while a write is in
      // flight, close the open burst with dummy beats. AXI forbids cancelling an
      // accepted AW, so we must still supply awlen beats; we just no longer consume
      // real camera data. After the B response is absorbed, trans/len clear and the
      // next frame's command is accepted again (only the bad frame is lost).
      assign w_progress = (t_m_axi_wvalid == 1'b1) && (t_m_axi_wready == 1'b1);
      
      always @(posedge clk) begin
      	if((rst == 1'b1) || (trans == 1'b0) || (abort_r == 1'b1) || (w_progress == 1'b1))
      		wd_cnt <= 24'd0;
      	else if(wd_cnt != 24'hFFFFFF)
      		wd_cnt <= wd_cnt + 24'd1;
      end
      
      // [BFAST 2026-09-19] the DDR write port can stop returning B responses
      // (see [WD2]; re-observed 09-19: b_cnt ~26 total while aw_cnt ~60k).
      // Waiting the full 0.17 s watchdog once every command's beats are out
      // capped the camera path at ~5 fps. Give B a few microseconds after the
      // last beat, then force the close via the abort path; a late B is still
      // absorbed by the w_done/bready logic.
      reg [9:0] bwait_cnt;
      // (w_done intentionally not referenced: it is declared further below and
      // act_burst_len==0 && burst_trans already means every beat is out, B pending)
      wire all_beats_out = (len == 32'd0) && (act_burst_len == 8'd0) && burst_trans;
      always @(posedge clk) begin
      	if((rst == 1'b1) || (trans == 1'b0) || (all_beats_out == 1'b0) || (abort_r == 1'b1))
      		bwait_cnt <= 10'd0;
      	else if(bwait_cnt != 10'h3FF)
      		bwait_cnt <= bwait_cnt + 10'd1;
      end
      always @(posedge clk) begin
      	if(rst == 1'b1)
      		abort_r <= 1'b0;
      	// [BFAST2 2026-09-19] bwait fast-close DISABLED: B latency under DDR contention
      	// can legitimately exceed the 10us grace; force-closing mid-flight corrupted
      	// the crossbar/DDR transaction stream and killed M00 writes within seconds.
      	// Fall back to the long send-watchdog only.
      	else if((abort_r == 1'b0) && (trans == 1'b1) && (wd_cnt == 24'hFFFFFF))
      		abort_r <= 1'b1;
      	else if(abort_done == 1'b1)
      		abort_r <= 1'b0;
      end
      
      // [WD2 2026-09-18] burst_trans is only cleared by the B response, which is
      // exactly what never arrives in the wedge case (cam2: bvalid never asserted).
      // Requiring burst_trans==0 made abort_done unreachable -> no recovery.
      // All W beats for the open burst are out once act_burst_len hits 0, so that
      // is the correct release point; burst_trans is force-cleared below.
      assign abort_done = abort_r && (act_burst_len == 8'd0);
      // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------
      
      stream_pipe #(
        .DATA_WIDTH 	(DATA_WIDTH+1+KEEP_WIDTH)
      ) stream_pipe_3(
        .dataIn_valid     (t_m_axi_wvalid),
        .dataIn_ready     (t_m_axi_wready),
        .dataIn_payload   ({t_m_axi_wdata, t_m_axi_wstrb, t_m_axi_wlast}),
        .dataOut_valid    (m_axi_wvalid),
        .dataOut_ready    (m_axi_wready),
        .dataOut_payload  ({m_axi_wdata, m_axi_wstrb, m_axi_wlast}),
        .clk              (clk),
        .reset            (rst)
      );
      
      assign data_in_ready = abort_r ? 1'b0
                                     : (t_m_axi_wready && act_burst_len > 8'd0);
      assign t_m_axi_wvalid  = abort_r ? (act_burst_len > 8'd0)
                                       : (data_in_valid && act_burst_len > 8'd0);
      assign t_m_axi_wdata   = abort_r ? {DATA_WIDTH{1'b0}} : data_in;
      assign t_m_axi_wlast   = (act_burst_len == 8'd1);
      assign t_m_axi_wstrb   = abort_r ? {KEEP_WIDTH{1'b1}} : data_in_keep;
      
      //b
      reg w_done;
      always @(posedge clk) begin
      	if(rst == 1'b1) begin
      		w_done <= 1'b0;
      	end
      	else begin
      		if((t_m_axi_wvalid == 1'b1) && (t_m_axi_wready == 1'b1) && (t_m_axi_wlast == 1'b1)) begin
      			w_done <= 1'b1;
      		end
      		else begin
      			if((m_axi_bvalid == 1'b1) && (m_axi_bready == 1'b1)) begin
      				w_done <= 1'b0;
      			end
      		end
      	end
      end
      assign m_axi_bready = w_done;
      
      // [LEDGER 2026-09-19] single-ledger completion: pulse exactly once per
      // command on the trans 1->0 fall. Covers the normal close (B absorbed,
      // len==0) AND both watchdog abort paths; the old B-gated expression never
      // pulsed when a B response was lost, wedging the frame FSM in DATA forever.
      reg trans_q;
      always @(posedge clk) begin
      	if(rst == 1'b1) trans_q <= 1'b0;
      	else            trans_q <= trans;
      end
      
      always @(posedge clk ) begin
      	if(rst == 1'b1)begin
      		data_in_last <= 1'b0;
      	end
      	else begin
      		data_in_last <= trans_q && (trans == 1'b0);
      	end
      end
      
      endmodule

      module ov5640_reg #(
          parameter BASE_ADDR = 32'h2000_0000,
          parameter [31:0] CAM_ADDR_1_DEF = 32'h0080_0000,
          parameter [31:0] CAM_ADDR_2_DEF = 32'h00A0_0000,

      //锟侥达拷锟斤拷锟斤拷址
      localparam REG_ACK       = BASE_ADDR + 32'h00;
      localparam REG_CAM_EN    = BASE_ADDR + 32'h40;
      localparam REG_CAM_ADDR_1= BASE_ADDR + 32'h80;
      localparam REG_CAM_ADDR_2= BASE_ADDR + 32'hc0;
      // [PROBE 2026-09-18] every offset is 16-byte aligned: the PCIe M01 read
      // path ignores addr[3:0], so only *0 offsets are individually readable.
      localparam REG_DBG_PCLK_CNT  = BASE_ADDR + 32'h10;
      localparam REG_DBG_VSYNCS    = BASE_ADDR + 32'h20;
      localparam REG_DBG_CAM_WORDS = BASE_ADDR + 32'h30;
      localparam REG_DBG_AXI_STICKY= BASE_ADDR + 32'h50;
      localparam REG_DBG_I2C_ID    = BASE_ADDR + 32'h60;
      localparam REG_DBG_SYS       = BASE_ADDR + 32'h70;
      localparam REG_DBG_HREF_RAW  = BASE_ADDR + 32'h90;
      localparam REG_DBG_BEAT_CNT  = BASE_ADDR + 32'ha0;
      localparam REG_DBG_BEAT_LAST = BASE_ADDR + 32'hf0;
      localparam REG_DBG_XDMA_REQ  = BASE_ADDR + 32'hb0;
      localparam REG_DBG_VSYNC_RAW = BASE_ADDR + 32'he0;
      localparam REG_DBG_AXI_NOW   = BASE_ADDR + 32'hd0;
      // [ZDIAG 2026-09-18] 0x50/0x90 repurposed from the old axi_sticky/href_raw
      // probes (kept inside the addr[9:8]=00 CAM1 segment; 0x100+ routes to prep).
      localparam REG_DBG_ZDIN      = BASE_ADDR + 32'h50;
      localparam REG_DBG_ZOUT      = BASE_ADDR + 32'h90;
      
          reg bvalid        ;
          reg data_out_valid;
      
          reg rvalid;
          reg [AXI_ADDR_WIDTH-1 : 0] rdata ;
      
          //XDAM应锟斤拷
          always @(posedge clk) begin
              if(rst)begin
                  xdma_ack <= 2'b0;
              end
              else if((s_axi_awvalid & s_axi_awready) && (s_axi_wvalid & s_axi_wready) && (s_axi_awaddr == REG_ACK))begin
                  xdma_ack <= s_axi_wdata[1 : 0];
              end
              else begin
                  xdma_ack <= 2'b0;
              end
          end
      
          //锟斤拷锟斤拷头使锟斤拷
          always @(posedge clk) begin
              if(rst)begin
                  cam_en <= CAM_EN_DEF;
              end
              else if((s_axi_awvalid & s_axi_awready) && (s_axi_wvalid & s_axi_wready) && (s_axi_awaddr == REG_CAM_EN))begin
                  cam_en <= s_axi_wdata[0];
              end
          end
      
          //图片锟斤拷址1
          always @(posedge clk) begin
              if(rst)begin
                  cam_addr_1 <= CAM_ADDR_1_DEF;
              end
              else if((s_axi_awvalid & s_axi_awready) && (s_axi_wvalid & s_axi_wready) && (s_axi_awaddr == REG_CAM_ADDR_1))begin
                  cam_addr_1 <= s_axi_wdata;
              end
          end
      
          //图片锟斤拷址2
          always @(posedge clk) begin
              if(rst)begin
                  cam_addr_2 <= CAM_ADDR_2_DEF;
              end
              else if((s_axi_awvalid & s_axi_awready) && (s_axi_wvalid & s_axi_wready) && (s_axi_awaddr == REG_CAM_ADDR_2))begin
                  cam_addr_2 <= s_axi_wdata;
              end
          end
      
          //锟斤拷为锟斤拷一锟斤拷锟斤拷锟侥达拷锟斤拷锟斤拷锟斤拷锟斤拷锟斤拷锟斤拷锟矫伙拷锟斤拷卸隙锟斤拷锟街�
          reg r_state;
          always @(posedge clk) begin
              if(rst)begin
                  r_state <= 1'b0;
              end
              else begin
                  if(s_axi_arvalid & s_axi_arready) begin
                      r_state <= 1'b1;
                  end
                  else if(s_axi_rvalid & s_axi_rready) begin
                      r_state <= 1'b0;
                  end
              end
          end
      
          always @(posedge clk) begin
              if(rst)begin
                  data_out_valid <= 1'b0;
              end
              else begin
                  if(s_axi_arvalid & s_axi_arready)begin
                      data_out_valid <= 1'b1;
                  end
                  else begin
                      data_out_valid <= 1'b0;
                  end
              end
          end
      
      
          // 锟斤拷锟斤拷一锟斤拷锟捷达拷锟斤拷锟街凤拷募拇锟斤拷锟�
          reg [AXI_ADDR_WIDTH-1:0] raddr_reg;
          always @(posedge clk) begin
              if (s_axi_arvalid & s_axi_arready) begin
                  raddr_reg <= s_axi_araddr; // 锟斤拷锟街成癸拷瞬锟戒，锟斤拷锟斤拷锟斤拷锟斤拷锟斤拷锟斤拷锟侥讹拷锟斤拷址
              end
          end
      
      
          always @(posedge clk) begin
              if(rst)begin
                  rvalid <= 1'b0;
                  rdata  <= {AXI_ADDR_WIDTH{1'b0}}; // 注锟解：rdata 位锟斤拷应锟斤拷锟斤拷 32锟斤拷锟斤拷锟斤拷 1
              end
              else begin
                  if(data_out_valid) begin
                      rvalid <= 1'b1;
                      // 锟斤拷锟捷刚诧拷锟斤拷锟斤拷亩锟斤拷锟街凤拷锟斤拷锟斤拷囟锟接︼拷拇锟斤拷锟斤拷锟斤拷锟绞抵�
                      case(raddr_reg)
                          REG_ACK:        rdata <= {{AXI_ADDR_WIDTH-2{1'b0}}, xdma_ack};
                          REG_CAM_EN:     rdata <= {{AXI_ADDR_WIDTH-1{1'b0}}, cam_en};
                          REG_CAM_ADDR_1: rdata <= cam_addr_1;
                          REG_CAM_ADDR_2: rdata <= cam_addr_2;
                          REG_DBG_CAM_WORDS: rdata <= dbg_cam_words;
                          REG_DBG_VSYNCS:    rdata <= dbg_vsyncs;
                          REG_DBG_ZDIN:      rdata <= dbg_zdin;
                          REG_DBG_ZOUT:      rdata <= dbg_zout;
                          REG_DBG_BEAT_CNT:  rdata <= dbg_beat_cnt;
                          REG_DBG_BEAT_LAST: rdata <= dbg_last_cnt;
                          REG_DBG_XDMA_REQ:  rdata <= {{(AXI_ADDR_WIDTH-2){1'b0}}, dbg_xdma_req};
                          REG_DBG_VSYNC_RAW: rdata <= dbg_vsync_raw;
                          REG_DBG_I2C_ID:    rdata <= {dbg_wd_cnt[7:0], dbg_state[7:0], dbg_cmd_cnt[15:0]};
                          REG_DBG_PCLK_CNT:  rdata <= dbg_pclk_cnt;
                          REG_DBG_SYS:       rdata <= {dbg_b_cnt[15:0], dbg_aw_cnt[15:0]};
                          REG_DBG_AXI_NOW:   rdata <= dbg_axi_num;
                          default:        rdata <= {AXI_ADDR_WIDTH{1'b1}}; // 锟斤拷锟斤拷锟角凤拷锟斤拷址锟斤拷锟斤拷锟斤拷锟斤拷锟角ｏ拷锟斤拷锟斤拷 debug
                      endcase
                  end
                  else if(s_axi_rvalid & s_axi_rready)begin
                      rvalid <= 1'b0;
                      // rdata 锟斤拷锟街诧拷锟戒即锟缴ｏ拷直锟斤拷锟斤拷一锟轿讹拷锟斤拷锟斤拷
                  end
              end
          end
      
      
          always @(posedge clk) begin
              if(rst)begin
                  bvalid <= 1'b0;
              end
              else begin
                  if((s_axi_awvalid & s_axi_awready) && (s_axi_wvalid & s_axi_wready))begin
                      bvalid <= 1'b1;
                  end
                  else if(bvalid & s_axi_bready)begin
                      bvalid <= 1'b0;
                  end
              end
          end
      
          assign s_axi_awready = s_axi_awvalid & s_axi_wvalid;
          assign s_axi_wready  = s_axi_awvalid & s_axi_wvalid;
      
          assign s_axi_arready = s_axi_arvalid & (r_state == 1'b0);
          assign s_axi_rvalid  = rvalid        ;
          assign s_axi_rdata   = rdata         ;
          assign s_axi_rresp   = 2'b00         ;
      
          assign s_axi_bvalid = bvalid;
          assign s_axi_bresp  = 2'b00 ;
      
      
      endmodule

      // ============================================================================
      // ddr_w_arb.v -- [WARB 2026-09-19] minimal 2-master DDR write arbiter.
      //
      // WHY: the Forencich axi_crossbar's M00 write path leaks its per-master W-channel
      // select across handoffs (bench-proven in sim/wedge: after S01's burst tail the
      // M00 w_select_valid latches forever, S04's beats are never released, and both
      // camera engines wedge after 1-2 bursts). This module replaces the crossbar on
      // the DDR write path for the two camera engines.
      //
      // DESIGN: single-outstanding end-to-end, matching the DDR3 IP user-port contract
      // (no wvalid, unthrottleable wready, one burst processed at a time):
      //   IDLE  : present one master's AW (round-robin tie-break); the accept from the
      //           port glue locks OWNER for the whole burst.
      //   BUSY  : only OWNER's W stream reaches the glue; the fabric-minted B (from
      //           wusero_last) is routed back to OWNER; its accept frees the slot and
      //           flips the round-robin bit.
      // AXI-legal: awvalid/wvalid are held with stable payload until accepted; the
      // non-owner master's awready/wready stay low, so its burst cannot start.
      // ============================================================================
      `timescale 1ns/1ps
      module ddr_w_arb (
          input  wire         clk,
          input  wire         rst,
      
          // ---- master 0 (cam1 DMA) ----
          input  wire [3:0]   m0_awid,
          input  wire [31:0]  m0_awaddr,
          input  wire [7:0]   m0_awlen,
          input  wire [2:0]   m0_awsize,
          input  wire [1:0]   m0_awburst,
          input  wire         m0_awlock,
          input  wire [3:0]   m0_awcache,
          input  wire [2:0]   m0_awprot,
          input  wire         m0_awvalid,
          output wire         m0_awready,
          input  wire [127:0] m0_wdata,
          input  wire [15:0]  m0_wstrb,
          input  wire         m0_wlast,
          input  wire         m0_wvalid,
          output wire         m0_wready,
          output wire [3:0]   m0_bid,

          output wire         m1_bvalid,
          input  wire         m1_bready,
      
          // ---- slave (DDR3 port glue) ----
          output wire [3:0]   s_awid,
          output wire [31:0]  s_awaddr,
          output wire [7:0]   s_awlen,
          output wire [2:0]   s_awsize,
          output wire [1:0]   s_awburst,
          output wire         s_awlock,
          output wire [3:0]   s_awcache,

          output wire [15:0]  s_wstrb,
          output wire         s_wlast,
          output wire         s_wvalid,
          input  wire         s_wready,
          input  wire [3:0]   s_bid,
          input  wire [1:0]   s_bresp,
          input  wire         s_bvalid,
          output wire         s_bready
      );
      
          // Experimental throughput version: retain ownership for eight adjacent
          // DDR bursts before rotating. The user requested restoring this exact
          // experiment after the rollback image was tested.
          localparam [2:0] BURSTS_PER_TURN = 3'd8;

          reg  owner;     // 0 = master0 owns the slot, 1 = master1
          reg  rr;        // round-robin tie-break for the next idle grant
          reg  [2:0] turn_count;
      
          // grant decision: only when idle; alternate when both masters ask
          wire aw_gnt_m1 = ~busy & m1_awvalid & ( rr | ~m0_awvalid);
          wire aw_gnt_m0 = ~busy & m0_awvalid & ~(m1_awvalid & rr);
      
          // AW datapath (granted master's request)
          assign s_awid    = aw_gnt_m1 ? m1_awid    : m0_awid;
          assign s_awaddr  = aw_gnt_m1 ? m1_awaddr  : m0_awaddr;
          assign s_awlen   = aw_gnt_m1 ? m1_awlen   : m0_awlen;
          assign s_awsize  = aw_gnt_m1 ? m1_awsize  : m0_awsize;
          assign s_awburst = aw_gnt_m1 ? m1_awburst : m0_awburst;
          assign s_awlock  = aw_gnt_m1 ? m1_awlock  : m0_awlock;
          assign s_awcache = aw_gnt_m1 ? m1_awcache : m0_awcache;
          assign s_awprot  = aw_gnt_m1 ? m1_awprot  : m0_awprot;
          assign s_awvalid = aw_gnt_m0 | aw_gnt_m1;
      
          assign m0_awready = aw_gnt_m0 & s_awready;
          assign m1_awready = aw_gnt_m1 & s_awready;
      
          // W datapath (only the owner's beats can flow)
          assign s_wdata  = owner ? m1_wdata : m0_wdata;
          assign s_wstrb  = owner ? m1_wstrb : m0_wstrb;
          assign s_wlast  = owner ? m1_wlast : m0_wlast;
          assign s_wvalid = busy & (owner ? m1_wvalid : m0_wvalid);
      
          assign m0_wready = busy & ~owner & s_wready;
          assign m1_wready = busy &  owner & s_wready;
      
          // B path: single outstanding -> the owner gets the fabric-minted response
          assign m0_bvalid = busy & ~owner & s_bvalid;
          assign m1_bvalid = busy &  owner & s_bvalid;
          assign m0_bid    = s_bid;
          assign m1_bid    = s_bid;
          assign m0_bresp  = s_bresp;
          assign m1_bresp  = s_bresp;
          assign s_bready  = busy & (owner ? m1_bready : m0_bready);
      
          always @(posedge clk) begin
              if (rst) begin
                  busy  <= 1'b0;
                  owner <= 1'b0;
                  rr    <= 1'b0;
                  turn_count <= 3'd0;
              end
              else begin
                  if (!busy && (aw_gnt_m0 | aw_gnt_m1) && s_awready) begin

                      owner <= aw_gnt_m1;

                      end
                      else begin

                      end
                  end
                  else if (busy && s_bvalid && s_bready) begin
                      busy  <= 1'b0;
                  end
              end
          end
      
      endmodule

      2: // ddr_w_arb.v -- [WARB 2026-09-19] minimal 2-master DDR write arbiter.
      3: //
      4: // WHY: the Forencich axi_crossbar's M00 write path leaks its per-master W-channel
      5: // select across handoffs (bench-proven in sim/wedge: after S01's burst tail the
      6: // M00 w_select_valid latches forever, S04's beats are never released, and both
      7: // camera engines wedge after 1-2 bursts). This module replaces the crossbar on
      8: // the DDR write path for the two camera engines.
      9: //
      10: // DESIGN: single-outstanding end-to-end, matching the DDR3 IP user-port contract
      11: // (no wvalid, unthrottleable wready, one burst processed at a time):
      12: //   IDLE  : present one master's AW (round-robin tie-break); the accept from the
      13: //           port glue locks OWNER for the whole burst.
      14: //   BUSY  : only OWNER's W stream reaches the glue; the fabric-minted B (from
      15: //           wusero_last) is routed back to OWNER; its accept frees the slot and
      16: //           flips the round-robin bit.

      90:     reg  owner;     // 0 = master0 owns the slot, 1 = master1
      91:     reg  rr;        // round-robin tie-break for the next idle grant
      92:
      93:     // grant decision: only when idle; alternate when both masters ask
      94:     wire aw_gnt_m1 = ~busy & m1_awvalid & ( rr | ~m0_awvalid);
      95:     wire aw_gnt_m0 = ~busy & m0_awvalid & ~(m1_awvalid & rr);
      96:

      99:     assign s_awaddr  = aw_gnt_m1 ? m1_awaddr  : m0_awaddr;
      100:     assign s_awlen   = aw_gnt_m1 ? m1_awlen   : m0_awlen;
      101:     assign s_awsize  = aw_gnt_m1 ? m1_awsize  : m0_awsize;
      102:     assign s_awburst = aw_gnt_m1 ? m1_awburst : m0_awburst;
      103:     assign s_awlock  = aw_gnt_m1 ? m1_awlock  : m0_awlock;
      104:     assign s_awcache = aw_gnt_m1 ? m1_awcache : m0_awcache;
      105:     assign s_awprot  = aw_gnt_m1 ? m1_awprot  : m0_awprot;
      106:     assign s_awvalid = aw_gnt_m0 | aw_gnt_m1;
      107:
      108:     assign m0_awready = aw_gnt_m0 & s_awready;
      109:     assign m1_awready = aw_gnt_m1 & s_awready;
      110:
      111:     // W datapath (only the owner's beats can flow)
      112:     assign s_wdata  = owner ? m1_wdata : m0_wdata;
      113:     assign s_wstrb  = owner ? m1_wstrb : m0_wstrb;
      114:     assign s_wlast  = owner ? m1_wlast : m0_wlast;
      115:     assign s_wvalid = busy & (owner ? m1_wvalid : m0_wvalid);
      116:
      117:     assign m0_wready = busy & ~owner & s_wready;
      118:     assign m1_wready = busy &  owner & s_wready;
      119:
      120:     // B path: single outstanding -> the owner gets the fabric-minted response
      121:     assign m0_bvalid = busy & ~owner & s_bvalid;
      122:     assign m1_bvalid = busy &  owner & s_bvalid;
      123:     assign m0_bid    = s_bid;

      125:     assign m0_bresp  = s_bresp;

      135:         else begin

      182:     always @(posedge axi_clk) begin

      185:         end

      189:             end
      190:             else if(frame_done)begin

      192:             end
      193:             else if(axi_cmd_valid & axi_cmd_ready)begin
      194:                 axi_cmd_valid <= 1'b0;
      195:             end
      196:         end
      197:     end
      198:
      199:
      200:     always @(posedge axi_clk) begin

      202:             cmd_addr <= cam_data_addr_2;
      203:         end
      204:         else begin
      205:             cmd_addr <= cam_data_addr_1;
      206:         end
      207:     end
      208:
      209:     assign axi_cmd_addr = (curr_state == ADDR_TAG) ? tag_addr : cmd_addr;
      210:     // [FRTAG 2026-09-14] tag command = one 16-byte beat at frame_base + frame size
      211:     assign axi_cmd_len  = (curr_state == ADDR_TAG) ? 32'd16
      212:                         : {{AXI_LEN_WIDTH-4-$clog2(CAM_DATA_LEN){1'd0}}, cam_data_len, 4'b0};
      213:
      214:
      215:     // [FRTAG 2026-09-14] frame counter + tag beat generation --------------------
      216:     // frame_base is latched when the FRAME command is accepted (cmd_addr still
      217:     // points at the buffer being written at that moment; w_ping flips later).
      218:     always @(posedge axi_clk) begin
      219:         if(axi_rst)begin
      220:             frame_base <= {AXI_ADDR_WIDTH{1'b0}};
      221:         end
      222:         else if((curr_state == ADDR) && axi_cmd_valid && axi_cmd_ready)begin
      223:             frame_base <= cmd_addr;
      224:         end
      225:     end
      226:
      227:     assign tag_addr = frame_base + (CAM_DATA_LEN << 4);
      228:
      229:     always @(posedge axi_clk) begin
      230:         if(axi_rst)begin
      231:             frame_cnt <= 32'd0;
      232:         end
      233:         else if(frame_done)begin
      234:             frame_cnt <= frame_cnt + 32'd1;
      235:         end
      236:     end
      237:
      238:     assign tag_active  = (curr_state == DATA_TAG);
      239:     assign tag_data    = {{(AXI_DATA_WIDTH-32){1'b0}}, frame_cnt};
      240:     assign tag_fire    = tag_active & tag_ready;
      241:     // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
      242:
      243:
      244:     //XDMA乒锟斤拷锟斤拷锟斤拷
      245:     reg [1 : 0] s_xdma_req;
      246:     always @(posedge axi_clk) begin
      247:         if(axi_rst)begin
      248:             s_xdma_req <= 2'b0;
      249:         end
      250:         else begin
      251:             if(frame_done)begin
      252:                 if(w_ping)begin
      253:                     s_xdma_req[1] <= 1'b1;
      254:                 end
      255:                 else begin
      256:                     s_xdma_req[0] <= 1'b1;
      257:                 end
      258:             end
      259:             else begin
      260:                 if(xdma_ack[0]) begin
      261:                     s_xdma_req[0] <= 1'b0;
      262:                 end
      263:                 if(xdma_ack[1]) begin
      264:                     s_xdma_req[1] <= 1'b0;
      265:                 end
      266:             end
      267:         end
      268:     end
      269:
      270:     assign xdma_req = s_xdma_req;
      271:     assign dbg_state = {29'd0, curr_state};
      272:     assign engine_busy = (curr_state != IDLE);

      274:     // [FIX 2026-09-18] frame-write watchdog: a frame that does not complete
      275:     // (lost/short camera stream) used to wedge this FSM in DATA forever. Bail
      276:     // back to IDLE after ~0.16 s and retry on the next vsync.
      277:     reg [31:0] wd_cnt;
      278:     // [WDFIX 2026-09-19] reset the budget on every state CHANGE, not only in
      279:     // IDLE: a frame that burns the budget in DATA (slow DMA close with the B
      280:     // path dead) used to make the immediately following ADDR_TAG/DATA_TAG
      281:     // expire instantly, silently skipping the frame-tag write.
      282:     reg [2:0] wd_prev_state;

      285:         else        wd_prev_state <= curr_state;

      290:     end
      291:     assign wd_expire = (wd_cnt >= 32'd20_000_000);
      292:     assign dbg_wd_cnt = wd_cnt;
      293:
      294:     reg [31:0] last_cnt;
      295:     always @(posedge axi_clk) begin
      296:         if(axi_rst) last_cnt <= 32'd0;
      297:         else if(frame_done) last_cnt <= last_cnt + 32'd1;
      298:     end
      299:     assign dbg_last_cnt = last_cnt;

      36:         if ($text -match 'The Progress:.*100%.*The done bit is 1' -or

      1: #!/usr/bin/env python3
      2: """serial_xfer.py v2: 涓插彛閫愬潡纭浼犺緭 (鍙潬) + md5 鏍￠獙
      3: 鐢ㄦ硶: python serial_xfer.py <鏈湴鏂囦欢> <鏉夸笂璺緞>
      4: """
      5: import serial, sys, time, base64, hashlib, math
      6:
      7: PORT = 'COM9'
      8: BAUD = 1500000
      9: CHUNK = 1400
      10: NL = b'\n'
      11:
      12: def open_port():
      13:     s = serial.Serial(PORT, BAUD, timeout=0.05)
      14:     s.reset_input_buffer()
      15:     s.write(NL); time.sleep(0.3); s.reset_input_buffer()
      16:     return s
      17:
      18: def run(s, cmd, timeout=30):
      19:     s.reset_input_buffer()
      20:     s.write(cmd.encode() + NL); s.flush()
      21:     t0 = time.time(); buf = b''
      22:     while time.time() - t0 < timeout:
      23:         c = s.read(8192)
      24:         if c:
      25:             buf += c
      26:             if b'__RDY__' in buf.split(cmd.encode())[-1]:
      27:                 break
      28:     s.reset_input_buffer()
      29:     text = buf.decode('utf-8', errors='replace')
      30:     return '\n'.join(l for l in text.splitlines() if '__RDY__' not in l)
      31:
      32: def send_chunk(s, chunk, path, seq):
      33:     line = "printf '%s' '" + chunk + "' >> " + path + ".b64; echo ACK" + str(seq) + "$?"
      34:     for attempt in range(4):
      35:         s.reset_input_buffer()
      36:         s.write(line.encode() + NL); s.flush()
      37:         t0 = time.time(); buf = b''
      38:         want = ('ACK' + str(seq)).encode()
      39:         while time.time() - t0 < 5:
      40:             c = s.read(4096)
      41:             if c:
      42:                 buf += c
      43:                 if want in buf:
      44:                     return True
      45:         s.write(("truncate -s -" + str(len(chunk)) + " " + path + ".b64 2>/dev/null" + chr(10)).encode())
      46:     return False
      47:
      48: def main(src, dst):
      49:     data = open(src, 'rb').read()
      50:     md5 = hashlib.md5(data).hexdigest()
      51:     b64 = base64.b64encode(data).decode()
      52:     nch = math.ceil(len(b64) / CHUNK)
      53:     print(f"transfer {len(data)} B -> {dst} ({nch} chunks)")
      54:     s = open_port()
      55:     print(run(s, "mkdir -p $(dirname " + dst + "); rm -f " + dst + ".b64 " + dst + "; stty -echo; echo READY"))
      56:     t0 = time.time()
      57:     for i in range(nch):
      58:         chunk = b64[i*CHUNK:(i+1)*CHUNK]
      59:         if not send_chunk(s, chunk, dst, i):
      60:             print(f"CHUNK {i} FAILED"); s.close(); return 1
      61:         if i % 40 == 0:
      62:             print(f"  {i}/{nch} {time.time()-t0:.0f}s")
      63:     dt = time.time() - t0
      64:     out = run(s, "base64 -d " + dst + ".b64 > " + dst + " && md5sum " + dst, timeout=120)
      65:     run(s, "rm -f " + dst + ".b64")
      66:     print(f"transfer {dt:.0f}s")
      67:     if md5 in out:
      68:         print(f"VERIFY OK {dst} md5={md5}")
      69:         s.close(); return 0
      70:     print(f"VERIFY FAILED expect={md5}")
      71:     print(out[-300:])
      72:     s.close(); return 1
      73:

      ### flash_safe.ps1 True 2928
      $ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
      
      $pds = Get-Process -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { $_.ProcessName -match '^pds' }
      if ($pds) {
          throw 'PDS GUI is running. Close PDS before starting the standalone JTAG programmer.'
      }
      
      Get-Process cdt_cfg,cdt_js -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue |
          Stop-Process -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
      
      $bin = 'C:\pango\PDS_2022.2-SP6.4\bin'
      $port = 65465
      $server = $null
      $cfg = $null
      $outFile = Join-Path $env:TEMP 'pango_cdt_cfg.out.log'
      $errFile = Join-Path $env:TEMP 'pango_cdt_cfg.err.log'
      Remove-Item -LiteralPath $outFile, $errFile -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
      try {
          $server = Start-Process -FilePath "$bin\cdt_js.exe" `
              -ArgumentList '-port', $port -PassThru -WindowStyle Hidden
          Start-Sleep -Seconds 4
      
          # Keep the configuration window alive while the cable programs the FPGA.
          # Close it only after the tool has reported the completed program command.
          $cfg = Start-Process -FilePath "$bin\cdt_cfg.exe" `
              -ArgumentList '-ip','127.0.0.1','-port',$port,'-file','C:\Users\NineSun\Desktop\ov56401\project\flash_jtag.tcl' `
              -RedirectStandardOutput $outFile -RedirectStandardError $errFile -PassThru
      
          $deadline = (Get-Date).AddMinutes(5)
          $programDone = $false
          while ((Get-Date) -lt $deadline) {
              Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 250
              $text = if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $outFile) {
                  Get-Content -LiteralPath $outFile -Raw -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
              } else { '' }
              if ($text -match 'The Progress:.*100%.*The done bit is 1' -or
                  $text -match 'The done bit is 1' -and
                  $text -match 'COMMAND\[Program\] execute successfully|cfg_program .*successfully') {
                  $programDone = $true
                  break
              }
              if ($cfg.HasExited) { break }
          }
      
          if (-not $programDone) {
              $detail = if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $outFile) { Get-Content -LiteralPath $outFile -Raw } else { '' }
              throw "cdt_cfg did not complete programming. $detail"
          }
      
          Write-Host '100% / done bit / Program successfully detected.'
          Write-Host 'Waiting 10 seconds for the programmer window and cable state to settle.'
          Start-Sleep -Seconds 10
          Write-Host 'Closing the CDT programming window now.'
          Stop-Process -Id $cfg.Id -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
          Wait-Process -Id $cfg.Id -Timeout 3 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
          Start-Sleep -Seconds 3
          Write-Host 'Programming window closed; burn completed successfully.'
      }
      finally {
          if ($cfg -and -not $cfg.HasExited) {
              Stop-Process -Id $cfg.Id -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
          }
          Get-Process cdt_cfg,cdt_js -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue |
              Stop-Process -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
          if ($server) {
              Wait-Process -Id $server.Id -Timeout 3 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
          }
      }
      
      Write-Host 'JTAG programming flow finished; cdt_js was stopped.'

      module axi_dma_write
      	#(
      		parameter 		BURST_LEN 	= 8		,
      		parameter       ID_WIDTH  	= 4		,
      		parameter       DATA_WIDTH 	= 128	,
      		parameter       KEEP_WIDTH  = DATA_WIDTH / 8
      	)
      	(
      	input 				clk 			,    // Clock
      	input 				rst 			,    // Synchronous reset active high
      
      	//cmd interface
      	input       	 					cmd_valid		,
      	input 			[31:0] 				cmd_addr		,
      	input 			[31:0] 				cmd_len			,
      	input			[ID_WIDTH - 1:0]    cmd_id          ,

      	//trans data in

      	input			[KEEP_WIDTH - 1:0]	data_in_keep	,
      	input         						data_in_valid	,
      	output reg                          data_in_last    ,
      	output        						data_in_ready	,
      
      	//axi w
      	output reg		[ID_WIDTH - 1:0]   			m_axi_awid   	,
      	output reg		[31:0]  					m_axi_awaddr 	,
      	output reg		[7:0]   					m_axi_awlen  	,
      	output 			[2:0]   					m_axi_awsize 	,
      	output 			[1:0]   					m_axi_awburst	,
      	output 		    	    					m_axi_awlock 	,
      	output 			[3:0]   					m_axi_awcache	,
      	output 			[2:0]   					m_axi_awprot	,
      	output reg		        					m_axi_awvalid	,
      	input  		 	        					m_axi_awready	,
      	output 			[DATA_WIDTH - 1:0] 			m_axi_wdata		,
      	output 			[KEEP_WIDTH - 1:0]  		m_axi_wstrb		,
      	output 			        					m_axi_wlast		,
      	output 			        					m_axi_wvalid	,
      	input  			        					m_axi_wready	,
      	input  			[ID_WIDTH - 1:0]   			m_axi_bid  		,
      	input  			[1:0]   					m_axi_bresp 	,
      	input  			        					m_axi_bvalid	,
      	output 			        					m_axi_bready
      
      );
      
      
      localparam AXI_BURST_SIZE = $clog2(KEEP_WIDTH); //log2(DATA_WIDTH / 8)
      
      // [WD 2026-09-18] transmit watchdog state
      reg        abort_r;
      reg [23:0] wd_cnt;
      wire       w_progress;
      wire       abort_done;
      
      wire [DATA_WIDTH - 1:0] 		t_m_axi_wdata;
      wire [KEEP_WIDTH - 1:0]  		t_m_axi_wstrb;
      wire         					t_m_axi_wlast;
      wire         					t_m_axi_wvalid;
      wire         					t_m_axi_wready;
      
      //common para
      assign m_axi_awsize 	= 		AXI_BURST_SIZE	;
      assign m_axi_awburst 	= 		2'b01			;
      assign m_axi_awlock 	= 		1'b0			;
      assign m_axi_awcache 	= 		4'b0011			;
      assign m_axi_awprot 	= 		3'b000			;
      
      
      wire [7:0] burst_len    ;
      wire [7:0] max_burst_len;
      
      //cmd
      reg [31:0] addr;
      reg [31:0] len;
      reg        trans;
      
      always @(posedge clk) begin
      	if((cmd_ready == 1'b1) && (cmd_valid == 1'b1))begin
      		addr <= cmd_addr;
      	end
      	else begin
      		if((m_axi_awvalid == 1'b1) && (m_axi_awready == 1'b1))begin
      			addr <= addr + ((m_axi_awlen + 1'b1) << AXI_BURST_SIZE);
      		end
      	end
      end
      
      always @(posedge clk) begin
      	if((cmd_ready == 1'b1) && (cmd_valid == 1'b1))begin
      		len <= cmd_len[31:AXI_BURST_SIZE] + (|cmd_len[AXI_BURST_SIZE - 1:0]);
      	end
      	else begin
      		if((m_axi_awvalid == 1'b1) && (m_axi_awready == 1'b1))begin
      			len <= len - (m_axi_awlen + 1'b1);
      		end
      		else if(abort_done == 1'b1)begin
      			len <= 32'd0;       // [WD]
      		end
      	end
      end

      	if(rst == 1'b1)begin
      		trans <= 1'b0;
      	end
      	else begin
      		if((cmd_ready == 1'b1) && (cmd_valid == 1'b1))begin
      			trans <= 1'b1;
      		end
      		else begin
      			if((m_axi_bready == 1'b1) && (m_axi_bvalid == 1'b1) && (len == 32'd0))begin
      				trans <= 1'b0;
      			end
      			else if(abort_done == 1'b1)begin

      			end
      		end
      	end
      end
      
      always @(posedge  clk)begin
      	if(rst == 1'b1)begin
      		cmd_ready <= 1'b0;
      	end
      	else begin
      		if(trans == 1'b0)begin
      			if((cmd_ready == 1'b1) && (cmd_valid == 1'b1))begin
      				cmd_ready <= 1'b0;
      			end
      			else begin
      				cmd_ready <= 1'b1;
      			end
      		end
      		else begin
      			cmd_ready <= 1'b0;
      		end
      	end
      end
      
      //aw
      
      reg burst_trans;
      assign burst_len     = len > BURST_LEN ? BURST_LEN : len;
      assign max_burst_len = (((addr & 12'hfff) + (burst_len << AXI_BURST_SIZE )) >> 12)  != 0 ? (13'h1000 - (addr & 12'hfff)) >> AXI_BURST_SIZE : burst_len;
      always@(posedge clk)begin
      	if(rst == 1'b1)begin
      		burst_trans <= 1'b0;
      	end
      	else begin
      		if((m_axi_awvalid == 1'b1) && (m_axi_awready == 1'b1))begin
      			burst_trans <= 1'b1;
      		end
      		else begin
      			// if((m_axi_wvalid == 1'b1) && (m_axi_wready == 1'b1) && (m_axi_wlast == 1'b1))begin
      			if((m_axi_bvalid == 1'b1) && (m_axi_bready == 1'b1))begin
      				burst_trans <= 1'b0;
      			end
      			else if(abort_done == 1'b1)begin
      				burst_trans <= 1'b0;   // [WD2] force-release; B may never arrive
      			end
      		end
      	end
      end
      always @(posedge clk)begin
      	if(rst == 1'b1)begin
      		m_axi_awvalid <= 1'b0;
      	end
      	else begin
      		if((m_axi_awvalid == 1'b1) && (m_axi_awready == 1'b1))begin
      			m_axi_awvalid <= 1'b0;
      		end
      		else begin
      			if((burst_trans == 1'b0) && (len != 32'd0) && (abort_r == 1'b0))begin
      				m_axi_awvalid <= 1'b1;
      			end
      		end
      	end
      end
      
      always @(posedge clk)begin
      	m_axi_awlen <= max_burst_len - 8'd1;
      end
      always @(posedge clk)begin
      	m_axi_awaddr <= addr;
      end
      always @(posedge clk) begin
      	if((cmd_ready == 1'b1) && (cmd_valid == 1'b1))begin
      		m_axi_awid <= cmd_id;
      	end
      end
      //w
      reg [7:0] act_burst_len;
      always@ (posedge clk)begin
      	if(rst == 1'b1)begin
      		act_burst_len <= 8'd0;
      	end
      	else begin
      		if((m_axi_awvalid == 1'b1) && (m_axi_awready == 1'b1))begin
      			act_burst_len <= m_axi_awlen + 8'd1;
      		end
      		else begin
      			if((t_m_axi_wvalid == 1'b1) && (t_m_axi_wready == 1'b1))begin
      				act_burst_len <= act_burst_len - 8'd1;
      			end
      		end
      	end
      end
      
      // [WD 2026-09-18] ------------------------------------------------------------------
      // The DVP stream can deliver fewer 128-bit beats than CAM_DATA_LEN (CDC FIFO
      // overflow drops pixels and cannot back-pressure the sensor). A frame's AXI
      // burst then never completes: trans sticks at 1, cmd_ready stays low and the
      // frame FSM deadlocks forever (measured: state=ADDR, axi_cnt=0, 0 frames).
      //
      // Recovery: if there is no W-beat progress for ~0.17 s while a write is in
      // flight, close the open burst with dummy beats. AXI forbids cancelling an
      // accepted AW, so we must still supply awlen beats; we just no longer consume
      // real camera data. After the B response is absorbed, trans/len clear and the
      // next frame's command is accepted again (only the bad frame is lost).
      assign w_progress = (t_m_axi_wvalid == 1'b1) && (t_m_axi_wready == 1'b1);
      
      always @(posedge clk) begin
      	if((rst == 1'b1) || (trans == 1'b0) || (abort_r == 1'b1) || (w_progress == 1'b1))
      		wd_cnt <= 24'd0;
      	else if(wd_cnt != 24'hFFFFFF)
      		wd_cnt <= wd_cnt + 24'd1;
      end
      
      // [BFAST 2026-09-19] the DDR write port can stop returning B responses
      // (see [WD2]; re-observed 09-19: b_cnt ~26 total while aw_cnt ~60k).
      // Waiting the full 0.17 s watchdog once every command's beats are out
      // capped the camera path at ~5 fps. Give B a few microseconds after the
      // last beat, then force the close via the abort path; a late B is still
      // absorbed by the w_done/bready logic.
      reg [9:0] bwait_cnt;
      // (w_done intentionally not referenced: it is declared further below and
      // act_burst_len==0 && burst_trans already means every beat is out, B pending)
      wire all_beats_out = (len == 32'd0) && (act_burst_len == 8'd0) && burst_trans;
      always @(posedge clk) begin
      	if((rst == 1'b1) || (trans == 1'b0) || (all_beats_out == 1'b0) || (abort_r == 1'b1))
      		bwait_cnt <= 10'd0;
      	else if(bwait_cnt != 10'h3FF)
      		bwait_cnt <= bwait_cnt + 10'd1;
      end
      always @(posedge clk) begin
      	if(rst == 1'b1)
      		abort_r <= 1'b0;
      	// [BFAST2 2026-09-19] bwait fast-close DISABLED: B latency under DDR contention
      	// can legitimately exceed the 10us grace; force-closing mid-flight corrupted
      	// the crossbar/DDR transaction stream and killed M00 writes within seconds.
      	// Fall back to the long send-watchdog only.
      	else if((abort_r == 1'b0) && (trans == 1'b1) && (wd_cnt == 24'hFFFFFF))
      		abort_r <= 1'b1;
      	else if(abort_done == 1'b1)
      		abort_r <= 1'b0;
      end
      
      // [WD2 2026-09-18] burst_trans is only cleared by the B response, which is
      // exactly what never arrives in the wedge case (cam2: bvalid never asserted).
      // Requiring burst_trans==0 made abort_done unreachable -> no recovery.
      // All W beats for the open burst are out once act_burst_len hits 0, so that
      // is the correct release point; burst_trans is force-cleared below.
      assign abort_done = abort_r && (act_burst_len == 8'd0);
      // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------
      
      stream_pipe #(
        .DATA_WIDTH 	(DATA_WIDTH+1+KEEP_WIDTH)
      ) stream_pipe_3(
        .dataIn_valid     (t_m_axi_wvalid),
        .dataIn_ready     (t_m_axi_wready),
        .dataIn_payload   ({t_m_axi_wdata, t_m_axi_wstrb, t_m_axi_wlast}),
        .dataOut_valid    (m_axi_wvalid),
        .dataOut_ready    (m_axi_wready),
        .dataOut_payload  ({m_axi_wdata, m_axi_wstrb, m_axi_wlast}),
        .clk              (clk),
        .reset            (rst)
      );
      
      assign data_in_ready = abort_r ? 1'b0
                                     : (t_m_axi_wready && act_burst_len > 8'd0);
      assign t_m_axi_wvalid  = abort_r ? (act_burst_len > 8'd0)
                                       : (data_in_valid && act_burst_len > 8'd0);
      assign t_m_axi_wdata   = abort_r ? {DATA_WIDTH{1'b0}} : data_in;
      assign t_m_axi_wlast   = (act_burst_len == 8'd1);
      assign t_m_axi_wstrb   = abort_r ? {KEEP_WIDTH{1'b1}} : data_in_keep;
      
      //b
      reg w_done;
      always @(posedge clk) begin
      	if(rst == 1'b1) begin
      		w_done <= 1'b0;
      	end
      	else begin
      		if((t_m_axi_wvalid == 1'b1) && (t_m_axi_wready == 1'b1) && (t_m_axi_wlast == 1'b1)) begin
      			w_done <= 1'b1;
      		end
      		else begin
      			if((m_axi_bvalid == 1'b1) && (m_axi_bready == 1'b1)) begin
      				w_done <= 1'b0;
      			end
      		end
      	end
      end
      assign m_axi_bready = w_done;
      
      // [LEDGER 2026-09-19] single-ledger completion: pulse exactly once per
      // command on the trans 1->0 fall. Covers the normal close (B absorbed,
      // len==0) AND both watchdog abort paths; the old B-gated expression never
      // pulsed when a B response was lost, wedging the frame FSM in DATA forever.
      reg trans_q;
      always @(posedge clk) begin
      	if(rst == 1'b1) trans_q <= 1'b0;
      	else            trans_q <= trans;
      end
      
      always @(posedge clk ) begin
      	if(rst == 1'b1)begin
      		data_in_last <= 1'b0;
      	end
      	else begin
      		data_in_last <= trans_q && (trans == 1'b0);
      	end
      end
      
      endmodule
      
      ### source/axi_crossbar/ddr_w_arb.v True 6371
      // ============================================================================
      // ddr_w_arb.v -- [WARB 2026-09-19] minimal 2-master DDR write arbiter.
      //
      // WHY: the Forencich axi_crossbar's M00 write path leaks its per-master W-channel
      // select across handoffs (bench-proven in sim/wedge: after S01's burst tail the
      // M00 w_select_valid latches forever, S04's beats are never released, and both
      // camera engines wedge after 1-2 bursts). This module replaces the crossbar on
      // the DDR write path for the two camera engines.
      //
      // DESIGN: single-outstanding end-to-end, matching the DDR3 IP user-port contract
      // (no wvalid, unthrottleable wready, one burst processed at a time):
      //   IDLE  : present one master's AW (round-robin tie-break); the accept from the
      //           port glue locks OWNER for the whole burst.
      //   BUSY  : only OWNER's W stream reaches the glue; the fabric-minted B (from
      //           wusero_last) is routed back to OWNER; its accept frees the slot and
      //           flips the round-robin bit.
      // AXI-legal: awvalid/wvalid are held with stable payload until accepted; the
      // non-owner master's awready/wready stay low, so its burst cannot start.
      // ============================================================================
      `timescale 1ns/1ps
      module ddr_w_arb (
          input  wire         clk,
          input  wire         rst,
      
          // ---- master 0 (cam1 DMA) ----
          input  wire [3:0]   m0_awid,
          input  wire [31:0]  m0_awaddr,
          input  wire [7:0]   m0_awlen,
          input  wire [2:0]   m0_awsize,
          input  wire [1:0]   m0_awburst,
          input  wire         m0_awlock,
          input  wire [3:0]   m0_awcache,
          input  wire [2:0]   m0_awprot,
          input  wire         m0_awvalid,
          output wire         m0_awready,
          input  wire [127:0] m0_wdata,
          input  wire [15:0]  m0_wstrb,
          input  wire         m0_wlast,
          input  wire         m0_wvalid,
          output wire         m0_wready,
          output wire [3:0]   m0_bid,
          output wire [1:0]   m0_bresp,
          output wire         m0_bvalid,
          input  wire         m0_bready,
      
          // ---- master 1 (cam2 DMA) ----
          input  wire [3:0]   m1_awid,
          input  wire [31:0]  m1_awaddr,
          input  wire [7:0]   m1_awlen,
          input  wire [2:0]   m1_awsize,
          input  wire [1:0]   m1_awburst,
          input  wire         m1_awlock,
          input  wire [3:0]   m1_awcache,
          input  wire [2:0]   m1_awprot,
          input  wire         m1_awvalid,
          output wire         m1_awready,
          input  wire [127:0] m1_wdata,
          input  wire [15:0]  m1_wstrb,
          input  wire         m1_wlast,
          input  wire         m1_wvalid,
          output wire         m1_wready,
          output wire [3:0]   m1_bid,
          output wire [1:0]   m1_bresp,
          output wire         m1_bvalid,
          input  wire         m1_bready,
      
          // ---- slave (DDR3 port glue) ----
          output wire [3:0]   s_awid,
          output wire [31:0]  s_awaddr,
          output wire [7:0]   s_awlen,
          output wire [2:0]   s_awsize,
          output wire [1:0]   s_awburst,
          output wire         s_awlock,
          output wire [3:0]   s_awcache,
          output wire [2:0]   s_awprot,
          output wire         s_awvalid,
          input  wire         s_awready,
          output wire [127:0] s_wdata,
          output wire [15:0]  s_wstrb,
          output wire         s_wlast,
          output wire         s_wvalid,
          input  wire         s_wready,
          input  wire [3:0]   s_bid,
          input  wire [1:0]   s_bresp,
          input  wire         s_bvalid,
          output wire         s_bready
      );
      
          // Experimental throughput version: retain ownership for eight adjacent
          // DDR bursts before rotating. The user requested restoring this exact
          // experiment after the rollback image was tested.
          localparam [2:0] BURSTS_PER_TURN = 3'd8;
      
          reg  busy;      // an AW is locked in (waiting for its B)
          reg  owner;     // 0 = master0 owns the slot, 1 = master1
          reg  rr;        // round-robin tie-break for the next idle grant
          reg  [2:0] turn_count;
      
          // grant decision: only when idle; alternate when both masters ask
          wire aw_gnt_m1 = ~busy & m1_awvalid & ( rr | ~m0_awvalid);
          wire aw_gnt_m0 = ~busy & m0_awvalid & ~(m1_awvalid & rr);
      
          // AW datapath (granted master's request)
          assign s_awid    = aw_gnt_m1 ? m1_awid    : m0_awid;
          assign s_awaddr  = aw_gnt_m1 ? m1_awaddr  : m0_awaddr;
          assign s_awlen   = aw_gnt_m1 ? m1_awlen   : m0_awlen;
          assign s_awsize  = aw_gnt_m1 ? m1_awsize  : m0_awsize;
          assign s_awburst = aw_gnt_m1 ? m1_awburst : m0_awburst;
          assign s_awlock  = aw_gnt_m1 ? m1_awlock  : m0_awlock;
          assign s_awcache = aw_gnt_m1 ? m1_awcache : m0_awcache;
          assign s_awprot  = aw_gnt_m1 ? m1_awprot  : m0_awprot;
          assign s_awvalid = aw_gnt_m0 | aw_gnt_m1;
      
          assign m0_awready = aw_gnt_m0 & s_awready;
          assign m1_awready = aw_gnt_m1 & s_awready;
      
          // W datapath (only the owner's beats can flow)
          assign s_wdata  = owner ? m1_wdata : m0_wdata;
          assign s_wstrb  = owner ? m1_wstrb : m0_wstrb;
          assign s_wlast  = owner ? m1_wlast : m0_wlast;
          assign s_wvalid = busy & (owner ? m1_wvalid : m0_wvalid);
      
          assign m0_wready = busy & ~owner & s_wready;
          assign m1_wready = busy &  owner & s_wready;
      
          // B path: single outstanding -> the owner gets the fabric-minted response
          assign m0_bvalid = busy & ~owner & s_bvalid;
          assign m1_bvalid = busy &  owner & s_bvalid;
          assign m0_bid    = s_bid;
          assign m1_bid    = s_bid;
          assign m0_bresp  = s_bresp;
          assign m1_bresp  = s_bresp;
          assign s_bready  = busy & (owner ? m1_bready : m0_bready);
      
          always @(posedge clk) begin
              if (rst) begin
                  busy  <= 1'b0;
                  owner <= 1'b0;
                  rr    <= 1'b0;
                  turn_count <= 3'd0;
              end
              else begin
                  if (!busy && (aw_gnt_m0 | aw_gnt_m1) && s_awready) begin
                      busy  <= 1'b1;
                      owner <= aw_gnt_m1;
                      if (turn_count == BURSTS_PER_TURN - 1'b1) begin
                          turn_count <= 3'd0;
                          rr <= aw_gnt_m0;         // rotate after the eight-burst quantum
                      end
                      else begin
                          turn_count <= turn_count + 1'b1;
                          rr <= rr;                // keep the same owner during the quantum
                      end
                  end
                  else if (busy && s_bvalid && s_bready) begin
                      busy  <= 1'b0;
                  end
              end
          end
      
      endmodule
      
      
      ### source/ov5640/ov5640_ddr/ov5640_ddr_w_en.v True 2493
      module ov5640_ddr_w_en #(
          parameter DATA_WIDTH = 24
      )(
          input          axi_clk      ,
          input          axi_rst      ,
      
          input          axi_cam_en   ,
          input  [1:0]   frame_pending,
          input          engine_busy,   // [IDLEGATE 2026-09-19] write engine FSM busy
      
          input  [DATA_WIDTH-1 : 0]  s_data       ,
          input                      s_data_valid ,
          input                      s_hsync      ,
          input                      s_vsync      ,
      
          output [DATA_WIDTH-1 : 0]  m_data       ,
          output                     m_data_valid ,
          output                     m_hsync      ,
          output                     m_vsync
      );
      
      localparam IDLE = 2'b01;
      localparam DATA = 2'b10;
      
      reg [1:0] curr_state;
      reg [1:0] next_state;
      
      reg [1:0] s_vsync_ff;
      reg       s_vsync_rise;
      
      always @(posedge axi_clk) begin
          if(axi_rst)begin
              curr_state <= IDLE;
          end
          else begin
              curr_state <= next_state;
          end
      end
      
      always @(*) begin
          case (curr_state)
              IDLE: begin
                      if(s_vsync_rise & axi_cam_en && !engine_busy) begin  // [IDLEGATE 2026-09-19] admit a frame only when the engine finished the previous one
                      next_state = DATA;
                  end
                  else begin
                      next_state = IDLE;
                  end
              end
              DATA: begin
                  if(s_vsync_rise) begin
                          if(axi_cam_en && !engine_busy) begin  // [IDLEGATE] engine wedged mid-frame: drop the rest at this vsync
                          next_state = DATA;
                      end
                      else begin
                          next_state = IDLE;
                      end
                  end
                  else begin
                      next_state = DATA;
                  end
              end
              default: begin
                  next_state = IDLE;
              end
          endcase
      end
      
      always @(posedge axi_clk) begin
          if(axi_rst)begin
              s_vsync_ff <= 2'b0;
          end
          else begin
              s_vsync_ff <= {s_vsync_ff[0], s_vsync};
          end
      end
      
      always @(posedge axi_clk) begin
          if(axi_rst)begin
              s_vsync_rise <= 1'b0;
          end
          else begin
              s_vsync_rise <= s_vsync_ff[0] & (~s_vsync_ff[1]);
          end
      end
      
      assign m_data       = s_data;
      assign m_data_valid = s_data_valid & (curr_state == DATA);
      
      // A completed frame owns its DDR buffer until the host acknowledges it.
      // Drop whole sensor frames at VSYNC boundaries while one frame is pending.
          assign m_vsync = s_vsync_rise & axi_cam_en && !engine_busy;  // [IDLEGATE 2026-09-19]
      
      endmodule
      
      
      ### source/ov5640/ov5640_ddr/ov5640_ddr_w_ctrl.v True 10132
      //����CMD����
      module ov5640_ddr_w_ctrl #(
          parameter AXI_ADDR_WIDTH = 32,
          parameter AXI_LEN_WIDTH  = 32,
          parameter AXI_DATA_WIDTH = 128,
          parameter CAM_DATA_LEN   = 172800 //1280*720*3/16
      )(
          input          axi_clk        ,
          input          axi_rst        ,
      
          input  [AXI_ADDR_WIDTH-1 : 0]      cam_data_addr_1,
          input  [AXI_ADDR_WIDTH-1 : 0]      cam_data_addr_2,
          input  [$clog2(CAM_DATA_LEN) : 0]  cam_data_len   , //��16�ֽ�Ϊ��λ
      
          input          s_vsync        ,
      
          input          dma_done       ,  // [LEDGER 2026-09-19] DMA transaction-done pulse (authoritative beat ledger)
      
          output [AXI_ADDR_WIDTH-1 : 0]  axi_cmd_addr   /*synthesis PAP_MARK_DEBUG="1"*/,
          output [AXI_LEN_WIDTH-1 : 0]   axi_cmd_len    /*synthesis PAP_MARK_DEBUG="1"*/,
          output reg                     axi_cmd_valid  /*synthesis PAP_MARK_DEBUG="1"*/,
          input                          axi_cmd_ready  /*synthesis PAP_MARK_DEBUG="1"*/,
      
          output [1 : 0]   xdma_req       ,
          input  [1 : 0]   xdma_ack       ,
      
          // [FRTAG 2026-09-14] frame-tag injection. After each frame's last stream beat the
          // FSM issues a SECOND 16-byte AXI command writing a 32-bit frame counter to
          // frame_base + CAM_DATA_LEN*16. The wrapper (ov5640_ddr.v) muxes tag_data onto
          // the data stream while tag_active is high. The transaction must complete:
          // aborting it would leave a pending frame with no new tag for the host.
          output                           tag_active     ,
          output [AXI_DATA_WIDTH-1 : 0]    tag_data       ,
          input                            tag_ready,
          output [31:0]                    dbg_state,
          output                           engine_busy,     // [IDLEGATE 2026-09-19] FSM not IDLE (frame or tag in flight)
          output [31:0]                    dbg_last_cnt,
          output [31:0]                    dbg_wd_cnt
      );
      
          localparam IDLE      = 3'b001;
          localparam ADDR      = 3'b010;
          localparam DATA      = 3'b100;
          // [FRTAG 2026-09-14] tag states: second (16B) command after the frame completes
          localparam ADDR_TAG  = 3'b011;
          localparam DATA_TAG  = 3'b101;
      
          reg [2 : 0] curr_state/*synthesis PAP_MARK_DEBUG="1"*/;
          // [LEDGER 2026-09-19] both the frame command and the 16B tag command pulse
          // dma_done; only the frame command's completion may advance frame state.
          wire frame_done = dma_done && (curr_state == DATA);
          reg [2 : 0] next_state;
          wire wd_expire;
      
          // [FRTAG 2026-09-14] frame-tag declarations (forward, before first use)
          reg                          vsync_pending;
          reg  [AXI_ADDR_WIDTH-1 : 0]  frame_base;
          reg  [31 : 0]                frame_cnt;
          wire [AXI_ADDR_WIDTH-1 : 0]  tag_addr;
          wire                         tag_fire;
      
          reg [1 : 0] axi_vsync_ff/*synthesis PAP_MARK_DEBUG="1"*/;
          reg axi_vsync_rise/*synthesis PAP_MARK_DEBUG="1"*/;
      
      
          reg [AXI_ADDR_WIDTH-1 : 0] cmd_addr;
      
      
          //״̬��
          always @(posedge axi_clk) begin
              if(axi_rst)begin
                  curr_state <= IDLE;
              end
              else begin
                  curr_state <= next_state;
              end
          end
      
          always @(*) begin
              case (curr_state)
                  IDLE: begin
                      if(vsync_pending)begin
                          next_state = ADDR;
                      end
                      else begin
                          next_state = IDLE;
                      end
                  end
                  ADDR: begin
                      if(axi_cmd_ready & axi_cmd_valid)begin
                          next_state = DATA;
                      end
                      else if(wd_expire)begin
                          next_state = IDLE;      // [WD2] cmd_ready stuck -> retry
                      end
                      else begin
                          next_state = ADDR;
                      end
                  end
                  DATA: begin
                      if(frame_done)begin
                          next_state = ADDR_TAG;              // [FRTAG] frame complete, go write the tag
                      end
                      else if(wd_expire)begin
                          next_state = IDLE;                  // [FIX] retry next vsync
                      end
                      else begin
                          next_state = DATA;
                      end
                  end
                  ADDR_TAG: begin
                      if(axi_cmd_ready & axi_cmd_valid)begin
                          next_state = DATA_TAG;
                      end
                      else if(wd_expire)begin
                          next_state = IDLE;                  // [FIX]
                      end
                      else begin
                          next_state = ADDR_TAG;
                      end
                  end
                  DATA_TAG: begin
                      if(tag_fire || wd_expire)begin
                          next_state = IDLE;

      #!/usr/bin/env python3
      """Read-only RK3568 dual-camera tag and DMA timing probe.
      
      The caller should stop camview before running this tool because the driver
      currently permits only one DMA mapping context. No FPGA registers are written.
      """
      import ctypes
      import fcntl
      import mmap
      import os
      import signal
      import struct
      import sys
      import time
      
      
      class Timeout(Exception):
          pass
      
      
      def alarm_handler(_signum, _frame):
          raise Timeout()
      
      
      class DmaOp(ctypes.Structure):
          _fields_ = [
              ("current_len", ctypes.c_uint32),
              ("offset_addr", ctypes.c_uint32),
              ("cmd", ctypes.c_uint32),
              ("ddr3_addr", ctypes.c_uint32),
              ("total_length", ctypes.c_uint32),
              ("read_buf", ctypes.c_void_p),
              ("write_buf", ctypes.c_void_p),
          ]
      
      
      def ioctl_code(number):
          return 0xC0000000 | (4 << 16) | (0x53 << 8) | number
      
      
      MAP_CMD = ioctl_code(2)
      F2H_CMD = ioctl_code(5)
      FRAME_BYTES = 640 * 480 * 2
      TAGS = {
          "c1a": 0x00800000 + FRAME_BYTES,
          "c1b": 0x00A00000 + FRAME_BYTES,
          "c2a": 0x00C00000 + FRAME_BYTES,
          "c2b": 0x00E00000 + FRAME_BYTES,
      }
      REGS = {
          "c1_pclk": 0x20000010,
          "c1_vsync": 0x20000020,
          "c1_words": 0x20000030,
          "c1_i2c": 0x20000060,
          "c1_sys": 0x20000070,
          "c1_axi_now": 0x200000D0,
          "c1_beat_cnt": 0x200000A0,
          "c1_href_raw": 0x20000090,
          "c1_vsync_raw": 0x200000E0,
          "c1_beat_last": 0x200000F0,
          "c2_pclk": 0x20000210,
          "c2_vsync": 0x20000220,
          "c2_words": 0x20000230,
          "c2_i2c": 0x20000260,
          "c2_sys": 0x20000270,
          "c2_axi_now": 0x200002D0,
          "c2_beat_cnt": 0x200002A0,
          "c2_href_raw": 0x20000290,
          "c2_vsync_raw": 0x200002E0,
          "c2_beat_last": 0x200002F0,
      }
      
      
      def timed_ioctl(fd, command, op, timeout=12):
          signal.alarm(timeout)
          try:
              fcntl.ioctl(fd, command, op, True)
          finally:
              signal.alarm(0)
      
      
      def main():
          signal.signal(signal.SIGALRM, alarm_handler)
          fd = os.open("/dev/pango_pci_driver", os.O_RDWR | os.O_SYNC)
          try:
              for mapping in (0, 1):
                  op = DmaOp()
                  op.cmd = mapping
                  op.total_length = 4 * 1024 * 1024
                  timed_ioctl(fd, MAP_CMD, op)
              rx = mmap.mmap(fd, 4 * 1024 * 1024, prot=mmap.PROT_READ | mmap.PROT_WRITE,
                             flags=mmap.MAP_SHARED, offset=1024 * 1024)
      
              def read_bytes(address, length):
                  op = DmaOp()
                  op.offset_addr = 0
                  op.ddr3_addr = address
                  op.total_length = length
                  start = time.perf_counter_ns()
                  try:
                      timed_ioctl(fd, F2H_CMD, op)
                  except Timeout:
                      return None, (time.perf_counter_ns() - start) / 1e6
                  return bytes(rx[:length]), (time.perf_counter_ns() - start) / 1e6
      
              def read_reg(address):
                  data, elapsed = read_bytes(address, 16)
                  return (None if data is None else struct.unpack_from("<I", data)[0]), elapsed
      
              diag_before = {}
              for name, address in REGS.items():
                  try:
                      diag_before[name] = read_reg(address)[0]
                  except (Timeout, OSError):
                      diag_before[name] = None
              print("diag_before=%s" % diag_before, flush=True)
      
              duration = 6
              print("probe_start frame_bytes=%d duration_s=%d" % (FRAME_BYTES, duration), flush=True)
              previous = None
              changes = {name: 0 for name in TAGS}
              read_errors = 0
              first_change = None
              start = time.monotonic()
              end = start + duration
              samples = 0
              while time.monotonic() < end:
                  row = {}
                  durations = []
                  for name, address in TAGS.items():
                      try:
                          data, elapsed = read_bytes(address, 16)
                      except (Timeout, OSError) as exc:
                          data, elapsed = None, 0.0
                          read_errors += 1
                      durations.append(elapsed)
                      row[name] = None if data is None else struct.unpack_from("<I", data)[0]
                  now = time.monotonic()
                  if previous is not None:
                      for name in TAGS:
                          if row[name] is not None and row[name] != previous[name]:
                              changes[name] += 1
                              if first_change is None:
                                  first_change = now
                  previous = row
                  samples += 1
                  if samples % 100 == 0:
                      print("sample=%d t=%.3f tags=%s tag_dma_ms=%.3f..%.3f" %
                            (samples, now, row, min(durations), max(durations)), flush=True)
                  time.sleep(0.005)
      
              elapsed = time.monotonic() - start
              print("tag_changes=%s samples=%d elapsed_s=%.3f read_errors=%d rates_fps=%s" %
                    (changes, samples, elapsed,
                     read_errors,
                     {name: round(value / elapsed, 3) for name, value in changes.items()}), flush=True)
              diag_after = {}
              for name, address in REGS.items():
                  try:
                      diag_after[name] = read_reg(address)[0]
                  except (Timeout, OSError):
                      diag_after[name] = None
              print("diag_after=%s" % diag_after, flush=True)
              if first_change is not None:
                  print("first_change_after_s=%.3f" % (first_change - start), flush=True)
      
              for label, address in (("cam1_a", 0x00800000), ("cam2_a", 0x00C00000)):
                  try:
                      data, elapsed = read_bytes(address, FRAME_BYTES)
                  except (Timeout, OSError) as exc:
                      data, elapsed = None, 0.0
                  print("frame_read=%s bytes=%s elapsed_ms=%.3f" %
                        (label, "timeout" if data is None else len(data), elapsed), flush=True)
          finally:
              os.close(fd)
      
      
      if __name__ == "__main__":
          try:
              main()
          except Exception as exc:
              print("probe_error=%s: %s" % (type(exc).__name__, exc), file=sys.stderr)
              raise
