        27: 	output reg		[ID_WIDTH - 1:0]   			m_axi_awid   	,
        28: 	output reg		[31:0]  					m_axi_awaddr 	,
        29: 	output reg		[7:0]   					m_axi_awlen  	,
        30: 	output 			[2:0]   					m_axi_awsize 	,
        31: 	output 			[1:0]   					m_axi_awburst	,
        32: 	output 		    	    					m_axi_awlock 	,
        33: 	output 			[3:0]   					m_axi_awcache	,
        34: 	output 			[2:0]   					m_axi_awprot	,
        35: 	output reg		        					m_axi_awvalid	,
        36: 	input  		 	        					m_axi_awready	,
        37: 	output 			[DATA_WIDTH - 1:0] 			m_axi_wdata		,
        38: 	output 			[KEEP_WIDTH - 1:0]  		m_axi_wstrb		,
        39: 	output 			        					m_axi_wlast		,
        40: 	output 			        					m_axi_wvalid	,
        41: 	input  			        					m_axi_wready	,
        42: 	input  			[ID_WIDTH - 1:0]   			m_axi_bid  		,
        43: 	input  			[1:0]   					m_axi_bresp 	,
        44: 	input  			        					m_axi_bvalid	,
        45: 	output 			        					m_axi_bready
        46:
        47: );
        48:
        49:
        50: localparam AXI_BURST_SIZE = $clog2(KEEP_WIDTH); //log2(DATA_WIDTH / 8)
        51:
        52: // [WD 2026-09-18] transmit watchdog state
        53: reg        abort_r;
        54: reg [23:0] wd_cnt;
        55: wire       w_progress;
        56: wire       abort_done;
        57:
        58: wire [DATA_WIDTH - 1:0] 		t_m_axi_wdata;
        59: wire [KEEP_WIDTH - 1:0]  		t_m_axi_wstrb;
        60: wire         					t_m_axi_wlast;
        61: wire         					t_m_axi_wvalid;
        62: wire         					t_m_axi_wready;
        63:
        64: //common para
        65: assign m_axi_awsize 	= 		AXI_BURST_SIZE	;
        66: assign m_axi_awburst 	= 		2'b01			;
        67: assign m_axi_awlock 	= 		1'b0			;
        68: assign m_axi_awcache 	= 		4'b0011			;
        69: assign m_axi_awprot 	= 		3'b000			;
        70:
        71:
        72: wire [7:0] burst_len    ;
        73: wire [7:0] max_burst_len;
        74:
        75: //cmd
        76: reg [31:0] addr;
        77: reg [31:0] len;
        78: reg        trans;
        79:
        80: always @(posedge clk) begin
        81: 	if((cmd_ready == 1'b1) && (cmd_valid == 1'b1))begin
        82: 		addr <= cmd_addr;
        83: 	end
        84: 	else begin
        85: 		if((m_axi_awvalid == 1'b1) && (m_axi_awready == 1'b1))begin
        86: 			addr <= addr + ((m_axi_awlen + 1'b1) << AXI_BURST_SIZE);
        87: 		end
        88: 	end
        89: end
        90:
        91: always @(posedge clk) begin
        92: 	if((cmd_ready == 1'b1) && (cmd_valid == 1'b1))begin
        93: 		len <= cmd_len[31:AXI_BURST_SIZE] + (|cmd_len[AXI_BURST_SIZE - 1:0]);
        94: 	end
        95: 	else begin
        96: 		if((m_axi_awvalid == 1'b1) && (m_axi_awready == 1'b1))begin
        97: 			len <= len - (m_axi_awlen + 1'b1);
        98: 		end
        99: 		else if(abort_done == 1'b1)begin
       100: 			len <= 32'd0;       // [WD]
       101: 		end
       102: 	end
       103: end
       104: always @(posedge clk)begin
       105: 	if(rst == 1'b1)begin
       106: 		trans <= 1'b0;
       107: 	end
       108: 	else begin
       109: 		if((cmd_ready == 1'b1) && (cmd_valid == 1'b1))begin
       110: 			trans <= 1'b1;
       111: 		end
       112: 		else begin
       113: 			if((m_axi_bready == 1'b1) && (m_axi_bvalid == 1'b1) && (len == 32'd0))begin
       114: 				trans <= 1'b0;
       115: 			end
       116: 			else if(abort_done == 1'b1)begin
       117: 				trans <= 1'b0;      // [WD] release the stuck transaction
       118: 			end
       119: 		end
       120: 	end
       121: end
       122:
       123: always @(posedge  clk)begin
       124: 	if(rst == 1'b1)begin
       125: 		cmd_ready <= 1'b0;
       126: 	end
       127: 	else begin
       128: 		if(trans == 1'b0)begin
       129: 			if((cmd_ready == 1'b1) && (cmd_valid == 1'b1))begin
       130: 				cmd_ready <= 1'b0;
       131: 			end
       132: 			else begin
       133: 				cmd_ready <= 1'b1;
       134: 			end
       135: 		end
       136: 		else begin
       137: 			cmd_ready <= 1'b0;
       138: 		end
       139: 	end
       140: end
       141:
       142: //aw
       143:
       144: reg burst_trans;
       145: assign burst_len     = len > BURST_LEN ? BURST_LEN : len;
       146: assign max_burst_len = (((addr & 12'hfff) + (burst_len << AXI_BURST_SIZE )) >> 12)  != 0 ? (13'h1000 - (addr & 12'hfff)) >> AXI_BURST_SIZE : burst_len;
       147: always@(posedge clk)begin
       148: 	if(rst == 1'b1)begin
       149: 		burst_trans <= 1'b0;
       150: 	end
       151: 	else begin
       152: 		if((m_axi_awvalid == 1'b1) && (m_axi_awready == 1'b1))begin
       153: 			burst_trans <= 1'b1;
       154: 		end
       155: 		else begin
       156: 			// if((m_axi_wvalid == 1'b1) && (m_axi_wready == 1'b1) && (m_axi_wlast == 1'b1))begin
       157: 			if((m_axi_bvalid == 1'b1) && (m_axi_bready == 1'b1))begin
       158: 				burst_trans <= 1'b0;
       159: 			end
       160: 			else if(abort_done == 1'b1)begin
       161: 				burst_trans <= 1'b0;   // [WD2] force-release; B may never arrive
       162: 			end
       163: 		end
       164: 	end
       165: end
       166: always @(posedge clk)begin
       167: 	if(rst == 1'b1)begin
       168: 		m_axi_awvalid <= 1'b0;
       169: 	end
       170: 	else begin
       171: 		if((m_axi_awvalid == 1'b1) && (m_axi_awready == 1'b1))begin
       172: 			m_axi_awvalid <= 1'b0;
       173: 		end
       174: 		else begin
       175: 			if((burst_trans == 1'b0) && (len != 32'd0) && (abort_r == 1'b0))begin
       176: 				m_axi_awvalid <= 1'b1;
       177: 			end
       178: 		end
       179: 	end
       180: end
       181:
       182: always @(posedge clk)begin
       183: 	m_axi_awlen <= max_burst_len - 8'd1;
       184: end
       185: always @(posedge clk)begin
       186: 	m_axi_awaddr <= addr;
       187: end
       188: always @(posedge clk) begin
       189: 	if((cmd_ready == 1'b1) && (cmd_valid == 1'b1))begin
       190: 		m_axi_awid <= cmd_id;
       191: 	end
       192: end
       193: //w
       194: reg [7:0] act_burst_len;
       195: always@ (posedge clk)begin
       196: 	if(rst == 1'b1)begin
       197: 		act_burst_len <= 8'd0;
       198: 	end
       199: 	else begin
       200: 		if((m_axi_awvalid == 1'b1) && (m_axi_awready == 1'b1))begin
       201: 			act_burst_len <= m_axi_awlen + 8'd1;
       202: 		end
       203: 		else begin
       204: 			if((t_m_axi_wvalid == 1'b1) && (t_m_axi_wready == 1'b1))begin
       205: 				act_burst_len <= act_burst_len - 8'd1;
       206: 			end
       207: 		end
       208: 	end
       209: end
       210:
       211: // [WD 2026-09-18] ------------------------------------------------------------------
       212: // The DVP stream can deliver fewer 128-bit beats than CAM_DATA_LEN (CDC FIFO
       213: // overflow drops pixels and cannot back-pressure the sensor). A frame's AXI
       214: // burst then never completes: trans sticks at 1, cmd_ready stays low and the
       215: // frame FSM deadlocks forever (measured: state=ADDR, axi_cnt=0, 0 frames).
       216: //
       217: // Recovery: if there is no W-beat progress for ~0.17 s while a write is in
       218: // flight, close the open burst with dummy beats. AXI forbids cancelling an
       219: // accepted AW, so we must still supply awlen beats; we just no longer consume
       220: // real camera data. After the B response is absorbed, trans/len clear and the
       221: // next frame's command is accepted again (only the bad frame is lost).
       222: assign w_progress = (t_m_axi_wvalid == 1'b1) && (t_m_axi_wready == 1'b1);
       223:
       224: always @(posedge clk) begin
       225: 	if((rst == 1'b1) || (trans == 1'b0) || (abort_r == 1'b1) || (w_progress == 1'b1))
       226: 		wd_cnt <= 24'd0;
       227: 	else if(wd_cnt != 24'hFFFFFF)
       228: 		wd_cnt <= wd_cnt + 24'd1;
       229: end
       230:
       231: // [BFAST 2026-09-19] the DDR write port can stop returning B responses
       232: // (see [WD2]; re-observed 09-19: b_cnt ~26 total while aw_cnt ~60k).
       233: // Waiting the full 0.17 s watchdog once every command's beats are out
       234: // capped the camera path at ~5 fps. Give B a few microseconds after the
       235: // last beat, then force the close via the abort path; a late B is still
       236: // absorbed by the w_done/bready logic.
       237: reg [9:0] bwait_cnt;
       238: // (w_done intentionally not referenced: it is declared further below and
       239: // act_burst_len==0 && burst_trans already means every beat is out, B pending)
       240: wire all_beats_out = (len == 32'd0) && (act_burst_len == 8'd0) && burst_trans;
       241: always @(posedge clk) begin
       242: 	if((rst == 1'b1) || (trans == 1'b0) || (all_beats_out == 1'b0) || (abort_r == 1'b1))
       243: 		bwait_cnt <= 10'd0;
       244: 	else if(bwait_cnt != 10'h3FF)
       245: 		bwait_cnt <= bwait_cnt + 10'd1;
       246: end
       247: always @(posedge clk) begin
       248: 	if(rst == 1'b1)
       249: 		abort_r <= 1'b0;
       250: 	// [BFAST2 2026-09-19] bwait fast-close DISABLED: B latency under DDR contention
       251: 	// can legitimately exceed the 10us grace; force-closing mid-flight corrupted
       252: 	// the crossbar/DDR transaction stream and killed M00 writes within seconds.
       253: 	// Fall back to the long send-watchdog only.
       254: 	else if((abort_r == 1'b0) && (trans == 1'b1) && (wd_cnt == 24'hFFFFFF))
       255: 		abort_r <= 1'b1;
       256: 	else if(abort_done == 1'b1)
       257: 		abort_r <= 1'b0;
       258: end
       259:
       260: // [WD2 2026-09-18] burst_trans is only cleared by the B response, which is
       261: // exactly what never arrives in the wedge case (cam2: bvalid never asserted).
       262: // Requiring burst_trans==0 made abort_done unreachable -> no recovery.
       263: // All W beats for the open burst are out once act_burst_len hits 0, so that
       264: // is the correct release point; burst_trans is force-cleared below.
       265: assign abort_done = abort_r && (act_burst_len == 8'd0);
       266: // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------
       267:
       268: stream_pipe #(
       269:   .DATA_WIDTH 	(DATA_WIDTH+1+KEEP_WIDTH)
       270: ) stream_pipe_3(
       271:   .dataIn_valid     (t_m_axi_wvalid),
       272:   .dataIn_ready     (t_m_axi_wready),
       273:   .dataIn_payload   ({t_m_axi_wdata, t_m_axi_wstrb, t_m_axi_wlast}),
       274:   .dataOut_valid    (m_axi_wvalid),
       275:   .dataOut_ready    (m_axi_wready),
       276:   .dataOut_payload  ({m_axi_wdata, m_axi_wstrb, m_axi_wlast}),
       277:   .clk              (clk),
       278:   .reset            (rst)
       279: );
       280:
       281: assign data_in_ready = abort_r ? 1'b0
       282:                                : (t_m_axi_wready && act_burst_len > 8'd0);
       283: assign t_m_axi_wvalid  = abort_r ? (act_burst_len > 8'd0)
       284:                                  : (data_in_valid && act_burst_len > 8'd0);
       285: assign t_m_axi_wdata   = abort_r ? {DATA_WIDTH{1'b0}} : data_in;
       286: assign t_m_axi_wlast   = (act_burst_len == 8'd1);
       287: assign t_m_axi_wstrb   = abort_r ? {KEEP_WIDTH{1'b1}} : data_in_keep;
       288:
       289: //b
       290: reg w_done;
       291: always @(posedge clk) begin
       292: 	if(rst == 1'b1) begin
       293: 		w_done <= 1'b0;
       294: 	end
       295: 	else begin
       296: 		if((t_m_axi_wvalid == 1'b1) && (t_m_axi_wready == 1'b1) && (t_m_axi_wlast == 1'b1)) begin
       297: 			w_done <= 1'b1;
       298: 		end
       299: 		else begin
       300: 			if((m_axi_bvalid == 1'b1) && (m_axi_bready == 1'b1)) begin
       301: 				w_done <= 1'b0;
       302: 			end
       303: 		end
       304: 	end
       305: end
       306: assign m_axi_bready = w_done;
       307:
       308: // [LEDGER 2026-09-19] single-ledger completion: pulse exactly once per
       309: // command on the trans 1->0 fall. Covers the normal close (B absorbed,
       310: // len==0) AND both watchdog abort paths; the old B-gated expression never
       311: // pulsed when a B response was lost, wedging the frame FSM in DATA forever.
       312: reg trans_q;
       313: always @(posedge clk) begin
       314: 	if(rst == 1'b1) trans_q <= 1'b0;
       315: 	else            trans_q <= trans;
       316: end
       317:
       318: always @(posedge clk ) begin
       319: 	if(rst == 1'b1)begin
       320: 		data_in_last <= 1'b0;
       321: 	end
       322: 	else begin
       323: 		data_in_last <= trans_q && (trans == 1'b0);
       324: 	end
       325: end
       326:
       327: endmodule
      
      ### source/axi_crossbar/ddr_w_arb.v
         1: // ============================================================================
         2: // ddr_w_arb.v -- [WARB 2026-09-19] minimal 2-master DDR write arbiter.
         3: //
         4: // WHY: the Forencich axi_crossbar's M00 write path leaks its per-master W-channel
         5: // select across handoffs (bench-proven in sim/wedge: after S01's burst tail the
         6: // M00 w_select_valid latches forever, S04's beats are never released, and both
         7: // camera engines wedge after 1-2 bursts). This module replaces the crossbar on
         8: // the DDR write path for the two camera engines.
         9: //
        10: // DESIGN: single-outstanding end-to-end, matching the DDR3 IP user-port contract
        11: // (no wvalid, unthrottleable wready, one burst processed at a time):
        12: //   IDLE  : present one master's AW (round-robin tie-break); the accept from the
        13: //           port glue locks OWNER for the whole burst.
        14: //   BUSY  : only OWNER's W stream reaches the glue; the fabric-minted B (from
        15: //           wusero_last) is routed back to OWNER; its accept frees the slot and
        16: //           flips the round-robin bit.
        17: // AXI-legal: awvalid/wvalid are held with stable payload until accepted; the
        18: // non-owner master's awready/wready stay low, so its burst cannot start.
        19: // ============================================================================
        20: `timescale 1ns/1ps
        21: module ddr_w_arb (
        22:     input  wire         clk,
        23:     input  wire         rst,
        24:
        25:     // ---- master 0 (cam1 DMA) ----
        26:     input  wire [3:0]   m0_awid,
        27:     input  wire [31:0]  m0_awaddr,
        28:     input  wire [7:0]   m0_awlen,
        29:     input  wire [2:0]   m0_awsize,
        30:     input  wire [1:0]   m0_awburst,
        31:     input  wire         m0_awlock,
        32:     input  wire [3:0]   m0_awcache,
        33:     input  wire [2:0]   m0_awprot,
        34:     input  wire         m0_awvalid,
        35:     output wire         m0_awready,
        36:     input  wire [127:0] m0_wdata,
        37:     input  wire [15:0]  m0_wstrb,
        38:     input  wire         m0_wlast,
        39:     input  wire         m0_wvalid,
        40:     output wire         m0_wready,
        41:     output wire [3:0]   m0_bid,
        42:     output wire [1:0]   m0_bresp,
        43:     output wire         m0_bvalid,
        44:     input  wire         m0_bready,
        45:
        46:     // ---- master 1 (cam2 DMA) ----
        47:     input  wire [3:0]   m1_awid,
        48:     input  wire [31:0]  m1_awaddr,
        49:     input  wire [7:0]   m1_awlen,
        50:     input  wire [2:0]   m1_awsize,
        51:     input  wire [1:0]   m1_awburst,
        52:     input  wire         m1_awlock,
        53:     input  wire [3:0]   m1_awcache,
        54:     input  wire [2:0]   m1_awprot,
        55:     input  wire         m1_awvalid,
        56:     output wire         m1_awready,
        57:     input  wire [127:0] m1_wdata,
        58:     input  wire [15:0]  m1_wstrb,
        59:     input  wire         m1_wlast,
        60:     input  wire         m1_wvalid,
        61:     output wire         m1_wready,
        62:     output wire [3:0]   m1_bid,
        63:     output wire [1:0]   m1_bresp,
        64:     output wire         m1_bvalid,
        65:     input  wire         m1_bready,
        66:
        67:     // ---- slave (DDR3 port glue) ----
        68:     output wire [3:0]   s_awid,
        69:     output wire [31:0]  s_awaddr,
        70:     output wire [7:0]   s_awlen,
        71:     output wire [2:0]   s_awsize,
        72:     output wire [1:0]   s_awburst,
        73:     output wire         s_awlock,
        74:     output wire [3:0]   s_awcache,
        75:     output wire [2:0]   s_awprot,
        76:     output wire         s_awvalid,
        77:     input  wire         s_awready,
        78:     output wire [127:0] s_wdata,
        79:     output wire [15:0]  s_wstrb,
        80:     output wire         s_wlast,
        81:     output wire         s_wvalid,
        82:     input  wire         s_wready,
        83:     input  wire [3:0]   s_bid,
        84:     input  wire [1:0]   s_bresp,
        85:     input  wire         s_bvalid,
        86:     output wire         s_bready
        87: );
        88:
        89:     // Experimental throughput version: retain ownership for eight adjacent
        90:     // DDR bursts before rotating. The user requested restoring this exact
        91:     // experiment after the rollback image was tested.
        92:     localparam [2:0] BURSTS_PER_TURN = 3'd8;
        93:
        94:     reg  busy;      // an AW is locked in (waiting for its B)
        95:     reg  owner;     // 0 = master0 owns the slot, 1 = master1
        96:     reg  rr;        // round-robin tie-break for the next idle grant
        97:     reg  [2:0] turn_count;
        98:
        99:     // grant decision: only when idle; alternate when both masters ask
       100:     wire aw_gnt_m1 = ~busy & m1_awvalid & ( rr | ~m0_awvalid);
       101:     wire aw_gnt_m0 = ~busy & m0_awvalid & ~(m1_awvalid & rr);
       102:
       103:     // AW datapath (granted master's request)
       104:     assign s_awid    = aw_gnt_m1 ? m1_awid    : m0_awid;
       105:     assign s_awaddr  = aw_gnt_m1 ? m1_awaddr  : m0_awaddr;
       106:     assign s_awlen   = aw_gnt_m1 ? m1_awlen   : m0_awlen;
       107:     assign s_awsize  = aw_gnt_m1 ? m1_awsize  : m0_awsize;
       108:     assign s_awburst = aw_gnt_m1 ? m1_awburst : m0_awburst;
       109:     assign s_awlock  = aw_gnt_m1 ? m1_awlock  : m0_awlock;
       110:     assign s_awcache = aw_gnt_m1 ? m1_awcache : m0_awcache;
       111:     assign s_awprot  = aw_gnt_m1 ? m1_awprot  : m0_awprot;
       112:     assign s_awvalid = aw_gnt_m0 | aw_gnt_m1;
       113:
       114:     assign m0_awready = aw_gnt_m0 & s_awready;
       115:     assign m1_awready = aw_gnt_m1 & s_awready;
       116:
       117:     // W datapath (only the owner's beats can flow)
       118:     assign s_wdata  = owner ? m1_wdata : m0_wdata;
       119:     assign s_wstrb  = owner ? m1_wstrb : m0_wstrb;
       120:     assign s_wlast  = owner ? m1_wlast : m0_wlast;
       121:     assign s_wvalid = busy & (owner ? m1_wvalid : m0_wvalid);
       122:
       123:     assign m0_wready = busy & ~owner & s_wready;
       124:     assign m1_wready = busy &  owner & s_wready;
       125:
       126:     // B path: single outstanding -> the owner gets the fabric-minted response
       127:     assign m0_bvalid = busy & ~owner & s_bvalid;
       128:     assign m1_bvalid = busy &  owner & s_bvalid;
       129:     assign m0_bid    = s_bid;
       130:     assign m1_bid    = s_bid;
       131:     assign m0_bresp  = s_bresp;
       132:     assign m1_bresp  = s_bresp;
       133:     assign s_bready  = busy & (owner ? m1_bready : m0_bready);
       134:
       135:     always @(posedge clk) begin
       136:         if (rst) begin
       137:             busy  <= 1'b0;
       138:             owner <= 1'b0;
       139:             rr    <= 1'b0;
       140:             turn_count <= 3'd0;
       141:         end
       142:         else begin
       143:             if (!busy && (aw_gnt_m0 | aw_gnt_m1) && s_awready) begin
       144:                 busy  <= 1'b1;
       145:                 owner <= aw_gnt_m1;
       146:                 if (turn_count == BURSTS_PER_TURN - 1'b1) begin
       147:                     turn_count <= 3'd0;
       148:                     rr <= aw_gnt_m0;         // rotate after the eight-burst quantum
       149:                 end
       150:                 else begin
       151:                     turn_count <= turn_count + 1'b1;
       152:                     rr <= rr;                // keep the same owner during the quantum
       153:                 end
       154:             end
       155:             else if (busy && s_bvalid && s_bready) begin
       156:                 busy  <= 1'b0;
       157:             end
       158:         end
       159:     end
       160:
       161: endmodule
      
      ### source/ov5640/ov5640_ddr/ov5640_ddr_w_ctrl.v
         1: //����CMD����
         2: module ov5640_ddr_w_ctrl #(
         3:     parameter AXI_ADDR_WIDTH = 32,
         4:     parameter AXI_LEN_WIDTH  = 32,
         5:     parameter AXI_DATA_WIDTH = 128,
         6:     parameter CAM_DATA_LEN   = 172800 //1280*720*3/16
         7: )(
         8:     input          axi_clk        ,
         9:     input          axi_rst        ,
        10:
        11:     input  [AXI_ADDR_WIDTH-1 : 0]      cam_data_addr_1,
        12:     input  [AXI_ADDR_WIDTH-1 : 0]      cam_data_addr_2,
        13:     input  [$clog2(CAM_DATA_LEN) : 0]  cam_data_len   , //��16�ֽ�Ϊ��λ
        14:
        15:     input          s_vsync        ,
        16:
        17:     input          dma_done       ,  // [LEDGER 2026-09-19] DMA transaction-done pulse (authoritative beat ledger)
        18:
        19:     output [AXI_ADDR_WIDTH-1 : 0]  axi_cmd_addr   /*synthesis PAP_MARK_DEBUG="1"*/,
        20:     output [AXI_LEN_WIDTH-1 : 0]   axi_cmd_len    /*synthesis PAP_MARK_DEBUG="1"*/,
        21:     output reg                     axi_cmd_valid  /*synthesis PAP_MARK_DEBUG="1"*/,
        22:     input                          axi_cmd_ready  /*synthesis PAP_MARK_DEBUG="1"*/,
        23:
        24:     output [1 : 0]   xdma_req       ,
        25:     input  [1 : 0]   xdma_ack       ,
        26:
        27:     // [FRTAG 2026-09-14] frame-tag injection. After each frame's last stream beat the
        28:     // FSM issues a SECOND 16-byte AXI command writing a 32-bit frame counter to
        29:     // frame_base + CAM_DATA_LEN*16. The wrapper (ov5640_ddr.v) muxes tag_data onto
        30:     // the data stream while tag_active is high. The transaction must complete:
        31:     // aborting it would leave a pending frame with no new tag for the host.
        32:     output                           tag_active     ,
        33:     output [AXI_DATA_WIDTH-1 : 0]    tag_data       ,
        34:     input                            tag_ready,
        35:     output [31:0]                    dbg_state,
        36:     output                           engine_busy,     // [IDLEGATE 2026-09-19] FSM not IDLE (frame or tag in flight)
        37:     output [31:0]                    dbg_last_cnt,
        38:     output [31:0]                    dbg_wd_cnt
        39: );
        40:
        41:     localparam IDLE      = 3'b001;
        42:     localparam ADDR      = 3'b010;
        43:     localparam DATA      = 3'b100;
        44:     // [FRTAG 2026-09-14] tag states: second (16B) command after the frame completes
        45:     localparam ADDR_TAG  = 3'b011;
        46:     localparam DATA_TAG  = 3'b101;
        47:
        48:     reg [2 : 0] curr_state/*synthesis PAP_MARK_DEBUG="1"*/;
        49:     // [LEDGER 2026-09-19] both the frame command and the 16B tag command pulse
        50:     // dma_done; only the frame command's completion may advance frame state.
        51:     wire frame_done = dma_done && (curr_state == DATA);
        52:     reg [2 : 0] next_state;
        53:     wire wd_expire;
        54:
        55:     // [FRTAG 2026-09-14] frame-tag declarations (forward, before first use)
        56:     reg                          vsync_pending;
        57:     reg  [AXI_ADDR_WIDTH-1 : 0]  frame_base;
        58:     reg  [31 : 0]                frame_cnt;
        59:     wire [AXI_ADDR_WIDTH-1 : 0]  tag_addr;
        60:     wire                         tag_fire;
        61:
        62:     reg [1 : 0] axi_vsync_ff/*synthesis PAP_MARK_DEBUG="1"*/;
        63:     reg axi_vsync_rise/*synthesis PAP_MARK_DEBUG="1"*/;
        64:
        65:
        66:     reg [AXI_ADDR_WIDTH-1 : 0] cmd_addr;
        67:
        68:
        69:     //״̬��
        70:     always @(posedge axi_clk) begin
        71:         if(axi_rst)begin
        72:             curr_state <= IDLE;
        73:         end
        74:         else begin
        75:             curr_state <= next_state;
        76:         end
        77:     end
        78:
        79:     always @(*) begin
        80:         case (curr_state)
        81:             IDLE: begin
        82:                 if(vsync_pending)begin
        83:                     next_state = ADDR;
        84:                 end
        85:                 else begin
        86:                     next_state = IDLE;
        87:                 end
        88:             end
        89:             ADDR: begin
        90:                 if(axi_cmd_ready & axi_cmd_valid)begin
        91:                     next_state = DATA;
        92:                 end
        93:                 else if(wd_expire)begin
        94:                     next_state = IDLE;      // [WD2] cmd_ready stuck -> retry
        95:                 end
        96:                 else begin
        97:                     next_state = ADDR;
        98:                 end
        99:             end
       100:             DATA: begin
       101:                 if(frame_done)begin
       102:                     next_state = ADDR_TAG;              // [FRTAG] frame complete, go write the tag
       103:                 end
       104:                 else if(wd_expire)begin
       105:                     next_state = IDLE;                  // [FIX] retry next vsync
       106:                 end
       107:                 else begin
       108:                     next_state = DATA;
       109:                 end
       110:             end
       111:             ADDR_TAG: begin
       112:                 if(axi_cmd_ready & axi_cmd_valid)begin
       113:                     next_state = DATA_TAG;
       114:                 end
       115:                 else if(wd_expire)begin
       116:                     next_state = IDLE;                  // [FIX]
       117:                 end
       118:                 else begin
       119:                     next_state = ADDR_TAG;
       120:                 end
       121:             end
       122:             DATA_TAG: begin
       123:                 if(tag_fire || wd_expire)begin
       124:                     next_state = IDLE;
       125:                 end
       126:                 else begin
       127:                     next_state = DATA_TAG;
       128:                 end
       129:             end
       130:             default: begin
       131:                 next_state = IDLE;
       132:             end
       133:         endcase
       134:     end
       135:
       136:
       137:     always @(posedge axi_clk) begin
       138:         if(axi_rst)begin
       139:             axi_vsync_ff <= 2'b0;
       140:         end
       141:         else begin
       142:             axi_vsync_ff <= {axi_vsync_ff[0], s_vsync};
       143:         end
       144:     end
       145:
       146:     always @(posedge axi_clk) begin
       147:         if(axi_rst)begin
       148:             axi_vsync_rise <= 1'b0;
       149:         end
       150:         else begin
       151:             axi_vsync_rise <= axi_vsync_ff[0] & (~axi_vsync_ff[1]);
       152:         end
       153:     end
       154:
       155:     reg w_ping;
       156:     always @(posedge axi_clk) begin
       157:         if(axi_rst)begin
       158:             w_ping <= 1'b0;
       159:         end
       160:         else begin
       161:             if(frame_done)begin
       162:                 w_ping <= ~w_ping;
       163:             end
       164:         end
       165:     end
       166:
       167:
       168:     // [FRTAG 2026-09-14] sticky vsync latch: a vsync pulse arriving while the tag
       169:     // states are running must not be lost (previously a 1-cycle rise pulse).
       170:     always @(posedge axi_clk) begin
       171:         if(axi_rst)begin
       172:             vsync_pending <= 1'b0;
       173:         end
       174:         else if(axi_vsync_rise)begin
       175:             vsync_pending <= 1'b1;
       176:         end
       177:         else if((curr_state == IDLE) && vsync_pending)begin
       178:             vsync_pending <= 1'b0;
       179:         end
       180:     end
       181:
       182:     always @(posedge axi_clk) begin
       183:         if(axi_rst)begin
       184:             axi_cmd_valid <= 1'b0;
       185:         end
       186:         else begin
       187:             if((curr_state == IDLE) && vsync_pending)begin
       188:                 axi_cmd_valid <= 1'b1;
       189:             end
       190:             else if(frame_done)begin
       191:                 axi_cmd_valid <= 1'b1;      // [FRTAG] frame done -> present the tag command
       192:             end
       193:             else if(axi_cmd_valid & axi_cmd_ready)begin
       194:                 axi_cmd_valid <= 1'b0;
       195:             end
       196:         end
       197:     end
       198:
       199:
       200:     always @(posedge axi_clk) begin
       201:         if(w_ping)begin
       202:             cmd_addr <= cam_data_addr_2;
       203:         end
       204:         else begin
       205:             cmd_addr <= cam_data_addr_1;
       206:         end
       207:     end
       208:
       209:     assign axi_cmd_addr = (curr_state == ADDR_TAG) ? tag_addr : cmd_addr;
       210:     // [FRTAG 2026-09-14] tag command = one 16-byte beat at frame_base + frame size
       211:     assign axi_cmd_len  = (curr_state == ADDR_TAG) ? 32'd16
       212:                         : {{AXI_LEN_WIDTH-4-$clog2(CAM_DATA_LEN){1'd0}}, cam_data_len, 4'b0};
       213:
       214:
       215:     // [FRTAG 2026-09-14] frame counter + tag beat generation --------------------
       216:     // frame_base is latched when the FRAME command is accepted (cmd_addr still
       217:     // points at the buffer being written at that moment; w_ping flips later).
       218:     always @(posedge axi_clk) begin
       219:         if(axi_rst)begin
       220:             frame_base <= {AXI_ADDR_WIDTH{1'b0}};
       221:         end
       222:         else if((curr_state == ADDR) && axi_cmd_valid && axi_cmd_ready)begin
       223:             frame_base <= cmd_addr;
       224:         end
       225:     end
       226:
       227:     assign tag_addr = frame_base + (CAM_DATA_LEN << 4);
       228:
       229:     always @(posedge axi_clk) begin
       230:         if(axi_rst)begin
       231:             frame_cnt <= 32'd0;
       232:         end
       233:         else if(frame_done)begin
       234:             frame_cnt <= frame_cnt + 32'd1;
       235:         end
       236:     end
       237:
       238:     assign tag_active  = (curr_state == DATA_TAG);
       239:     assign tag_data    = {{(AXI_DATA_WIDTH-32){1'b0}}, frame_cnt};
       240:     assign tag_fire    = tag_active & tag_ready;
       241:     // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
       242:
       243:
       244:     //XDMAƹ������
       245:     reg [1 : 0] s_xdma_req;
       246:     always @(posedge axi_clk) begin
       247:         if(axi_rst)begin
       248:             s_xdma_req <= 2'b0;
       249:         end
       250:         else begin
       251:             if(frame_done)begin
       252:                 if(w_ping)begin
       253:                     s_xdma_req[1] <= 1'b1;
       254:                 end
       255:                 else begin
       256:                     s_xdma_req[0] <= 1'b1;
       257:                 end
       258:             end
       259:             else begin
       260:                 if(xdma_ack[0]) begin
       261:                     s_xdma_req[0] <= 1'b0;
       262:                 end
       263:                 if(xdma_ack[1]) begin
       264:                     s_xdma_req[1] <= 1'b0;
       265:                 end
       266:             end
       267:         end
       268:     end
       269:
       270:     assign xdma_req = s_xdma_req;
       271:     assign dbg_state = {29'd0, curr_state};
       272:     assign engine_busy = (curr_state != IDLE);
       273:
       274:     // [FIX 2026-09-18] frame-write watchdog: a frame that does not complete
       275:     // (lost/short camera stream) used to wedge this FSM in DATA forever. Bail
       276:     // back to IDLE after ~0.16 s and retry on the next vsync.
       277:     reg [31:0] wd_cnt;
       278:     // [WDFIX 2026-09-19] reset the budget on every state CHANGE, not only in
       279:     // IDLE: a frame that burns the budget in DATA (slow DMA close with the B
       280:     // path dead) used to make the immediately following ADDR_TAG/DATA_TAG
       281:     // expire instantly, silently skipping the frame-tag write.
       282:     reg [2:0] wd_prev_state;
       283:     always @(posedge axi_clk) begin
       284:         if(axi_rst) wd_prev_state <= IDLE;
       285:         else        wd_prev_state <= curr_state;
       286:     end
       287:     always @(posedge axi_clk) begin
       288:         if(axi_rst || (curr_state == IDLE) || (curr_state != wd_prev_state)) wd_cnt <= 32'd0;
       289:         else if(wd_cnt != 32'hffffffff)     wd_cnt <= wd_cnt + 32'd1;
       290:     end
       291:     assign wd_expire = (wd_cnt >= 32'd20_000_000);
       292:     assign dbg_wd_cnt = wd_cnt;
       293:
       294:     reg [31:0] last_cnt;
       295:     always @(posedge axi_clk) begin
       296:         if(axi_rst) last_cnt <= 32'd0;
       297:         else if(frame_done) last_cnt <= last_cnt + 32'd1;
       298:     end
       299:     assign dbg_last_cnt = last_cnt;
       300:
       301:
       302:
       303:
       304: endmodule
      
      ### source/ov5640/ov5640_ddr/ov5640_ddr_w_en.v
         1: module ov5640_ddr_w_en #(
         2:     parameter DATA_WIDTH = 24
         3: )(
         4:     input          axi_clk      ,
         5:     input          axi_rst      ,
         6:
         7:     input          axi_cam_en   ,
         8:     input  [1:0]   frame_pending,
         9:     input          engine_busy,   // [IDLEGATE 2026-09-19] write engine FSM busy
        10:
        11:     input  [DATA_WIDTH-1 : 0]  s_data       ,
        12:     input                      s_data_valid ,
        13:     input                      s_hsync      ,
        14:     input                      s_vsync      ,
        15:
        16:     output [DATA_WIDTH-1 : 0]  m_data       ,
        17:     output                     m_data_valid ,
        18:     output                     m_hsync      ,
        19:     output                     m_vsync
        20: );
        21:
        22: localparam IDLE = 2'b01;
        23: localparam DATA = 2'b10;
        24:
        25: reg [1:0] curr_state;
        26: reg [1:0] next_state;
        27:
        28: reg [1:0] s_vsync_ff;
        29: reg       s_vsync_rise;
        30:
        31: always @(posedge axi_clk) begin
        32:     if(axi_rst)begin
        33:         curr_state <= IDLE;
        34:     end
        35:     else begin
        36:         curr_state <= next_state;
        37:     end
        38: end
        39:
        40: always @(*) begin
        41:     case (curr_state)
        42:         IDLE: begin
        43:                 if(s_vsync_rise & axi_cam_en && !engine_busy) begin  // [IDLEGATE 2026-09-19] admit a frame only when the engine finished the previous one
        44:                 next_state = DATA;
        45:             end
        46:             else begin
        47:                 next_state = IDLE;
        48:             end
        49:         end
        50:         DATA: begin
        51:             if(s_vsync_rise) begin
        52:                     if(axi_cam_en && !engine_busy) begin  // [IDLEGATE] engine wedged mid-frame: drop the rest at this vsync
        53:                     next_state = DATA;
        54:                 end
        55:                 else begin
        56:                     next_state = IDLE;
        57:                 end
        58:             end
        59:             else begin
        60:                 next_state = DATA;
        61:             end
        62:         end
        63:         default: begin
        64:             next_state = IDLE;
        65:         end
        66:     endcase
        67: end
        68:
        69: always @(posedge axi_clk) begin
        70:     if(axi_rst)begin
        71:         s_vsync_ff <= 2'b0;
        72:     end
        73:     else begin
        74:         s_vsync_ff <= {s_vsync_ff[0], s_vsync};
        75:     end
        76: end
        77:
        78: always @(posedge axi_clk) begin
        79:     if(axi_rst)begin
        80:         s_vsync_rise <= 1'b0;
        81:     end
        82:     else begin
        83:         s_vsync_rise <= s_vsync_ff[0] & (~s_vsync_ff[1]);
        84:     end
        85: end
        86:
        87: assign m_data       = s_data;
        88: assign m_data_valid = s_data_valid & (curr_state == DATA);
        89:
        90: // A completed frame owns its DDR buffer until the host acknowledges it.
        91: // Drop whole sensor frames at VSYNC boundaries while one frame is pending.
        92:     assign m_vsync = s_vsync_rise & axi_cam_en && !engine_busy;  // [IDLEGATE 2026-09-19]
        93:
        94: endmodule

    status: Completed · exit 0
      $ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
      
      $pds = Get-Process -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { $_.ProcessName -match '^pds' }
      if ($pds) {
          throw 'PDS GUI is running. Close PDS before starting the standalone JTAG programmer.'
      }
      
      Get-Process cdt_cfg,cdt_js -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue |
          Stop-Process -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
      
      $bin = 'C:\pango\PDS_2022.2-SP6.4\bin'
      $port = 65465
      $server = $null
      $cfg = $null
      $programDone = $false
      $windowClosed = $false
      $outFile = Join-Path $env:TEMP 'pango_cdt_cfg.out.log'
      $errFile = Join-Path $env:TEMP 'pango_cdt_cfg.err.log'
      Remove-Item -LiteralPath $outFile, $errFile -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
      try {
          $server = Start-Process -FilePath "$bin\cdt_js.exe" `
              -ArgumentList '-port', $port -PassThru -WindowStyle Hidden
          Start-Sleep -Seconds 4
      
          # Keep the configuration window alive while the cable programs the FPGA.
          # Close it only after the tool has reported the completed program command.
          $cfg = Start-Process -FilePath "$bin\cdt_cfg.exe" `
              -ArgumentList '-ip','127.0.0.1','-port',$port,'-file','C:\Users\NineSun\Desktop\ov56401\project\flash_jtag.tcl' `
              -RedirectStandardOutput $outFile -RedirectStandardError $errFile -PassThru
      
          $deadline = (Get-Date).AddMinutes(5)
          while ((Get-Date) -lt $deadline) {
              Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 250
              $text = if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $outFile) {
                  Get-Content -LiteralPath $outFile -Raw -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
              } else { '' }
              if ($text -match 'The Progress:.*100%.*The done bit is 1' -or
                  $text -match 'The done bit is 1' -and
                  $text -match 'COMMAND\[Program\] execute successfully|cfg_program .*successfully') {
                  $programDone = $true
                  break
              }
              if ($cfg.HasExited) { break }
          }
      
          if (-not $programDone) {
              $detail = if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $outFile) { Get-Content -LiteralPath $outFile -Raw } else { '' }
              throw "cdt_cfg did not complete programming. $detail"
          }
      
          Write-Host '100% / done bit / Program successfully detected.'
          Write-Host '鐑у綍宸插畬鎴愶紝璇锋墜鍔ㄥ叧闂?Fabric Configuration 绐楀彛銆?
          Write-Host '绛夊緟绐楀彛閫€鍑猴紱涓嶄細鑷姩鍏抽棴 cdt_cfg銆?
      
          # The user owns the final close action.  Do not use Stop-Process here:
          # closing the GUI is also the explicit acknowledgement that the cable and
          # configuration state can be released for PCIe remove/rescan and testing.
          while ($true) {
              $cfg.Refresh()
              if ($cfg.HasExited) {
                  $windowClosed = $true
                  break
              }
              Start-Sleep -Seconds 1
          }
      
          Write-Host '鐑у綍瀹屾垚锛岀獥鍙ｅ凡鍏抽棴锛屽彲浠ヨ繘琛?PCIe remove/rescan 鍜屽抚鐜囨祴璇曘€?
      }
      finally {
          # On failure or Ctrl+C, avoid leaving a half-programmed GUI behind.  On
          # the successful path the window has already been closed by the user.
          if ($cfg -and -not $cfg.HasExited -and -not $windowClosed) {
              Stop-Process -Id $cfg.Id -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
          }
          Get-Process cdt_js -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue |
              Stop-Process -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
          if ($server) {
              Wait-Process -Id $server.Id -Timeout 3 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
          }
      }
      
      Write-Host 'JTAG programming flow finished; cdt_js was stopped.'

      #!/usr/bin/env python3
      # -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
      """board_ssh.py -- RK3568 board access over the LAPTOP hotspot (192.168.137.x).
      SSH linaro/linaro; helper CLI used by the deploy/verify steps.
      
      Usage:
        python board_ssh.py run "<shell command>"
        python board_ssh.py put <local> <remote>
        python board_ssh.py get <remote> <local>
      """
      import sys, paramiko
      
      HOST = '192.168.137.4'
      USER, PW = 'linaro', 'linaro'
      
      
      def connect():
          cli = paramiko.SSHClient()
          cli.set_missing_host_key_policy(paramiko.AutoAddPolicy())
          cli.connect(HOST, 22, USER, PW, timeout=8, allow_agent=False, look_for_keys=False)
          return cli
      
      
      def run(cli, cmd, timeout=120, sudo=False):
          if sudo:
              cmd = "echo '%s' | sudo -S bash -c %s" % (PW, "'" + cmd.replace("'", "'\\''") + "'")
          stdin, stdout, stderr = cli.exec_command(cmd, timeout=timeout)
          out = stdout.read().decode('utf-8', 'replace')
          err = stderr.read().decode('utf-8', 'replace')
          rc = stdout.channel.recv_exit_status()
          return rc, out, err
      
      
      def main():
          cli = connect()
          try:
              mode = sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv) > 1 else 'run'
              if mode == 'run':
                  rc, out, err = run(cli, sys.argv[2], timeout=300, sudo=('--sudo' in sys.argv))
                  print(out)
                  if err.strip():
                      print('[stderr]', err[-1500:])
                  sys.exit(rc)
              elif mode == 'put':
                  sftp = cli.open_sftp()
                  sftp.put(sys.argv[2], sys.argv[3])
                  sftp.close()
                  print('put OK')
              elif mode == 'get':
                  sftp = cli.open_sftp()
                  sftp.get(sys.argv[2], sys.argv[3])
                  sftp.close()
                  print('get OK')
          finally:
              cli.close()
      
      
      if __name__ == '__main__':
          main()

      #!/usr/bin/env python3
      """serial_run.py : 鍦?RK3568 涓插彛鎺у埗鍙版墽琛屽懡浠?(COM9 @1500000)
      鐢ㄦ硶: python serial_run.py "command1" "command2" ...
      姣忔潯鍛戒护绛夊緟鎻愮ず绗﹀悗杈撳嚭銆傞暱鍛戒护鍙敤 -t 绉掓暟 璋冩暣瓒呮椂銆?"""
      import serial, sys, time
      
      PORT = 'COM5'
      BAUD = 1500000
      
      def open_port():
          s = serial.Serial(PORT, BAUD, timeout=0.3)
          s.reset_input_buffer()
          return s
      
      def run(s, cmd, timeout=30):
          s.reset_input_buffer()
          s.write((cmd + '\n').encode())
          s.flush()
          t0 = time.time()
          buf = b''
          marker = b'__EOC__'
          s.write(b'echo __EOC__\n')  # 浼氬湪涓婁竴鏉℃墽琛屽畬鍚庢帓闃?    while time.time() - t0 < timeout:
              chunk = s.read(4096)
              if chunk:
                  buf += chunk
                  if marker in buf.split(cmd.encode()+b'\n')[-1]:
                      break
              else:
                  # 鍐嶆暡涓€娆℃爣璁伴槻姝涪澶?            s.write(b'echo __EOC__\n')
          s.reset_input_buffer()
          # 鍘绘帀鍥炴樉涓庢爣璁拌
          text = buf.decode('utf-8', errors='replace')
          lines = [l for l in text.splitlines() if '__EOC__' not in l]
          return '\n'.join(lines)
      
      if __name__ == '__main__':
          args = sys.argv[1:]
          timeout = 30
          if args and args[0] == '-t':
              timeout = int(args[1]); args = args[2:]
          s = open_port()
          for cmd in args:
              print(f'### {cmd}')
              print(run(s, cmd, timeout))
          s.close()

      1417: 	.m_axi_bid     (cam2_axi_bid     ),
      1418: 	.m_axi_bresp   (cam2_axi_bresp   ),
      1419: 	.m_axi_bvalid  (cam2_axi_bvalid  ),
      1420: 	.m_axi_bready  (cam2_axi_bready  )
      1500: //     .s_ready        (prep_pp_ready),
      1501: //     .s_frame_sync   (prep_pp_fsync),
      1502: //     .m_ready        (prep_out_ready),
      1503: //     .m_rgb565       (prep_out_data),
      1504: //     .m_valid        (prep_out_valid),
      1505: //     .m_frame_sync   (prep_out_fsync),
      1506: //     .reg_bypass     (prep_bypass_w),
      1507: //     .reg_mode       (prep_mode_w),
      1508: //     .reg_img_width  (prep_img_width_w),
      1509: //     .reg_thr_sat    (prep_thr_sat_w),
      1510: //     .reg_thr_hue    (prep_thr_hue_w),
      1511: //     .reg_thr_val    (prep_thr_val_w),
      1512: //     .reg_thr_low    (prep_thr_low_w),
      1513: //     .reg_thr_edge   (prep_thr_edge_w),
      1514: //     .out_frame_start(prep_out_frame_start),
      1515: //     .edge_stream_valid (prep_edge_valid),
      1516: //     .edge_stream_edge  (prep_edge_bit),
      1517: //     .edge_stream_center(prep_edge_center),
      1518: //     .color_id_valid (prep_cid_valid),
      1519: //     .color_id       (prep_cid)
      1520: // );
      1521:
      1522: // [OptionB 2026-09-12] WIP pixel-path disabled: recover 53006-reg verified netlist (DOC v1.1 3.3). Phase-2: recalibrate cam_prep_link TB then restore.
      1523: // lane_detect #(
      1524: //     .MAX_WIDTH(1920)
      1525: // ) lane_detect_u (
      1526: //     .clk        (axi_clk),
      1527: //     .rst_n      (~axi_rst),
      1528: //     .img_width  (prep_img_width_w),
      1529: //     .img_height (12'd720),
      1530: //     .roi_top_pct(prep_lane_roi_top_w),
      1531: //     .roi_bot_pct(prep_lane_roi_bot_w),
      1532: //     .row_thr    (prep_lane_row_thr_w),
      1533: //     .dash_thr   (prep_lane_dash_thr_w),
      1534: //     .s_center   (prep_edge_center),
      1535: //     .s_edge     (prep_edge_bit),
      1536: //     .s_valid    (prep_edge_valid),
      1537: //     .s_frame_sync(prep_out_frame_start),
      1538: //     .m_left_type (lane_left_type_w),
      1539: //     .m_right_type(lane_right_type_w),
      1540: //     .m_left_valid (lane_left_valid_w),
      1541: //     .m_right_valid(lane_right_valid_w),
      1542: //     .m_frame_upd  (lane_frame_upd_w)
      1543: // );
      1544:
      1545:
      1546: // ===== [2026-09-12] RAW camera path restored =====
      1547: // OptionB commented out cam_prep_link but left cam_s_data undriven, so the
      1548: // camera never wrote DDR -> no frames / no MSI. ov5640_top already emits a
      1549: // complete raw AXI-stream write request, so wire it straight to the raw write
      1550: // engine. The preprocess tap is intentionally NOT used (its TB still fails and
      1551: // its dummy-inject can back-pressure/stall the camera).
      1552: assign cam_s_data         = cam_tap_data;
      1553: assign cam_s_data_valid   = cam_tap_data_valid;
      1554: assign cam_s_data_last    = cam_tap_data_last;
      1555: assign cam_tap_data_ready = cam_s_data_ready;
      1556:
      1557: // preprocess datapath disabled: keep the processed-frame write engine idle
      1558: assign prep_wr_cmd_valid = 1'b0;
      1559: assign prep_wr_cmd_addr  = 32'b0;
      1560: assign prep_wr_cmd_len   = 32'b0;
      1561: assign prep_wr_data      = 128'b0;
      1562: assign prep_wr_valid     = 1'b0;
      1563:
      1564: // processed-frame write engine (second write master -> crossbar S03 AW/W/B)
      1565: wire [AXI_ID_LEN-1:0]   prep2_axi_awid;
      1566: wire [31:0]             prep2_axi_awaddr;
      1567: wire [3:0]              prep2_axi_awlen;
      1568: wire [2:0]              prep2_axi_awsize;
      1569: wire [1:0]              prep2_axi_awburst;
      1570: wire                    prep2_axi_awlock;
      1571: wire [3:0]              prep2_axi_awcache;
      1572: wire [2:0]              prep2_axi_awprot;
      1573: wire                    prep2_axi_awvalid;
      1574: wire                    prep2_axi_awready;
      1575: wire [AXI_DATA_LEN-1:0] prep2_axi_wdata;
      1576: wire [AXI_STRB_LEN-1:0] prep2_axi_wstrb;
      1577: wire                    prep2_axi_wlast;
      1578: wire                    prep2_axi_wvalid;
      1579: wire                    prep2_axi_wready;
      1580: wire [AXI_ID_LEN-1:0]   prep2_axi_bid;
      1581: wire [1:0]              prep2_axi_bresp;
      1582: wire                    prep2_axi_bvalid;
      1583: wire                    prep2_axi_bready;
      1584:
      1585: axi_dma_write #(
      1586:     .BURST_LEN  (BURST_LEN),
      1587:     .ID_WIDTH   (AXI_ID_LEN),
      1588:     .DATA_WIDTH (AXI_DATA_LEN)
      1589: ) prep_axi_dma_write(
      1590:     .clk(axi_clk),
      1591:     .rst(axi_rst),
      1592:     .cmd_valid (prep_wr_cmd_valid),
      1593:     .cmd_addr  (prep_wr_cmd_addr),
      1594:     .cmd_len   (prep_wr_cmd_len),
      1595:     .cmd_id    (4'b0111),
      1596:     .cmd_ready (prep_wr_cmd_ready),
      1597:     .data_in       (prep_wr_data),
      1598:     .data_in_keep  ({AXI_STRB_LEN{1'b1}}),
      1599:     .data_in_valid (prep_wr_valid),
      1600:     .data_in_last  (),
      1601:     .data_in_ready (prep_wr_ready),
      1602:     .m_axi_awid    (prep2_axi_awid),
      1603:     .m_axi_awaddr  (prep2_axi_awaddr),
      1604:     .m_axi_awlen   (prep2_axi_awlen),
      1605:     .m_axi_awsize  (prep2_axi_awsize),
      1606:     .m_axi_awburst (prep2_axi_awburst),
      1607:     .m_axi_awlock  (prep2_axi_awlock),
      1608:     .m_axi_awcache (prep2_axi_awcache),
      1609:     .m_axi_awprot  (prep2_axi_awprot),
      1610:     .m_axi_awvalid (prep2_axi_awvalid),
      1611:     .m_axi_awready (prep2_axi_awready),
      1612:     .m_axi_wdata   (prep2_axi_wdata),
      1613:     .m_axi_wstrb   (prep2_axi_wstrb),
      1614:     .m_axi_wlast   (prep2_axi_wlast),
      1615:     .m_axi_wvalid  (prep2_axi_wvalid),
      1616:     .m_axi_wready  (prep2_axi_wready),
      1617:     .m_axi_bid     (prep2_axi_bid),
      1618:     .m_axi_bresp   (prep2_axi_bresp),
      1619:     .m_axi_bvalid  (prep2_axi_bvalid),
      1620:     .m_axi_bready  (prep2_axi_bready)
      1621: );
      1622: // =================== preprocess datapath end ===================
      1623:
      1624:
      1625: /////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
      1626: wire [AXI_ID_LEN-1:0]   npu_reg_axi_awid    /*synthesis PAP_MARK_DEBUG="1"*/;
      1627: wire [31:0]             npu_reg_axi_awaddr  /*synthesis PAP_MARK_DEBUG="1"*/;
      1628: wire [3:0]              npu_reg_axi_awlen   /*synthesis PAP_MARK_DEBUG="1"*/;
      1629: wire [2:0]              npu_reg_axi_awsize  /*synthesis PAP_MARK_DEBUG="1"*/;
      1630: wire [1:0]              npu_reg_axi_awburst /*synthesis PAP_MARK_DEBUG="1"*/;
      
      ### source/ov5640/ov5640_ddr/ov5640_ddr_w.v
         1: module ov5640_ddr_w #(
         2:     parameter DATA_WIDTH = 24,
         3:     parameter AXI_DATA_WIDTH = 128,
         4:     parameter CAM_DATA_LEN  = 172800, //1280*720*3/16
         5:     parameter DEVICE = "PG"
         6: )(
         7:     input          axi_clk        ,
         8:     input          axi_rst        ,
         9:
        10:     input  [$clog2(CAM_DATA_LEN) : 0]  data_len       /*synthesis PAP_MARK_DEBUG="1"*/, //��16�ֽ�Ϊ��λ
        11:
        12:     input  [DATA_WIDTH-1 :0]       s_data       ,
        13:     input                          s_data_valid ,
        14:     input                          s_vsync      ,
        15:     input                          s_hsync      ,       //û��
        16:
        17:     output [AXI_DATA_WIDTH-1 : 0]  axi_data       /*synthesis PAP_MARK_DEBUG="1"*/,
        18:     output                         axi_data_valid /*synthesis PAP_MARK_DEBUG="1"*/,
        19:     output                         axi_data_last  /*synthesis PAP_MARK_DEBUG="1"*/,
        20:     input                          axi_data_ready /*synthesis PAP_MARK_DEBUG="1"*/,
        21:     output [31:0]                  dbg_axi_cnt,
        22:     output [31:0]                  dbg_axi_num  ,
        23:     // [ZDIAG 2026-09-18] per-frame zero-beat accounting, latched at VSYNC so
        24:     // it can be read reliably once streaming stops.
        25:     output [31:0]                  dbg_zdin     ,  // wr_en && din==0
        26:     output [31:0]                  dbg_zout         // fifo_we && fifo_wd==0
        27: );
        28:
        29:
        30:
        31:
        32:     reg             wr_en;
        33:     reg  [31 : 0]   din  ;
        34:     wire            rd_en;
        35:     wire [AXI_DATA_WIDTH-1 : 0] dout ;
        36:
        37:     wire                        empty;
        38:     wire                        full /*synthesis PAP_MARK_DEBUG="1"*/;
        39:
        40:
        41:
        42:     reg [1 : 0] cnt;
        43:     always @(posedge axi_clk) begin
        44:         if(axi_rst)begin
        45:             cnt <= 2'd0;
        46:         end
        47:         else if(s_data_valid)begin
        48:             cnt <= cnt + 2'd1;
        49:         end
        50:     end
        51: generate
        52:     if(DATA_WIDTH == 24) begin
        53:
        54:         reg [23 : 0]  cam_data_temp;
        55:         always @(posedge axi_clk) begin
        56:             if(s_data_valid)begin
        57:                 case (cnt)
        58:                     2'b00:begin
        59:                         cam_data_temp <= s_data;
        60:                     end
        61:                     2'b01:begin
        62:                         cam_data_temp <= {8'd0, s_data[23:8]};
        63:                     end
        64:                     2'b10:begin
        65:                         cam_data_temp <= {16'd0, s_data[23:16]};
        66:                     end
        67:                     2'b11:begin
        68:                         cam_data_temp <= 24'd0;
        69:                     end
        70:                 endcase
        71:             end
        72:         end
        73:
        74:         always @(posedge axi_clk) begin
        75:             if(s_data_valid)begin
        76:                 case (cnt)
        77:                     2'b01:begin
        78:                         din <= {s_data[7:0], cam_data_temp[23:0]};
        79:                     end
        80:                     2'b10:begin
        81:                         din <= {s_data[15:0], cam_data_temp[15:0]};
        82:                     end
        83:                     2'b11:begin
        84:                         din <= {s_data, cam_data_temp[7:0]};
        85:                     end
        86:                 endcase
        87:             end
        88:         end
        89:
        90:         always @(posedge axi_clk) begin
        91:             if(axi_rst)begin
        92:                 wr_en <= 1'b0;
        93:             end
        94:             else if(s_data_valid & (cnt != 2'b00))begin
        95:                 wr_en <= 1'b1;
        96:             end
        97:             else begin
        98:                 wr_en <= 1'b0;
        99:             end
       100:         end
       101:
       102:     end
       103:     else if(DATA_WIDTH == 16) begin
       104:
       105:         reg [15 : 0] cam_data_temp;
       106:         always @(posedge axi_clk) begin
       107:             if(s_data_valid) begin
       108:                 cam_data_temp <= s_data;
       109:             end
       110:         end
       111:
       112:
       113:         always @(posedge axi_clk) begin
       114:             if(s_data_valid)begin
       115:                 if(cnt[0]) begin
       116:                     din <= {s_data, cam_data_temp};
       117:                 end
       118:             end
       119:         end
       120:
       121:         always @(posedge axi_clk) begin
       122:             if(axi_rst)begin
       123:                 wr_en <= 1'b0;
       124:             end
       125:             else if(s_data_valid & cnt[0])begin
       126:                 wr_en <= 1'b1;
       127:             end
       128:             else begin
       129:                 wr_en <= 1'b0;
       130:             end
       131:         end
       132:
       133:     end
       134:     else if(DATA_WIDTH == 8) begin
       135:
       136:         reg [23 : 0] cam_data_temp;
       137:         always @(posedge axi_clk) begin
       138:             if(s_data_valid) begin
       139:                 cam_data_temp <= {s_data, cam_data_temp[23:8]};
       140:             end
       141:         end
       142:
       143:         always @(posedge axi_clk) begin
       144:             if(s_data_valid)begin
       145:                 if(&cnt) begin
       146:                     din <= {s_data, cam_data_temp};
       147:                 end
       148:             end
       149:         end
       150:
       151:
       152:         always @(posedge axi_clk) begin
       153:             if(axi_rst)begin
       154:                 wr_en <= 1'b0;
       155:             end
       156:             else if(s_data_valid & &cnt)begin
       157:                 wr_en <= 1'b1;
       158:             end
       159:             else begin
       160:                 wr_en <= 1'b0;
       161:             end
       162:         end
       163:
       164:     end
       165: endgenerate
       166:
       167:
       168:
       169:
       170:
       171:
       172:         reg [$clog2(CAM_DATA_LEN) : 0] axi_num/*synthesis PAP_MARK_DEBUG="1"*/;
       173:         reg [$clog2(CAM_DATA_LEN) : 0] axi_cnt/*synthesis PAP_MARK_DEBUG="1"*/;
       174:
       175:         always @(posedge axi_clk) begin
       176:             if(axi_rst)begin
       177:                 axi_num <= 20'd0;
       178:             end
       179:             else begin
       180:                 axi_num <= data_len - 20'd1;
       181:             end
       182:         end
       183:
       184:         always @(posedge axi_clk) begin
       185:             if(axi_rst)begin
       186:                 axi_cnt <= 20'd0;
       187:             end
       188:             else if(s_vsync)begin
       189:                 axi_cnt <= 20'd0;
       190:             end
       191:             else if(axi_data_valid & axi_data_ready)begin
       192:                 if(axi_data_last)begin
       193:                     axi_cnt <= 20'd0;
       194:                 end
       195:                 else begin
       196:                     axi_cnt <= axi_cnt + 20'd1;
       197:                 end
       198:             end
       199:         end
       200:
       201:     // reg test1/*synthesis PAP_MARK_DEBUG="1"*/;
       202:     // always @(posedge axi_clk) begin
       203:     //     if(axi_rst) begin
       204:     //         test1 <= 1'b0;
       205:     //     end
       206:     //     else if(s_vsync && (axi_cnt != 0)) begin
       207:     //         test1 <= 1'b1;
       208:     //     end
       209:     // end
       210:
       211:
       212:     // The distributed FIFO is first-word fall-through with OUTPUT_REG=0:
       213:     // dout already addresses the current head, and rd_en advances it only
       214:     // after the AXI consumer accepts that word.
       215:     assign rd_en = axi_data_valid & axi_data_ready;
       216:     assign axi_data_last = (axi_cnt == axi_num);
       217:     assign axi_data = dout;
       218:     assign axi_data_valid = !empty;
       219:
       220:
       221:
       222:
       223:         wire [AXI_DATA_WIDTH-1 : 0] dout_drm;
       224:         wire                        empty_drm/*synthesis PAP_MARK_DEBUG="1"*/;
       225:         wire                        almost_full_drm;
       226:         wire                        almost_full_out;
       227:         // Do not drain the DRM FIFO unless both stages can accept the word.
       228:         // Without almost_full_out the output FIFO fills during AXI stalls and
       229:         // DRM words are silently dropped -> periodic 128-bit stripes.
       230:         wire rd_en_drm = !(almost_full_drm | empty_drm | almost_full_out);
       231:         ov5640_ddr_fifo_DRM ov5640_ddr_fifo_DRM (
       232:           .clk(axi_clk),                      // input
       233:           .rst(axi_rst),                      // input
       234:           .wr_en(wr_en),                  // input
       235:           .wr_data(din),              // input [31:0]
       236:           .wr_full(full),              // output
       237:
       238:           .rd_en(rd_en_drm),                  // input
       239:           .rd_data(dout_drm),              // output [127:0]
       240:           .rd_empty(empty_drm),            // output
       241:
       242:           .almost_full(almost_full_drm),      // output
       243:           .almost_empty()     // output
       244:         );
       245:
       246:
       247:         // reg rd_en_drm_d;
       248:         // always @(posedge axi_clk) begin
       249:         //     if(axi_rst) begin
       250:         //         rd_en_drm_d <= 1'b0;
       251:         //     end
       252:         //     else begin
       253:         //         rd_en_drm_d <= rd_en_drm;
       254:         //     end
       255:         // end
       256:
       257:         // DRM rd_data is valid one cycle after rd_en. Delay only the write
       258:         // enable; dout_drm is aligned with wr_en_drm on that following cycle.
       259:         reg wr_en_drm;
       260:         always @(posedge axi_clk) begin
       261:             if (axi_rst) begin
       262:                 wr_en_drm <= 1'b0;
       263:             end
       264:             else begin
       265:                 wr_en_drm <= rd_en_drm;
       266:             end
       267:         end
       268:
       269:         wire                     fifo_we  = wr_en_drm;
       270:         wire [AXI_DATA_WIDTH-1:0] fifo_wd = dout_drm;
       271:
       272:         ov5640_ddr_fifo ov5640_ddr_fifo (
       273:           .clk(axi_clk),                      // input
       274:           .rst(axi_rst),                      // input
       275:           .wr_en  (fifo_we ),                  // input
       276:           .wr_data(fifo_wd ),              // input [127:0]
       277:           .full(),              // output
       278:
       279:
       280:           .rd_en(rd_en),                  // input
       281:           .rd_data(dout),              // output [127:0]
       282:           .empty(empty),            // output
       283:
       284:           .almost_full(almost_full_out),      // output
       285:           .almost_empty()     // output
       286:         );
       287:
       288:
       289:
       290:
       291:
       292:
       293:     assign dbg_axi_cnt = axi_cnt;
       294:     assign dbg_axi_num = axi_num;
       295:
       296:     // [ZDIAG 2026-09-18] zero-beat accounting for the stripe hunt.
       297:     reg [31:0] zdin_cnt, zout_cnt;
       298:     reg [31:0] zdin_lat, zout_lat;
       299:     always @(posedge axi_clk) begin
       300:         if (axi_rst) begin
       301:             zdin_cnt <= 32'd0;
       302:             zout_cnt <= 32'd0;
       303:             zdin_lat <= 32'd0;
       304:             zout_lat <= 32'd0;
       305:         end
       306:         else begin
       307:             if (wr_en   && (din      == {32{1'b0}})) zdin_cnt <= zdin_cnt + 32'd1;
       308:             if (fifo_we && (fifo_wd  == {AXI_DATA_WIDTH{1'b0}})) zout_cnt <= zout_cnt + 32'd1;
       309:             if (s_vsync) begin
       310:                 zdin_lat <= zdin_cnt;
       311:                 zout_lat <= zout_cnt;
       312:                 zdin_cnt <= 32'd0;
       313:                 zout_cnt <= 32'd0;
       314:             end
       315:         end
       316:     end
       317:     assign dbg_zdin = zdin_lat;
       318:     assign dbg_zout = zout_lat;
       319:
       320: endmodule
      
      ### source/ov5640/ov5640_ddr/ov5640_ddr_w_ctrl.v
         1: //����CMD����
         2: module ov5640_ddr_w_ctrl #(
         3:     parameter AXI_ADDR_WIDTH = 32,
         4:     parameter AXI_LEN_WIDTH  = 32,
         5:     parameter AXI_DATA_WIDTH = 128,
         6:     parameter CAM_DATA_LEN   = 172800 //1280*720*3/16
         7: )(
         8:     input          axi_clk        ,
         9:     input          axi_rst        ,
        10:
        11:     input  [AXI_ADDR_WIDTH-1 : 0]      cam_data_addr_1,
        12:     input  [AXI_ADDR_WIDTH-1 : 0]      cam_data_addr_2,
        13:     input  [$clog2(CAM_DATA_LEN) : 0]  cam_data_len   , //��16�ֽ�Ϊ��λ
        14:
        15:     input          s_vsync        ,
        16:
        17:     input          dma_done       ,  // [LEDGER 2026-09-19] DMA transaction-done pulse (authoritative beat ledger)
        18:
        19:     output [AXI_ADDR_WIDTH-1 : 0]  axi_cmd_addr   /*synthesis PAP_MARK_DEBUG="1"*/,
        20:     output [AXI_LEN_WIDTH-1 : 0]   axi_cmd_len    /*synthesis PAP_MARK_DEBUG="1"*/,
        21:     output reg                     axi_cmd_valid  /*synthesis PAP_MARK_DEBUG="1"*/,
        22:     input                          axi_cmd_ready  /*synthesis PAP_MARK_DEBUG="1"*/,
        23:
        24:     output [1 : 0]   xdma_req       ,
        25:     input  [1 : 0]   xdma_ack       ,
        26:
        27:     // [FRTAG 2026-09-14] frame-tag injection. After each frame's last stream beat the
        28:     // FSM issues a SECOND 16-byte AXI command writing a 32-bit frame counter to
        29:     // frame_base + CAM_DATA_LEN*16. The wrapper (ov5640_ddr.v) muxes tag_data onto
        30:     // the data stream while tag_active is high. The transaction must complete:
        31:     // aborting it would leave a pending frame with no new tag for the host.
        32:     output                           tag_active     ,
        33:     output [AXI_DATA_WIDTH-1 : 0]    tag_data       ,
        34:     input                            tag_ready,
        35:     output [31:0]                    dbg_state,
        36:     output                           engine_busy,     // [IDLEGATE 2026-09-19] FSM not IDLE (frame or tag in flight)
        37:     output [31:0]                    dbg_last_cnt,
        38:     output [31:0]                    dbg_wd_cnt
        39: );
        40:
        41:     localparam IDLE      = 3'b001;

       211: // [WD 2026-09-18] ------------------------------------------------------------------
       212: // The DVP stream can deliver fewer 128-bit beats than CAM_DATA_LEN (CDC FIFO
       213: // overflow drops pixels and cannot back-pressure the sensor). A frame's AXI
       214: // burst then never completes: trans sticks at 1, cmd_ready stays low and the
       215: // frame FSM deadlocks forever (measured: state=ADDR, axi_cnt=0, 0 frames).
       216: //
       217: // Recovery: if there is no W-beat progress for ~0.17 s while a write is in
       218: // flight, close the open burst with dummy beats. AXI forbids cancelling an
       219: // accepted AW, so we must still supply awlen beats; we just no longer consume
       220: // real camera data. After the B response is absorbed, trans/len clear and the
       221: // next frame's command is accepted again (only the bad frame is lost).
       222: assign w_progress = (t_m_axi_wvalid == 1'b1) && (t_m_axi_wready == 1'b1);
       223:
       224: always @(posedge clk) begin
       225: 	if((rst == 1'b1) || (trans == 1'b0) || (abort_r == 1'b1) || (w_progress == 1'b1))
       226: 		wd_cnt <= 24'd0;
       227: 	else if(wd_cnt != 24'hFFFFFF)
       228: 		wd_cnt <= wd_cnt + 24'd1;
       229: end
       230:
       231: // [BFAST 2026-09-19] the DDR write port can stop returning B responses
       232: // (see [WD2]; re-observed 09-19: b_cnt ~26 total while aw_cnt ~60k).
       233: // Waiting the full 0.17 s watchdog once every command's beats are out
       234: // capped the camera path at ~5 fps. Give B a few microseconds after the
       235: // last beat, then force the close via the abort path; a late B is still
       236: // absorbed by the w_done/bready logic.
       237: reg [9:0] bwait_cnt;
       238: // (w_done intentionally not referenced: it is declared further below and
       239: // act_burst_len==0 && burst_trans already means every beat is out, B pending)
       240: wire all_beats_out = (len == 32'd0) && (act_burst_len == 8'd0) && burst_trans;
       241: always @(posedge clk) begin
       242: 	if((rst == 1'b1) || (trans == 1'b0) || (all_beats_out == 1'b0) || (abort_r == 1'b1))
       243: 		bwait_cnt <= 10'd0;
       244: 	else if(bwait_cnt != 10'h3FF)
       245: 		bwait_cnt <= bwait_cnt + 10'd1;
       246: end
       247: always @(posedge clk) begin
       248: 	if(rst == 1'b1)
       249: 		abort_r <= 1'b0;

       251: 	// can legitimately exceed the 10us grace; force-closing mid-flight corrupted
       252: 	// the crossbar/DDR transaction stream and killed M00 writes within seconds.
       253: 	// Fall back to the long send-watchdog only.
       254: 	else if((abort_r == 1'b0) && (trans == 1'b1) && (wd_cnt == 24'hFFFFFF))
       255: 		abort_r <= 1'b1;
       256: 	else if(abort_done == 1'b1)

       260: // [WD2 2026-09-18] burst_trans is only cleared by the B response, which is
       261: // exactly what never arrives in the wedge case (cam2: bvalid never asserted).
       262: // Requiring burst_trans==0 made abort_done unreachable -> no recovery.
       263: // All W beats for the open burst are out once act_burst_len hits 0, so that
       264: // is the correct release point; burst_trans is force-cleared below.
       265: assign abort_done = abort_r && (act_burst_len == 8'd0);

       268: stream_pipe #(
       269:   .DATA_WIDTH 	(DATA_WIDTH+1+KEEP_WIDTH)
       270: ) stream_pipe_3(
       271:   .dataIn_valid     (t_m_axi_wvalid),
       272:   .dataIn_ready     (t_m_axi_wready),
       273:   .dataIn_payload   ({t_m_axi_wdata, t_m_axi_wstrb, t_m_axi_wlast}),

       281: assign data_in_ready = abort_r ? 1'b0
       282:                                : (t_m_axi_wready && act_burst_len > 8'd0);
       283: assign t_m_axi_wvalid  = abort_r ? (act_burst_len > 8'd0)
       284:                                  : (data_in_valid && act_burst_len > 8'd0);
       285: assign t_m_axi_wdata   = abort_r ? {DATA_WIDTH{1'b0}} : data_in;
       286: assign t_m_axi_wlast   = (act_burst_len == 8'd1);
       287: assign t_m_axi_wstrb   = abort_r ? {KEEP_WIDTH{1'b1}} : data_in_keep;

       291: always @(posedge clk) begin

          parameter KEEP_ENABLE = (DATA_WIDTH>8),
          // tkeep signal width (words per cycle)
          parameter KEEP_WIDTH = ((DATA_WIDTH+7)/8),
          // Propagate tlast signal
          parameter LAST_ENABLE = 1,
          // Propagate tid signal
          parameter ID_ENABLE = 0,
          // tid signal width
          parameter ID_WIDTH = 8,
          // Propagate tdest signal
          parameter DEST_ENABLE = 0,
          // tdest signal width
          parameter DEST_WIDTH = 8,
          // Propagate tuser signal
          parameter USER_ENABLE = 1,
          // tuser signal width
          parameter USER_WIDTH = 1,
          // number of RAM pipeline registers
          parameter RAM_PIPELINE = 1,
          // use output FIFO
          // When set, the RAM read enable and pipeline clock enables are removed
          parameter OUTPUT_FIFO_ENABLE = 0,
          // Frame FIFO mode - operate on frames instead of cycles
          // When set, m_axis_tvalid will not be deasserted within a frame
          // Requires LAST_ENABLE set
          parameter FRAME_FIFO = 0,
          // tuser value for bad frame marker
          parameter USER_BAD_FRAME_VALUE = 1'b1,
          // tuser mask for bad frame marker
          parameter USER_BAD_FRAME_MASK = 1'b1,
          // Drop frames larger than FIFO
          // Requires FRAME_FIFO set
          parameter DROP_OVERSIZE_FRAME = FRAME_FIFO,
          // Drop frames marked bad
          // Requires FRAME_FIFO and DROP_OVERSIZE_FRAME set
          parameter DROP_BAD_FRAME = 0,
          // Drop incoming frames when full
          // When set, s_axis_tready is always asserted
          // Requires FRAME_FIFO and DROP_OVERSIZE_FRAME set
          parameter DROP_WHEN_FULL = 0,
          // Mark incoming frames as bad frames when full
          // When set, s_axis_tready is always asserted
          // Requires FRAME_FIFO to be clear
          parameter MARK_WHEN_FULL = 0,

          parameter PAUSE_ENABLE = 0,
          // Pause between frames
          parameter FRAME_PAUSE = FRAME_FIFO
