      ### source\preprocess\prep_sync_fifo.v
      //============================================================================
      // prep_sync_fifo.v : 同步 FIFO (推断 BRAM, 无 IP 依赖, 仿真/综合一致)
      // 近满 prog_full 用于上游 s_ready 反压, 保证无溢出
      //============================================================================
      module prep_sync_fifo #(
          parameter DW        = 16,
          parameter DEPTH     = 512,                 // 2 的幂
          parameter AW        = $clog2(DEPTH),
          parameter AFULL     = DEPTH - 32           // 近满阈值
      )(
          input  wire        clk,
          input  wire        rst_n,                  // 同步释放由顶层保证
          input  wire        wr_en,
          input  wire [DW-1:0] wr_data,
          input  wire        rd_en,
          output wire [DW-1:0] rd_data,
          output wire        rd_valid,               // 非空
          output wire        prog_full,              // 近满: 计数 >= AFULL
          output wire [AW:0] cnt
      );
      
          reg [DW-1:0] mem [0:DEPTH-1];
          reg [AW:0]   wptr, rptr;
      
          assign cnt       = wptr - rptr;
          assign prog_full = (cnt >= AFULL[AW:0]);
          assign rd_valid  = (cnt != 0);
          assign rd_data   = mem[rptr[AW-1:0]];
      
          always @(posedge clk) begin
              if (wr_en) mem[wptr[AW-1:0]] <= wr_data;
          end
      
          always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
              if (!rst_n)      wptr <= 0;
              else if (wr_en)  wptr <= wptr + 1'b1;
          end
      
          always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
              if (!rst_n)                    rptr <= 0;
              else if (rd_en && rd_valid)    rptr <= rptr + 1'b1;
          end
      
      endmodule
      
      ### source\npu\common\fifo_ram.v
      module fifo_ram #(
          parameter DATA_WIDTH = 8,
          parameter DATA_DEPTH = 16,
          parameter ADDR_WIDTH = $clog2(DATA_DEPTH)
      )(
          input wire clk,
          input wire wen,
          input wire [DATA_WIDTH-1:0] din,
          input wire [ADDR_WIDTH-1:0] waddr,
          input wire ren,
          input wire [ADDR_WIDTH-1:0] raddr,
          output wire [DATA_WIDTH-1:0] dout
      );
      
          reg [DATA_WIDTH-1:0] mem [0:DATA_DEPTH-1];
      
          always @(posedge clk) begin
              if(wen) begin
                  mem[waddr] <= din;
              end
          end
      
      
          // 读操作：必须是在时钟沿触发的同步读
          reg [DATA_WIDTH-1:0] dout_r;
          always @(posedge clk) begin
              if(ren) begin
                 dout_r <= mem[raddr];
              end
          end
          assign dout = dout_r;
      
      
      
      
      endmodule
      
      ### source\npu\common\sync_fifo.v
      module sync_fifo #(
          parameter DATA_WIDTH = 8,
          parameter DATA_DEPTH = 16,
          // --- 新增：水位阈值参数 ---
          parameter ALMOST_FULL_NUM  = 12, // 高水位阈值：达到或超过此值时 almost_full 拉高
          parameter ALMOST_EMPTY_NUM = 4   // 低水位阈值：等于或低于此值时 almost_empty 拉高
      )(
          input  wire clk,
          input  wire rst,
          input  wire wr_en,
          input  wire rd_en,
          input  wire [DATA_WIDTH-1 : 0] din,
          output wire [DATA_WIDTH-1 : 0] dout,
          output wire full,
          output wire empty,
      
          // --- 新增：水位指示输出端口 ---
          output wire [$clog2(DATA_DEPTH) : 0] fifo_cnt, // 精确水位：当前FIFO中的数据个数
          output wire almost_full,                           // 高水位指示（将满）
          output wire almost_empty                           // 低水位指示（将空）
      );
      
          localparam ADDR_WIDTH = $clog2(DATA_DEPTH);
      
          reg [DATA_WIDTH-1 : 0] mem [0 : DATA_DEPTH-1];
      
          reg [ADDR_WIDTH-1 : 0] wr_ptr = 0;
          reg [ADDR_WIDTH-1 : 0] rd_ptr = 0;
          reg [ADDR_WIDTH : 0] count = 0;   // 数据计数器
      
          wire ren;
          wire [DATA_WIDTH-1:0] ram_dout;
      
          // 实例化同步RAM
          fifo_ram #(
              .DATA_WIDTH(DATA_WIDTH),
              .DATA_DEPTH(DATA_DEPTH)
          )
          FIFO_BRAM(
              .clk(clk),
              .wen(wr_en && !full),
              .waddr(wr_ptr),
              .din(din),
              .ren(ren),
              .raddr(rd_ptr),
              .dout(ram_dout)
          );
      
          // FWFT相关信号
          reg dout_valid = 0;
      
          // 输出直接连接寄存器
          assign dout = ram_dout;
          assign empty = ~dout_valid;
          assign full = (count == DATA_DEPTH);
      
          // --- 新增：水位指示的组合逻辑赋值 ---
          assign fifo_cnt = count;
          assign almost_full  = (count >= ALMOST_FULL_NUM);
          assign almost_empty = (count <= ALMOST_EMPTY_NUM);
          // ------------------------------------
      
          assign ren = (~dout_valid && count > 0) || (rd_en && ~empty && (count > 1));
      
          // 写操作
          always @(posedge clk) begin
              if (rst) begin
                  wr_ptr <= 0;
              end
              else if (wr_en && !full) begin
                  if(wr_ptr == DATA_DEPTH-1) begin
                      wr_ptr <= 0;
                  end
                  else begin
                      wr_ptr <= wr_ptr + 1;
                  end
              end
          end
      
          // 读操作和FWFT逻辑
          always @(posedge clk) begin
              if (rst) begin
                  rd_ptr <= 0;
                  dout_valid <= 0;
                  count <= 0;
              end
              else begin
                  // 更新数据计数器
                  case ({wr_en && ~full, rd_en && ~empty})
                      2'b01: count <= count - 1;
                      2'b10: count <= count + 1;
                      default: count <= count;
                  endcase
      
                  // FWFT逻辑
                  if (~dout_valid && count > 0) begin
                      // FWFT特性：当输出无效但FIFO不空时，自动加载第一个数据
                      dout_valid <= 1;
                      rd_ptr <= (rd_ptr == DATA_DEPTH - 1) ? 0 : rd_ptr + 1;
                  end
                  else if (rd_en && ~empty) begin
                      // 正常读取
                      if(count > 1) begin
                          rd_ptr <= (rd_ptr == DATA_DEPTH - 1) ? 0 : rd_ptr + 1;
                      end
      
                      if (count > 1) begin
                          dout_valid <= 1;
                      end
                      else begin            // 如果读取后 FIFO 为空，则取消 valid
                          dout_valid <= 0;
                      end
                  end
              end
          end
      
      endmodule
      
      ### source\npu\common\sync_fifo_replay.v
      module sync_fifo_replay #(
          parameter DATA_WIDTH = 8,
          parameter DATA_DEPTH = 16
      )(
          input wire clk,
          input wire rst,
          input wire rewind,        // 【新增】重读使能信号，高电平有效
          input wire wr_en,
          input wire rd_en,
          input wire [DATA_WIDTH-1 : 0] din,
          output wire [DATA_WIDTH-1 : 0] dout,
          output wire full,

      );
      
          localparam ADDR_WIDTH = $clog2(DATA_DEPTH);
      
          reg [DATA_WIDTH-1 : 0] mem [0 : DATA_DEPTH-1];
      
      
          // 内部指针
          reg [ADDR_WIDTH-1 : 0] wr_ptr = 0;
          reg [ADDR_WIDTH-1 : 0] rd_ptr = 0;
          reg [ADDR_WIDTH : 0] count = 0;   // 数据计数器
      
      
      
          wire ren;
          wire [DATA_WIDTH-1:0] ram_dout;
          // 实例化同步RAM
          fifo_ram #(
              .DATA_WIDTH(DATA_WIDTH),
              .DATA_DEPTH(DATA_DEPTH)
          )
          FIFO_BRAM(
              .clk(clk),
              .wen(wr_en && !full),
              .waddr(wr_ptr),
              .din(din),
      
              .ren(ren),
              .raddr(rd_ptr),
              .dout(ram_dout)
          );
      
      
          // FWFT相关信号
          reg dout_valid = 0;
      
      
          // 输出直接连接寄存器
          assign dout = ram_dout;
          // 只要 dout_valid 为 1，就不空（FWFT特性）
          assign empty = ~dout_valid;
          assign full = (count == DATA_DEPTH);
          assign ren = (~dout_valid && count > 0) || (rd_en && ~empty && (count > 1));
      
          // 写操作 (保持不变，但增加 rewind 时的保护可选用)
          always @(posedge clk) begin
              if (rst) begin
                  wr_ptr <= 0;
              end
              else if (wr_en && !full) begin
                  if(wr_ptr == DATA_DEPTH-1) begin
                      wr_ptr <= 0;
                  end
                  else begin
                      wr_ptr <= wr_ptr + 1;
                  end
              end
          end
      
          // 读操作、FWFT逻辑 和 Rewind逻辑
          always @(posedge clk) begin
              if (rst) begin
                  rd_ptr <= 0;
                  dout_valid <= 0;
                  count <= 0;
              end
              else if (rewind) begin
                  // 【新增】重读逻辑核心
                  // 1. 读指针归零
                  rd_ptr <= 0;
      
                  // 2. 清除当前输出有效位，迫使 FWFT 逻辑在下个周期重新从地址 0 加载数据
                  dout_valid <= 0;
      
                  // 3. 重置计数器
                  // 逻辑：剩下的可读数据 = 已经写入的数据位置 (假设从0写到wr_ptr)
                  // 注意：如果 wr_ptr 绕回了 0 (写满了)，这里需要特殊处理防止 count 变成 0
                  if (wr_ptr == 0 && count != 0)
                      count <= DATA_DEPTH; // 如果本来是满的，rewind 后还是满的
                  else
                      count <= wr_ptr;     // 否则 count 等于当前写指针的位置
              end
              else begin
                  // --------------------------------------------------------
                  // 1. 更新数据计数器 (常规读写)
                  // --------------------------------------------------------
                  case ({wr_en && ~full, rd_en && ~empty})
                      2'b01: count <= count - 1;
                      2'b10: count <= count + 1;
                      default: count <= count;
                  endcase
      
                  // --------------------------------------------------------
                  // 2. FWFT 预取逻辑
                  // --------------------------------------------------------
                  // 场景 A: 输出无效(刚复位或刚rewind) 且 RAM 里有数据
                  if (~dout_valid && count > 0) begin
                      dout_valid <= 1;
                      // 指针移动到下一个位置，准备下一次读取
                      rd_ptr <= (rd_ptr == DATA_DEPTH - 1) ? 0 : rd_ptr + 1;
                  end
                  // 场景 B: 外部正在读取，且 FIFO 不空
                  else if (rd_en && ~empty) begin
                      // 如果 RAM 里还有剩余数据 (>1 说明除了当前输出的，里面还有)
                      if (count > 1) begin
                          dout_valid <= 1;
                          rd_ptr <= (rd_ptr == DATA_DEPTH - 1) ? 0 : rd_ptr + 1;
      
      ### source\pcie_dma\pcie_dma_ctrl\pgs_pciex4_prefetch_fifo_v1_2.v
      //******************************************************************
      // Copyright (c) 2015 PANGO MICROSYSTEMS, INC
      // ALL RIGHTS REVERVED.
      //******************************************************************
      
      `timescale 1ns/1ps
      
      module pgs_pciex4_prefetch_fifo_v1_2
          #(
             parameter D = 16, //should be 2^N
             parameter W = 8,
             parameter TYPE = "Distributed"  // "Distributed" or "DRM"
           )
          (
            input                     clk,
            input                     rst_n,
      
            input                     data_in_valid,
            input  [W-1:0]            data_in,
            output                    data_in_ready,
      
            input                     data_out_ready,
            output [W-1:0]            data_out,
            output                    data_out_valid
          );
      
      //===================================================================
      //     Type        |  Latency   |   ADDR_WIDTH   |   Data width
      // "Distributed"   |    2       |      4~10      |     1~256
      // "DRM"           |    3       |      9~20      |     1~1152
      //===================================================================
      
      reg                         fifo_vld;
      reg                         rd_en_ff1;
      reg  [2:0]                  shift_vld;
      reg  [W-1:0]                rd_data_ff1;
      
      wire [W-1:0]                rd_data;
      wire                        pop;
      wire                        wr_en;
      wire                        rd_en;
      wire                        empty;
      wire                        full;
      wire                        rst;
      
      //
      assign wr_en = data_in_valid & ~full;
      assign data_in_ready = ~full;
      assign rst = ~rst_n;
      
      //
      generate
      if (TYPE == "Distributed") //"Distributed"
      begin
          localparam DEPTH = (D < 16) ? 16 : D;
          assign rd_en = ~empty & (~data_out_valid | data_out_ready);
          assign data_out_valid = fifo_vld;
          always@(posedge clk or negedge rst_n)
          begin
              if(!rst_n)
                  fifo_vld <= 1'b0;
              else if (rd_en)
                  fifo_vld <= 1'b1;
              else if (data_out_ready)
                  fifo_vld <= 1'b0;
          end
      
          assign data_out = rd_data_ff1;
          always@(posedge clk or negedge rst_n)
          begin
              if (!rst_n)
                  rd_data_ff1 <= 1'b0;
              else if (rd_en)
                  rd_data_ff1 <= rd_data;
          end
      
          // distributed_fifo
          pgs_pciex4_fifo_v1_2
              #(
                .DATA_WIDTH ( W           ),
                .ADDR_WIDTH ( log2(DEPTH) ),
                .OUT_REG    ( 0           )
               )
              pgs_pciex4_fifo
              (
              .clk            ( clk      ),
              .rst_n          ( rst_n    ),
              .wr_data        ( data_in  ),
              .wr_en          ( wr_en    ),
              .full           ( full     ),
              .rd_data        ( rd_data  ),
              .rd_en          ( rd_en    ),
              .empty          ( empty    )
              );
      end
      else  //"DRM"
      begin
          localparam DEPTH = (D < 512) ? 512 : D;
          assign rd_en = (~shift_vld[2] | data_out_ready) & ~empty;
          always@(posedge clk or negedge rst_n)
          begin
              if (!rst_n)
                  rd_en_ff1 <= 1'b0;
              else
                  rd_en_ff1 <= rd_en;
          end
      
          assign pop = data_out_valid & data_out_ready;
          always@(posedge clk or negedge rst_n)
          begin
              if(!rst_n)
                  shift_vld <= 3'b001;
              else
              begin
                  case ({rd_en, pop})
                      2'b10: shift_vld <= {shift_vld[1:0], shift_vld[2]};
                      2'b01: shift_vld <= {shift_vld[0], shift_vld[2:1]};
                  endcase
              end
          end

      ////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
      
      `timescale 1 ns / 1 ps
      
      module ipm_distributed_sdpram_v1_2_distributed_fifo
          #(
            parameter  ADDR_WIDTH     	      = 4          ,    //address width   range:4-10
            parameter  DATA_WIDTH     	      = 4          ,    //data width      range:1-256
            parameter  RST_TYPE                 = "ASYNC"    ,    //reset type   "ASYNC" "SYNC"
            parameter  OUT_REG                  = 0          ,    //output options :non_register(0)  register(1)
            parameter  INIT_FILE                = "NONE"     ,    //legal value:"NONE" or "initial file name"
            parameter  FILE_FORMAT              = "BIN"           //initial data format : "BIN" or "HEX"
           )
           (
            input   wire [DATA_WIDTH-1:0]       wr_data      ,
            input   wire [ADDR_WIDTH-1:0]       wr_addr      ,
            input   wire [ADDR_WIDTH-1:0]       rd_addr      ,
            input   wire                        wr_clk       ,
            input   wire                        rd_clk       ,
            input   wire                        wr_en        ,
            input   wire                        rst          ,
            output  wire [DATA_WIDTH-1:0]       rd_data
           )/* synthesis syn_ramstyle = "select_ram" */;
      
      
      wire                                      asyn_rst     ;
      wire                                      syn_rst      ;
      wire  [DATA_WIDTH-1:0]                    q            ;
      reg   [DATA_WIDTH-1:0]                    q_reg        ;
      
      reg   [DATA_WIDTH-1:0]                    mem [2**ADDR_WIDTH-1:0];
      
      //***********************************************************************reset*******************************************************************
      assign  asyn_rst  = (RST_TYPE == "ASYNC") ? rst : 0  ;
      assign  syn_rst   = (RST_TYPE == "SYNC" ) ? rst : 0  ;
      
      //initialize sdpram
      generate
          integer i,j;
          if (INIT_FILE != "NONE") begin
              if (FILE_FORMAT == "BIN") begin
                  initial begin
                      $readmemb(INIT_FILE,mem);
                  end
              end
              else if (FILE_FORMAT == "HEX") begin
                  initial begin
                      $readmemh(INIT_FILE,mem);
                  end
              end
          end
          else begin
              initial begin
                  for (i=0;i<2**ADDR_WIDTH;i=i+1) begin
                      for (j=0;j<DATA_WIDTH;j=j+1) begin
                          mem[i][j] = 1'b0;
                      end
                  end
              end
          end
      endgenerate
      
      //write & read
      generate
          always @(posedge wr_clk) begin
              if(wr_en)
                  mem[wr_addr] <= wr_data;
          end
      
          assign q = mem[rd_addr];
      
          if (RST_TYPE == "ASYNC") begin
              always@(posedge rd_clk or posedge asyn_rst)
              begin
                  if(asyn_rst)
                      q_reg <= {DATA_WIDTH{1'b0}};
                  else
                      q_reg <= q;
              end
          end
          else if (RST_TYPE == "SYNC") begin
              always@(posedge rd_clk)
              begin
                  if(syn_rst)
                      q_reg <= {DATA_WIDTH{1'b0}};
                  else
                      q_reg <= q;
              end
          end
      endgenerate
      
      assign rd_data = (OUT_REG == 1) ? q_reg : q;
      
      endmodule
      
      ### source\pcie_dma\pcie_dma_ctrl\fifo\pgs_pciex4_fifo_ctrl.v
      //******************************************************************
      // Copyright (c) 2015 PANGO MICROSYSTEMS, INC
      // ALL RIGHTS REVERVED.
      //******************************************************************
      
      `timescale 1ns/1ps
      
      module pgs_pciex4_fifo_ctrl #(
          parameter  ADDR_WIDTH  = 9
      )
      ( input                                 clk            ,
        input                                 rst_n          ,
        input                                 w_en           ,
        output reg [ADDR_WIDTH-1 : 0]         wr_addr         ,
        output reg                            wfull          ,
      
        input                                 r_en           ,
        output reg  [ADDR_WIDTH-1 : 0]        rd_addr        ,
        output reg                            rempty
      
      );
      
      reg [ADDR_WIDTH-1 : 0] fifo_cnt;
      
      always@(posedge clk or negedge rst_n)
      begin
          if (!rst_n)
              fifo_cnt <= {ADDR_WIDTH{1'b0}};
          else
              case({w_en, r_en})
                 2'b10: fifo_cnt <= fifo_cnt + {{(ADDR_WIDTH-1){1'b0}}, 1'b1};
                 2'b01: fifo_cnt <= fifo_cnt - {{(ADDR_WIDTH-1){1'b0}}, 1'b1};
              endcase
      end
      
      always@(posedge clk or negedge rst_n)
      begin
          if (!rst_n)
              wr_addr <=  {ADDR_WIDTH{1'b0}};
          else if(w_en)
              wr_addr <= wr_addr + {{(ADDR_WIDTH-1){1'b0}}, 1'b1};
      end
      
      always@(posedge clk or negedge rst_n)
      begin
          if (!rst_n)
              rd_addr <=  {ADDR_WIDTH{1'b0}};
          else if(r_en)
              rd_addr <= rd_addr + {{(ADDR_WIDTH-1){1'b0}}, 1'b1};
      end
      
      //FIFO full
      always@(posedge clk or negedge rst_n)
      begin
          if (!rst_n)
              wfull <= 1'b0;
          else if ( (fifo_cnt == {{(ADDR_WIDTH-1){1'b1}}, 1'b0}) & w_en & ~r_en )
              wfull <= 1'b1;
          else if (~w_en & r_en)
              wfull <= 1'b0;
      end
      
      //FIFO empty
      always@(posedge clk or negedge rst_n)
      begin
          if (!rst_n)
              rempty <= 1'b1;
          else if ( (fifo_cnt == {{(ADDR_WIDTH-1){1'b0}}, 1'b1}) & ~w_en & r_en )
              rempty <= 1'b1;
          else if (w_en & ~r_en)
              rempty <= 1'b0;
      end
      
      endmodule

      //******************************************************************
      // Copyright (c) 2015 PANGO MICROSYSTEMS, INC
      // ALL RIGHTS REVERVED.
      //******************************************************************
      
      `timescale 1ns/1ps
      
      module pgs_pciex4_fifo_v1_2 #(
        parameter  ADDR_WIDTH               = 10            ,  // fifo depth width 4 -- 10
        parameter  DATA_WIDTH               = 32            ,  // write data width 1 -- 256
        parameter  OUT_REG                  = 0
      )
      (
         input                               clk             ,  // input write clock
         input                               rst_n           ,  // input write reset
      
         input     [DATA_WIDTH-1 : 0]        wr_data         ,  // input write data
         input                               wr_en           ,  // input write enable 1 active
         output                              full            ,  // output write full  flag 1 active
      
      
         output    [DATA_WIDTH-1 : 0]        rd_data         ,  // output read data
         input                               rd_en           ,  // input  read enable
         output                              empty             // output read empty
      );
      
       wire  [ADDR_WIDTH-1 : 0]  wr_addr         ;
       wire  [ADDR_WIDTH-1 : 0]  rd_addr         ;
       wire                      wr_en_tmp       ;
       wire                      rd_en_tmp       ;
      
      assign   wr_en_tmp =  wr_en & (~full);
      assign   rd_en_tmp =  rd_en & (~empty);
      
      //instance sdpram
      ipm_distributed_sdpram_v1_2_distributed_fifo
      #(
       .ADDR_WIDTH(ADDR_WIDTH )  ,    //address width   range:4-10
       .DATA_WIDTH(DATA_WIDTH )  ,    //data width      range:4-256
       .RST_TYPE  ("ASYNC"   )  ,    //reset type   "ASYNC_RESET" "SYNC_RESET"
       .OUT_REG   (OUT_REG    )
       ) ipm_distributed_sdpram_distributed_fifo
       (
        .wr_data  (wr_data    )  ,
        .wr_addr  (wr_addr    )  ,
        .rd_addr  (rd_addr    )  ,
        .wr_clk   (clk        )  ,
        .rd_clk   (clk        )  ,
        .wr_en    (wr_en_tmp  )  ,
        .rst      (~rst_n     )  ,
        .rd_data  (rd_data    )
       );
      
      pgs_pciex4_fifo_ctrl
       #(
        .ADDR_WIDTH       (ADDR_WIDTH      )
        ) pgs_pciex4_fifo_ctrl
        (
        .clk              (clk             ),            //write clock
        .w_en             (wr_en_tmp       ),             //write enable 1 active
        .wr_addr          (wr_addr         ),           //write address          //write reset
        .wfull            (full            ),           //write full flag 1 active
        .r_en             (rd_en_tmp       ),            //read enable 1 active
        .rd_addr          (rd_addr         ),          //read address
        .rst_n            (rst_n           ),         //read reset
        .rempty           (empty           )         //read empty  1 active
      );
      
      endmodule //pgs_pciex4_fifo

       (

        empty           ,

          localparam ADDR_WIDTH = 4 ; //@IPC int 4,10

        .DATA_WIDTH       (DATA_WIDTH      ) ,  // write data width 4 -- 256
        .OUT_REG          (OUT_REG         ) ,  // output register   legal value:0 or 1

      `timescale   1ns / 1ps
      
      module  ov5640_ddr_fifo_tb ();
      
          localparam T_CLK_PERIOD = 10  ; //clock a half perid
          localparam T_RST_TIME   = 200 ; //reset time
      
          localparam ADDR_WIDTH = 4 ; //@IPC int 4,10
      
          localparam DATA_WIDTH = 128 ; //@IPC int 1,256
      
          localparam OUT_REG = 0 ; //@IPC bool
      
          localparam RST_TYPE = "SYNC" ; //@IPC enum ASYNC,SYNC
      
          localparam FIFO_TYPE = "SYNC_FIFO" ; //@IPC enum ASYNC_FIFO,SYNC_FIFO
      
          localparam ALMOST_FULL_NUM = 15 ; //@IPC int 4,1024
      
          localparam ALMOST_EMPTY_NUM = 4 ; //@IPC int 4,1024
      
          localparam WR_WATER_LEVEL_ENABLE = 0 ; //@IPC bool
      
          localparam RD_WATER_LEVEL_ENABLE = 0 ; //@IPC bool
      
      
      // variable declaration
          reg                       clk_tb            ;
          reg                       tb_rst            ;
          reg   [DATA_WIDTH-1:0]    tb_wrdata         ;
          wire  [DATA_WIDTH-1:0]    tb_rddata         ;
          reg                       tb_wr_en          ;
          reg                       tb_rd_en          ;
      
          wire                      tb_full           ;
          wire                      tb_empty          ;
          wire                      tb_almost_full    ;
          wire                      tb_almost_empty   ;
          reg                       check_err         ;
          reg   [2:0]               results_cnt       ;
          reg   [ADDR_WIDTH:0]      write_numbers     ;
          reg   [ADDR_WIDTH:0]      read_numbers      ;
          reg   [DATA_WIDTH-1:0]    tb_rddata_cnt     ;
          wire  [DATA_WIDTH-1:0]    tb_rddata_expect  ;
          reg   [DATA_WIDTH-1:0]    tb_rddata_cnt_d1  ;
          reg   [DATA_WIDTH-1:0]    tb_rddata_cnt_d2  ;
      
          wire                      cnt_en            ;
      //********************************************** CGU ****************************************************************************
      //generate clk_tb
      initial
      begin
          clk_tb = 0;
          forever #(T_CLK_PERIOD/2)  clk_tb = ~clk_tb ;
      end
      
      //********************************************** DGU ********************************************************************************
      
      assign cnt_en = tb_rd_en && (!tb_empty) ;
      
      
      always@(posedge clk_tb or posedge tb_rst) begin
        if(tb_rst)
            tb_rddata_cnt<=0;
        else if ( cnt_en )
            tb_rddata_cnt <= tb_rddata_cnt + 1;
        else
            tb_rddata_cnt <= 0;
      end
      
      always@(posedge clk_tb or posedge tb_rst) begin
        if(tb_rst)
        begin
            tb_rddata_cnt_d1<=0;
        end
        else
        begin
            tb_rddata_cnt_d1 <= tb_rddata_cnt;
        end
      end
      
      assign  tb_rddata_expect = (OUT_REG==1) ? tb_rddata_cnt_d1 : tb_rddata_cnt;
      
      initial begin
      
          tb_rst    = 1;
          tb_wrdata = 0;
          tb_wr_en  = 0;
          tb_rd_en  = 0;
      
          #T_RST_TIME;
          tb_rst   = 0;
          #15        ;
      
          //write fifo task
          $display("writing fifo");
          write_fifo;
          #10       ;
          //read fifo task;
          $display("reading fifo");
          read_fifo ;
          #10       ;
          $display("Simulation done");

      reg [DEPTH : 0]  wrptr1             /* synthesis syn_preserve=1 */;          //1st read-domain to write-domain synchronizer
      reg [DEPTH : 0]  wrptr2             ;          //2nd read-domain to write-domain synchronizer
      reg [DEPTH : 0]  wbin               ;          //write current binary  pointer
      reg [DEPTH : 0]  wbnext             ;          //write next binary  pointer
      reg [DEPTH : 0]  wgnext             ;          //write next gray pointer
      reg              waddr_msb          ;          //the MSB of waddr
      wire             wgnext_2ndmsb      ;          //the second MSB of wgnex
      wire             wrptr2_2ndmsb      ;          //the second MSB of wrptr2
      
      //read address operation variables
      reg [DEPTH : 0]  rptr               /* synthesis syn_preserve=1 */;          //read pointer
      reg [DEPTH : 0]  rwptr1             /* synthesis syn_preserve=1 */;          //1st  write-domain to read-domain synchronizer
      reg [DEPTH : 0]  rwptr2             ;          //2nd  write-domain to read-domain synchronizer
      reg [DEPTH : 0]  rbin               ;          //read current binary  pointer
      reg [DEPTH : 0]  rbnext             ;          //read next binary  pointer
      reg [DEPTH : 0]  rgnext             ;          //read next gray pointer
      reg              raddr_msb          ;          //the MSB of raddr
      
      reg [DEPTH : 0]  wrptr2_b           ;          //wrptr2 into binary
      reg [DEPTH : 0]  rwptr2_b           ;          //rwptr2 into binary
      //**************************************************************************************************************
      reg              asyn_wfull         ;
      reg              asyn_almost_full   ;
      reg              asyn_rempty        ;
      reg              asyn_almost_empty  ;
      reg              syn_wfull          ;
      reg              syn_almost_full    ;
      reg              syn_rempty         ;
      reg              syn_almost_empty   ;
      //main code
      //**************************************************************************************************************
      
      generate
      if(FIFO_TYPE == "ASYNC_FIFO")
      begin:ASYN_CTRL
      //write gray pointer generate
          integer  i;
          always@(*)
          begin
              for(i = 0;i <= DEPTH;i = i+1 )  //gray to binary converter
                  wbin[i] = ^(wptr >> i);
          end
          always@(*)
          begin
              if(!wfull)
                  wbnext = wbin + w_en;
              else
                  wbnext = wbin;
          end
          always@(*)
          begin
              wgnext = (wbnext >> 1) ^ wbnext;          //binary to gray converter
          end
          always@( posedge wr_clk or posedge wrst )
          begin
              if(wrst)
              begin
                  wptr <=0;
                  waddr_msb <=0;
              end
              else
              begin
                 wptr <= wgnext;
                 waddr_msb <= wgnext[DEPTH] ^ wgnext[DEPTH-1];
              end
          end
          //read domain to write domain synchronizer
          always@( posedge wr_clk or posedge wrst )
          begin
              if(wrst)
                  {wrptr2,wrptr1} <= 0;
              else
                  {wrptr2,wrptr1} <= {wrptr1,rptr};
          end

        input                               wr_rst          ,  // input write reset

        input                               rd_clk          ,  // input  read clock

      #(
       .ADDR_WIDTH(ADDR_WIDTH )  ,    //address width   range:4-10
       .DATA_WIDTH(DATA_WIDTH )  ,    //data width      range:4-256
       .RST_TYPE  (RST_TYPE   )  ,    //reset type   "ASYNC_RESET" "SYNC_RESET"

       ) ipm_distributed_sdpram_ov5640_ddr_fifo

      //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
      //
      // Library:
      // Filename:ipm_distributed_sdpram_v1_3_ov5640_ddr_fifo.v
      ////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
      
      `timescale 1 ns / 1 ps
      
      module ipm_distributed_sdpram_v1_3_ov5640_ddr_fifo
          #(
            parameter  ADDR_WIDTH               = 4          ,    //address width   range:4-10
            parameter  DATA_WIDTH               = 4          ,    //data width      range:1-256
            parameter  RST_TYPE                 = "ASYNC"    ,    //reset type   "ASYNC" "SYNC"
            parameter  OUT_REG                  = 0          ,    //output options :non_register(0)  register(1)
            parameter  INIT_FILE                = "NONE"     ,    //legal value:"NONE" or "initial file name"
            parameter  FILE_FORMAT              = "BIN"           //initial data format : "BIN" or "HEX"
           )
           (
            input   wire [DATA_WIDTH-1:0]       wr_data      ,
            input   wire [ADDR_WIDTH-1:0]       wr_addr      ,
            input   wire [ADDR_WIDTH-1:0]       rd_addr      ,
            input   wire                        wr_clk       ,
            input   wire                        rd_clk       ,
            input   wire                        wr_en        ,
            input   wire                        rst          ,
            output  wire [DATA_WIDTH-1:0]       rd_data
           )/* synthesis syn_ramstyle = "select_ram" */;
      
      
      wire                                      asyn_rst     ;
      wire                                      syn_rst      ;
      wire  [DATA_WIDTH-1:0]                    q            ;
      reg   [DATA_WIDTH-1:0]                    q_reg        ;
      
      reg   [DATA_WIDTH-1:0]                    mem [2**ADDR_WIDTH-1:0];
      
      //***********************************************************************reset*******************************************************************
      assign  asyn_rst  = (RST_TYPE == "ASYNC") ? rst : 0  ;
      assign  syn_rst   = (RST_TYPE == "SYNC" ) ? rst : 0  ;
      
      //initialize sdpram
      generate
          integer i;
          if (INIT_FILE != "NONE") begin
              if (FILE_FORMAT == "BIN") begin
                  initial begin
                      $readmemb(INIT_FILE,mem);
                  end
              end
              else if (FILE_FORMAT == "HEX") begin
                  initial begin
                      $readmemh(INIT_FILE,mem);
                  end
              end
          end
          else begin
              initial begin
                  for (i=0;i<2**ADDR_WIDTH;i=i+1) begin
                      mem[i] = {DATA_WIDTH{1'b0}};
                  end
              end
          end
      endgenerate
      
      //write & read
      generate
          always @(posedge wr_clk) begin
              if(wr_en)
                  mem[wr_addr] <= wr_data;
          end
      
          assign q = mem[rd_addr];
      
          if (RST_TYPE == "ASYNC") begin
              always@(posedge rd_clk or posedge asyn_rst)
              begin
                  if(asyn_rst)
                      q_reg <= {DATA_WIDTH{1'b0}};
                  else
                      q_reg <= q;
              end
          end
          else if (RST_TYPE == "SYNC") begin
              always@(posedge rd_clk)
              begin
                  if(syn_rst)
                      q_reg <= {DATA_WIDTH{1'b0}};
                  else
                      q_reg <= q;
              end
          end
      endgenerate
      
      assign rd_data = (OUT_REG == 1) ? q_reg : q;
      
      endmodule

      //wire                        wgnext_2ndmsb   ;          //the second MSB of wgnext

      //1st  write-domain to read-domain synchronizer

      reg [c_WR_DEPTH_WIDTH : 0]  rwptr2          ;          //2nd  write-domain to read-domain synchronizer

      reg                         asyn_almost_full    ;

      reg                         asyn_almost_empty   ;
      reg                         syn_wfull           ;
      reg                         syn_almost_full     ;
      reg                         syn_rempty          ;
      reg                         syn_almost_empty    ;
      
      wire    [c_WR_DEPTH_WIDTH:0]    wwptr;
      wire    [c_WR_DEPTH_WIDTH:0]    wrptr;
      wire    [c_RD_DEPTH_WIDTH:0]    rwptr;
      wire    [c_RD_DEPTH_WIDTH:0]    rrptr;

              //write gray pointer generate

                  if(!wfull)
                      wbnext = wbin + w_en;

       252:     // ------------- VIP: RGB565 3x3 median filter, cam1 only -------------
       253:     // Taps the 16-bit RGB565 stream produced by the capture block and hands it to
       254:     // the DDR write packer. The module owns 2 line buffers (~2 lines of latency),
       255:     // re-times vsync and drops the camera tail dummy beat, so ov5640_ddr still sees
       256:     // exactly W*H pixels per frame. MEDIAN_EN=0 selects a pure wire bypass, so a
       257:     // camera without filtering keeps its original timing and uses no BRAM.
       258:     wire                    sh_video_valid;
       259:     wire [DATA_WIDTH-1 : 0] sh_video_data ;
       260:     wire                    sh_video_vsync;
       261:
       262:     generate
       263:         if (MEDIAN_EN) begin : g_median
       264:             vip #(
       265:                 .W       (H_CMOS_DISP),
       266:                 .H       (V_CMOS_DISP),
       267:                 .STRIDE  (1024),
       268:                 .AW      (10),
       269:                 // Keep the retimed frame marker separate from data without
       270:                 // creating a large producer/consumer backlog at frame end.
       271:                 .GAP_LEN (8)
       272:             ) u_vip (
       273:                 .clk       (video_clk      ),
       274:                 .rst       (video_rst      ),
       275:                 .en        (1'b1           ),
       276:                 .strength  (MEDIAN_RSVD    ),
       277:                 .in_valid  (video_valid    ),
       278:                 .in_pixel  (video_data     ),
       279:                 .in_vsync  (video_vsync    ),
       280:                 .out_valid (sh_video_valid ),
       281:                 .out_pixel (sh_video_data  ),
       282:                 .out_vsync (sh_video_vsync )
       283:             );
       284:         end
       285:         else begin : g_bypass
       286:             assign sh_video_valid = video_valid;
       287:             assign sh_video_data  = video_data ;
       288:             assign sh_video_vsync = video_vsync;
       289:         end
       290:     endgenerate
       291:

      1: // ============================================================================
      2: // ddr_w_arb.v -- [WARB 2026-09-19] minimal 2-master DDR write arbiter.
      3: //
      4: // WHY: the Forencich axi_crossbar's M00 write path leaks its per-master W-channel
      5: // select across handoffs (bench-proven in sim/wedge: after S01's burst tail the
      6: // M00 w_select_valid latches forever, S04's beats are never released, and both
      7: // camera engines wedge after 1-2 bursts). This module replaces the crossbar on
      8: // the DDR write path for the two camera engines.
      9: //
      10: // DESIGN: single-outstanding end-to-end, matching the DDR3 IP user-port contract
      11: // (no wvalid, unthrottleable wready, one burst processed at a time):
      12: //   IDLE  : present one master's AW (round-robin tie-break); the accept from the
      13: //           port glue locks OWNER for the whole burst.
      14: //   BUSY  : only OWNER's W stream reaches the glue; the fabric-minted B (from
      15: //           wusero_last) is routed back to OWNER; its accept frees the slot and
      16: //           flips the round-robin bit.
      17: // AXI-legal: awvalid/wvalid are held with stable payload until accepted; the
      18: // non-owner master's awready/wready stay low, so its burst cannot start.
      19: // ============================================================================

      95:     wire aw_gnt_m0 = ~busy & m0_awvalid & ~(m1_awvalid & rr);
      96:

      105:     assign s_awprot  = aw_gnt_m1 ? m1_awprot  : m0_awprot;
      106:     assign s_awvalid = aw_gnt_m0 | aw_gnt_m1;
      107:
      108:     assign m0_awready = aw_gnt_m0 & s_awready;
      109:     assign m1_awready = aw_gnt_m1 & s_awready;
      110:
      111:     // W datapath (only the owner's beats can flow)
      112:     assign s_wdata  = owner ? m1_wdata : m0_wdata;
      113:     assign s_wstrb  = owner ? m1_wstrb : m0_wstrb;
      114:     assign s_wlast  = owner ? m1_wlast : m0_wlast;
      115:     assign s_wvalid = busy & (owner ? m1_wvalid : m0_wvalid);
      116:
      117:     assign m0_wready = busy & ~owner & s_wready;
      118:     assign m1_wready = busy &  owner & s_wready;
      119:
      120:     // B path: single outstanding -> the owner gets the fabric-minted response
      121:     assign m0_bvalid = busy & ~owner & s_bvalid;
      122:     assign m1_bvalid = busy &  owner & s_bvalid;
      123:     assign m0_bid    = s_bid;
      124:     assign m1_bid    = s_bid;
      125:     assign m0_bresp  = s_bresp;
      126:     assign m1_bresp  = s_bresp;
      127:     assign s_bready  = busy & (owner ? m1_bready : m0_bready);
      128:
      129:     always @(posedge clk) begin
      130:         if (rst) begin
      131:             busy  <= 1'b0;
      132:             owner <= 1'b0;
      133:             rr    <= 1'b0;

      140:             end
      141:             else if (busy && s_bvalid && s_bready) begin
      142:                 busy  <= 1'b0;
      143:             end
      144:         end
      145:     end

      147: endmodule

      ## Assistant (Build · gpt-6-astra · 51.0s)
      
      已完成第一轮测量、RK3568 端排查和 FPGA DMA/DDR 静态检查。结果比较明确：
      
      > 当前双路约 17 fps 的首要瓶颈在 FPGA 端“有效帧提交/tag 更新”，不是 OV5640 采集能力，也不是 PCIe 物理带宽。
      
      ## 1. 实测结果
      
      ### OV5640 原始输入
      
      停止 `camview`、重载驱动后，通过 FPGA 调试寄存器测量：
      
      ```text
      cam1 原始 vsync：约 32.2 fps
      cam2 原始 vsync：约 32.2 fps
      ```
      
      当前寄存器配置：
      
      ```text
      640×480
      HTS = 1896
      VTS = 984
      PCLK ≈ 60 MHz
      ```
      
      因此摄像头本身正在以约 32 fps 产生帧。
      
      ### FPGA frame tag
      
      同一时间轮询四个 tag：
      
      ```text
      cam1 ping tag：约 8 fps
      cam1 pong tag：约 8 fps
      cam2 ping tag：约 8 fps
      cam2 pong tag：约 8 fps
      ```
      
      两个 buffer 合计：
      
      ```text
      cam1 有效完成帧：约 16.1 fps
      cam2 有效完成帧：约 16.1 fps
      ```
      
      也就是说：
      
      ```text
      传感器输入：约 32 fps
      FPGA 写 DDR 并完成 tag：约 16 fps
      ```
      
      这正好是“每隔一帧才提交一帧”的表现。
      
      测量工具已经加入：
      
      ```text
      tools/measure_dualcam.py
      ```
      
      它只读四个 frame tag、调试寄存器，并测量 640×480 单帧 DMA 读取耗时。
      
      ## 2. RK3568 端测量
      
      单独读取一帧的实测耗时：
      
      ```text
      cam1：约 6.1 ms
      cam2：约 6.2 ms
      ```
      
      两帧合计约：
      
      ```text
      12.3 ms
      ```
      
      这对应理论处理能力：
      
      ```text
      1000 / 12.3 ≈ 81 fps
      ```
      
      因此在 DMA 正常时，主机读取 30 fps 双路原始 RGB565 是有余量的。
      
      但是板端 `dmesg` 持续出现：
      
      ```text
      PCI_DMA_WRITE Error: Timeout waiting for MSI interrupt
      ```
      
      同时中断统计显示：
      
      ```text
      IRQ0：累计约 177 万次
      其他 MSI 向量：0
      ```
      
      因此 RK3568 侧确实存在 DMA/MSI 异常，但它更主要表现为：
      
      - 帧率抖动；
      - 偶尔降到 3~5 fps；
      - `ioctl` 超时；
      - 读取重试；
      - 显示不稳定。
      
      它不是造成稳定 16 fps 上限的第一原因，因为 FPGA tag 本身已经只有约 16 fps。
      
      ## 3. 已修改并验证的 camview
      
      修改文件：
      
      ```text
      host/camview/main.cpp
      ```
      
      原代码中有两个主动限速点：
      
      ```cpp
      msleep(40);
      ```
      
      以及：
      
      ```cpp
      msleep(60);
      ```
      
      特别是：
      
      ```cpp
      msleep(60);   // [PACE] total loop period ~80ms
      ```
      
      这会让双路读取循环被人为限制在约 13~17 fps。
      
      已修改为：
      
      ```cpp
      msleep(2);
      ```
      
      用于无新 tag 时的短轮询；
      
      ```cpp
      msleep(1);
      ```
      
      用于完成一轮双帧读取后的让步。
      
      另外增加了日志：
      
      ```text
      camview_fps=xx.xxx
      ```
      
      板端已经完成：
      
      ```text
      qmake
      make -j4
      ```
      
      编译成功。
      
      修改后 `camview` 的日志可以短时间达到：
      
      ```text
      约 18~23 fps
      ```
      
      但仍会受到 FPGA tag 16 fps和 DMA/MSI timeout 的影响，期间出现：
      
      ```text
      3~5 fps 的瞬时低谷
      ```
      
      所以仅修改主机延时不能稳定达到 30 fps。
      
      ## 4. FPGA DDR/DMA 结构检查结果
      
      ### 当前双路共享一个 DDR 写仲裁器
      
      `source/top.v` 中：
      
      ```verilog
      ddr_w_arb u_ddr_w_arb
      ```
      
      cam1 和 cam2 都经过该模块写入 DDR。
      
      `source/axi_crossbar/ddr_w_arb.v` 的设计是：
      
      ```verilog
      reg busy;
      reg owner;
      ```
      
      整个 DDR 写 burst 采用：
      
      ```text
      单 outstanding
      一次只允许 cam1 或 cam2 其中一路占用 DDR 写口
      ```
      
      也就是说，两路摄像头并不是独立并行写 DDR，而是完整 burst 级串行仲裁。
      
      ### 当前单帧写入大小
      
      当前：
      
      ```text
      640 × 480 RGB565
      = 614400 Bytes
      = 38400 个 128-bit beat
      ```
      
      `dbg_axi_num` 读到：
      
      ```text
      38399
      ```
      
      说明当前 FPGA 仍然按正确的 38400 个 128-bit beat 组成一帧。
      
      ### frame busy 会丢弃输入帧
      
      `source/ov5640/ov5640_ddr/ov5640_ddr_w_en.v` 中：
      
      ```verilog
      if (s_vsync_rise & axi_cam_en && !engine_busy)
          next_state = DATA;
      ```
      
      以及：
      
      ```verilog
      assign m_vsync = s_vsync_rise & axi_cam_en && !engine_busy;
      ```
      
      当上一帧还没有完成 DDR 写事务时，下一次传感器 `vsync` 到来会被丢弃。
      
      因此现在的逻辑行为是：
      
      ```text
      传感器产生 32 fps
      DDR 写引擎来不及在每个帧间隔完成
      下一帧被 engine_busy 丢弃
      最终 tag 约 16 fps
      ```
      
      这与实测结果高度吻合。
      
      ### 当前 DDR 时序
      
      最新时序报告：
      
      ```text
      ddrphy_sysclk WNS = -0.211 ns
      6 个 setup violation endpoints
      ```
      
      文件：
      
      ```text
      project/place_route/top_timing_summary_after_hold_fix.txt
      ```
      
      这不是直接证明“每隔一帧丢帧”的唯一原因，但说明 DDR PHY 时序尚未完全收敛，不能盲目提高 DDR/AXI 频率。
      
      ### 当前 DMA 写引擎
      
      `source/axi_dma/axi_dma_write.v` 中：
      
      ```verilog
      BURST_LEN = 16
      ```
      
      并且：
      
      - 每次最多 16 个 128-bit beat；
      - 每个 burst 等待 DDR B response；
      - `ddr_w_arb` 只允许一个 burst 所属 master；
      - 发生异常时有约 0.17 秒 watchdog；
      - cam1/cam2 共享写回路径。
      
      这个结构主要问题不是单帧数据量，而是：
      
      ```text
      burst/B response/仲裁/DDR停顿导致一帧写事务无法在下一帧到来前稳定完成
      ```
      
      ## 5. 当前结论
      
      现在链路可以分成三种帧率：
      
      | 位置 | 实测/理论帧率 |
      |---|---:|
      | OV5640 原始 vsync | 约 32.2 fps |
      | FPGA 完成 DDR 写入并更新 tag | 约 16.1 fps |
      | RK3568 camview 稳定显示 | 约 16~20 fps，DMA异常时会降到3~5 fps |
      
      所以当前实际瓶颈顺序是：
      
      ```text
      第一瓶颈：FPGA DDR写事务/engine_busy/tag提交
      第二瓶颈：RK3568 PCIe DMA/MSI异常
      第三瓶颈：原camview主动延时
      ```
      
      `camview` 主动限速已经去掉，但它不是唯一问题。
      
      ## 6. 压缩现在能不能解决？
      
      目前不建议先加 JPEG XS 或 MJPEG。
      
      原因是当前双路原始数据量只有：
      
      ```text
      614400 × 2 × 32
      ≈ 39.3 MB/s
      ```
      
      而单帧 DMA 实测只有约 6 ms，PCIe 带宽并未达到理论上限。
      
      现在即使加入压缩，也可能变成：
      
      ```text
      FPGA采集
      → 压缩器等待/编码
      → DDR/PCIe传输
      → RK3568解码
      ```
      
      如果 FPGA DDR 写引擎本身已经无法每帧完成，新增压缩器反而会增加资源和时序压力。
      
      当前优先级应该是：
      
      ```text
      先让 FPGA tag 从16 fps恢复到接近30 fps
      再处理RK3568 DMA/MSI异常
      最后再评估是否还需要压缩
      ```
      
      ## 7. 下一步建议
      
      ### FPGA 侧优先改动
      
      建议先做一个单变量实验：
      
      1. 给 cam1/cam2 分别增加：
         - frame start timestamp；
         - AXI command accept counter；
         - DMA done counter；
         - DDR B response counter；
         - engine busy duration counter。
      2. 测量一帧从：
      
         ```text
         vsync → cmd accept → first W → last W → B response → tag
         ```
      
         的完整时间。
      3. 确认具体是：
         - DDR 写数据吞吐不足；
         - B response 延迟；
         - `ddr_w_arb` 仲裁等待；
         - `cam_dma_done` 没有每帧产生；
         - 还是 `engine_busy` 一直跨越下一帧。
      
      ### RK3568 侧优先改动
      
      继续保留当前 `camview` 的去限速修改，同时处理：
      
      - PCIe DMA ioctl 超时后的驱动状态清理；
      - 减少连续小 tag DMA；
      - 将四次 16-byte tag 读取合并为一次连续读取；
      - 检查 `g_dma_flag` 和 `g_cam_flag` 的清除逻辑；
      - 修复 MSI 向量只集中到 IRQ0 的问题；
      - 将两路帧读取改成连续 DMA 或一次描述符提交；
      - 保持 `QImage`/显示线程不阻塞采集线程。
      
      ### 不建议现在做的事
      
      暂时不建议：
      
      ```text
      直接加入 JPEG XS
      直接把 BURST_LEN 改大
      直接修改 DDR 时钟
      直接取消 engine_busy
      ```
      
      这些改动可能会重新引入之前的：
      
      - 竖纹；
      - FIFO 溢出；
      - DDR 写死锁；
      - DMA timeout；
      - ping-pong buffer 撕裂。
      
      当前已经确认的是：
      
      > `camview` 原来的 60 ms 限速确实需要删除；但即使删除，FPGA tag仍约16 fps，真正的下一步应定位 FPGA DDR 写事务为什么跨越了一个传感器帧周期。

      ## 当前结果
      
      8-burst 版本已烧录，但串口检查发现它的 PCIe 配置异常：
      
      
      通过串口执行：
      
      ```bash
      rmmod pango_pci_driver
      ```
      
      当前状态：
      
      ```text
      camview：未运行
      detview：未运行
      pango_pci_driver：已卸载
      没有继续进行 DMA
      没有继续触发 3568
      ```
      
      串口已经切换并确认可用：
      
      ```text
      COM5 @ 1500000
      ```
      
      ## 重要结论
      
      当前 8-burst 实验版本不能继续用于帧率测试。它需要先修复 PCIe BAR 配置，否则驱动无法正常映射 FPGA BAR，也无法建立 MSI。
      
      后续应先检查：
      
      ```text
      PCIe IP BAR0 配置
      project.pds 中 PCIe IP 参数
      稳定 bitstream 与 8-burst bitstream 的 PCIe 配置差异
      ```
      
      在修复前不应启动：
      
      ```text
      pango_pci_driver
      camview
      measure_dualcam.py
      ```
      
      以免再次触发 RK3568 内核异常。

      $ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'

      if ($pds) {

      Get-Process cdt_cfg,cdt_js -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue |

      try {

          Start-Sleep -Seconds 4
      
          # Keep the configuration window alive while the cable programs the FPGA.
          # Close it only after the tool has reported the completed program command.
          $cfg = Start-Process -FilePath "$bin\cdt_cfg.exe" `

              -RedirectStandardOutput $outFile -RedirectStandardError $errFile -PassThru
      
          $deadline = (Get-Date).AddMinutes(5)
          while ((Get-Date) -lt $deadline) {
              Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 250
              $text = if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $outFile) {
                  Get-Content -LiteralPath $outFile -Raw -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
              } else { '' }
              if ($text -match 'The Progress:.*100%.*The done bit is 1' -or
                  $text -match 'The done bit is 1' -and
                  $text -match 'COMMAND\[Program\] execute successfully|cfg_program .*successfully') {
                  $programDone = $true
                  break
              }
              if ($cfg.HasExited) { break }
          }
      
          if (-not $programDone) {
              $detail = if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $outFile) { Get-Content -LiteralPath $outFile -Raw } else { '' }
              throw "cdt_cfg did not complete programming. $detail"
          }
      
          Write-Host '100% / done bit / Program successfully detected.'
          Write-Host '烧录已完成，请手动关闭 Fabric Configuration 窗口。'
          Write-Host '等待窗口退出；不会自动关闭 cdt_cfg。'
      
          # The user owns the final close action.  Do not use Stop-Process here:
          # closing the GUI is also the explicit acknowledgement that the cable and
          # configuration state can be released for PCIe remove/rescan and testing.
          while ($true) {
              $cfg.Refresh()
              if ($cfg.HasExited) {
                  $windowClosed = $true
                  break
              }
              Start-Sleep -Seconds 1
          }
      
          Write-Host '烧录完成，窗口已关闭，可以进行 PCIe remove/rescan 和帧率测试。'
      }
      finally {
          # On failure or Ctrl+C, avoid leaving a half-programmed GUI behind.  On
          # the successful path the window has already been closed by the user.
          if ($cfg -and -not $cfg.HasExited -and -not $windowClosed) {

          }
          Get-Process cdt_js -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue |

          }

        509: /////////////////////////////////////// DDR3 AW/AR latch shims [AWFIX/ARFIX 2026-09-19] ///
        510: // Proper single-handshake adapters between the crossbar and the DDR3 IP.
        511: // The crossbar is acknowledged exactly when we latch a request; the request is
        512: // then HELD with stable payload until the IP accepts (AXI-legal, no retraction).
        513: // Single-outstanding end-to-end (no held request + write FIFO empty + no pending
        514: // B for AW; read FIFO empty for AR) also keeps the aw_sid/ar_sid ID rebuilds sane.
        515: // [STAGE 2026-09-19] The DDR3 IP's W channel is UNTHROTTLEABLE: it pulses
        516: // wready at its own pace and counts awlen+1 beats itself (see the IP's own
        517: // example_design -- there is no wvalid at all). Presenting an AW before its
        518: // beats are in the FIFO let the IP consume GHOST beats from an empty FIFO;
        519: // the real beats then stranded in the FIFO forever and blocked all later AWs
        520: // (the permanent M00 write wedge). Hold each latched AW until its ENTIRE
        521: // burst is staged in the FIFO, then present it: during IP consumption the
        522: // FIFO only drains, so every demanded beat is guaranteed present.
        523: wire aw_burst_fits   = (ddr_axi_awlen < (5'd16 - wr_water_level));
        524: wire aw_latch_now    = ddr_axi_awvalid && !ddr3_aw_v && !aw_hold_v
        525:                        && w_fifo_empty && aw_burst_fits && !ddr_axi_bvalid_int;
        526: wire ar_latch_now    = ddr_axi_arvalid && !ddr3_ar_v && ddr_axi_fifo_empty;
        527:
        528: reg              ddr3_aw_v, ddr3_ar_v;
        529: reg              aw_hold_v;
        530: reg [27:0]       ddr3_aw_addr, ddr3_ar_addr;
        531: reg [3:0]        ddr3_aw_len,  ddr3_ar_len;
        532: reg              ddr3_aw_ap,   ddr3_ar_ap;
        533: reg [AXI_ID_M_LEN-1:0] ddr3_aw_id, ddr3_ar_id;
        534:
        535: wire aw_stage_ok = (wr_water_level >= ({1'b0, ddr3_aw_len} + 5'd1)) && !w_fifo_empty;
        536:
        537: always @(posedge axi_clk) begin
        538:     if (axi_rst) begin
        539:         aw_hold_v <= 1'b0;
        540:         ddr3_aw_v <= 1'b0;
        541:     end
        542:     else begin
        543:         if (aw_latch_now) begin
        544:             aw_hold_v   <= 1'b1;
        545:             ddr3_aw_addr <= ddr_axi_awaddr[27:0];
        546:             ddr3_aw_len  <= ddr_axi_awlen;
        547:             ddr3_aw_ap   <= ddr_axi_awuser_ap;
        548:             ddr3_aw_id   <= ddr_axi_awuser_id;
        549:         end
        550:         if (aw_hold_v && !ddr3_aw_v && aw_stage_ok) begin
        551:             aw_hold_v <= 1'b0;
        552:             ddr3_aw_v <= 1'b1;
        553:         end
        554:         else if (ddr3_aw_v && ddr_axi_awready) begin
        555:             ddr3_aw_v <= 1'b0;
        556:         end
        557:     end
        558: end
        559: always @(posedge axi_clk) begin
        560:     if (axi_rst) ddr3_ar_v <= 1'b0;
        561:     else if (ar_latch_now)                       ddr3_ar_v <= 1'b1;
        562:     else if (ddr3_ar_v && ddr_axi_arready)       ddr3_ar_v <= 1'b0;
        563: end
        564: always @(posedge axi_clk) begin
        565:     if (ar_latch_now) begin
        566:         ddr3_ar_addr <= ddr_axi_araddr[27:0];
        567:         ddr3_ar_len  <= ddr_axi_arlen;
        568:         ddr3_ar_ap   <= ddr_axi_aruser_ap;
        569:         ddr3_ar_id   <= ddr_axi_aruser_id;
        570:     end
        571: end
        572: // crossbar-facing readies: acknowledge exactly at latch time
        573: wire ddr_axi_awready_xbar = aw_latch_now;
        574: wire ddr_axi_arready_xbar = ar_latch_now;
        575:

        577: /////////////////////////////     DDR3   ///////////////////////////////////////////////////
        578:     wire       [AXI_ID_LEN-1:0]       pcie_axi_awid   ;
        579:     wire       [31:0]                 pcie_axi_awaddr ;
        580:     wire       [ 3:0]                 pcie_axi_awlen  ;
        581:     wire       [ 2:0]                 pcie_axi_awsize ;
        582:     wire       [ 1:0]                 pcie_axi_awburst;
        583:     wire                              pcie_axi_awlock ;
        584:     wire       [ 3:0]                 pcie_axi_awcache;
        585:     wire       [ 2:0]                 pcie_axi_awprot ;
        586:     wire       [ 3:0]                 pcie_axi_awqos  ;
        587:     wire                              pcie_axi_awvalid;
        588:     wire                              pcie_axi_awready;
        589:
        590:     wire       [AXI_DATA_LEN-1:0]     pcie_axi_wdata  ;
        591:     wire       [AXI_STRB_LEN-1:0]     pcie_axi_wstrb  ;
        592:     wire                              pcie_axi_wlast  ;
        593:     wire                              pcie_axi_wvalid ;
        594:     wire                              pcie_axi_wready ;
        595:
        596:     wire       [AXI_ID_LEN-1:0]       pcie_axi_bid    ;
        597:     wire       [ 1:0]                 pcie_axi_bresp  ;
        598:     wire                              pcie_axi_bvalid ;
        599:     wire                              pcie_axi_bready ;
        600:
        601:     wire       [AXI_ID_LEN-1:0]       pcie_axi_arid   ;
        602:     wire       [31:0]                 pcie_axi_araddr ;
        603:     wire       [ 3:0]                 pcie_axi_arlen  ;
        604:     wire       [ 2:0]                 pcie_axi_arsize ;
        605:     wire       [ 1:0]                 pcie_axi_arburst;
        606:     wire                              pcie_axi_arlock ;
        607:     wire       [ 3:0]                 pcie_axi_arcache;
        608:     wire       [ 2:0]                 pcie_axi_arprot ;
        609:     wire       [ 3:0]                 pcie_axi_arqos  ;
        610:     wire                              pcie_axi_arvalid;
        611:     wire                              pcie_axi_arready;
        612:
        613:     wire       [AXI_ID_LEN-1:0]       pcie_axi_rid    ;
        614:     wire       [AXI_DATA_LEN-1:0]     pcie_axi_rdata  ;
        615:     wire       [ 1:0]                 pcie_axi_rresp  ;
        616:     wire                              pcie_axi_rlast  ;
        617:     wire                              pcie_axi_rvalid ;
        618:     wire                              pcie_axi_rready ;
        619:
        620:     wire                              pcie_clk        ;
      --- source/axi_crossbar/ddr_w_arb.v 1:260 ---
          1: // ============================================================================
          2: // ddr_w_arb.v -- [WARB 2026-09-19] minimal 2-master DDR write arbiter.
          3: //
          4: // WHY: the Forencich axi_crossbar's M00 write path leaks its per-master W-channel
          5: // select across handoffs (bench-proven in sim/wedge: after S01's burst tail the
          6: // M00 w_select_valid latches forever, S04's beats are never released, and both
          7: // camera engines wedge after 1-2 bursts). This module replaces the crossbar on
          8: // the DDR write path for the two camera engines.
          9: //
         10: // DESIGN: single-outstanding end-to-end, matching the DDR3 IP user-port contract
         11: // (no wvalid, unthrottleable wready, one burst processed at a time):
         12: //   IDLE  : present one master's AW (round-robin tie-break); the accept from the
         13: //           port glue locks OWNER for the whole burst.
         14: //   BUSY  : only OWNER's W stream reaches the glue; the fabric-minted B (from
         15: //           wusero_last) is routed back to OWNER; its accept frees the slot and
         16: //           flips the round-robin bit.
         17: // AXI-legal: awvalid/wvalid are held with stable payload until accepted; the
         18: // non-owner master's awready/wready stay low, so its burst cannot start.
         19: // ============================================================================
         20: `timescale 1ns/1ps
         21: module ddr_w_arb (
         22:     input  wire         clk,
         23:     input  wire         rst,
         24:
         25:     // ---- master 0 (cam1 DMA) ----
         26:     input  wire [3:0]   m0_awid,
         27:     input  wire [31:0]  m0_awaddr,
         28:     input  wire [7:0]   m0_awlen,
         29:     input  wire [2:0]   m0_awsize,
         30:     input  wire [1:0]   m0_awburst,
         31:     input  wire         m0_awlock,
         32:     input  wire [3:0]   m0_awcache,
         33:     input  wire [2:0]   m0_awprot,
         34:     input  wire         m0_awvalid,
         35:     output wire         m0_awready,
         36:     input  wire [127:0] m0_wdata,
         37:     input  wire [15:0]  m0_wstrb,
         38:     input  wire         m0_wlast,
         39:     input  wire         m0_wvalid,
         40:     output wire         m0_wready,
         41:     output wire [3:0]   m0_bid,
         42:     output wire [1:0]   m0_bresp,
         43:     output wire         m0_bvalid,
         44:     input  wire         m0_bready,
         45:
         46:     // ---- master 1 (cam2 DMA) ----
         47:     input  wire [3:0]   m1_awid,
         48:     input  wire [31:0]  m1_awaddr,
         49:     input  wire [7:0]   m1_awlen,
         50:     input  wire [2:0]   m1_awsize,
         51:     input  wire [1:0]   m1_awburst,
         52:     input  wire         m1_awlock,
         53:     input  wire [3:0]   m1_awcache,
         54:     input  wire [2:0]   m1_awprot,
         55:     input  wire         m1_awvalid,
         56:     output wire         m1_awready,
         57:     input  wire [127:0] m1_wdata,
         58:     input  wire [15:0]  m1_wstrb,
         59:     input  wire         m1_wlast,
         60:     input  wire         m1_wvalid,
         61:     output wire         m1_wready,
         62:     output wire [3:0]   m1_bid,
         63:     output wire [1:0]   m1_bresp,
         64:     output wire         m1_bvalid,
         65:     input  wire         m1_bready,
         66:
         67:     // ---- slave (DDR3 port glue) ----
         68:     output wire [3:0]   s_awid,
         69:     output wire [31:0]  s_awaddr,
         70:     output wire [7:0]   s_awlen,
         71:     output wire [2:0]   s_awsize,
         72:     output wire [1:0]   s_awburst,
         73:     output wire         s_awlock,
         74:     output wire [3:0]   s_awcache,
         75:     output wire [2:0]   s_awprot,
         76:     output wire         s_awvalid,
         77:     input  wire         s_awready,
         78:     output wire [127:0] s_wdata,
         79:     output wire [15:0]  s_wstrb,
         80:     output wire         s_wlast,
         81:     output wire         s_wvalid,
         82:     input  wire         s_wready,
         83:     input  wire [3:0]   s_bid,
         84:     input  wire [1:0]   s_bresp,
         85:     input  wire         s_bvalid,
         86:     output wire         s_bready
         87: );
         88:
         89:     // Experimental throughput version: retain ownership for eight adjacent
         90:     // DDR bursts before rotating. The user requested restoring this exact
         91:     // experiment after the rollback image was tested.
         92:     localparam [2:0] BURSTS_PER_TURN = 3'd8;
         93:
         94:     reg  busy;      // an AW is locked in (waiting for its B)
         95:     reg  owner;     // 0 = master0 owns the slot, 1 = master1
         96:     reg  rr;        // round-robin tie-break for the next idle grant
         97:     reg  [2:0] turn_count;
         98:
         99:     // grant decision: only when idle; alternate when both masters ask
        100:     wire aw_gnt_m1 = ~busy & m1_awvalid & ( rr | ~m0_awvalid);
        101:     wire aw_gnt_m0 = ~busy & m0_awvalid & ~(m1_awvalid & rr);
        102:
        103:     // AW datapath (granted master's request)
        104:     assign s_awid    = aw_gnt_m1 ? m1_awid    : m0_awid;
        105:     assign s_awaddr  = aw_gnt_m1 ? m1_awaddr  : m0_awaddr;
        106:     assign s_awlen   = aw_gnt_m1 ? m1_awlen   : m0_awlen;
        107:     assign s_awsize  = aw_gnt_m1 ? m1_awsize  : m0_awsize;
        108:     assign s_awburst = aw_gnt_m1 ? m1_awburst : m0_awburst;
        109:     assign s_awlock  = aw_gnt_m1 ? m1_awlock  : m0_awlock;
        110:     assign s_awcache = aw_gnt_m1 ? m1_awcache : m0_awcache;
        111:     assign s_awprot  = aw_gnt_m1 ? m1_awprot  : m0_awprot;
        112:     assign s_awvalid = aw_gnt_m0 | aw_gnt_m1;
        113:
        114:     assign m0_awready = aw_gnt_m0 & s_awready;
        115:     assign m1_awready = aw_gnt_m1 & s_awready;
        116:
        117:     // W datapath (only the owner's beats can flow)
        118:     assign s_wdata  = owner ? m1_wdata : m0_wdata;
        119:     assign s_wstrb  = owner ? m1_wstrb : m0_wstrb;
        120:     assign s_wlast  = owner ? m1_wlast : m0_wlast;
        121:     assign s_wvalid = busy & (owner ? m1_wvalid : m0_wvalid);
        122:
        123:     assign m0_wready = busy & ~owner & s_wready;
        124:     assign m1_wready = busy &  owner & s_wready;
        125:
        126:     // B path: single outstanding -> the owner gets the fabric-minted response
        127:     assign m0_bvalid = busy & ~owner & s_bvalid;
        128:     assign m1_bvalid = busy &  owner & s_bvalid;
        129:     assign m0_bid    = s_bid;
        130:     assign m1_bid    = s_bid;
        131:     assign m0_bresp  = s_bresp;
        132:     assign m1_bresp  = s_bresp;
        133:     assign s_bready  = busy & (owner ? m1_bready : m0_bready);
        134:
        135:     always @(posedge clk) begin
        136:         if (rst) begin
        137:             busy  <= 1'b0;
        138:             owner <= 1'b0;
        139:             rr    <= 1'b0;
        140:             turn_count <= 3'd0;
        141:         end
        142:         else begin
        143:             if (!busy && (aw_gnt_m0 | aw_gnt_m1) && s_awready) begin
        144:                 busy  <= 1'b1;
        145:                 owner <= aw_gnt_m1;
        146:                 if (turn_count == BURSTS_PER_TURN - 1'b1) begin
        147:                     turn_count <= 3'd0;
        148:                     rr <= aw_gnt_m0;         // rotate after the eight-burst quantum
        149:                 end
        150:                 else begin
        151:                     turn_count <= turn_count + 1'b1;
        152:                     rr <= rr;                // keep the same owner during the quantum
        153:                 end
        154:             end
        155:             else if (busy && s_bvalid && s_bready) begin
        156:                 busy  <= 1'b0;
        157:             end
        158:         end
        159:     end
        160:
        161: endmodule
      --- source/axi_dma/axi_dma_write.v 1:360 ---
          1: module axi_dma_write
          2: 	#(
          3: 		parameter 		BURST_LEN 	= 8		,
          4: 		parameter       ID_WIDTH  	= 4		,
          5: 		parameter       DATA_WIDTH 	= 128	,
          6: 		parameter       KEEP_WIDTH  = DATA_WIDTH / 8
          7: 	)
          8: 	(
          9: 	input 				clk 			,    // Clock
         10: 	input 				rst 			,    // Synchronous reset active high
         11:
         12: 	//cmd interface
         13: 	input       	 					cmd_valid		,
         14: 	input 			[31:0] 				cmd_addr		,
         15: 	input 			[31:0] 				cmd_len			,
         16: 	input			[ID_WIDTH - 1:0]    cmd_id          ,
         17: 	output reg  	    				cmd_ready		,
         18:
         19: 	//trans data in
         20: 	input 			[DATA_WIDTH - 1:0]  data_in      	,
         21: 	input			[KEEP_WIDTH - 1:0]	data_in_keep	,
         22: 	input         						data_in_valid	,
         23: 	output reg                          data_in_last    ,
         24: 	output        						data_in_ready	,
         25:
         26: 	//axi w
         27: 	output reg		[ID_WIDTH - 1:0]   			m_axi_awid   	,
         28: 	output reg		[31:0]  					m_axi_awaddr 	,
         29: 	output reg		[7:0]   					m_axi_awlen  	,
         30: 	output 			[2:0]   					m_axi_awsize 	,
         31: 	output 			[1:0]   					m_axi_awburst	,
         32: 	output 		    	    					m_axi_awlock 	,
         33: 	output 			[3:0]   					m_axi_awcache	,
         34: 	output 			[2:0]   					m_axi_awprot	,
         35: 	output reg		        					m_axi_awvalid	,
         36: 	input  		 	        					m_axi_awready	,
         37: 	output 			[DATA_WIDTH - 1:0] 			m_axi_wdata		,
         38: 	output 			[KEEP_WIDTH - 1:0]  		m_axi_wstrb		,
         39: 	output 			        					m_axi_wlast		,
         40: 	output 			        					m_axi_wvalid	,
         41: 	input  			        					m_axi_wready	,
         42: 	input  			[ID_WIDTH - 1:0]   			m_axi_bid  		,
         43: 	input  			[1:0]   					m_axi_bresp 	,
         44: 	input  			        					m_axi_bvalid	,
         45: 	output 			        					m_axi_bready
         46:
         47: );
         48:
         49:
         50: localparam AXI_BURST_SIZE = $clog2(KEEP_WIDTH); //log2(DATA_WIDTH / 8)
         51:
         52: // [WD 2026-09-18] transmit watchdog state
         53: reg        abort_r;
         54: reg [23:0] wd_cnt;
         55: wire       w_progress;
         56: wire       abort_done;
         57:
         58: wire [DATA_WIDTH - 1:0] 		t_m_axi_wdata;
         59: wire [KEEP_WIDTH - 1:0]  		t_m_axi_wstrb;
         60: wire         					t_m_axi_wlast;
         61: wire         					t_m_axi_wvalid;
         62: wire         					t_m_axi_wready;
         63:
         64: //common para
         65: assign m_axi_awsize 	= 		AXI_BURST_SIZE	;
         66: assign m_axi_awburst 	= 		2'b01			;
         67: assign m_axi_awlock 	= 		1'b0			;
         68: assign m_axi_awcache 	= 		4'b0011			;
         69: assign m_axi_awprot 	= 		3'b000			;
         70:
         71:
         72: wire [7:0] burst_len    ;
         73: wire [7:0] max_burst_len;
         74:
         75: //cmd
         76: reg [31:0] addr;
         77: reg [31:0] len;
         78: reg        trans;
         79:
         80: always @(posedge clk) begin
         81: 	if((cmd_ready == 1'b1) && (cmd_valid == 1'b1))begin
         82: 		addr <= cmd_addr;
         83: 	end
         84: 	else begin
         85: 		if((m_axi_awvalid == 1'b1) && (m_axi_awready == 1'b1))begin
         86: 			addr <= addr + ((m_axi_awlen + 1'b1) << AXI_BURST_SIZE);
         87: 		end
         88: 	end
         89: end
         90:
         91: always @(posedge clk) begin
         92: 	if((cmd_ready == 1'b1) && (cmd_valid == 1'b1))begin
         93: 		len <= cmd_len[31:AXI_BURST_SIZE] + (|cmd_len[AXI_BURST_SIZE - 1:0]);
         94: 	end
         95: 	else begin
         96: 		if((m_axi_awvalid == 1'b1) && (m_axi_awready == 1'b1))begin
         97: 			len <= len - (m_axi_awlen + 1'b1);
         98: 		end
         99: 		else if(abort_done == 1'b1)begin
        100: 			len <= 32'd0;       // [WD]
        101: 		end
        102: 	end
        103: end
        104: always @(posedge clk)begin
        105: 	if(rst == 1'b1)begin
        106: 		trans <= 1'b0;
        107: 	end
        108: 	else begin
        109: 		if((cmd_ready == 1'b1) && (cmd_valid == 1'b1))begin
        110: 			trans <= 1'b1;
        111: 		end
        112: 		else begin
        113: 			if((m_axi_bready == 1'b1) && (m_axi_bvalid == 1'b1) && (len == 32'd0))begin
        114: 				trans <= 1'b0;
        115: 			end
        116: 			else if(abort_done == 1'b1)begin
        117: 				trans <= 1'b0;      // [WD] release the stuck transaction
        118: 			end
        119: 		end
        120: 	end
        121: end
        122:
        123: always @(posedge  clk)begin
        124: 	if(rst == 1'b1)begin
        125: 		cmd_ready <= 1'b0;
        126: 	end
        127: 	else begin
        128: 		if(trans == 1'b0)begin
        129: 			if((cmd_ready == 1'b1) && (cmd_valid == 1'b1))begin
        130: 				cmd_ready <= 1'b0;
        131: 			end
        132: 			else begin
        133: 				cmd_ready <= 1'b1;
        134: 			end
        135: 		end
        136: 		else begin
        137: 			cmd_ready <= 1'b0;
        138: 		end
        139: 	end
        140: end
        141:
        142: //aw
        143:
        144: reg burst_trans;
        145: assign burst_len     = len > BURST_LEN ? BURST_LEN : len;
        146: assign max_burst_len = (((addr & 12'hfff) + (burst_len << AXI_BURST_SIZE )) >> 12)  != 0 ? (13'h1000 - (addr & 12'hfff)) >> AXI_BURST_SIZE : burst_len;
        147: always@(posedge clk)begin
        148: 	if(rst == 1'b1)begin
        149: 		burst_trans <= 1'b0;
        150: 	end
        151: 	else begin
        152: 		if((m_axi_awvalid == 1'b1) && (m_axi_awready == 1'b1))begin
        153: 			burst_trans <= 1'b1;
        154: 		end
        155: 		else begin
        156: 			// if((m_axi_wvalid == 1'b1) && (m_axi_wready == 1'b1) && (m_axi_wlast == 1'b1))begin
        157: 			if((m_axi_bvalid == 1'b1) && (m_axi_bready == 1'b1))begin
        158: 				burst_trans <= 1'b0;
        159: 			end
        160: 			else if(abort_done == 1'b1)begin
        161: 				burst_trans <= 1'b0;   // [WD2] force-release; B may never arrive
        162: 			end
        163: 		end
        164: 	end
        165: end
        166: always @(posedge clk)begin
        167: 	if(rst == 1'b1)begin
        168: 		m_axi_awvalid <= 1'b0;
        169: 	end
        170: 	else begin
        171: 		if((m_axi_awvalid == 1'b1) && (m_axi_awready == 1'b1))begin
        172: 			m_axi_awvalid <= 1'b0;
        173: 		end
        174: 		else begin
        175: 			if((burst_trans == 1'b0) && (len != 32'd0) && (abort_r == 1'b0))begin
        176: 				m_axi_awvalid <= 1'b1;
        177: 			end
        178: 		end
        179: 	end
        180: end
        181:
        182: always @(posedge clk)begin
        183: 	m_axi_awlen <= max_burst_len - 8'd1;
        184: end
        185: always @(posedge clk)begin
        186: 	m_axi_awaddr <= addr;
        187: end
        188: always @(posedge clk) begin
        189: 	if((cmd_ready == 1'b1) && (cmd_valid == 1'b1))begin
        190: 		m_axi_awid <= cmd_id;
        191: 	end
        192: end
        193: //w
        194: reg [7:0] act_burst_len;
        195: always@ (posedge clk)begin
        196: 	if(rst == 1'b1)begin
        197: 		act_burst_len <= 8'd0;
        198: 	end
        199: 	else begin
        200: 		if((m_axi_awvalid == 1'b1) && (m_axi_awready == 1'b1))begin
        201: 			act_burst_len <= m_axi_awlen + 8'd1;
        202: 		end
        203: 		else begin
        204: 			if((t_m_axi_wvalid == 1'b1) && (t_m_axi_wready == 1'b1))begin
        205: 				act_burst_len <= act_burst_len - 8'd1;
        206: 			end
        207: 		end
        208: 	end
        209: end
        210:
        211: // [WD 2026-09-18] ------------------------------------------------------------------
        212: // The DVP stream can deliver fewer 128-bit beats than CAM_DATA_LEN (CDC FIFO
        213: // overflow drops pixels and cannot back-pressure the sensor). A frame's AXI
        214: // burst then never completes: trans sticks at 1, cmd_ready stays low and the
        215: // frame FSM deadlocks forever (measured: state=ADDR, axi_cnt=0, 0 frames).
        216: //
        217: // Recovery: if there is no W-beat progress for ~0.17 s while a write is in
        218: // flight, close the open burst with dummy beats. AXI forbids cancelling an
        219: // accepted AW, so we must still supply awlen beats; we just no longer consume
        220: // real camera data. After the B response is absorbed, trans/len clear and the
        221: // next frame's command is accepted again (only the bad frame is lost).
        222: assign w_progress = (t_m_axi_wvalid == 1'b1) && (t_m_axi_wready == 1'b1);
        223:
        224: always @(posedge clk) begin
        225: 	if((rst == 1'b1) || (trans == 1'b0) || (abort_r == 1'b1) || (w_progress == 1'b1))
        226: 		wd_cnt <= 24'd0;
        227: 	else if(wd_cnt != 24'hFFFFFF)
        228: 		wd_cnt <= wd_cnt + 24'd1;
        229: end
        230:
        231: // [BFAST 2026-09-19] the DDR write port can stop returning B responses
        232: // (see [WD2]; re-observed 09-19: b_cnt ~26 total while aw_cnt ~60k).
        233: // Waiting the full 0.17 s watchdog once every command's beats are out
        234: // capped the camera path at ~5 fps. Give B a few microseconds after the
        235: // last beat, then force the close via the abort path; a late B is still
        236: // absorbed by the w_done/bready logic.
        237: reg [9:0] bwait_cnt;
        238: // (w_done intentionally not referenced: it is declared further below and
        239: // act_burst_len==0 && burst_trans already means every beat is out, B pending)
        240: wire all_beats_out = (len == 32'd0) && (act_burst_len == 8'd0) && burst_trans;
        241: always @(posedge clk) begin
        242: 	if((rst == 1'b1) || (trans == 1'b0) || (all_beats_out == 1'b0) || (abort_r == 1'b1))
        243: 		bwait_cnt <= 10'd0;
        244: 	else if(bwait_cnt != 10'h3FF)
        245: 		bwait_cnt <= bwait_cnt + 10'd1;
        246: end
        247: always @(posedge clk) begin
        248: 	if(rst == 1'b1)
        249: 		abort_r <= 1'b0;

        265: assign abort_done = abort_r && (act_burst_len == 8'd0);

        267:
        268: stream_pipe #(

        273:   .dataIn_payload   ({t_m_axi_wdata, t_m_axi_wstrb, t_m_axi_wlast}),
        274:   .dataOut_valid    (m_axi_wvalid),
        275:   .dataOut_ready    (m_axi_wready),
        276:   .dataOut_payload  ({m_axi_wdata, m_axi_wstrb, m_axi_wlast}),
        277:   .clk              (clk),
        278:   .reset            (rst)

        281: assign data_in_ready = abort_r ? 1'b0

        283: assign t_m_axi_wvalid  = abort_r ? (act_burst_len > 8'd0)
        284:                                  : (data_in_valid && act_burst_len > 8'd0);
        285: assign t_m_axi_wdata   = abort_r ? {DATA_WIDTH{1'b0}} : data_in;
        286: assign t_m_axi_wlast   = (act_burst_len == 8'd1);
        287: assign t_m_axi_wstrb   = abort_r ? {KEEP_WIDTH{1'b1}} : data_in_keep;

        290: reg w_done;
        291: always @(posedge clk) begin
        292: 	if(rst == 1'b1) begin
        293: 		w_done <= 1'b0;
        294: 	end
        295: 	else begin

        297: 			w_done <= 1'b1;
        298: 		end
        299: 		else begin
        300: 			if((m_axi_bvalid == 1'b1) && (m_axi_bready == 1'b1)) begin
        301: 				w_done <= 1'b0;
        302: 			end
        303: 		end
        304: 	end

        306: assign m_axi_bready = w_done;

        308: // [LEDGER 2026-09-19] single-ledger completion: pulse exactly once per

        312: reg trans_q;
        313: always @(posedge clk) begin
        314: 	if(rst == 1'b1) trans_q <= 1'b0;
        315: 	else            trans_q <= trans;
        316: end
        317:
        318: always @(posedge clk ) begin
        319: 	if(rst == 1'b1)begin

        321: 	end
        322: 	else begin
        323: 		data_in_last <= trans_q && (trans == 1'b0);
        324: 	end
        325: end

        327: endmodule
