          1: //锟斤拷锟斤拷CMD锟斤拷锟斤拷
          2: module ov5640_ddr_w_ctrl #(
          3:     parameter AXI_ADDR_WIDTH = 32,
          4:     parameter AXI_LEN_WIDTH  = 32,
          5:     parameter AXI_DATA_WIDTH = 128,
          6:     parameter CAM_DATA_LEN   = 172800 //1280*720*3/16
          7: )(
          8:     input          axi_clk        ,
          9:     input          axi_rst        ,
         10:
         11:     input  [AXI_ADDR_WIDTH-1 : 0]      cam_data_addr_1,
         12:     input  [AXI_ADDR_WIDTH-1 : 0]      cam_data_addr_2,
         13:     input  [$clog2(CAM_DATA_LEN) : 0]  cam_data_len   , //锟斤拷16锟街斤拷为锟斤拷位
         14:
         15:     input          s_vsync        ,
         16:
         17:     input          dma_done       ,  // [LEDGER 2026-09-19] DMA transaction-done pulse (authoritative beat ledger)
         18:
         19:     output [AXI_ADDR_WIDTH-1 : 0]  axi_cmd_addr   /*synthesis PAP_MARK_DEBUG="1"*/,
         20:     output [AXI_LEN_WIDTH-1 : 0]   axi_cmd_len    /*synthesis PAP_MARK_DEBUG="1"*/,
         21:     output reg                     axi_cmd_valid  /*synthesis PAP_MARK_DEBUG="1"*/,
         22:     input                          axi_cmd_ready  /*synthesis PAP_MARK_DEBUG="1"*/,
         23:
         24:     output [1 : 0]   xdma_req       ,
         25:     input  [1 : 0]   xdma_ack       ,
         26:
         27:     // [FRTAG 2026-09-14] frame-tag injection. After each frame's last stream beat the
         28:     // FSM issues a SECOND 16-byte AXI command writing a 32-bit frame counter to
         29:     // frame_base + CAM_DATA_LEN*16. The wrapper (ov5640_ddr.v) muxes tag_data onto
         30:     // the data stream while tag_active is high. The transaction must complete:
         31:     // aborting it would leave a pending frame with no new tag for the host.
         32:     output                           tag_active     ,
         33:     output [AXI_DATA_WIDTH-1 : 0]    tag_data       ,
         34:     input                            tag_ready,
         35:     output [31:0]                    dbg_state,
         36:     output                           engine_busy,     // [IDLEGATE 2026-09-19] FSM not IDLE (frame or tag in flight)
         37:     output [31:0]                    dbg_last_cnt,
         38:     output [31:0]                    dbg_wd_cnt
         39: );
         40:
         41:     localparam IDLE      = 3'b001;
         42:     localparam ADDR      = 3'b010;
         43:     localparam DATA      = 3'b100;
         44:     // [FRTAG 2026-09-14] tag states: second (16B) command after the frame completes
         45:     localparam ADDR_TAG  = 3'b011;
         46:     localparam DATA_TAG  = 3'b101;
         47:
         48:     reg [2 : 0] curr_state/*synthesis PAP_MARK_DEBUG="1"*/;
         49:     // [LEDGER 2026-09-19] both the frame command and the 16B tag command pulse
         50:     // dma_done; only the frame command's completion may advance frame state.
         51:     wire frame_done = dma_done && (curr_state == DATA);
         52:     reg [2 : 0] next_state;
         53:     wire wd_expire;
         54:
         55:     // [FRTAG 2026-09-14] frame-tag declarations (forward, before first use)
         56:     reg                          vsync_pending;
         57:     reg  [AXI_ADDR_WIDTH-1 : 0]  frame_base;
         58:     reg  [31 : 0]                frame_cnt;
         59:     wire [AXI_ADDR_WIDTH-1 : 0]  tag_addr;
         60:     wire                         tag_fire;
         61:
         62:     reg [1 : 0] axi_vsync_ff/*synthesis PAP_MARK_DEBUG="1"*/;
         63:     reg axi_vsync_rise/*synthesis PAP_MARK_DEBUG="1"*/;
         64:
         65:
         66:     reg [AXI_ADDR_WIDTH-1 : 0] cmd_addr;
         67:
         68:
         69:     //状态锟斤拷
         70:     always @(posedge axi_clk) begin
         71:         if(axi_rst)begin
         72:             curr_state <= IDLE;
         73:         end
         74:         else begin
         75:             curr_state <= next_state;
         76:         end
         77:     end
         78:
         79:     always @(*) begin
         80:         case (curr_state)
         81:             IDLE: begin
         82:                 if(vsync_pending)begin
         83:                     next_state = ADDR;
         84:                 end
         85:                 else begin
         86:                     next_state = IDLE;
         87:                 end
         88:             end
         89:             ADDR: begin
         90:                 if(axi_cmd_ready & axi_cmd_valid)begin
         91:                     next_state = DATA;
         92:                 end
         93:                 else if(wd_expire)begin
         94:                     next_state = IDLE;      // [WD2] cmd_ready stuck -> retry
         95:                 end
         96:                 else begin
         97:                     next_state = ADDR;
         98:                 end
         99:             end
        100:             DATA: begin
        101:                 if(frame_done)begin
        102:                     next_state = ADDR_TAG;              // [FRTAG] frame complete, go write the tag
        103:                 end
        104:                 else if(wd_expire)begin
        105:                     next_state = IDLE;                  // [FIX] retry next vsync
        106:                 end
        107:                 else begin
        108:                     next_state = DATA;
        109:                 end
        110:             end
        111:             ADDR_TAG: begin
        112:                 if(axi_cmd_ready & axi_cmd_valid)begin
        113:                     next_state = DATA_TAG;
        114:                 end
        115:                 else if(wd_expire)begin
        116:                     next_state = IDLE;                  // [FIX]
        117:                 end
        118:                 else begin
        119:                     next_state = ADDR_TAG;
        120:                 end
        121:             end
        122:             DATA_TAG: begin
        123:                 if(tag_fire || wd_expire)begin
        124:                     next_state = IDLE;
        125:                 end
        126:                 else begin
        127:                     next_state = DATA_TAG;
        128:                 end
        129:             end
        130:             default: begin
        131:                 next_state = IDLE;
        132:             end
        133:         endcase
        134:     end
        135:
        136:
        137:     always @(posedge axi_clk) begin
        138:         if(axi_rst)begin
        139:             axi_vsync_ff <= 2'b0;
        140:         end
        141:         else begin
        142:             axi_vsync_ff <= {axi_vsync_ff[0], s_vsync};
        143:         end
        144:     end
        145:
        146:     always @(posedge axi_clk) begin
        147:         if(axi_rst)begin
        148:             axi_vsync_rise <= 1'b0;
        149:         end
        150:         else begin
        151:             axi_vsync_rise <= axi_vsync_ff[0] & (~axi_vsync_ff[1]);
        152:         end
        153:     end
        154:
        155:     reg w_ping;
        156:     always @(posedge axi_clk) begin
        157:         if(axi_rst)begin
        158:             w_ping <= 1'b0;
        159:         end
        160:         else begin
        161:             if(frame_done)begin
        162:                 w_ping <= ~w_ping;
        163:             end
        164:         end
        165:     end
        166:
        167:
        168:     // [FRTAG 2026-09-14] sticky vsync latch: a vsync pulse arriving while the tag
        169:     // states are running must not be lost (previously a 1-cycle rise pulse).
        170:     always @(posedge axi_clk) begin
        171:         if(axi_rst)begin
        172:             vsync_pending <= 1'b0;
        173:         end
        174:         else if(axi_vsync_rise)begin
        175:             vsync_pending <= 1'b1;
        176:         end
        177:         else if((curr_state == IDLE) && vsync_pending)begin
        178:             vsync_pending <= 1'b0;
        179:         end
        180:     end
        181:
        182:     always @(posedge axi_clk) begin
        183:         if(axi_rst)begin
        184:             axi_cmd_valid <= 1'b0;
        185:         end
        186:         else begin
        187:             if((curr_state == IDLE) && vsync_pending)begin
        188:                 axi_cmd_valid <= 1'b1;
        189:             end
        190:             else if(frame_done)begin
        191:                 axi_cmd_valid <= 1'b1;      // [FRTAG] frame done -> present the tag command
        192:             end
        193:             else if(axi_cmd_valid & axi_cmd_ready)begin
        194:                 axi_cmd_valid <= 1'b0;
        195:             end
        196:         end
        197:     end
        198:
        199:
        200:     always @(posedge axi_clk) begin
        201:         if(w_ping)begin
        202:             cmd_addr <= cam_data_addr_2;
        203:         end
        204:         else begin
        205:             cmd_addr <= cam_data_addr_1;
        206:         end
        207:     end
        208:
        209:     assign axi_cmd_addr = (curr_state == ADDR_TAG) ? tag_addr : cmd_addr;
        210:     // [FRTAG 2026-09-14] tag command = one 16-byte beat at frame_base + frame size
        211:     assign axi_cmd_len  = (curr_state == ADDR_TAG) ? 32'd16
        212:                         : {{AXI_LEN_WIDTH-4-$clog2(CAM_DATA_LEN){1'd0}}, cam_data_len, 4'b0};
        213:
        214:
        215:     // [FRTAG 2026-09-14] frame counter + tag beat generation --------------------
        216:     // frame_base is latched when the FRAME command is accepted (cmd_addr still
        217:     // points at the buffer being written at that moment; w_ping flips later).
        218:     always @(posedge axi_clk) begin
        219:         if(axi_rst)begin
        220:             frame_base <= {AXI_ADDR_WIDTH{1'b0}};
        221:         end
        222:         else if((curr_state == ADDR) && axi_cmd_valid && axi_cmd_ready)begin
        223:             frame_base <= cmd_addr;
        224:         end
        225:     end
        226:
        227:     assign tag_addr = frame_base + (CAM_DATA_LEN << 4);
        228:
        229:     always @(posedge axi_clk) begin
        230:         if(axi_rst)begin
        231:             frame_cnt <= 32'd0;
        232:         end
        233:         else if(frame_done)begin
        234:             frame_cnt <= frame_cnt + 32'd1;
        235:         end
        236:     end
        237:
        238:     assign tag_active  = (curr_state == DATA_TAG);
        239:     assign tag_data    = {{(AXI_DATA_WIDTH-32){1'b0}}, frame_cnt};
        240:     assign tag_fire    = tag_active & tag_ready;
        241:     // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
        242:
        243:
        244:     //XDMA乒锟斤拷锟斤拷锟斤拷
        245:     reg [1 : 0] s_xdma_req;
        246:     always @(posedge axi_clk) begin
        247:         if(axi_rst)begin
        248:             s_xdma_req <= 2'b0;
        249:         end
        250:         else begin
        251:             if(frame_done)begin
        252:                 if(w_ping)begin
        253:                     s_xdma_req[1] <= 1'b1;
        254:                 end
        255:                 else begin
        256:                     s_xdma_req[0] <= 1'b1;
        257:                 end
        258:             end
        259:             else begin
        260:                 if(xdma_ack[0]) begin
        261:                     s_xdma_req[0] <= 1'b0;
        262:                 end
        263:                 if(xdma_ack[1]) begin
        264:                     s_xdma_req[1] <= 1'b0;
        265:                 end
        266:             end
        267:         end
        268:     end
        269:
        270:     assign xdma_req = s_xdma_req;
        271:     assign dbg_state = {29'd0, curr_state};
        272:     assign engine_busy = (curr_state != IDLE);
        273:
        274:     // [FIX 2026-09-18] frame-write watchdog: a frame that does not complete
        275:     // (lost/short camera stream) used to wedge this FSM in DATA forever. Bail
        276:     // back to IDLE after ~0.16 s and retry on the next vsync.
        277:     reg [31:0] wd_cnt;
        278:     // [WDFIX 2026-09-19] reset the budget on every state CHANGE, not only in
        279:     // IDLE: a frame that burns the budget in DATA (slow DMA close with the B
        280:     // path dead) used to make the immediately following ADDR_TAG/DATA_TAG
        281:     // expire instantly, silently skipping the frame-tag write.
        282:     reg [2:0] wd_prev_state;

        284:         if(axi_rst) wd_prev_state <= IDLE;
        285:         else        wd_prev_state <= curr_state;
        286:     end
        287:     always @(posedge axi_clk) begin
        288:         if(axi_rst || (curr_state == IDLE) || (curr_state != wd_prev_state)) wd_cnt <= 32'd0;

        291:     assign wd_expire = (wd_cnt >= 32'd20_000_000);
        292:     assign dbg_wd_cnt = wd_cnt;
        293:
        294:     reg [31:0] last_cnt;
        295:     always @(posedge axi_clk) begin
        296:         if(axi_rst) last_cnt <= 32'd0;
        297:         else if(frame_done) last_cnt <= last_cnt + 32'd1;
        298:     end
        299:     assign dbg_last_cnt = last_cnt;

        301:
        302:
        303:
        304: endmodule

         13:     input                      s_hsync      ,
         14:     input                      s_vsync      ,

         18:     output                     m_hsync      ,
         19:     output                     m_vsync
         20: );
         21:
         22: localparam IDLE = 2'b01;
         23: localparam DATA = 2'b10;
         24:
         25: reg [1:0] curr_state;
         26: reg [1:0] next_state;
         27:
         28: reg [1:0] s_vsync_ff;
         29: reg       s_vsync_rise;
         30:
         31: always @(posedge axi_clk) begin
         32:     if(axi_rst)begin
         33:         curr_state <= IDLE;
         34:     end
         35:     else begin
         36:         curr_state <= next_state;
         37:     end
         38: end
         39:
         40: always @(*) begin
         41:     case (curr_state)
         42:         IDLE: begin
         43:                 if(s_vsync_rise & axi_cam_en && !engine_busy) begin  // [IDLEGATE 2026-09-19] admit a frame only when the engine finished the previous one
         44:                 next_state = DATA;
         45:             end
         46:             else begin
         47:                 next_state = IDLE;
         48:             end
         49:         end
         50:         DATA: begin
         51:             if(s_vsync_rise) begin
         52:                     if(axi_cam_en && !engine_busy) begin  // [IDLEGATE] engine wedged mid-frame: drop the rest at this vsync
         53:                     next_state = DATA;
         54:                 end
         55:                 else begin
         56:                     next_state = IDLE;
         57:                 end
         58:             end
         59:             else begin
         60:                 next_state = DATA;
         61:             end
         62:         end
         63:         default: begin
         64:             next_state = IDLE;
         65:         end
         66:     endcase
         67: end
         68:

         71:         s_vsync_ff <= 2'b0;
         72:     end
         73:     else begin

         75:     end
         76: end
         77:
         78: always @(posedge axi_clk) begin
         79:     if(axi_rst)begin
         80:         s_vsync_rise <= 1'b0;
         81:     end
         82:     else begin
         83:         s_vsync_rise <= s_vsync_ff[0] & (~s_vsync_ff[1]);
         84:     end
         85: end

        378: wire [31:0]  arb_s_awaddr;
        379: wire [7:0]   arb_s_awlen;
        380: wire [2:0]   arb_s_awsize, arb_s_awprot;
        381: wire [1:0]   arb_s_awburst;
        382: wire         arb_s_awlock;
        383: wire [3:0]   arb_s_awcache;
        384: wire         arb_s_awvalid, arb_s_awready;
        385: wire [127:0] arb_s_wdata;
        386: wire [15:0]  arb_s_wstrb;
        387: wire         arb_s_wlast, arb_s_wvalid, arb_s_wready;
        388: wire [3:0]   arb_s_bid;
        389: wire [1:0]   arb_s_bresp;
        390: wire         arb_s_bvalid, arb_s_bready;
        391: // parked crossbar M00 write ports
        392: wire [6:0]   arb2x_awid;
        393: wire [31:0]  arb2x_awaddr;
        394: wire [7:0]   arb2x_awlen;
        395: wire [2:0]   arb2x_awsize, arb2x_awprot;
        396: wire [1:0]   arb2x_awburst;
        397: wire         arb2x_awlock;
        398: wire [3:0]   arb2x_awcache;
        399: wire [3:0]   arb2x_awqos;
        400: wire [1:0]   arb2x_awuser;

        402: wire [127:0] arb2x_wdata;
        403: wire [15:0]  arb2x_wstrb;
        404: wire         arb2x_wlast, arb2x_wvalid;
        405: wire [1:0]   arb2x_wuser;
        406: ddr_w_arb u_ddr_w_arb (
        407:     .clk(axi_clk), .rst(axi_rst),

        412:     .m0_awvalid (ov5640_axi_awvalid ), .m0_awready(ov5640_axi_awready),
        413:     .m0_wdata   (ov5640_axi_wdata   ), .m0_wstrb  (ov5640_axi_wstrb  ),
        414:     .m0_wlast   (ov5640_axi_wlast   ), .m0_wvalid (ov5640_axi_wvalid ),
        415:     .m0_wready  (ov5640_axi_wready  ),
        416:     .m0_bid     (ov5640_axi_bid     ), .m0_bresp  (ov5640_axi_bresp  ),
        417:     .m0_bvalid  (ov5640_axi_bvalid  ), .m0_bready (ov5640_axi_bready ),

        419:     .m1_awlen   (cam2_axi_awlen     ), .m1_awsize (cam2_axi_awsize   ),
        420:     .m1_awburst (cam2_axi_awburst   ), .m1_awlock (cam2_axi_awlock   ),
        421:     .m1_awcache (cam2_axi_awcache   ), .m1_awprot (cam2_axi_awprot   ),
        422:     .m1_awvalid (cam2_axi_awvalid   ), .m1_awready(cam2_axi_awready  ),
        423:     .m1_wdata   (cam2_axi_wdata     ), .m1_wstrb  (cam2_axi_wstrb    ),
        424:     .m1_wlast   (cam2_axi_wlast     ), .m1_wvalid (cam2_axi_wvalid   ),
        425:     .m1_wready  (cam2_axi_wready    ),
        426:     .m1_bid     (cam2_axi_bid       ), .m1_bresp  (cam2_axi_bresp    ),
        427:     .m1_bvalid  (cam2_axi_bvalid    ), .m1_bready (cam2_axi_bready   ),
        428:     .s_awid     (arb_s_awid         ), .s_awaddr (arb_s_awaddr      ),
        429:     .s_awlen    (arb_s_awlen        ), .s_awsize (arb_s_awsize      ),
        430:     .s_awburst  (arb_s_awburst      ), .s_awlock (arb_s_awlock      ),
        431:     .s_awcache  (arb_s_awcache      ), .s_awprot (arb_s_awprot      ),
        432:     .s_awvalid  (arb_s_awvalid      ), .s_awready(arb_s_awready     ),
        433:     .s_wdata    (arb_s_wdata        ), .s_wstrb  (arb_s_wstrb       ),
        434:     .s_wlast    (arb_s_wlast        ), .s_wvalid (arb_s_wvalid      ),
        435:     .s_wready   (arb_s_wready       ),
        436:     .s_bid      (arb_s_bid          ), .s_bresp  (arb_s_bresp       ),
        437:     .s_bvalid   (arb_s_bvalid       ), .s_bready (arb_s_bready      )
        438: );
        439: // DDR glue AW/W side now fed by the arbiter
        440: assign ddr_axi_awaddr     = arb_s_awaddr;
        441: assign ddr_axi_awlen      = arb_s_awlen;
        442: assign ddr_axi_awvalid    = arb_s_awvalid;
        443: assign arb_s_awready      = ddr_axi_awready_xbar;
        444: assign ddr_axi_wdata      = arb_s_wdata;
        445: assign ddr_axi_wstrb      = arb_s_wstrb;
        446: assign ddr_axi_wlast      = arb_s_wlast;
        447: assign ddr_axi_wvalid     = arb_s_wvalid;
        448: assign arb_s_wready       = !ddr_axi_fifo_full;
        449: assign arb_s_bvalid       = ddr_axi_bvalid;
        450: assign arb_s_bresp        = ddr_axi_bresp;
        451: assign ddr_axi_bready     = arb_s_bready;
        452: // awuser id now carries the arbiter's source id (m0=0001, m1=0100 4-bit form)
        453: assign ddr_axi_awuser_id  = {3'b000, arb_s_awid};
        454: assign ddr_axi_awuser_ap  = 1'b0;
        455: assign arb_s_bid          = {3'b000, 1'b0};
        456:
        457: /////////////////////////////////////// DDR3 B-Channel Bridge //////////////////////////////////////
        458: reg  [AXI_ID_M_LEN-1 : AXI_ID_LEN]                  ddr_axi_aw_sid        ;//ddr_axi_awuser_id??3?
        459: reg  [AXI_ID_M_LEN-1 : AXI_ID_LEN]                  ddr_axi_ar_sid        ;//ddr_axi_aruser_id??3?
        460:
        461: // latch aw_sid on AW handshake
        462: always @(posedge axi_clk) begin
        463:     if (axi_rst) begin
        464:         ddr_axi_aw_sid <= {(AXI_ID_M_LEN - AXI_ID_LEN){1'b0}};
        465:     end
        466:     else if (ddr_axi_awvalid && ddr_axi_awready_xbar) begin   // [AWFIX] ack at latch
        467:         ddr_axi_aw_sid <= ddr_axi_awuser_id[AXI_ID_M_LEN-1 : AXI_ID_LEN];
        468:     end
        469: end
        470:
        471: // latch ar_sid on AR handshake
        472: always @(posedge axi_clk) begin
        473:     if (axi_rst) begin
        474:         ddr_axi_ar_sid <= {(AXI_ID_M_LEN - AXI_ID_LEN){1'b0}};
        475:     end
        476:     else if (ddr_axi_arvalid && ddr_axi_arready_xbar) begin   // [ARFIX] ack at latch
        477:         ddr_axi_ar_sid <= ddr_axi_aruser_id[AXI_ID_M_LEN-1 : AXI_ID_LEN];
        478:     end
        479: end
        480:
        481:
        482: reg                         ddr_axi_bvalid_int    ;
        483: reg  [1:0]                  ddr_axi_bresp_int     ;
        484: reg  [AXI_ID_M_LEN-1:0]     ddr_axi_bid_int       ;
        485: always @(posedge axi_clk) begin
        486:     if (axi_rst) begin
        487:         ddr_axi_bvalid_int  <= 1'b0;
        488:         ddr_axi_bresp_int   <= 2'b01;
        489:         ddr_axi_bid_int <= {AXI_ID_M_LEN{1'b0}};
        490:     end
        491:     else begin
        492:         if (ddr_axi_wready_ddr3 && ddr_axi_wusero_last_ddr3) begin
        493:             ddr_axi_bvalid_int <= 1'b1;
        494:             ddr_axi_bresp_int  <= 2'b00;
        495:             ddr_axi_bid_int <= {ddr_axi_aw_sid[AXI_ID_M_LEN-1 : AXI_ID_LEN], ddr_axi_wusero_id};
        496:         end
        497:         else if (ddr_axi_bvalid && ddr_axi_bready) begin
        498:             ddr_axi_bvalid_int <= 1'b0;
        499:             ddr_axi_bresp_int  <= 2'b01;
        500:             ddr_axi_bid_int <= {AXI_ID_M_LEN{1'b0}};
        501:         end
        502:     end
        503: end
        504:
        505: assign ddr_axi_bvalid = ddr_axi_bvalid_int;
        506: assign ddr_axi_bresp  = ddr_axi_bresp_int;
        507: assign ddr_axi_bid    = ddr_axi_bid_int;
        508:
        509: /////////////////////////////////////// DDR3 AW/AR latch shims [AWFIX/ARFIX 2026-09-19] ///
        510: // Proper single-handshake adapters between the crossbar and the DDR3 IP.
        511: // The crossbar is acknowledged exactly when we latch a request; the request is
        512: // then HELD with stable payload until the IP accepts (AXI-legal, no retraction).
        513: // Single-outstanding end-to-end (no held request + write FIFO empty + no pending
        514: // B for AW; read FIFO empty for AR) also keeps the aw_sid/ar_sid ID rebuilds sane.
        515: // [STAGE 2026-09-19] The DDR3 IP's W channel is UNTHROTTLEABLE: it pulses
        516: // wready at its own pace and counts awlen+1 beats itself (see the IP's own
        517: // example_design -- there is no wvalid at all). Presenting an AW before its
        518: // beats are in the FIFO let the IP consume GHOST beats from an empty FIFO;
        519: // the real beats then stranded in the FIFO forever and blocked all later AWs
        520: // (the permanent M00 write wedge). Hold each latched AW until its ENTIRE
        521: // burst is staged in the FIFO, then present it: during IP consumption the
        522: // FIFO only drains, so every demanded beat is guaranteed present.
        523: wire aw_burst_fits   = (ddr_axi_awlen < (5'd16 - wr_water_level));
        524: wire aw_latch_now    = ddr_axi_awvalid && !ddr3_aw_v && !aw_hold_v
        525:                        && w_fifo_empty && aw_burst_fits && !ddr_axi_bvalid_int;
        526: wire ar_latch_now    = ddr_axi_arvalid && !ddr3_ar_v && ddr_axi_fifo_empty;
        527:
        528: reg              ddr3_aw_v, ddr3_ar_v;
        529: reg              aw_hold_v;
        530: reg [27:0]       ddr3_aw_addr, ddr3_ar_addr;
        531: reg [3:0]        ddr3_aw_len,  ddr3_ar_len;
        532: reg              ddr3_aw_ap,   ddr3_ar_ap;
        533: reg [AXI_ID_M_LEN-1:0] ddr3_aw_id, ddr3_ar_id;
        534:
        535: wire aw_stage_ok = (wr_water_level >= ({1'b0, ddr3_aw_len} + 5'd1)) && !w_fifo_empty;
        536:
        537: always @(posedge axi_clk) begin
        538:     if (axi_rst) begin
        539:         aw_hold_v <= 1'b0;
        540:         ddr3_aw_v <= 1'b0;
        541:     end
        542:     else begin
        543:         if (aw_latch_now) begin
        544:             aw_hold_v   <= 1'b1;
        545:             ddr3_aw_addr <= ddr_axi_awaddr[27:0];
        546:             ddr3_aw_len  <= ddr_axi_awlen;
        547:             ddr3_aw_ap   <= ddr_axi_awuser_ap;
        548:             ddr3_aw_id   <= ddr_axi_awuser_id;
        549:         end
        550:         if (aw_hold_v && !ddr3_aw_v && aw_stage_ok) begin
        551:             aw_hold_v <= 1'b0;
        552:             ddr3_aw_v <= 1'b1;
        553:         end
        554:         else if (ddr3_aw_v && ddr_axi_awready) begin
        555:             ddr3_aw_v <= 1'b0;
        556:         end
        557:     end
        558: end
        559: always @(posedge axi_clk) begin
        560:     if (axi_rst) ddr3_ar_v <= 1'b0;
        561:     else if (ar_latch_now)                       ddr3_ar_v <= 1'b1;
        562:     else if (ddr3_ar_v && ddr_axi_arready)       ddr3_ar_v <= 1'b0;
        563: end
        564: always @(posedge axi_clk) begin
        565:     if (ar_latch_now) begin
        566:         ddr3_ar_addr <= ddr_axi_araddr[27:0];
        567:         ddr3_ar_len  <= ddr_axi_arlen;
        568:         ddr3_ar_ap   <= ddr_axi_aruser_ap;
        569:         ddr3_ar_id   <= ddr_axi_aruser_id;
        570:     end
        571: end
        572: // crossbar-facing readies: acknowledge exactly at latch time
        573: wire ddr_axi_awready_xbar = aw_latch_now;
        574: wire ddr_axi_arready_xbar = ar_latch_now;
        575:
        576:
        577: /////////////////////////////     DDR3   ///////////////////////////////////////////////////
        578:     wire       [AXI_ID_LEN-1:0]       pcie_axi_awid   ;
        579:     wire       [31:0]                 pcie_axi_awaddr ;
        580:     wire       [ 3:0]                 pcie_axi_awlen  ;
        581:     wire       [ 2:0]                 pcie_axi_awsize ;
        582:     wire       [ 1:0]                 pcie_axi_awburst;
        583:     wire                              pcie_axi_awlock ;
        584:     wire       [ 3:0]                 pcie_axi_awcache;
        585:     wire       [ 2:0]                 pcie_axi_awprot ;
        586:     wire       [ 3:0]                 pcie_axi_awqos  ;
        587:     wire                              pcie_axi_awvalid;
        588:     wire                              pcie_axi_awready;
        589:
        590:     wire       [AXI_DATA_LEN-1:0]     pcie_axi_wdata  ;
        591:     wire       [AXI_STRB_LEN-1:0]     pcie_axi_wstrb  ;

        593:     wire                              pcie_axi_wvalid ;
        594:     wire                              pcie_axi_wready ;
        595:
        596:     wire       [AXI_ID_LEN-1:0]       pcie_axi_bid    ;
        597:     wire       [ 1:0]                 pcie_axi_bresp  ;
        598:     wire                              pcie_axi_bvalid ;
        599:     wire                              pcie_axi_bready ;
        600:
        601:     wire       [AXI_ID_LEN-1:0]       pcie_axi_arid   ;
        602:     wire       [31:0]                 pcie_axi_araddr ;
        603:     wire       [ 3:0]                 pcie_axi_arlen  ;
        604:     wire       [ 2:0]                 pcie_axi_arsize ;
        605:     wire       [ 1:0]                 pcie_axi_arburst;
        606:     wire                              pcie_axi_arlock ;
        607:     wire       [ 3:0]                 pcie_axi_arcache;
        608:     wire       [ 2:0]                 pcie_axi_arprot ;
        609:     wire       [ 3:0]                 pcie_axi_arqos  ;

        612:
        613:     wire       [AXI_ID_LEN-1:0]       pcie_axi_rid    ;

      --- source/axi_crossbar/ddr_w_arb.v 1:280 (161) ---
          1: // ============================================================================
          2: // ddr_w_arb.v -- [WARB 2026-09-19] minimal 2-master DDR write arbiter.
          3: //
          4: // WHY: the Forencich axi_crossbar's M00 write path leaks its per-master W-channel
          5: // select across handoffs (bench-proven in sim/wedge: after S01's burst tail the
          6: // M00 w_select_valid latches forever, S04's beats are never released, and both
          7: // camera engines wedge after 1-2 bursts). This module replaces the crossbar on
          8: // the DDR write path for the two camera engines.
          9: //
         10: // DESIGN: single-outstanding end-to-end, matching the DDR3 IP user-port contract
         11: // (no wvalid, unthrottleable wready, one burst processed at a time):
         12: //   IDLE  : present one master's AW (round-robin tie-break); the accept from the
         13: //           port glue locks OWNER for the whole burst.
         14: //   BUSY  : only OWNER's W stream reaches the glue; the fabric-minted B (from
         15: //           wusero_last) is routed back to OWNER; its accept frees the slot and
         16: //           flips the round-robin bit.
         17: // AXI-legal: awvalid/wvalid are held with stable payload until accepted; the
         18: // non-owner master's awready/wready stay low, so its burst cannot start.
         19: // ============================================================================
         20: `timescale 1ns/1ps
         21: module ddr_w_arb (
         22:     input  wire         clk,
         23:     input  wire         rst,
         24:
         25:     // ---- master 0 (cam1 DMA) ----
         26:     input  wire [3:0]   m0_awid,
         27:     input  wire [31:0]  m0_awaddr,
         28:     input  wire [7:0]   m0_awlen,
         29:     input  wire [2:0]   m0_awsize,
         30:     input  wire [1:0]   m0_awburst,
         31:     input  wire         m0_awlock,
         32:     input  wire [3:0]   m0_awcache,
         33:     input  wire [2:0]   m0_awprot,
         34:     input  wire         m0_awvalid,
         35:     output wire         m0_awready,
         36:     input  wire [127:0] m0_wdata,
         37:     input  wire [15:0]  m0_wstrb,
         38:     input  wire         m0_wlast,
         39:     input  wire         m0_wvalid,
         40:     output wire         m0_wready,
         41:     output wire [3:0]   m0_bid,
         42:     output wire [1:0]   m0_bresp,
         43:     output wire         m0_bvalid,
         44:     input  wire         m0_bready,
         45:
         46:     // ---- master 1 (cam2 DMA) ----
         47:     input  wire [3:0]   m1_awid,
         48:     input  wire [31:0]  m1_awaddr,
         49:     input  wire [7:0]   m1_awlen,
         50:     input  wire [2:0]   m1_awsize,
         51:     input  wire [1:0]   m1_awburst,
         52:     input  wire         m1_awlock,
         53:     input  wire [3:0]   m1_awcache,
         54:     input  wire [2:0]   m1_awprot,
         55:     input  wire         m1_awvalid,
         56:     output wire         m1_awready,
         57:     input  wire [127:0] m1_wdata,
         58:     input  wire [15:0]  m1_wstrb,
         59:     input  wire         m1_wlast,
         60:     input  wire         m1_wvalid,
         61:     output wire         m1_wready,
         62:     output wire [3:0]   m1_bid,
         63:     output wire [1:0]   m1_bresp,
         64:     output wire         m1_bvalid,
         65:     input  wire         m1_bready,
         66:
         67:     // ---- slave (DDR3 port glue) ----
         68:     output wire [3:0]   s_awid,
         69:     output wire [31:0]  s_awaddr,
         70:     output wire [7:0]   s_awlen,
         71:     output wire [2:0]   s_awsize,
         72:     output wire [1:0]   s_awburst,
         73:     output wire         s_awlock,
         74:     output wire [3:0]   s_awcache,
         75:     output wire [2:0]   s_awprot,
         76:     output wire         s_awvalid,
         77:     input  wire         s_awready,
         78:     output wire [127:0] s_wdata,
         79:     output wire [15:0]  s_wstrb,
         80:     output wire         s_wlast,
         81:     output wire         s_wvalid,
         82:     input  wire         s_wready,
         83:     input  wire [3:0]   s_bid,
         84:     input  wire [1:0]   s_bresp,
         85:     input  wire         s_bvalid,
         86:     output wire         s_bready
         87: );
         88:
         89:     // Experimental throughput version: retain ownership for eight adjacent
         90:     // DDR bursts before rotating. The user requested restoring this exact
         91:     // experiment after the rollback image was tested.
         92:     localparam [2:0] BURSTS_PER_TURN = 3'd8;
         93:
         94:     reg  busy;      // an AW is locked in (waiting for its B)
         95:     reg  owner;     // 0 = master0 owns the slot, 1 = master1
         96:     reg  rr;        // round-robin tie-break for the next idle grant
         97:     reg  [2:0] turn_count;
         98:
         99:     // grant decision: only when idle; alternate when both masters ask
        100:     wire aw_gnt_m1 = ~busy & m1_awvalid & ( rr | ~m0_awvalid);
        101:     wire aw_gnt_m0 = ~busy & m0_awvalid & ~(m1_awvalid & rr);
        102:
        103:     // AW datapath (granted master's request)
        104:     assign s_awid    = aw_gnt_m1 ? m1_awid    : m0_awid;
        105:     assign s_awaddr  = aw_gnt_m1 ? m1_awaddr  : m0_awaddr;
        106:     assign s_awlen   = aw_gnt_m1 ? m1_awlen   : m0_awlen;
        107:     assign s_awsize  = aw_gnt_m1 ? m1_awsize  : m0_awsize;
        108:     assign s_awburst = aw_gnt_m1 ? m1_awburst : m0_awburst;
        109:     assign s_awlock  = aw_gnt_m1 ? m1_awlock  : m0_awlock;
        110:     assign s_awcache = aw_gnt_m1 ? m1_awcache : m0_awcache;
        111:     assign s_awprot  = aw_gnt_m1 ? m1_awprot  : m0_awprot;
        112:     assign s_awvalid = aw_gnt_m0 | aw_gnt_m1;
        113:
        114:     assign m0_awready = aw_gnt_m0 & s_awready;
        115:     assign m1_awready = aw_gnt_m1 & s_awready;
        116:
        117:     // W datapath (only the owner's beats can flow)
        118:     assign s_wdata  = owner ? m1_wdata : m0_wdata;
        119:     assign s_wstrb  = owner ? m1_wstrb : m0_wstrb;
        120:     assign s_wlast  = owner ? m1_wlast : m0_wlast;
        121:     assign s_wvalid = busy & (owner ? m1_wvalid : m0_wvalid);
        122:
        123:     assign m0_wready = busy & ~owner & s_wready;
        124:     assign m1_wready = busy &  owner & s_wready;
        125:
        126:     // B path: single outstanding -> the owner gets the fabric-minted response
        127:     assign m0_bvalid = busy & ~owner & s_bvalid;
        128:     assign m1_bvalid = busy &  owner & s_bvalid;
        129:     assign m0_bid    = s_bid;
        130:     assign m1_bid    = s_bid;

      ###source/axi_crossbar/ddr_w_arb.v
      // ============================================================================
      // ddr_w_arb.v -- [WARB 2026-09-19] minimal 2-master DDR write arbiter.
      //
      // WHY: the Forencich axi_crossbar's M00 write path leaks its per-master W-channel
      // select across handoffs (bench-proven in sim/wedge: after S01's burst tail the
      // M00 w_select_valid latches forever, S04's beats are never released, and both
      // camera engines wedge after 1-2 bursts). This module replaces the crossbar on
      // the DDR write path for the two camera engines.
      //
      // DESIGN: single-outstanding end-to-end, matching the DDR3 IP user-port contract
      // (no wvalid, unthrottleable wready, one burst processed at a time):
      //   IDLE  : present one master's AW (round-robin tie-break); the accept from the
      //           port glue locks OWNER for the whole burst.
      //   BUSY  : only OWNER's W stream reaches the glue; the fabric-minted B (from
      //           wusero_last) is routed back to OWNER; its accept frees the slot and
      //           flips the round-robin bit.
      // AXI-legal: awvalid/wvalid are held with stable payload until accepted; the
      // non-owner master's awready/wready stay low, so its burst cannot start.
      // ============================================================================
      `timescale 1ns/1ps
      module ddr_w_arb (
          input  wire         clk,
          input  wire         rst,
      
          // ---- master 0 (cam1 DMA) ----
          input  wire [3:0]   m0_awid,
          input  wire [31:0]  m0_awaddr,
          input  wire [7:0]   m0_awlen,
          input  wire [2:0]   m0_awsize,
          input  wire [1:0]   m0_awburst,
          input  wire         m0_awlock,
          input  wire [3:0]   m0_awcache,
          input  wire [2:0]   m0_awprot,
          input  wire         m0_awvalid,
          output wire         m0_awready,
          input  wire [127:0] m0_wdata,
          input  wire [15:0]  m0_wstrb,
          input  wire         m0_wlast,
          input  wire         m0_wvalid,
          output wire         m0_wready,
          output wire [3:0]   m0_bid,
          output wire [1:0]   m0_bresp,
          output wire         m0_bvalid,
          input  wire         m0_bready,
      
          // ---- master 1 (cam2 DMA) ----
          input  wire [3:0]   m1_awid,
          input  wire [31:0]  m1_awaddr,
          input  wire [7:0]   m1_awlen,
          input  wire [2:0]   m1_awsize,
          input  wire [1:0]   m1_awburst,
          input  wire         m1_awlock,
          input  wire [3:0]   m1_awcache,
          input  wire [2:0]   m1_awprot,
          input  wire         m1_awvalid,
          output wire         m1_awready,
          input  wire [127:0] m1_wdata,
          input  wire [15:0]  m1_wstrb,
          input  wire         m1_wlast,
          input  wire         m1_wvalid,
          output wire         m1_wready,
          output wire [3:0]   m1_bid,
          output wire [1:0]   m1_bresp,
          output wire         m1_bvalid,
          input  wire         m1_bready,
      
          // ---- slave (DDR3 port glue) ----
          output wire [3:0]   s_awid,
          output wire [31:0]  s_awaddr,
          output wire [7:0]   s_awlen,
          output wire [2:0]   s_awsize,
          output wire [1:0]   s_awburst,
          output wire         s_awlock,
          output wire [3:0]   s_awcache,
          output wire [2:0]   s_awprot,
          output wire         s_awvalid,
          input  wire         s_awready,
          output wire [127:0] s_wdata,
          output wire [15:0]  s_wstrb,
          output wire         s_wlast,
          output wire         s_wvalid,
          input  wire         s_wready,
          input  wire [3:0]   s_bid,
          input  wire [1:0]   s_bresp,
          input  wire         s_bvalid,
          output wire         s_bready
      );
      
          // Experimental throughput version: retain ownership for eight adjacent
          // DDR bursts before rotating. The user requested restoring this exact
          // experiment after the rollback image was tested.
          localparam [2:0] BURSTS_PER_TURN = 3'd8;
      
          reg  busy;      // an AW is locked in (waiting for its B)
          reg  owner;     // 0 = master0 owns the slot, 1 = master1
          reg  rr;        // round-robin tie-break for the next idle grant
          reg  [2:0] turn_count;
      
          // grant decision: only when idle; alternate when both masters ask
          wire aw_gnt_m1 = ~busy & m1_awvalid & ( rr | ~m0_awvalid);
          wire aw_gnt_m0 = ~busy & m0_awvalid & ~(m1_awvalid & rr);
      
          // AW datapath (granted master's request)
          assign s_awid    = aw_gnt_m1 ? m1_awid    : m0_awid;
          assign s_awaddr  = aw_gnt_m1 ? m1_awaddr  : m0_awaddr;
          assign s_awlen   = aw_gnt_m1 ? m1_awlen   : m0_awlen;
          assign s_awsize  = aw_gnt_m1 ? m1_awsize  : m0_awsize;
          assign s_awburst = aw_gnt_m1 ? m1_awburst : m0_awburst;
          assign s_awlock  = aw_gnt_m1 ? m1_awlock  : m0_awlock;
          assign s_awcache = aw_gnt_m1 ? m1_awcache : m0_awcache;
          assign s_awprot  = aw_gnt_m1 ? m1_awprot  : m0_awprot;
          assign s_awvalid = aw_gnt_m0 | aw_gnt_m1;
      
          assign m0_awready = aw_gnt_m0 & s_awready;
          assign m1_awready = aw_gnt_m1 & s_awready;
      
          // W datapath (only the owner's beats can flow)
          assign s_wdata  = owner ? m1_wdata : m0_wdata;
          assign s_wstrb  = owner ? m1_wstrb : m0_wstrb;
          assign s_wlast  = owner ? m1_wlast : m0_wlast;
          assign s_wvalid = busy & (owner ? m1_wvalid : m0_wvalid);
      
          assign m0_wready = busy & ~owner & s_wready;
          assign m1_wready = busy &  owner & s_wready;
      
          // B path: single outstanding -> the owner gets the fabric-minted response
          assign m0_bvalid = busy & ~owner & s_bvalid;
          assign m1_bvalid = busy &  owner & s_bvalid;
          assign m0_bid    = s_bid;
          assign m1_bid    = s_bid;
          assign m0_bresp  = s_bresp;
          assign m1_bresp  = s_bresp;
          assign s_bready  = busy & (owner ? m1_bready : m0_bready);
      
          always @(posedge clk) begin
              if (rst) begin
                  busy  <= 1'b0;
                  owner <= 1'b0;
                  rr    <= 1'b0;
                  turn_count <= 3'd0;
              end
              else begin
                  if (!busy && (aw_gnt_m0 | aw_gnt_m1) && s_awready) begin
                      busy  <= 1'b1;
                      owner <= aw_gnt_m1;
                      if (turn_count == BURSTS_PER_TURN - 1'b1) begin
                          turn_count <= 3'd0;
                          rr <= aw_gnt_m0;         // rotate after the eight-burst quantum
                      end
                      else begin
                          turn_count <= turn_count + 1'b1;
                          rr <= rr;                // keep the same owner during the quantum
                      end
                  end
                  else if (busy && s_bvalid && s_bready) begin
                      busy  <= 1'b0;
                  end
              end
          end
      
      endmodule
      
      
      ###source/axi_dma/axi_dma_write.v
      module axi_dma_write
      	#(
      		parameter 		BURST_LEN 	= 8		,
      		parameter       ID_WIDTH  	= 4		,
      		parameter       DATA_WIDTH 	= 128	,
      		parameter       KEEP_WIDTH  = DATA_WIDTH / 8
      	)
      	(
      	input 				clk 			,    // Clock
      	input 				rst 			,    // Synchronous reset active high
      
      	//cmd interface
      	input       	 					cmd_valid		,
      	input 			[31:0] 				cmd_addr		,
      	input 			[31:0] 				cmd_len			,
      	input			[ID_WIDTH - 1:0]    cmd_id          ,
      	output reg  	    				cmd_ready		,
      
      	//trans data in
      	input 			[DATA_WIDTH - 1:0]  data_in      	,
      	input			[KEEP_WIDTH - 1:0]	data_in_keep	,
      	input         						data_in_valid	,
      	output reg                          data_in_last    ,
      	output        						data_in_ready	,
      
      	//axi w
      	output reg		[ID_WIDTH - 1:0]   			m_axi_awid   	,
      	output reg		[31:0]  					m_axi_awaddr 	,
      	output reg		[7:0]   					m_axi_awlen  	,
      	output 			[2:0]   					m_axi_awsize 	,
      	output 			[1:0]   					m_axi_awburst	,
      	output 		    	    					m_axi_awlock 	,
      	output 			[3:0]   					m_axi_awcache	,
      	output 			[2:0]   					m_axi_awprot	,
      	output reg		        					m_axi_awvalid	,
      	input  		 	        					m_axi_awready	,
      	output 			[DATA_WIDTH - 1:0] 			m_axi_wdata		,
      	output 			[KEEP_WIDTH - 1:0]  		m_axi_wstrb		,
      	output 			        					m_axi_wlast		,
      	output 			        					m_axi_wvalid	,
      	input  			        					m_axi_wready	,
      	input  			[ID_WIDTH - 1:0]   			m_axi_bid  		,
      	input  			[1:0]   					m_axi_bresp 	,
      	input  			        					m_axi_bvalid	,
      	output 			        					m_axi_bready
      
      );
      
      
      localparam AXI_BURST_SIZE = $clog2(KEEP_WIDTH); //log2(DATA_WIDTH / 8)
      
      // [WD 2026-09-18] transmit watchdog state
      reg        abort_r;
      reg [23:0] wd_cnt;
      wire       w_progress;
      wire       abort_done;
      
      wire [DATA_WIDTH - 1:0] 		t_m_axi_wdata;
      wire [KEEP_WIDTH - 1:0]  		t_m_axi_wstrb;
      wire         					t_m_axi_wlast;
      wire         					t_m_axi_wvalid;
      wire         					t_m_axi_wready;
      
      //common para
      assign m_axi_awsize 	= 		AXI_BURST_SIZE	;
      assign m_axi_awburst 	= 		2'b01			;
      assign m_axi_awlock 	= 		1'b0			;
      assign m_axi_awcache 	= 		4'b0011			;
      assign m_axi_awprot 	= 		3'b000			;
      
      
      wire [7:0] burst_len    ;
      wire [7:0] max_burst_len;
      
      //cmd
      reg [31:0] addr;
      reg [31:0] len;
      reg        trans;
      
      always @(posedge clk) begin
      	if((cmd_ready == 1'b1) && (cmd_valid == 1'b1))begin
      		addr <= cmd_addr;
      	end
      	else begin
      		if((m_axi_awvalid == 1'b1) && (m_axi_awready == 1'b1))begin
      			addr <= addr + ((m_axi_awlen + 1'b1) << AXI_BURST_SIZE);
      		end
      	end
      end
      
      always @(posedge clk) begin
      	if((cmd_ready == 1'b1) && (cmd_valid == 1'b1))begin
      		len <= cmd_len[31:AXI_BURST_SIZE] + (|cmd_len[AXI_BURST_SIZE - 1:0]);
      	end
      	else begin
      		if((m_axi_awvalid == 1'b1) && (m_axi_awready == 1'b1))begin
      			len <= len - (m_axi_awlen + 1'b1);
      		end
      		else if(abort_done == 1'b1)begin
      			len <= 32'd0;       // [WD]
      		end
      	end
      end
      always @(posedge clk)begin
      	if(rst == 1'b1)begin
      		trans <= 1'b0;
      	end
      	else begin
      		if((cmd_ready == 1'b1) && (cmd_valid == 1'b1))begin
      			trans <= 1'b1;
      		end
      		else begin
      			if((m_axi_bready == 1'b1) && (m_axi_bvalid == 1'b1) && (len == 32'd0))begin
      				trans <= 1'b0;
      			end
      			else if(abort_done == 1'b1)begin
      				trans <= 1'b0;      // [WD] release the stuck transaction
      			end
      		end
      	end
      end
      
      always @(posedge  clk)begin
      	if(rst == 1'b1)begin
      		cmd_ready <= 1'b0;
      	end
      	else begin
      		if(trans == 1'b0)begin
      			if((cmd_ready == 1'b1) && (cmd_valid == 1'b1))begin
      				cmd_ready <= 1'b0;
      			end
      			else begin
      				cmd_ready <= 1'b1;
      			end
      		end
      		else begin
      			cmd_ready <= 1'b0;
      		end
      	end
      end
      
      //aw
      
      reg burst_trans;
      assign burst_len     = len > BURST_LEN ? BURST_LEN : len;
      assign max_burst_len = (((addr & 12'hfff) + (burst_len << AXI_BURST_SIZE )) >> 12)  != 0 ? (13'h1000 - (addr & 12'hfff)) >> AXI_BURST_SIZE : burst_len;
      always@(posedge clk)begin
      	if(rst == 1'b1)begin
      		burst_trans <= 1'b0;
      	end
      	else begin
      		if((m_axi_awvalid == 1'b1) && (m_axi_awready == 1'b1))begin
      			burst_trans <= 1'b1;
      		end
      		else begin
      			// if((m_axi_wvalid == 1'b1) && (m_axi_wready == 1'b1) && (m_axi_wlast == 1'b1))begin
      			if((m_axi_bvalid == 1'b1) && (m_axi_bready == 1'b1))begin
      				burst_trans <= 1'b0;
      			end
      			else if(abort_done == 1'b1)begin
      				burst_trans <= 1'b0;   // [WD2] force-release; B may never arrive
      			end
      		end
      	end
      end
      always @(posedge clk)begin
      	if(rst == 1'b1)begin
      		m_axi_awvalid <= 1'b0;
      	end
      	else begin
      		if((m_axi_awvalid == 1'b1) && (m_axi_awready == 1'b1))begin
      			m_axi_awvalid <= 1'b0;
      		end
      		else begin
      			if((burst_trans == 1'b0) && (len != 32'd0) && (abort_r == 1'b0))begin
      				m_axi_awvalid <= 1'b1;
      			end
      		end
      	end
      end
      
      always @(posedge clk)begin
      	m_axi_awlen <= max_burst_len - 8'd1;
      end
      always @(posedge clk)begin
      	m_axi_awaddr <= addr;
      end
      always @(posedge clk) begin
      	if((cmd_ready == 1'b1) && (cmd_valid == 1'b1))begin
      		m_axi_awid <= cmd_id;
      	end
      end
      //w
      reg [7:0] act_burst_len;
      always@ (posedge clk)begin
      	if(rst == 1'b1)begin
      		act_burst_len <= 8'd0;
      	end
      	else begin
      		if((m_axi_awvalid == 1'b1) && (m_axi_awready == 1'b1))begin
      			act_burst_len <= m_axi_awlen + 8'd1;
      		end
      		else begin
      			if((t_m_axi_wvalid == 1'b1) && (t_m_axi_wready == 1'b1))begin
      				act_burst_len <= act_burst_len - 8'd1;
      			end
      		end
      	end
      end
      
      // [WD 2026-09-18] ------------------------------------------------------------------
      // The DVP stream can deliver fewer 128-bit beats than CAM_DATA_LEN (CDC FIFO
      // overflow drops pixels and cannot back-pressure the sensor). A frame's AXI
      // burst then never completes: trans sticks at 1, cmd_ready stays low and the
      // frame FSM deadlocks forever (measured: state=ADDR, axi_cnt=0, 0 frames).
      //
      // Recovery: if there is no W-beat progress for ~0.17 s while a write is in
      // flight, close the open burst with dummy beats. AXI forbids cancelling an
      // accepted AW, so we must still supply awlen beats; we just no longer consume
      // real camera data. After the B response is absorbed, trans/len clear and the
      // next frame's command is accepted again (only the bad frame is lost).
      assign w_progress = (t_m_axi_wvalid == 1'b1) && (t_m_axi_wready == 1'b1);
      
      always @(posedge clk) begin
      	if((rst == 1'b1) || (trans == 1'b0) || (abort_r == 1'b1) || (w_progress == 1'b1))
      		wd_cnt <= 24'd0;
      	else if(wd_cnt != 24'hFFFFFF)
      		wd_cnt <= wd_cnt + 24'd1;
      end
      
      // [BFAST 2026-09-19] the DDR write port can stop returning B responses
      // (see [WD2]; re-observed 09-19: b_cnt ~26 total while aw_cnt ~60k).
      // Waiting the full 0.17 s watchdog once every command's beats are out
      // capped the camera path at ~5 fps. Give B a few microseconds after the
      // last beat, then force the close via the abort path; a late B is still
      // absorbed by the w_done/bready logic.
      reg [9:0] bwait_cnt;
      // (w_done intentionally not referenced: it is declared further below and
      // act_burst_len==0 && burst_trans already means every beat is out, B pending)
      wire all_beats_out = (len == 32'd0) && (act_burst_len == 8'd0) && burst_trans;
      always @(posedge clk) begin
      	if((rst == 1'b1) || (trans == 1'b0) || (all_beats_out == 1'b0) || (abort_r == 1'b1))
      		bwait_cnt <= 10'd0;
      	else if(bwait_cnt != 10'h3FF)
      		bwait_cnt <= bwait_cnt + 10'd1;
      end
      always @(posedge clk) begin
      	if(rst == 1'b1)
      		abort_r <= 1'b0;
      	// [BFAST2 2026-09-19] bwait fast-close DISABLED: B latency under DDR contention
      	// can legitimately exceed the 10us grace; force-closing mid-flight corrupted
      	// the crossbar/DDR transaction stream and killed M00 writes within seconds.
      	// Fall back to the long send-watchdog only.
      	else if((abort_r == 1'b0) && (trans == 1'b1) && (wd_cnt == 24'hFFFFFF))
      		abort_r <= 1'b1;
      	else if(abort_done == 1'b1)
      		abort_r <= 1'b0;
      end
      
      // [WD2 2026-09-18] burst_trans is only cleared by the B response, which is
      // exactly what never arrives in the wedge case (cam2: bvalid never asserted).
      // Requiring burst_trans==0 made abort_done unreachable -> no recovery.
      // All W beats for the open burst are out once act_burst_len hits 0, so that
      // is the correct release point; burst_trans is force-cleared below.
      assign abort_done = abort_r && (act_burst_len == 8'd0);
      // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------
      
      stream_pipe #(
        .DATA_WIDTH 	(DATA_WIDTH+1+KEEP_WIDTH)
      ) stream_pipe_3(
        .dataIn_valid     (t_m_axi_wvalid),
        .dataIn_ready     (t_m_axi_wready),
        .dataIn_payload   ({t_m_axi_wdata, t_m_axi_wstrb, t_m_axi_wlast}),
        .dataOut_valid    (m_axi_wvalid),
        .dataOut_ready    (m_axi_wready),
        .dataOut_payload  ({m_axi_wdata, m_axi_wstrb, m_axi_wlast}),
        .clk              (clk),
        .reset            (rst)
      );
      
      assign data_in_ready = abort_r ? 1'b0
                                     : (t_m_axi_wready && act_burst_len > 8'd0);
      assign t_m_axi_wvalid  = abort_r ? (act_burst_len > 8'd0)
                                       : (data_in_valid && act_burst_len > 8'd0);
      assign t_m_axi_wdata   = abort_r ? {DATA_WIDTH{1'b0}} : data_in;
      assign t_m_axi_wlast   = (act_burst_len == 8'd1);
      assign t_m_axi_wstrb   = abort_r ? {KEEP_WIDTH{1'b1}} : data_in_keep;
      
      //b
      reg w_done;
      always @(posedge clk) begin
      	if(rst == 1'b1) begin
      		w_done <= 1'b0;
      	end
      	else begin
      		if((t_m_axi_wvalid == 1'b1) && (t_m_axi_wready == 1'b1) && (t_m_axi_wlast == 1'b1)) begin
      			w_done <= 1'b1;
      		end
      		else begin
      			if((m_axi_bvalid == 1'b1) && (m_axi_bready == 1'b1)) begin
      				w_done <= 1'b0;
      			end
      		end
      	end
      end
      assign m_axi_bready = w_done;
      
      // [LEDGER 2026-09-19] single-ledger completion: pulse exactly once per
      // command on the trans 1->0 fall. Covers the normal close (B absorbed,
      // len==0) AND both watchdog abort paths; the old B-gated expression never
      // pulsed when a B response was lost, wedging the frame FSM in DATA forever.
      reg trans_q;
      always @(posedge clk) begin
      	if(rst == 1'b1) trans_q <= 1'b0;
      	else            trans_q <= trans;
      end
      
      always @(posedge clk ) begin
      	if(rst == 1'b1)begin
      		data_in_last <= 1'b0;
      	end
      	else begin
      		data_in_last <= trans_q && (trans == 1'b0);
      	end
      end
      
      endmodule
      
      ###source/ov5640/ov5640_ddr/ov5640_ddr_w_ctrl.v
      //锟斤拷锟斤拷CMD锟斤拷锟斤拷
      module ov5640_ddr_w_ctrl #(
          parameter AXI_ADDR_WIDTH = 32,
          parameter AXI_LEN_WIDTH  = 32,
          parameter AXI_DATA_WIDTH = 128,

          // it can be read reliably once streaming stops.

                              cam_data_temp <= s_data;
                          end
                          2'b01:begin
                              cam_data_temp <= {8'd0, s_data[23:8]};
                          end
                          2'b10:begin
                              cam_data_temp <= {16'd0, s_data[23:16]};

      #!/usr/bin/env python3
      """Read-only RK3568 dual-camera tag and DMA timing probe.
      
      The caller should stop camview before running this tool because the driver
      currently permits only one DMA mapping context. No FPGA registers are written.
      """
      import ctypes
      import fcntl
      import mmap
      import os
      import signal
      import struct
      import sys
      import time
      
      
      class Timeout(Exception):
          pass
      
      
      def alarm_handler(_signum, _frame):
          raise Timeout()
      
      
      class DmaOp(ctypes.Structure):
          _fields_ = [
              ("current_len", ctypes.c_uint32),
              ("offset_addr", ctypes.c_uint32),
              ("cmd", ctypes.c_uint32),
              ("ddr3_addr", ctypes.c_uint32),
              ("total_length", ctypes.c_uint32),
              ("read_buf", ctypes.c_void_p),
              ("write_buf", ctypes.c_void_p),
          ]
      
      
      def ioctl_code(number):
          return 0xC0000000 | (4 << 16) | (0x53 << 8) | number
      
      
      MAP_CMD = ioctl_code(2)
      F2H_CMD = ioctl_code(5)
      FRAME_BYTES = 640 * 480 * 2
      TAGS = {
          "c1a": 0x00800000 + FRAME_BYTES,
          "c1b": 0x00A00000 + FRAME_BYTES,
          "c2a": 0x00C00000 + FRAME_BYTES,
          "c2b": 0x00E00000 + FRAME_BYTES,
      }
      REGS = {
          "c1_pclk": 0x20000010,
          "c1_vsync": 0x20000020,
          "c1_words": 0x20000030,
          "c1_i2c": 0x20000060,
          "c1_sys": 0x20000070,
          "c1_axi_now": 0x200000D0,
          "c1_beat_cnt": 0x200000A0,
          "c1_href_raw": 0x20000090,
          "c1_vsync_raw": 0x200000E0,
          "c1_beat_last": 0x200000F0,
          "c2_pclk": 0x20000210,
          "c2_vsync": 0x20000220,
          "c2_words": 0x20000230,
          "c2_i2c": 0x20000260,
          "c2_sys": 0x20000270,
          "c2_axi_now": 0x200002D0,
          "c2_beat_cnt": 0x200002A0,
          "c2_href_raw": 0x20000290,
          "c2_vsync_raw": 0x200002E0,
          "c2_beat_last": 0x200002F0,
      }
      
      
      def timed_ioctl(fd, command, op, timeout=12):
          signal.alarm(timeout)
          try:
              fcntl.ioctl(fd, command, op, True)
          finally:
              signal.alarm(0)
      
      
      def main():
          signal.signal(signal.SIGALRM, alarm_handler)
          fd = os.open("/dev/pango_pci_driver", os.O_RDWR | os.O_SYNC)
          try:
              for mapping in (0, 1):
                  op = DmaOp()
                  op.cmd = mapping
                  op.total_length = 4 * 1024 * 1024
                  timed_ioctl(fd, MAP_CMD, op)
              rx = mmap.mmap(fd, 4 * 1024 * 1024, prot=mmap.PROT_READ | mmap.PROT_WRITE,
                             flags=mmap.MAP_SHARED, offset=1024 * 1024)

      import ctypes

      class Timeout(Exception):

          return 0xC0000000 | (4 << 16) | (0x53 << 8) | number
      
      
      MAP_CMD = ioctl_code(2)
      F2H_CMD = ioctl_code(5)
      FRAME_BYTES = 640 * 480 * 2
      TAGS = {
          "c1a": 0x00800000 + FRAME_BYTES,
          "c1b": 0x00A00000 + FRAME_BYTES,

      }
      
      
      def timed_ioctl(fd, command, op, timeout=12):

      #!/usr/bin/env python3
      # -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
      """board_ssh.py -- RK3568 board access over the LAPTOP hotspot (192.168.137.x).
      SSH linaro/linaro; helper CLI used by the deploy/verify steps.
      
      Usage:
        python board_ssh.py run "<shell command>"
        python board_ssh.py put <local> <remote>
        python board_ssh.py get <remote> <local>
      """
      import sys, paramiko
      
      HOST = '192.168.137.4'
      USER, PW = 'linaro', 'linaro'
      
      
      def connect():
          cli = paramiko.SSHClient()
          cli.set_missing_host_key_policy(paramiko.AutoAddPolicy())
          cli.connect(HOST, 22, USER, PW, timeout=8, allow_agent=False, look_for_keys=False)
          return cli
      
      
      def run(cli, cmd, timeout=120, sudo=False):
          if sudo:
              cmd = "echo '%s' | sudo -S bash -c %s" % (PW, "'" + cmd.replace("'", "'\\''") + "'")
          stdin, stdout, stderr = cli.exec_command(cmd, timeout=timeout)
          out = stdout.read().decode('utf-8', 'replace')
          err = stderr.read().decode('utf-8', 'replace')
          rc = stdout.channel.recv_exit_status()
          return rc, out, err
      
      
      def main():
          cli = connect()
          try:
              mode = sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv) > 1 else 'run'
              if mode == 'run':
                  rc, out, err = run(cli, sys.argv[2], timeout=300, sudo=('--sudo' in sys.argv))
                  print(out)
                  if err.strip():
                      print('[stderr]', err[-1500:])
                  sys.exit(rc)
              elif mode == 'put':
                  sftp = cli.open_sftp()
                  sftp.put(sys.argv[2], sys.argv[3])
                  sftp.close()
                  print('put OK')
              elif mode == 'get':
                  sftp = cli.open_sftp()
                  sftp.get(sys.argv[2], sys.argv[3])
                  sftp.close()
                  print('get OK')
          finally:
              cli.close()
      
      
      if __name__ == '__main__':
          main()

      def run(s, cmd, timeout=30):

              s.write(("truncate -s -" + str(len(chunk)) + " " + path + ".b64 2>/dev/null" + chr(10)).encode())

      def main(src, dst):
          data = open(src, 'rb').read()
          md5 = hashlib.md5(data).hexdigest()
          b64 = base64.b64encode(data).decode()
          nch = math.ceil(len(b64) / CHUNK)
          print(f"transfer {len(data)} B -> {dst} ({nch} chunks)")
          s = open_port()
          print(run(s, "mkdir -p $(dirname " + dst + "); rm -f " + dst + ".b64 " + dst + "; stty -echo; echo READY"))
          t0 = time.time()
          for i in range(nch):
              chunk = b64[i*CHUNK:(i+1)*CHUNK]
              if not send_chunk(s, chunk, dst, i):
                  print(f"CHUNK {i} FAILED"); s.close(); return 1
              if i % 40 == 0:
                  print(f"  {i}/{nch} {time.time()-t0:.0f}s")
          dt = time.time() - t0
          out = run(s, "base64 -d " + dst + ".b64 > " + dst + " && md5sum " + dst, timeout=120)
          run(s, "rm -f " + dst + ".b64")
          print(f"transfer {dt:.0f}s")
          if md5 in out:
              print(f"VERIFY OK {dst} md5={md5}")
              s.close(); return 0
          print(f"VERIFY FAILED expect={md5}")
          print(out[-300:])
          s.close(); return 1
      
      if __name__ == '__main__':
          sys.exit(main(sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2]))

      #!/usr/bin/env python3
      # -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
      """board_ssh.py -- RK3568 board access over the LAPTOP hotspot (192.168.137.x).
      SSH linaro/linaro; helper CLI used by the deploy/verify steps.
      
      Usage:
        python board_ssh.py run "<shell command>"
        python board_ssh.py put <local> <remote>
        python board_ssh.py get <remote> <local>
      """
      import sys, paramiko
      
      HOST = '192.168.137.4'
      USER, PW = 'linaro', 'linaro'
      
      
      def connect():
          cli = paramiko.SSHClient()
          cli.set_missing_host_key_policy(paramiko.AutoAddPolicy())
          cli.connect(HOST, 22, USER, PW, timeout=8, allow_agent=False, look_for_keys=False)
          return cli
      
      
      def run(cli, cmd, timeout=120, sudo=False):
          if sudo:
              cmd = "echo '%s' | sudo -S bash -c %s" % (PW, "'" + cmd.replace("'", "'\\''") + "'")
          stdin, stdout, stderr = cli.exec_command(cmd, timeout=timeout)
          out = stdout.read().decode('utf-8', 'replace')
          err = stderr.read().decode('utf-8', 'replace')
          rc = stdout.channel.recv_exit_status()
          return rc, out, err
      
      
      def main():
          cli = connect()
          try:
              mode = sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv) > 1 else 'run'
              if mode == 'run':
                  rc, out, err = run(cli, sys.argv[2], timeout=300, sudo=('--sudo' in sys.argv))
                  print(out)
                  if err.strip():
                      print('[stderr]', err[-1500:])
                  sys.exit(rc)
              elif mode == 'put':
                  sftp = cli.open_sftp()
                  sftp.put(sys.argv[2], sys.argv[3])
                  sftp.close()
                  print('put OK')
              elif mode == 'get':
                  sftp = cli.open_sftp()
                  sftp.get(sys.argv[2], sys.argv[3])
                  sftp.close()
                  print('get OK')
          finally:
              cli.close()
      
      
      if __name__ == '__main__':
          main()
