         84:                 end
         85:                 else begin
         86:                     next_state = IDLE;
         87:                 end
         88:             end
         89:             ADDR: begin
         90:                 if(axi_cmd_ready & axi_cmd_valid)begin
         91:                     next_state = DATA;
         92:                 end
         93:                 else if(wd_expire)begin
         94:                     next_state = IDLE;      // [WD2] cmd_ready stuck -> retry
         95:                 end
         96:                 else begin
         97:                     next_state = ADDR;
         98:                 end
         99:             end
        100:             DATA: begin
        101:                 if(frame_done)begin
        102:                     next_state = ADDR_TAG;              // [FRTAG] frame complete, go write the tag
        103:                 end
        104:                 else if(wd_expire)begin
        105:                     next_state = IDLE;                  // [FIX] retry next vsync
        106:                 end
        107:                 else begin
        108:                     next_state = DATA;
        109:                 end
        110:             end
        111:             ADDR_TAG: begin
        112:                 if(axi_cmd_ready & axi_cmd_valid)begin
        113:                     next_state = DATA_TAG;
        114:                 end
        115:                 else if(wd_expire)begin
        116:                     next_state = IDLE;                  // [FIX]
        117:                 end
        118:                 else begin
        119:                     next_state = ADDR_TAG;
        120:                 end
        121:             end
        122:             DATA_TAG: begin
        123:                 if(tag_fire || wd_expire)begin
        124:                     next_state = IDLE;
        125:                 end
        126:                 else begin
        127:                     next_state = DATA_TAG;
        128:                 end
        129:             end
        130:             default: begin
        131:                 next_state = IDLE;
        132:             end
        133:         endcase
        134:     end
        135:
        136:
        137:     always @(posedge axi_clk) begin
        138:         if(axi_rst)begin
        139:             axi_vsync_ff <= 2'b0;
        140:         end
        141:         else begin
        142:             axi_vsync_ff <= {axi_vsync_ff[0], s_vsync};
        143:         end
        144:     end
        145:
        146:     always @(posedge axi_clk) begin
        147:         if(axi_rst)begin
        148:             axi_vsync_rise <= 1'b0;
        149:         end
        150:         else begin
        151:             axi_vsync_rise <= axi_vsync_ff[0] & (~axi_vsync_ff[1]);
        152:         end
        153:     end
        154:
        155:     reg w_ping;
        156:     always @(posedge axi_clk) begin
        157:         if(axi_rst)begin
        158:             w_ping <= 1'b0;
        159:         end
        160:         else begin
        161:             if(frame_done)begin
        162:                 w_ping <= ~w_ping;
        163:             end
        164:         end
        165:     end
        166:
        167:
        168:     // [FRTAG 2026-09-14] sticky vsync latch: a vsync pulse arriving while the tag
        169:     // states are running must not be lost (previously a 1-cycle rise pulse).
        170:     always @(posedge axi_clk) begin
        171:         if(axi_rst)begin
        172:             vsync_pending <= 1'b0;
        173:         end
        174:         else if(axi_vsync_rise)begin
        175:             vsync_pending <= 1'b1;
        176:         end
        177:         else if((curr_state == IDLE) && vsync_pending)begin
        178:             vsync_pending <= 1'b0;
        179:         end
        180:     end
        181:
        182:     always @(posedge axi_clk) begin
        183:         if(axi_rst)begin
        184:             axi_cmd_valid <= 1'b0;
        185:         end
        186:         else begin
        187:             if((curr_state == IDLE) && vsync_pending)begin
        188:                 axi_cmd_valid <= 1'b1;
        189:             end
        190:             else if(frame_done)begin
        191:                 axi_cmd_valid <= 1'b1;      // [FRTAG] frame done -> present the tag command
        192:             end
        193:             else if(axi_cmd_valid & axi_cmd_ready)begin
        194:                 axi_cmd_valid <= 1'b0;
        195:             end
        196:         end
        197:     end
        198:
        199:
        200:     always @(posedge axi_clk) begin
        201:         if(w_ping)begin
        202:             cmd_addr <= cam_data_addr_2;
        203:         end
        204:         else begin
        205:             cmd_addr <= cam_data_addr_1;
        206:         end
        207:     end
        208:
        209:     assign axi_cmd_addr = (curr_state == ADDR_TAG) ? tag_addr : cmd_addr;
        210:     // [FRTAG 2026-09-14] tag command = one 16-byte beat at frame_base + frame size
        211:     assign axi_cmd_len  = (curr_state == ADDR_TAG) ? 32'd16
        212:                         : {{AXI_LEN_WIDTH-4-$clog2(CAM_DATA_LEN){1'd0}}, cam_data_len, 4'b0};
        213:
        214:
        215:     // [FRTAG 2026-09-14] frame counter + tag beat generation --------------------
        216:     // frame_base is latched when the FRAME command is accepted (cmd_addr still
        217:     // points at the buffer being written at that moment; w_ping flips later).
        218:     always @(posedge axi_clk) begin
        219:         if(axi_rst)begin
        220:             frame_base <= {AXI_ADDR_WIDTH{1'b0}};
        221:         end
        222:         else if((curr_state == ADDR) && axi_cmd_valid && axi_cmd_ready)begin
        223:             frame_base <= cmd_addr;
        224:         end
        225:     end
        226:
        227:     assign tag_addr = frame_base + (CAM_DATA_LEN << 4);
        228:
        229:     always @(posedge axi_clk) begin
        230:         if(axi_rst)begin
        231:             frame_cnt <= 32'd0;
        232:         end
        233:         else if(frame_done)begin
        234:             frame_cnt <= frame_cnt + 32'd1;
        235:         end
        236:     end
        237:
        238:     assign tag_active  = (curr_state == DATA_TAG);
        239:     assign tag_data    = {{(AXI_DATA_WIDTH-32){1'b0}}, frame_cnt};
        240:     assign tag_fire    = tag_active & tag_ready;
        241:     // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
        242:
        243:
        244:     //XDMA乒锟斤拷锟斤拷锟斤拷
        245:     reg [1 : 0] s_xdma_req;
        246:     always @(posedge axi_clk) begin
        247:         if(axi_rst)begin
        248:             s_xdma_req <= 2'b0;
        249:         end
        250:         else begin
        251:             if(frame_done)begin
        252:                 if(w_ping)begin
        253:                     s_xdma_req[1] <= 1'b1;
        254:                 end
        255:                 else begin
        256:                     s_xdma_req[0] <= 1'b1;
        257:                 end
        258:             end
        259:             else begin
        260:                 if(xdma_ack[0]) begin
        261:                     s_xdma_req[0] <= 1'b0;
        262:                 end
        263:                 if(xdma_ack[1]) begin
        264:                     s_xdma_req[1] <= 1'b0;
        265:                 end
        266:             end
        267:         end
        268:     end
        269:
        270:     assign xdma_req = s_xdma_req;
        271:     assign dbg_state = {29'd0, curr_state};
        272:     assign engine_busy = (curr_state != IDLE);
        273:
        274:     // [FIX 2026-09-18] frame-write watchdog: a frame that does not complete
        275:     // (lost/short camera stream) used to wedge this FSM in DATA forever. Bail
        276:     // back to IDLE after ~0.16 s and retry on the next vsync.
        277:     reg [31:0] wd_cnt;
        278:     // [WDFIX 2026-09-19] reset the budget on every state CHANGE, not only in
        279:     // IDLE: a frame that burns the budget in DATA (slow DMA close with the B
        280:     // path dead) used to make the immediately following ADDR_TAG/DATA_TAG
        281:     // expire instantly, silently skipping the frame-tag write.
        282:     reg [2:0] wd_prev_state;
        283:     always @(posedge axi_clk) begin
        284:         if(axi_rst) wd_prev_state <= IDLE;
        285:         else        wd_prev_state <= curr_state;
        286:     end
        287:     always @(posedge axi_clk) begin
        288:         if(axi_rst || (curr_state == IDLE) || (curr_state != wd_prev_state)) wd_cnt <= 32'd0;
        289:         else if(wd_cnt != 32'hffffffff)     wd_cnt <= wd_cnt + 32'd1;
        290:     end
        291:     assign wd_expire = (wd_cnt >= 32'd20_000_000);
        292:     assign dbg_wd_cnt = wd_cnt;
        293:
        294:     reg [31:0] last_cnt;
        295:     always @(posedge axi_clk) begin
        296:         if(axi_rst) last_cnt <= 32'd0;
        297:         else if(frame_done) last_cnt <= last_cnt + 32'd1;
        298:     end
        299:     assign dbg_last_cnt = last_cnt;
        300:
        301:
        302:
        303:
        304: endmodule
      
      ### source/ov5640/ov5640_ddr/ov5640_ddr.v
          1: module ov5640_ddr #(
          2:     parameter DATA_WIDTH = 16,
          3:     parameter AXI_ADDR_WIDTH = 32,
          4:     parameter AXI_LEN_WIDTH  = 32,
          5:     parameter AXI_DATA_WIDTH = 128,
          6:     parameter CAM_DATA_LEN   = 172800, //1280*720*3/16
          7:     parameter DEVICE = "PG"
          8: )(
          9:     input          axi_clk        ,
         10:     input          axi_rst        ,
         11:     input          dma_done       ,  // [LEDGER 2026-09-19] DMA transaction-done pulse
         12:     input          axi_cam_en     ,      //锟斤拷锟斤拷头锟斤拷锟斤拷锟脚猴拷
         13:
         14:     input  [AXI_ADDR_WIDTH-1 : 0]      cam_data_addr_1,
         15:     input  [AXI_ADDR_WIDTH-1 : 0]      cam_data_addr_2,
         16:     input  [$clog2(CAM_DATA_LEN) : 0]  cam_data_len   , //锟斤拷16锟街斤拷为锟斤拷位
         17:
         18:     input  [DATA_WIDTH-1 : 0]  s_data         /*synthesis PAP_MARK_DEBUG="1"*/,
         19:     input                      s_data_valid   /*synthesis PAP_MARK_DEBUG="1"*/,
         20:     input                      s_hsync        /*synthesis PAP_MARK_DEBUG="1"*/,
         21:     input                      s_vsync        /*synthesis PAP_MARK_DEBUG="1"*/,
         22:
         23:     output [AXI_DATA_WIDTH-1 : 0] axi_data       /*synthesis PAP_MARK_DEBUG="1"*/,
         24:     output                        axi_data_valid /*synthesis PAP_MARK_DEBUG="1"*/,
         25:     output                        axi_data_last  /*synthesis PAP_MARK_DEBUG="1"*/,
         26:     input                         axi_data_ready /*synthesis PAP_MARK_DEBUG="1"*/,
         27:
         28:     output [AXI_ADDR_WIDTH-1 : 0]  axi_cmd_addr   /*synthesis PAP_MARK_DEBUG="1"*/,
         29:     output [AXI_LEN_WIDTH-1 : 0]   axi_cmd_len    /*synthesis PAP_MARK_DEBUG="1"*/,
         30:     output                         axi_cmd_valid  /*synthesis PAP_MARK_DEBUG="1"*/,
         31:     input                          axi_cmd_ready  /*synthesis PAP_MARK_DEBUG="1"*/,
         32:
         33:     output [1 : 0]   xdma_req       ,
         34:     output [31:0]    dbg_axi_cnt    ,
         35:     output [31:0]    dbg_axi_num    ,
         36:     output [31:0]    dbg_zdin       ,
         37:     output [31:0]    dbg_zout       ,
         38:     output [31:0]    dbg_state      ,
         39:     output [31:0]    dbg_last_cnt   ,
         40:     output [31:0]    dbg_wd_cnt     ,
         41:     input  [1 : 0]   xdma_ack
         42: );
         43:
         44:     wire [DATA_WIDTH-1 : 0]  m_data      /*synthesis PAP_MARK_DEBUG="1"*/;
         45:     wire                     m_data_valid/*synthesis PAP_MARK_DEBUG="1"*/;
         46:     wire                     m_hsync     /*synthesis PAP_MARK_DEBUG="1"*/;
         47:     wire                     m_vsync     /*synthesis PAP_MARK_DEBUG="1"*/;
         48:
         49:     // [FRTAG 2026-09-14] frame-tag plumbing: the packer stream is detoured through
         50:     // w_* and the ctrl can substitute one counter beat during its DATA_TAG state.
         51:     wire [AXI_DATA_WIDTH-1 : 0] w_data  ;
         52:     wire                        w_valid ;
         53:     wire                        w_last  ;
         54:     wire                        w_ready ;
         55:     wire                        tag_active;
         56:     wire [AXI_DATA_WIDTH-1 : 0] tag_data  ;
         57:     wire                    engine_busy;   // [IDLEGATE 2026-09-19]
         58:
         59:
         60: ov5640_ddr_w_en #(
         61:     .DATA_WIDTH(DATA_WIDTH)
         62: )
         63: ov5640_ddr_w_en(
         64:     .engine_busy   (engine_busy   ),   // [IDLEGATE 2026-09-19] gate admission on write-engine idle
         65:     .axi_clk       (axi_clk        ),
         66:     .axi_rst       (axi_rst        ),
         67:
         68:     .axi_cam_en    (axi_cam_en),
         69:     .frame_pending (xdma_req),
         70:
         71:     .s_data        (s_data         ),
         72:     .s_data_valid  (s_data_valid   ),
         73:     .s_hsync       (s_hsync        ),
         74:     .s_vsync       (s_vsync        ),
         75:
         76:     .m_data        (m_data         ),
         77:     .m_data_valid  (m_data_valid   ),
         78:     .m_hsync       (m_hsync        ),
         79:     .m_vsync       (m_vsync        )
         80: );
         81:
         82:
         83:
         84: ov5640_ddr_w #(
         85:     .DATA_WIDTH(DATA_WIDTH),
         86:     .AXI_DATA_WIDTH(AXI_DATA_WIDTH),
         87:     .CAM_DATA_LEN(CAM_DATA_LEN),
         88:     .DEVICE(DEVICE)
         89: )
         90: ov5640_ddr_w(
         91:     .axi_clk        (axi_clk        ),
         92:     .axi_rst        (axi_rst        ),
         93:
         94:     .data_len       (cam_data_len   ), //锟斤拷16锟街斤拷为锟斤拷位
         95:
         96:     .s_data         (m_data         ),
         97:     .s_data_valid   (m_data_valid   ),
         98:     .s_hsync        (m_hsync        ),
         99:     .s_vsync        (m_vsync        ),
        100:
        101:     .axi_data       (w_data         ),
        102:     .axi_data_valid (w_valid        ),
        103:     .axi_data_last  (w_last         ),
        104:     .axi_data_ready (w_ready        ),
        105:     .dbg_axi_cnt    (dbg_axi_cnt    ),
        106:     .dbg_axi_num    (dbg_axi_num    ),
        107:     .dbg_zdin       (dbg_zdin       ),
        108:     .dbg_zout       (dbg_zout       )
        109: );
        110:
        111:     // [FRTAG 2026-09-14] frame-tag stream mux: while the ctrl runs its DATA_TAG
        112:     // state it replaces the (idle) camera stream with one AXI_DATA_WIDTH beat
        113:     // carrying the 32-bit frame counter for the second 16-byte command. The
        114:     // camera stream is stalled (not dropped) for those few cycles; its FIFO
        115:     // absorbs the pause. Frame-path behaviour is otherwise bit-identical.
        116:     assign axi_data       = tag_active ? tag_data : w_data;
        117:     assign axi_data_valid = tag_active ? 1'b1    : w_valid;
        118:     assign axi_data_last  = w_last;
        119:     assign w_ready        = axi_data_ready & ~tag_active;
        120:
        121:
        122:
        123: ov5640_ddr_w_ctrl #(
        124:     .AXI_ADDR_WIDTH(AXI_ADDR_WIDTH),
        125:     .AXI_LEN_WIDTH (AXI_LEN_WIDTH ),
        126:     .AXI_DATA_WIDTH(AXI_DATA_WIDTH),
        127:     .CAM_DATA_LEN  (CAM_DATA_LEN  )  //1280*720*3/16
        128: )
        129: ov5640_ddr_w_ctrl(
        130:     .axi_clk        (axi_clk        ),
        131:     .axi_rst        (axi_rst        ),
        132:
        133:     .cam_data_addr_1(cam_data_addr_1),
        134:     .cam_data_addr_2(cam_data_addr_2),
        135:     .cam_data_len   (cam_data_len   ),
        136:
        137:     .s_vsync        (m_vsync        ),
        138:
        139:     .dma_done       (dma_done       ),  // [LEDGER 2026-09-19]
        140:
        141:     .axi_cmd_addr   (axi_cmd_addr   ),
        142:     .axi_cmd_len    (axi_cmd_len    ),
        143:     .axi_cmd_valid  (axi_cmd_valid  ),
        144:     .axi_cmd_ready  (axi_cmd_ready  ),
        145:
        146:     .tag_active     (tag_active     ),
        147:     .tag_data       (tag_data       ),
        148:     .tag_ready      (axi_data_ready ),
        149:
        150:     .engine_busy    (engine_busy    ),
        151:     .dbg_state      (dbg_state      ),
        152:     .dbg_last_cnt   (dbg_last_cnt   ),
        153:     .dbg_wd_cnt     (dbg_wd_cnt     ),
        154:     .xdma_req       (xdma_req       ),
        155:     .xdma_ack       (xdma_ack       )
        156: );
        157:
        158:
        159:
        160: endmodule
      
      ### source/ov5640/ov5640_ddr/ov5640_ddr_w.v
          1: module ov5640_ddr_w #(
          2:     parameter DATA_WIDTH = 24,
          3:     parameter AXI_DATA_WIDTH = 128,
          4:     parameter CAM_DATA_LEN  = 172800, //1280*720*3/16
          5:     parameter DEVICE = "PG"
          6: )(
          7:     input          axi_clk        ,
          8:     input          axi_rst        ,
          9:
         10:     input  [$clog2(CAM_DATA_LEN) : 0]  data_len       /*synthesis PAP_MARK_DEBUG="1"*/, //锟斤拷16锟街斤拷为锟斤拷位
         11:
         12:     input  [DATA_WIDTH-1 :0]       s_data       ,
         13:     input                          s_data_valid ,
         14:     input                          s_vsync      ,
         15:     input                          s_hsync      ,       //没锟斤拷
         16:
         17:     output [AXI_DATA_WIDTH-1 : 0]  axi_data       /*synthesis PAP_MARK_DEBUG="1"*/,
         18:     output                         axi_data_valid /*synthesis PAP_MARK_DEBUG="1"*/,
         19:     output                         axi_data_last  /*synthesis PAP_MARK_DEBUG="1"*/,
         20:     input                          axi_data_ready /*synthesis PAP_MARK_DEBUG="1"*/,
         21:     output [31:0]                  dbg_axi_cnt,
         22:     output [31:0]                  dbg_axi_num  ,
         23:     // [ZDIAG 2026-09-18] per-frame zero-beat accounting, latched at VSYNC so
         24:     // it can be read reliably once streaming stops.
         25:     output [31:0]                  dbg_zdin     ,  // wr_en && din==0
         26:     output [31:0]                  dbg_zout         // fifo_we && fifo_wd==0
         27: );
         28:
         29:
         30:
         31:
         32:     reg             wr_en;
         33:     reg  [31 : 0]   din  ;
         34:     wire            rd_en;
         35:     wire [AXI_DATA_WIDTH-1 : 0] dout ;
         36:
         37:     wire                        empty;
         38:     wire                        full /*synthesis PAP_MARK_DEBUG="1"*/;
         39:
         40:
         41:
         42:     reg [1 : 0] cnt;
         43:     always @(posedge axi_clk) begin
         44:         if(axi_rst)begin
         45:             cnt <= 2'd0;
         46:         end
         47:         else if(s_data_valid)begin
         48:             cnt <= cnt + 2'd1;
         49:         end
         50:     end
         51: generate
         52:     if(DATA_WIDTH == 24) begin
         53:
         54:         reg [23 : 0]  cam_data_temp;
         55:         always @(posedge axi_clk) begin
         56:             if(s_data_valid)begin
         57:                 case (cnt)
         58:                     2'b00:begin
         59:                         cam_data_temp <= s_data;
         60:                     end
         61:                     2'b01:begin
         62:                         cam_data_temp <= {8'd0, s_data[23:8]};
         63:                     end
         64:                     2'b10:begin
         65:                         cam_data_temp <= {16'd0, s_data[23:16]};
         66:                     end
         67:                     2'b11:begin
         68:                         cam_data_temp <= 24'd0;
         69:                     end
         70:                 endcase
         71:             end
         72:         end
         73:
         74:         always @(posedge axi_clk) begin
         75:             if(s_data_valid)begin
         76:                 case (cnt)
         77:                     2'b01:begin
         78:                         din <= {s_data[7:0], cam_data_temp[23:0]};
         79:                     end
         80:                     2'b10:begin
         81:                         din <= {s_data[15:0], cam_data_temp[15:0]};
         82:                     end
         83:                     2'b11:begin
         84:                         din <= {s_data, cam_data_temp[7:0]};
         85:                     end
         86:                 endcase
         87:             end
         88:         end
         89:
         90:         always @(posedge axi_clk) begin
         91:             if(axi_rst)begin
         92:                 wr_en <= 1'b0;
         93:             end
         94:             else if(s_data_valid & (cnt != 2'b00))begin
         95:                 wr_en <= 1'b1;
         96:             end
         97:             else begin
         98:                 wr_en <= 1'b0;
         99:             end
        100:         end
        101:
        102:     end
        103:     else if(DATA_WIDTH == 16) begin
        104:
        105:         reg [15 : 0] cam_data_temp;
        106:         always @(posedge axi_clk) begin
        107:             if(s_data_valid) begin
        108:                 cam_data_temp <= s_data;
        109:             end
        110:         end
        111:
        112:
        113:         always @(posedge axi_clk) begin
        114:             if(s_data_valid)begin
        115:                 if(cnt[0]) begin
        116:                     din <= {s_data, cam_data_temp};
        117:                 end
        118:             end
        119:         end
        120:
        121:         always @(posedge axi_clk) begin
        122:             if(axi_rst)begin
        123:                 wr_en <= 1'b0;
        124:             end
        125:             else if(s_data_valid & cnt[0])begin
        126:                 wr_en <= 1'b1;
        127:             end
        128:             else begin
        129:                 wr_en <= 1'b0;
        130:             end
        131:         end
        132:
        133:     end
        134:     else if(DATA_WIDTH == 8) begin
        135:
        136:         reg [23 : 0] cam_data_temp;
        137:         always @(posedge axi_clk) begin
        138:             if(s_data_valid) begin
        139:                 cam_data_temp <= {s_data, cam_data_temp[23:8]};
        140:             end
        141:         end
        142:
        143:         always @(posedge axi_clk) begin
        144:             if(s_data_valid)begin
        145:                 if(&cnt) begin
        146:                     din <= {s_data, cam_data_temp};
        147:                 end
        148:             end
        149:         end
        150:
        151:
        152:         always @(posedge axi_clk) begin
        153:             if(axi_rst)begin
        154:                 wr_en <= 1'b0;
        155:             end
        156:             else if(s_data_valid & &cnt)begin
        157:                 wr_en <= 1'b1;
        158:             end
        159:             else begin
        160:                 wr_en <= 1'b0;
        161:             end
        162:         end
        163:
        164:     end
        165: endgenerate
        166:
        167:
        168:
        169:
        170:
        171:
        172:         reg [$clog2(CAM_DATA_LEN) : 0] axi_num/*synthesis PAP_MARK_DEBUG="1"*/;
        173:         reg [$clog2(CAM_DATA_LEN) : 0] axi_cnt/*synthesis PAP_MARK_DEBUG="1"*/;
        174:

         17: 	output reg  	    				cmd_ready		,

         19: 	//trans data in

         21: 	input			[KEEP_WIDTH - 1:0]	data_in_keep	,
         22: 	input         						data_in_valid	,
         23: 	output reg                          data_in_last    ,
         24: 	output        						data_in_ready	,

         29: 	output reg		[7:0]   					m_axi_awlen  	,
         30: 	output 			[2:0]   					m_axi_awsize 	,
         31: 	output 			[1:0]   					m_axi_awburst	,
         32: 	output 		    	    					m_axi_awlock 	,
         33: 	output 			[3:0]   					m_axi_awcache	,
         34: 	output 			[2:0]   					m_axi_awprot	,
         35: 	output reg		        					m_axi_awvalid	,
         36: 	input  		 	        					m_axi_awready	,
         37: 	output 			[DATA_WIDTH - 1:0] 			m_axi_wdata		,
         38: 	output 			[KEEP_WIDTH - 1:0]  		m_axi_wstrb		,
         39: 	output 			        					m_axi_wlast		,
         40: 	output 			        					m_axi_wvalid	,
         41: 	input  			        					m_axi_wready	,
         42: 	input  			[ID_WIDTH - 1:0]   			m_axi_bid  		,
         43: 	input  			[1:0]   					m_axi_bresp 	,
         44: 	input  			        					m_axi_bvalid	,
         45: 	output 			        					m_axi_bready

         47: );

         50: localparam AXI_BURST_SIZE = $clog2(KEEP_WIDTH); //log2(DATA_WIDTH / 8)
         51:
         52: // [WD 2026-09-18] transmit watchdog state
         53: reg        abort_r;
         54: reg [23:0] wd_cnt;
         55: wire       w_progress;
         56: wire       abort_done;
         57:
         58: wire [DATA_WIDTH - 1:0] 		t_m_axi_wdata;
         59: wire [KEEP_WIDTH - 1:0]  		t_m_axi_wstrb;
         60: wire         					t_m_axi_wlast;
         61: wire         					t_m_axi_wvalid;
         62: wire         					t_m_axi_wready;
         63:
         64: //common para
         65: assign m_axi_awsize 	= 		AXI_BURST_SIZE	;
         66: assign m_axi_awburst 	= 		2'b01			;
         67: assign m_axi_awlock 	= 		1'b0			;
         68: assign m_axi_awcache 	= 		4'b0011			;
         69: assign m_axi_awprot 	= 		3'b000			;
         70:
         71:
         72: wire [7:0] burst_len    ;
         73: wire [7:0] max_burst_len;
         74:
         75: //cmd
         76: reg [31:0] addr;
         77: reg [31:0] len;
         78: reg        trans;
         79:
         80: always @(posedge clk) begin
         81: 	if((cmd_ready == 1'b1) && (cmd_valid == 1'b1))begin
         82: 		addr <= cmd_addr;
         83: 	end
         84: 	else begin
         85: 		if((m_axi_awvalid == 1'b1) && (m_axi_awready == 1'b1))begin
         86: 			addr <= addr + ((m_axi_awlen + 1'b1) << AXI_BURST_SIZE);
         87: 		end
         88: 	end
         89: end
         90:
         91: always @(posedge clk) begin
         92: 	if((cmd_ready == 1'b1) && (cmd_valid == 1'b1))begin
         93: 		len <= cmd_len[31:AXI_BURST_SIZE] + (|cmd_len[AXI_BURST_SIZE - 1:0]);
         94: 	end
         95: 	else begin
         96: 		if((m_axi_awvalid == 1'b1) && (m_axi_awready == 1'b1))begin
         97: 			len <= len - (m_axi_awlen + 1'b1);
         98: 		end
         99: 		else if(abort_done == 1'b1)begin
        100: 			len <= 32'd0;       // [WD]
        101: 		end
        102: 	end
        103: end
        104: always @(posedge clk)begin
        105: 	if(rst == 1'b1)begin
        106: 		trans <= 1'b0;
        107: 	end
        108: 	else begin
        109: 		if((cmd_ready == 1'b1) && (cmd_valid == 1'b1))begin
        110: 			trans <= 1'b1;
        111: 		end
        112: 		else begin
        113: 			if((m_axi_bready == 1'b1) && (m_axi_bvalid == 1'b1) && (len == 32'd0))begin
        114: 				trans <= 1'b0;
        115: 			end
        116: 			else if(abort_done == 1'b1)begin
        117: 				trans <= 1'b0;      // [WD] release the stuck transaction
        118: 			end
        119: 		end
        120: 	end
        121: end
        122:
        123: always @(posedge  clk)begin
        124: 	if(rst == 1'b1)begin
        125: 		cmd_ready <= 1'b0;
        126: 	end
        127: 	else begin
        128: 		if(trans == 1'b0)begin
        129: 			if((cmd_ready == 1'b1) && (cmd_valid == 1'b1))begin
        130: 				cmd_ready <= 1'b0;
        131: 			end
        132: 			else begin
        133: 				cmd_ready <= 1'b1;
        134: 			end
        135: 		end
        136: 		else begin
        137: 			cmd_ready <= 1'b0;
        138: 		end
        139: 	end
        140: end
        141:
        142: //aw
        143:
        144: reg burst_trans;
        145: assign burst_len     = len > BURST_LEN ? BURST_LEN : len;
        146: assign max_burst_len = (((addr & 12'hfff) + (burst_len << AXI_BURST_SIZE )) >> 12)  != 0 ? (13'h1000 - (addr & 12'hfff)) >> AXI_BURST_SIZE : burst_len;
        147: always@(posedge clk)begin
        148: 	if(rst == 1'b1)begin
        149: 		burst_trans <= 1'b0;
        150: 	end
        151: 	else begin
        152: 		if((m_axi_awvalid == 1'b1) && (m_axi_awready == 1'b1))begin
        153: 			burst_trans <= 1'b1;
        154: 		end
        155: 		else begin
        156: 			// if((m_axi_wvalid == 1'b1) && (m_axi_wready == 1'b1) && (m_axi_wlast == 1'b1))begin
        157: 			if((m_axi_bvalid == 1'b1) && (m_axi_bready == 1'b1))begin
        158: 				burst_trans <= 1'b0;
        159: 			end
        160: 			else if(abort_done == 1'b1)begin
        161: 				burst_trans <= 1'b0;   // [WD2] force-release; B may never arrive
        162: 			end
        163: 		end
        164: 	end
        165: end
        166: always @(posedge clk)begin
        167: 	if(rst == 1'b1)begin
        168: 		m_axi_awvalid <= 1'b0;
        169: 	end
        170: 	else begin
        171: 		if((m_axi_awvalid == 1'b1) && (m_axi_awready == 1'b1))begin
        172: 			m_axi_awvalid <= 1'b0;
        173: 		end
        174: 		else begin
        175: 			if((burst_trans == 1'b0) && (len != 32'd0) && (abort_r == 1'b0))begin
        176: 				m_axi_awvalid <= 1'b1;
        177: 			end
        178: 		end
        179: 	end
        180: end
        181:
        182: always @(posedge clk)begin
        183: 	m_axi_awlen <= max_burst_len - 8'd1;
        184: end
        185: always @(posedge clk)begin
        186: 	m_axi_awaddr <= addr;
        187: end
        188: always @(posedge clk) begin
        189: 	if((cmd_ready == 1'b1) && (cmd_valid == 1'b1))begin
        190: 		m_axi_awid <= cmd_id;
        191: 	end
        192: end
        193: //w
        194: reg [7:0] act_burst_len;
        195: always@ (posedge clk)begin
        196: 	if(rst == 1'b1)begin
        197: 		act_burst_len <= 8'd0;
        198: 	end
        199: 	else begin
        200: 		if((m_axi_awvalid == 1'b1) && (m_axi_awready == 1'b1))begin
        201: 			act_burst_len <= m_axi_awlen + 8'd1;
        202: 		end
        203: 		else begin
        204: 			if((t_m_axi_wvalid == 1'b1) && (t_m_axi_wready == 1'b1))begin
        205: 				act_burst_len <= act_burst_len - 8'd1;
        206: 			end
        207: 		end
        208: 	end
        209: end
        210:
        211: // [WD 2026-09-18] ------------------------------------------------------------------
        212: // The DVP stream can deliver fewer 128-bit beats than CAM_DATA_LEN (CDC FIFO
        213: // overflow drops pixels and cannot back-pressure the sensor). A frame's AXI
        214: // burst then never completes: trans sticks at 1, cmd_ready stays low and the
        215: // frame FSM deadlocks forever (measured: state=ADDR, axi_cnt=0, 0 frames).
        216: //
        217: // Recovery: if there is no W-beat progress for ~0.17 s while a write is in
        218: // flight, close the open burst with dummy beats. AXI forbids cancelling an
        219: // accepted AW, so we must still supply awlen beats; we just no longer consume
        220: // real camera data. After the B response is absorbed, trans/len clear and the
        221: // next frame's command is accepted again (only the bad frame is lost).
        222: assign w_progress = (t_m_axi_wvalid == 1'b1) && (t_m_axi_wready == 1'b1);
        223:
        224: always @(posedge clk) begin
        225: 	if((rst == 1'b1) || (trans == 1'b0) || (abort_r == 1'b1) || (w_progress == 1'b1))
        226: 		wd_cnt <= 24'd0;
        227: 	else if(wd_cnt != 24'hFFFFFF)
        228: 		wd_cnt <= wd_cnt + 24'd1;
        229: end
        230:
        231: // [BFAST 2026-09-19] the DDR write port can stop returning B responses
        232: // (see [WD2]; re-observed 09-19: b_cnt ~26 total while aw_cnt ~60k).
        233: // Waiting the full 0.17 s watchdog once every command's beats are out
        234: // capped the camera path at ~5 fps. Give B a few microseconds after the
        235: // last beat, then force the close via the abort path; a late B is still
        236: // absorbed by the w_done/bready logic.
        237: reg [9:0] bwait_cnt;
        238: // (w_done intentionally not referenced: it is declared further below and
        239: // act_burst_len==0 && burst_trans already means every beat is out, B pending)
        240: wire all_beats_out = (len == 32'd0) && (act_burst_len == 8'd0) && burst_trans;
        241: always @(posedge clk) begin
        242: 	if((rst == 1'b1) || (trans == 1'b0) || (all_beats_out == 1'b0) || (abort_r == 1'b1))
        243: 		bwait_cnt <= 10'd0;
        244: 	else if(bwait_cnt != 10'h3FF)
        245: 		bwait_cnt <= bwait_cnt + 10'd1;
        246: end
        247: always @(posedge clk) begin
        248: 	if(rst == 1'b1)
        249: 		abort_r <= 1'b0;
        250: 	// [BFAST2 2026-09-19] bwait fast-close DISABLED: B latency under DDR contention
        251: 	// can legitimately exceed the 10us grace; force-closing mid-flight corrupted
        252: 	// the crossbar/DDR transaction stream and killed M00 writes within seconds.
        253: 	// Fall back to the long send-watchdog only.
        254: 	else if((abort_r == 1'b0) && (trans == 1'b1) && (wd_cnt == 24'hFFFFFF))
        255: 		abort_r <= 1'b1;
        256: 	else if(abort_done == 1'b1)
        257: 		abort_r <= 1'b0;
        258: end
        259:
        260: // [WD2 2026-09-18] burst_trans is only cleared by the B response, which is
        261: // exactly what never arrives in the wedge case (cam2: bvalid never asserted).
        262: // Requiring burst_trans==0 made abort_done unreachable -> no recovery.
        263: // All W beats for the open burst are out once act_burst_len hits 0, so that
        264: // is the correct release point; burst_trans is force-cleared below.
        265: assign abort_done = abort_r && (act_burst_len == 8'd0);
        266: // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------
        267:
        268: stream_pipe #(
        269:   .DATA_WIDTH 	(DATA_WIDTH+1+KEEP_WIDTH)
        270: ) stream_pipe_3(
        271:   .dataIn_valid     (t_m_axi_wvalid),
        272:   .dataIn_ready     (t_m_axi_wready),
        273:   .dataIn_payload   ({t_m_axi_wdata, t_m_axi_wstrb, t_m_axi_wlast}),
        274:   .dataOut_valid    (m_axi_wvalid),
        275:   .dataOut_ready    (m_axi_wready),
        276:   .dataOut_payload  ({m_axi_wdata, m_axi_wstrb, m_axi_wlast}),
        277:   .clk              (clk),
        278:   .reset            (rst)
        279: );
        280:
        281: assign data_in_ready = abort_r ? 1'b0
        282:                                : (t_m_axi_wready && act_burst_len > 8'd0);
        283: assign t_m_axi_wvalid  = abort_r ? (act_burst_len > 8'd0)
        284:                                  : (data_in_valid && act_burst_len > 8'd0);
        285: assign t_m_axi_wdata   = abort_r ? {DATA_WIDTH{1'b0}} : data_in;
        286: assign t_m_axi_wlast   = (act_burst_len == 8'd1);
        287: assign t_m_axi_wstrb   = abort_r ? {KEEP_WIDTH{1'b1}} : data_in_keep;
        288:
        289: //b
        290: reg w_done;
        291: always @(posedge clk) begin
        292: 	if(rst == 1'b1) begin
        293: 		w_done <= 1'b0;
        294: 	end
        295: 	else begin
        296: 		if((t_m_axi_wvalid == 1'b1) && (t_m_axi_wready == 1'b1) && (t_m_axi_wlast == 1'b1)) begin
        297: 			w_done <= 1'b1;
        298: 		end
        299: 		else begin
        300: 			if((m_axi_bvalid == 1'b1) && (m_axi_bready == 1'b1)) begin
        301: 				w_done <= 1'b0;
        302: 			end
        303: 		end
        304: 	end
        305: end
        306: assign m_axi_bready = w_done;
        307:
        308: // [LEDGER 2026-09-19] single-ledger completion: pulse exactly once per
        309: // command on the trans 1->0 fall. Covers the normal close (B absorbed,
        310: // len==0) AND both watchdog abort paths; the old B-gated expression never
        311: // pulsed when a B response was lost, wedging the frame FSM in DATA forever.
        312: reg trans_q;
        313: always @(posedge clk) begin
        314: 	if(rst == 1'b1) trans_q <= 1'b0;
        315: 	else            trans_q <= trans;
        316: end
        317:
        318: always @(posedge clk ) begin
        319: 	if(rst == 1'b1)begin
        320: 		data_in_last <= 1'b0;
        321: 	end
        322: 	else begin
        323: 		data_in_last <= trans_q && (trans == 1'b0);
        324: 	end
        325: end
        326:
        327: endmodule

        509: /////////////////////////////////////// DDR3 AW/AR latch shims [AWFIX/ARFIX 2026-09-19] ///
        510: // Proper single-handshake adapters between the crossbar and the DDR3 IP.
        511: // The crossbar is acknowledged exactly when we latch a request; the request is
        512: // then HELD with stable payload until the IP accepts (AXI-legal, no retraction).
        513: // Single-outstanding end-to-end (no held request + write FIFO empty + no pending
        514: // B for AW; read FIFO empty for AR) also keeps the aw_sid/ar_sid ID rebuilds sane.
        515: // [STAGE 2026-09-19] The DDR3 IP's W channel is UNTHROTTLEABLE: it pulses
        516: // wready at its own pace and counts awlen+1 beats itself (see the IP's own
        517: // example_design -- there is no wvalid at all). Presenting an AW before its
        518: // beats are in the FIFO let the IP consume GHOST beats from an empty FIFO;
        519: // the real beats then stranded in the FIFO forever and blocked all later AWs
        520: // (the permanent M00 write wedge). Hold each latched AW until its ENTIRE
        521: // burst is staged in the FIFO, then present it: during IP consumption the
        522: // FIFO only drains, so every demanded beat is guaranteed present.
        523: wire aw_burst_fits   = (ddr_axi_awlen < (5'd16 - wr_water_level));
        524: wire aw_latch_now    = ddr_axi_awvalid && !ddr3_aw_v && !aw_hold_v
        525:                        && w_fifo_empty && aw_burst_fits && !ddr_axi_bvalid_int;
        526: wire ar_latch_now    = ddr_axi_arvalid && !ddr3_ar_v && ddr_axi_fifo_empty;
        527:
        528: reg              ddr3_aw_v, ddr3_ar_v;
        529: reg              aw_hold_v;
        530: reg [27:0]       ddr3_aw_addr, ddr3_ar_addr;
        531: reg [3:0]        ddr3_aw_len,  ddr3_ar_len;
        532: reg              ddr3_aw_ap,   ddr3_ar_ap;
        533: reg [AXI_ID_M_LEN-1:0] ddr3_aw_id, ddr3_ar_id;
        534:
        535: wire aw_stage_ok = (wr_water_level >= ({1'b0, ddr3_aw_len} + 5'd1)) && !w_fifo_empty;
        536:
        537: always @(posedge axi_clk) begin
        538:     if (axi_rst) begin
        539:         aw_hold_v <= 1'b0;
        540:         ddr3_aw_v <= 1'b0;
        541:     end
        542:     else begin
        543:         if (aw_latch_now) begin
        544:             aw_hold_v   <= 1'b1;
        545:             ddr3_aw_addr <= ddr_axi_awaddr[27:0];
        546:             ddr3_aw_len  <= ddr_axi_awlen;
        547:             ddr3_aw_ap   <= ddr_axi_awuser_ap;
        548:             ddr3_aw_id   <= ddr_axi_awuser_id;
        549:         end
        550:         if (aw_hold_v && !ddr3_aw_v && aw_stage_ok) begin
        551:             aw_hold_v <= 1'b0;
        552:             ddr3_aw_v <= 1'b1;
        553:         end
        554:         else if (ddr3_aw_v && ddr_axi_awready) begin
        555:             ddr3_aw_v <= 1'b0;
        556:         end
        557:     end
        558: end
        559: always @(posedge axi_clk) begin
        560:     if (axi_rst) ddr3_ar_v <= 1'b0;
        561:     else if (ar_latch_now)                       ddr3_ar_v <= 1'b1;
        562:     else if (ddr3_ar_v && ddr_axi_arready)       ddr3_ar_v <= 1'b0;
        563: end
        564: always @(posedge axi_clk) begin
        565:     if (ar_latch_now) begin
        566:         ddr3_ar_addr <= ddr_axi_araddr[27:0];
        567:         ddr3_ar_len  <= ddr_axi_arlen;
        568:         ddr3_ar_ap   <= ddr_axi_aruser_ap;
        569:         ddr3_ar_id   <= ddr_axi_aruser_id;
        570:     end
        571: end
        572: // crossbar-facing readies: acknowledge exactly at latch time
        573: wire ddr_axi_awready_xbar = aw_latch_now;
        574: wire ddr_axi_arready_xbar = ar_latch_now;

      1: // ============================================================================
      2: // ddr_w_arb.v -- [WARB 2026-09-19] minimal 2-master DDR write arbiter.
      3: //
      4: // WHY: the Forencich axi_crossbar's M00 write path leaks its per-master W-channel
      5: // select across handoffs (bench-proven in sim/wedge: after S01's burst tail the
      6: // M00 w_select_valid latches forever, S04's beats are never released, and both
      7: // camera engines wedge after 1-2 bursts). This module replaces the crossbar on
      8: // the DDR write path for the two camera engines.
      9: //
      10: // DESIGN: single-outstanding end-to-end, matching the DDR3 IP user-port contract
      11: // (no wvalid, unthrottleable wready, one burst processed at a time):
      12: //   IDLE  : present one master's AW (round-robin tie-break); the accept from the
      13: //           port glue locks OWNER for the whole burst.
      14: //   BUSY  : only OWNER's W stream reaches the glue; the fabric-minted B (from
      15: //           wusero_last) is routed back to OWNER; its accept frees the slot and
      16: //           flips the round-robin bit.
      17: // AXI-legal: awvalid/wvalid are held with stable payload until accepted; the
      18: // non-owner master's awready/wready stay low, so its burst cannot start.
      19: // ============================================================================
      20: `timescale 1ns/1ps
      21: module ddr_w_arb (
      22:     input  wire         clk,
      23:     input  wire         rst,
      24:
      25:     // ---- master 0 (cam1 DMA) ----
      26:     input  wire [3:0]   m0_awid,
      27:     input  wire [31:0]  m0_awaddr,
      28:     input  wire [7:0]   m0_awlen,
      29:     input  wire [2:0]   m0_awsize,
      30:     input  wire [1:0]   m0_awburst,
      31:     input  wire         m0_awlock,
      32:     input  wire [3:0]   m0_awcache,
      33:     input  wire [2:0]   m0_awprot,
      34:     input  wire         m0_awvalid,
      35:     output wire         m0_awready,
      36:     input  wire [127:0] m0_wdata,
      37:     input  wire [15:0]  m0_wstrb,
      38:     input  wire         m0_wlast,
      39:     input  wire         m0_wvalid,
      40:     output wire         m0_wready,
      41:     output wire [3:0]   m0_bid,
      42:     output wire [1:0]   m0_bresp,
      43:     output wire         m0_bvalid,
      44:     input  wire         m0_bready,
      45:
      46:     // ---- master 1 (cam2 DMA) ----
      47:     input  wire [3:0]   m1_awid,
      48:     input  wire [31:0]  m1_awaddr,
      49:     input  wire [7:0]   m1_awlen,
      50:     input  wire [2:0]   m1_awsize,
      51:     input  wire [1:0]   m1_awburst,
      52:     input  wire         m1_awlock,
      53:     input  wire [3:0]   m1_awcache,
      54:     input  wire [2:0]   m1_awprot,
      55:     input  wire         m1_awvalid,
      56:     output wire         m1_awready,
      57:     input  wire [127:0] m1_wdata,
      58:     input  wire [15:0]  m1_wstrb,
      59:     input  wire         m1_wlast,
      60:     input  wire         m1_wvalid,
      61:     output wire         m1_wready,
      62:     output wire [3:0]   m1_bid,
      63:     output wire [1:0]   m1_bresp,
      64:     output wire         m1_bvalid,
      65:     input  wire         m1_bready,
      66:
      67:     // ---- slave (DDR3 port glue) ----
      68:     output wire [3:0]   s_awid,
      69:     output wire [31:0]  s_awaddr,
      70:     output wire [7:0]   s_awlen,
      71:     output wire [2:0]   s_awsize,
      72:     output wire [1:0]   s_awburst,
      73:     output wire         s_awlock,
      74:     output wire [3:0]   s_awcache,
      75:     output wire [2:0]   s_awprot,
      76:     output wire         s_awvalid,
      77:     input  wire         s_awready,
      78:     output wire [127:0] s_wdata,
      79:     output wire [15:0]  s_wstrb,
      80:     output wire         s_wlast,
      81:     output wire         s_wvalid,
      82:     input  wire         s_wready,
      83:     input  wire [3:0]   s_bid,
      84:     input  wire [1:0]   s_bresp,
      85:     input  wire         s_bvalid,
      86:     output wire         s_bready
      87: );
      88:
      89:     reg  busy;      // an AW is locked in (waiting for its B)
      90:     reg  owner;     // 0 = master0 owns the slot, 1 = master1
      91:     reg  rr;        // round-robin tie-break for the next idle grant
      92:
      93:     // grant decision: only when idle; alternate when both masters ask
      94:     wire aw_gnt_m1 = ~busy & m1_awvalid & ( rr | ~m0_awvalid);
      95:     wire aw_gnt_m0 = ~busy & m0_awvalid & ~(m1_awvalid & rr);
      96:
      97:     // AW datapath (granted master's request)
      98:     assign s_awid    = aw_gnt_m1 ? m1_awid    : m0_awid;
      99:     assign s_awaddr  = aw_gnt_m1 ? m1_awaddr  : m0_awaddr;
      100:     assign s_awlen   = aw_gnt_m1 ? m1_awlen   : m0_awlen;
      101:     assign s_awsize  = aw_gnt_m1 ? m1_awsize  : m0_awsize;
      102:     assign s_awburst = aw_gnt_m1 ? m1_awburst : m0_awburst;
      103:     assign s_awlock  = aw_gnt_m1 ? m1_awlock  : m0_awlock;
      104:     assign s_awcache = aw_gnt_m1 ? m1_awcache : m0_awcache;
      105:     assign s_awprot  = aw_gnt_m1 ? m1_awprot  : m0_awprot;
      106:     assign s_awvalid = aw_gnt_m0 | aw_gnt_m1;
      107:
      108:     assign m0_awready = aw_gnt_m0 & s_awready;
      109:     assign m1_awready = aw_gnt_m1 & s_awready;
      110:
      111:     // W datapath (only the owner's beats can flow)
      112:     assign s_wdata  = owner ? m1_wdata : m0_wdata;
      113:     assign s_wstrb  = owner ? m1_wstrb : m0_wstrb;
      114:     assign s_wlast  = owner ? m1_wlast : m0_wlast;
      115:     assign s_wvalid = busy & (owner ? m1_wvalid : m0_wvalid);
      116:
      117:     assign m0_wready = busy & ~owner & s_wready;
      118:     assign m1_wready = busy &  owner & s_wready;
      119:
      120:     // B path: single outstanding -> the owner gets the fabric-minted response
      121:     assign m0_bvalid = busy & ~owner & s_bvalid;
      122:     assign m1_bvalid = busy &  owner & s_bvalid;
      123:     assign m0_bid    = s_bid;
      124:     assign m1_bid    = s_bid;
      125:     assign m0_bresp  = s_bresp;
      126:     assign m1_bresp  = s_bresp;
      127:     assign s_bready  = busy & (owner ? m1_bready : m0_bready);
      128:
      129:     always @(posedge clk) begin
      130:         if (rst) begin
      131:             busy  <= 1'b0;
      132:             owner <= 1'b0;
      133:             rr    <= 1'b0;
      134:         end
      135:         else begin
      136:             if (!busy && (aw_gnt_m0 | aw_gnt_m1) && s_awready) begin
      137:                 busy  <= 1'b1;
      138:                 owner <= aw_gnt_m1;
      139:                 rr    <= aw_gnt_m0;         // next idle grant favors the other master
      140:             end
      141:             else if (busy && s_bvalid && s_bready) begin
      142:                 busy  <= 1'b0;
      143:             end
      144:         end
      145:     end
      146:
      147: endmodule

      88:
      89:     reg  busy;      // an AW is locked in (waiting for its B)
      90:     reg  owner;     // 0 = master0 owns the slot, 1 = master1
      91:     reg  rr;        // round-robin tie-break for the next idle grant
      92:
      93:     // grant decision: only when idle; alternate when both masters ask
      94:     wire aw_gnt_m1 = ~busy & m1_awvalid & ( rr | ~m0_awvalid);
      95:     wire aw_gnt_m0 = ~busy & m0_awvalid & ~(m1_awvalid & rr);

      99:     assign s_awaddr  = aw_gnt_m1 ? m1_awaddr  : m0_awaddr;
      100:     assign s_awlen   = aw_gnt_m1 ? m1_awlen   : m0_awlen;
      101:     assign s_awsize  = aw_gnt_m1 ? m1_awsize  : m0_awsize;
      102:     assign s_awburst = aw_gnt_m1 ? m1_awburst : m0_awburst;
      103:     assign s_awlock  = aw_gnt_m1 ? m1_awlock  : m0_awlock;
      104:     assign s_awcache = aw_gnt_m1 ? m1_awcache : m0_awcache;
      105:     assign s_awprot  = aw_gnt_m1 ? m1_awprot  : m0_awprot;
      106:     assign s_awvalid = aw_gnt_m0 | aw_gnt_m1;
      107:
      108:     assign m0_awready = aw_gnt_m0 & s_awready;
      109:     assign m1_awready = aw_gnt_m1 & s_awready;
      110:
      111:     // W datapath (only the owner's beats can flow)
      112:     assign s_wdata  = owner ? m1_wdata : m0_wdata;
      113:     assign s_wstrb  = owner ? m1_wstrb : m0_wstrb;
      114:     assign s_wlast  = owner ? m1_wlast : m0_wlast;
      115:     assign s_wvalid = busy & (owner ? m1_wvalid : m0_wvalid);
      116:

      118:     assign m1_wready = busy &  owner & s_wready;
      119:
      120:     // B path: single outstanding -> the owner gets the fabric-minted response

        "patchText": "*** Begin Patch\n*** Update File: source/axi_crossbar/ddr_w_arb.v\n@@\n module ddr_w_arb (\n@@\n );\n+\n+    // The DDR3 port is single-outstanding, but switching camera ownership after\n+    // every 16-beat burst adds a turnaround at the arbiter and at the DDR port.\n+    // A short burst quantum keeps both cameras fair while allowing the selected\n+    // stream to issue several adjacent bursts (the frame writer already splits\n+    // at 4-KiB boundaries).  This is a throughput-only change: ownership is\n+    // still released at every B response and no camera can hold the port\n+    // indefinitely.\n+    localparam [2:0] BURSTS_PER_TURN = 3'd8;\n@@\n     reg  busy;      // an AW is locked in (waiting for its B)\n     reg  owner;     // 0 = master0 owns the slot, 1 = master1\n     reg  rr;        // round-robin tie-break for the next idle grant\n+    reg  [2:0] turn_count;\n@@\n         if (rst) begin\n             busy  <= 1'b0;\n             owner <= 1'b0;\n             rr    <= 1'b0;\n+            turn_count <= 3'd0;\n         end\n         else begin\n             if (!busy && (aw_gnt_m0 | aw_gnt_m1) && s_awready) begin\n                 busy  <= 1'b1;\n                 owner <= aw_gnt_m1;\n-                rr    <= aw_gnt_m0;         // next idle grant favors the other master\n+                if (turn_count == BURSTS_PER_TURN - 1'b1) begin\n+                    turn_count <= 3'd0;\n+                    rr <= aw_gnt_m0;         // after a quantum, favor the other master\n+                end\n+                else begin\n+                    turn_count <= turn_count + 1'b1;\n+                    rr <= rr;                // keep the same owner while its quantum runs\n+                end\n             end\n             else if (busy && s_bvalid && s_bready) begin\n                 busy  <= 1'b0;\n*** End Patch"

      34:     for attempt in range(4):
      35:         s.reset_input_buffer()
      36:         s.write(line.encode() + NL); s.flush()
      37:         t0 = time.time(); buf = b''
      38:         want = ('ACK' + str(seq)).encode()
      39:         while time.time() - t0 < 5:
      40:             c = s.read(4096)
      41:             if c:
      42:                 buf += c
      43:                 if want in buf:
      44:                     return True
      45:         s.write(("truncate -s -" + str(len(chunk)) + " " + path + ".b64 2>/dev/null" + chr(10)).encode())
      46:     return False
      47:
      48: def main(src, dst):
      49:     data = open(src, 'rb').read()
      50:     md5 = hashlib.md5(data).hexdigest()
      51:     b64 = base64.b64encode(data).decode()
      52:     nch = math.ceil(len(b64) / CHUNK)
      53:     print(f"transfer {len(data)} B -> {dst} ({nch} chunks)")
      54:     s = open_port()
      55:     print(run(s, "mkdir -p $(dirname " + dst + "); rm -f " + dst + ".b64 " + dst + "; stty -echo; echo READY"))
      56:     t0 = time.time()
      57:     for i in range(nch):
      58:         chunk = b64[i*CHUNK:(i+1)*CHUNK]
      59:         if not send_chunk(s, chunk, dst, i):
      60:             print(f"CHUNK {i} FAILED"); s.close(); return 1
      61:         if i % 40 == 0:
      62:             print(f"  {i}/{nch} {time.time()-t0:.0f}s")
      63:     dt = time.time() - t0
      64:     out = run(s, "base64 -d " + dst + ".b64 > " + dst + " && md5sum " + dst, timeout=120)
      65:     run(s, "rm -f " + dst + ".b64")
      66:     print(f"transfer {dt:.0f}s")
      67:     if md5 in out:
      68:         print(f"VERIFY OK {dst} md5={md5}")
      69:         s.close(); return 0
      70:     print(f"VERIFY FAILED expect={md5}")
      71:     print(out[-300:])
      72:     s.close(); return 1

      =====  tools\measure_dualcam.py  =====
      #!/usr/bin/env python3
      """Read-only RK3568 dual-camera tag and DMA timing probe.
      
      The caller should stop camview before running this tool because the driver
      currently permits only one DMA mapping context. No FPGA registers are written.
      """
      import ctypes
      import fcntl
      import mmap
      import os
      import signal
      import struct
      import sys
      import time
      
      
      class Timeout(Exception):
          pass
      
      
      def alarm_handler(_signum, _frame):
          raise Timeout()
      
      
      class DmaOp(ctypes.Structure):
          _fields_ = [
              ("current_len", ctypes.c_uint32),
              ("offset_addr", ctypes.c_uint32),
              ("cmd", ctypes.c_uint32),
              ("ddr3_addr", ctypes.c_uint32),
              ("total_length", ctypes.c_uint32),
              ("read_buf", ctypes.c_void_p),
              ("write_buf", ctypes.c_void_p),
          ]
      
      
      def ioctl_code(number):
          return 0xC0000000 | (4 << 16) | (0x53 << 8) | number
      
      
      MAP_CMD = ioctl_code(2)
      F2H_CMD = ioctl_code(5)
      FRAME_BYTES = 640 * 480 * 2
      TAGS = {
          "c1a": 0x00800000 + FRAME_BYTES,
          "c1b": 0x00A00000 + FRAME_BYTES,
          "c2a": 0x00C00000 + FRAME_BYTES,
          "c2b": 0x00E00000 + FRAME_BYTES,
      }
      REGS = {
          "c1_pclk": 0x20000010,
          "c1_vsync": 0x20000020,
          "c1_words": 0x20000030,
          "c1_i2c": 0x20000060,
          "c1_sys": 0x20000070,
          "c1_axi_now": 0x200000D0,
          "c1_beat_cnt": 0x200000A0,
          "c1_href_raw": 0x20000090,
          "c1_vsync_raw": 0x200000E0,
          "c1_beat_last": 0x200000F0,
          "c2_pclk": 0x20000210,
          "c2_vsync": 0x20000220,
          "c2_words": 0x20000230,
          "c2_i2c": 0x20000260,
          "c2_sys": 0x20000270,
          "c2_axi_now": 0x200002D0,
          "c2_beat_cnt": 0x200002A0,
          "c2_href_raw": 0x20000290,
          "c2_vsync_raw": 0x200002E0,
          "c2_beat_last": 0x200002F0,
      }
      
      
      def timed_ioctl(fd, command, op, timeout=12):
          signal.alarm(timeout)
          try:
              fcntl.ioctl(fd, command, op, True)
          finally:
              signal.alarm(0)
      
      
      def main():
          signal.signal(signal.SIGALRM, alarm_handler)
          fd = os.open("/dev/pango_pci_driver", os.O_RDWR | os.O_SYNC)
          try:
              for mapping in (0, 1):
                  op = DmaOp()
                  op.cmd = mapping
                  op.total_length = 4 * 1024 * 1024
                  timed_ioctl(fd, MAP_CMD, op)
              rx = mmap.mmap(fd, 4 * 1024 * 1024, prot=mmap.PROT_READ | mmap.PROT_WRITE,
                             flags=mmap.MAP_SHARED, offset=1024 * 1024)
      
              def read_bytes(address, length):
                  op = DmaOp()
                  op.offset_addr = 0
                  op.ddr3_addr = address
                  op.total_length = length
                  start = time.perf_counter_ns()
                  try:
                      timed_ioctl(fd, F2H_CMD, op)
                  except Timeout:
                      return None, (time.perf_counter_ns() - start) / 1e6
                  return bytes(rx[:length]), (time.perf_counter_ns() - start) / 1e6
      
              def read_reg(address):
                  data, elapsed = read_bytes(address, 16)
                  return (None if data is None else struct.unpack_from("<I", data)[0]), elapsed
      
              diag_before = {}
              for name, address in REGS.items():
                  try:
                      diag_before[name] = read_reg(address)[0]
                  except (Timeout, OSError):
                      diag_before[name] = None
              print("diag_before=%s" % diag_before, flush=True)
      
              duration = 6
              print("probe_start frame_bytes=%d duration_s=%d" % (FRAME_BYTES, duration), flush=True)
              previous = None
              changes = {name: 0 for name in TAGS}
              read_errors = 0
              first_change = None
              start = time.monotonic()
              end = start + duration
              samples = 0
              while time.monotonic() < end:
                  row = {}
                  durations = []
                  for name, address in TAGS.items():
                      try:
                          data, elapsed = read_bytes(address, 16)
                      except (Timeout, OSError) as exc:
                          data, elapsed = None, 0.0
                          read_errors += 1
                      durations.append(elapsed)
                      row[name] = None if data is None else struct.unpack_from("<I", data)[0]
                  now = time.monotonic()
                  if previous is not None:
                      for name in TAGS:
                          if row[name] is not None and row[name] != previous[name]:
                              changes[name] += 1
                              if first_change is None:
                                  first_change = now
                  previous = row
                  samples += 1
                  if samples % 100 == 0:
                      print("sample=%d t=%.3f tags=%s tag_dma_ms=%.3f..%.3f" %
                            (samples, now, row, min(durations), max(durations)), flush=True)
                  time.sleep(0.005)
      
              elapsed = time.monotonic() - start
              print("tag_changes=%s samples=%d elapsed_s=%.3f read_errors=%d rates_fps=%s" %
                    (changes, samples, elapsed,
                     read_errors,
                     {name: round(value / elapsed, 3) for name, value in changes.items()}), flush=True)
              diag_after = {}
              for name, address in REGS.items():
                  try:
                      diag_after[name] = read_reg(address)[0]
                  except (Timeout, OSError):
                      diag_after[name] = None
              print("diag_after=%s" % diag_after, flush=True)
              if first_change is not None:
                  print("first_change_after_s=%.3f" % (first_change - start), flush=True)
      
              for label, address in (("cam1_a", 0x00800000), ("cam2_a", 0x00C00000)):
                  try:
                      data, elapsed = read_bytes(address, FRAME_BYTES)
                  except (Timeout, OSError) as exc:
                      data, elapsed = None, 0.0
                  print("frame_read=%s bytes=%s elapsed_ms=%.3f" %
                        (label, "timeout" if data is None else len(data), elapsed), flush=True)
          finally:
              os.close(fd)
      
      
      if __name__ == "__main__":
          try:
              main()
          except Exception as exc:
              print("probe_error=%s: %s" % (type(exc).__name__, exc), file=sys.stderr)
              raise

    status: Completed · exit 0
      flash_safe.ps1
      $ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
      
      $pds = Get-Process -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { $_.ProcessName -match '^pds' }
      if ($pds) {
          throw 'PDS GUI is running. Close PDS before starting the standalone JTAG programmer.'
      }
      
      Get-Process cdt_cfg,cdt_js -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue |
          Stop-Process -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
      
      $bin = 'C:\pango\PDS_2022.2-SP6.4\bin'
      $port = 65465
      $server = $null
      $cfg = $null
      $programDone = $false
      $windowClosed = $false
      $outFile = Join-Path $env:TEMP 'pango_cdt_cfg.out.log'
      $errFile = Join-Path $env:TEMP 'pango_cdt_cfg.err.log'
      Remove-Item -LiteralPath $outFile, $errFile -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
      try {
          $server = Start-Process -FilePath "$bin\cdt_js.exe" `
              -ArgumentList '-port', $port -PassThru -WindowStyle Hidden
          Start-Sleep -Seconds 4
      
          # Keep the configuration window alive while the cable programs the FPGA.
          # Close it only after the tool has reported the completed program command.
          $cfg = Start-Process -FilePath "$bin\cdt_cfg.exe" `
              -ArgumentList '-ip','127.0.0.1','-port',$port,'-file','C:\Users\NineSun\Desktop\ov56401\project\flash_jtag.tcl' `
              -RedirectStandardOutput $outFile -RedirectStandardError $errFile -PassThru
      
          $deadline = (Get-Date).AddMinutes(5)
          while ((Get-Date) -lt $deadline) {
              Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 250
              $text = if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $outFile) {
                  Get-Content -LiteralPath $outFile -Raw -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
              } else { '' }
              if ($text -match 'The Progress:.*100%.*The done bit is 1' -or
                  $text -match 'The done bit is 1' -and
                  $text -match 'COMMAND\[Program\] execute successfully|cfg_program .*successfully') {
                  $programDone = $true
                  break
              }
              if ($cfg.HasExited) { break }
          }
      
          if (-not $programDone) {
              $detail = if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $outFile) { Get-Content -LiteralPath $outFile -Raw } else { '' }
              throw "cdt_cfg did not complete programming. $detail"
          }
      
          Write-Host '100% / done bit / Program successfully detected.'
          Write-Host '烧录已完成，请手动关闭 Fabric Configuration 窗口。'
          Write-Host '等待窗口退出；不会自动关闭 cdt_cfg。'
      
          # The user owns the final close action.  Do not use Stop-Process here:
          # closing the GUI is also the explicit acknowledgement that the cable and
          # configuration state can be released for PCIe remove/rescan and testing.
          while ($true) {
              $cfg.Refresh()
              if ($cfg.HasExited) {
                  $windowClosed = $true
                  break
              }
              Start-Sleep -Seconds 1
          }
      
          Write-Host '烧录完成，窗口已关闭，可以进行 PCIe remove/rescan 和帧率测试。'
      }
      finally {
          # On failure or Ctrl+C, avoid leaving a half-programmed GUI behind.  On
          # the successful path the window has already been closed by the user.
          if ($cfg -and -not $cfg.HasExited -and -not $windowClosed) {
              Stop-Process -Id $cfg.Id -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
          }
          Get-Process cdt_js -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue |
              Stop-Process -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
          if ($server) {
              Wait-Process -Id $server.Id -Timeout 3 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
          }
      }
      
      Write-Host 'JTAG programming flow finished; cdt_js was stopped.'

    status: Completed · exit 0
      #!/usr/bin/env python3
      # -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
      """board_ssh.py -- RK3568 board access over the LAPTOP hotspot (192.168.137.x).
      SSH linaro/linaro; helper CLI used by the deploy/verify steps.
      
      Usage:
        python board_ssh.py run "<shell command>"
        python board_ssh.py put <local> <remote>
        python board_ssh.py get <remote> <local>
      """
      import sys, paramiko
      
      HOST = '192.168.137.4'
      USER, PW = 'linaro', 'linaro'
      
      
      def connect():
          cli = paramiko.SSHClient()
          cli.set_missing_host_key_policy(paramiko.AutoAddPolicy())
          cli.connect(HOST, 22, USER, PW, timeout=8, allow_agent=False, look_for_keys=False)
          return cli
      
      
      def run(cli, cmd, timeout=120, sudo=False):
          if sudo:
              cmd = "echo '%s' | sudo -S bash -c %s" % (PW, "'" + cmd.replace("'", "'\\''") + "'")
          stdin, stdout, stderr = cli.exec_command(cmd, timeout=timeout)
          out = stdout.read().decode('utf-8', 'replace')
          err = stderr.read().decode('utf-8', 'replace')
          rc = stdout.channel.recv_exit_status()
          return rc, out, err
      
      
      def main():
          cli = connect()
          try:
              mode = sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv) > 1 else 'run'
              if mode == 'run':
                  rc, out, err = run(cli, sys.argv[2], timeout=300, sudo=('--sudo' in sys.argv))
                  print(out)
                  if err.strip():
                      print('[stderr]', err[-1500:])
                  sys.exit(rc)
              elif mode == 'put':
                  sftp = cli.open_sftp()
                  sftp.put(sys.argv[2], sys.argv[3])
                  sftp.close()
                  print('put OK')
              elif mode == 'get':
                  sftp = cli.open_sftp()
                  sftp.get(sys.argv[2], sys.argv[3])
                  sftp.close()
                  print('get OK')
          finally:
              cli.close()
      
      
      if __name__ == '__main__':
          main()

       252:     // ------------- VIP: RGB565 3x3 median filter, cam1 only -------------
       253:     // Taps the 16-bit RGB565 stream produced by the capture block and hands it to
       254:     // the DDR write packer. The module owns 2 line buffers (~2 lines of latency),
       255:     // re-times vsync and drops the camera tail dummy beat, so ov5640_ddr still sees
       256:     // exactly W*H pixels per frame. MEDIAN_EN=0 selects a pure wire bypass, so a
       257:     // camera without filtering keeps its original timing and uses no BRAM.
       258:     wire                    sh_video_valid;
       259:     wire [DATA_WIDTH-1 : 0] sh_video_data ;
       260:     wire                    sh_video_vsync;
       261:
       262:     generate
       263:         if (MEDIAN_EN) begin : g_median
       264:             vip #(
       265:                 .W       (H_CMOS_DISP),
       266:                 .H       (V_CMOS_DISP),
       267:                 .STRIDE  (1024),
       268:                 .AW      (10),
       269:                 // Keep the retimed frame marker separate from data without
       270:                 // creating a large producer/consumer backlog at frame end.
       271:                 .GAP_LEN (8)
       272:             ) u_vip (
       273:                 .clk       (video_clk      ),
       274:                 .rst       (video_rst      ),
       275:                 .en        (1'b1           ),
       276:                 .strength  (MEDIAN_RSVD    ),
       277:                 .in_valid  (video_valid    ),
       278:                 .in_pixel  (video_data     ),
       279:                 .in_vsync  (video_vsync    ),
       280:                 .out_valid (sh_video_valid ),
       280:                 .out_valid (sh_video_valid ),
       281:                 .out_pixel (sh_video_data  ),
       282:                 .out_vsync (sh_video_vsync )
       283:             );
       284:         end
       285:         else begin : g_bypass
       286:             assign sh_video_valid = video_valid;
       287:             assign sh_video_data  = video_data ;
       288:             assign sh_video_vsync = video_vsync;
       289:         end
       290:     endgenerate
       291:
       292:     // wire video_rst = !locked;
       293:
       294:     wire                        cam_en    /*synthesis PAP_MARK_DEBUG="1"*/;
       295:     wire [AXI_ADDR_WIDTH-1 : 0] cam_addr_1/*synthesis PAP_MARK_DEBUG="1"*/;
       296:     wire [AXI_ADDR_WIDTH-1 : 0] cam_addr_2/*synthesis PAP_MARK_DEBUG="1"*/;
       297:     wire [1 : 0]  xdma_req  ;
       298:     reg  [31:0]   dbg_beat_cnt;
       299:     reg  [31:0]   dbg_beat_last;
       300:     reg  [31:0]   dbg_cmd_cnt;
       301: wire [31:0]   dbg_axi_cnt;
       302: wire [31:0]   dbg_axi_num;
       303: wire [31:0]   dbg_zdin;
       304: wire [31:0]   dbg_zout;
       305:     wire [31:0]   dbg_state;
       306:     wire [31:0]   dbg_last_cnt;
       307:     wire [31:0]   dbg_wd_cnt;
       308:     reg  [15:0]   dbg_axi_sticky;
       309:     reg  [15:0]   dbg_b_cnt;
       310:     reg  [15:0]   dbg_aw_cnt;
       311:     reg  [15:0]   dbg_w_cnt;
       312:     wire [15:0]   dbg_axi_stat;
       313:     reg  [31:0]   dbg_clk_status;
       314:     wire [1 : 0]  xdma_ack  ;

       363:     // [DBG] camera activity counters (read via ov5640_reg +0x30/+0x34)
       364:     reg [31:0] dbg_cam_words;
       365:     always @(posedge video_clk) begin
       366:         if (video_rst) dbg_cam_words <= 32'd0;
       367:         else if (cam_s_data_valid) dbg_cam_words <= dbg_cam_words + 32'd1;
       368:     end
       369:     reg [31:0] dbg_vsyncs;
       370:     reg [2:0]  dbg_vs_ff;
       371:     always @(posedge video_clk) dbg_vs_ff <= {dbg_vs_ff[1:0], video_vsync};
       372:     always @(posedge video_clk) begin
       373:         if (video_rst) dbg_vsyncs <= 32'd0;
       374:         else if (dbg_vs_ff[2:1] == 2'b01) dbg_vsyncs <= dbg_vsyncs + 32'd1;
       375:     end
       376:     // [DBG] href (hsync) activity counter -> ov5640_reg +0x50
       377:     reg [31:0] dbg_hsyncs;
       378:     reg [2:0]  dbg_hs_ff;
       379:     always @(posedge video_clk) dbg_hs_ff <= {dbg_hs_ff[1:0], video_hsync};
       380:     always @(posedge video_clk) begin
       381:         if (video_rst) dbg_hsyncs <= 32'd0;
       382:         else if (dbg_hs_ff[2:1] == 2'b01) dbg_hsyncs <= dbg_hsyncs + 32'd1;
       383:     end
       384:     // [DIAG] AXI beat accounting: how many beats does the engine actually see
       385:     // per camera frame? If this != CAM_DATA_LEN the write FSM deadlocks.
       386:     reg [2:0] dbg_fs_ff;
       387:     always @(posedge video_clk) dbg_fs_ff <= {dbg_fs_ff[1:0], video_vsync};
       388:     wire dbg_frame_edge = (dbg_fs_ff[2:1] == 2'b01);
       389:     always @(posedge video_clk) begin
       390:         if (video_rst) begin
       391:             dbg_beat_cnt  <= 32'd0;
       392:             dbg_beat_last <= 32'd0;
       393:         end
       394:         else if (dbg_frame_edge) begin
       395:             dbg_beat_last <= dbg_beat_cnt;
       396:             dbg_beat_cnt  <= 32'd0;
       397:         end
       398:         else if (cam_s_data_valid & cam_s_data_ready) begin
       399:             dbg_beat_cnt <= dbg_beat_cnt + 32'd1;
       400:         end
       401:     end
       402:     // [DIAG] AXI write handshake visibility (which stage ever happened?)
       403:     // [DIAG2] numeric handshake counters (sticky only says "ever", not "how many")
       404:     always @(posedge video_clk) begin
       405:         if (video_rst) begin
       406:             dbg_b_cnt  <= 16'd0;
       407:             dbg_aw_cnt <= 16'd0;
       408:             dbg_w_cnt  <= 16'd0;
       409:         end
       410:         else begin
       411:             if (dbg_axi_bvalid & dbg_axi_bready) dbg_b_cnt  <= dbg_b_cnt  + 16'd1;
       412:             if (dbg_axi_awvalid & dbg_axi_awready) dbg_aw_cnt <= dbg_aw_cnt + 16'd1;
       413:             if (dbg_axi_wvalid & dbg_axi_wready)  dbg_w_cnt  <= dbg_w_cnt  + 16'd1;
       414:         end
       415:     end
       416:     assign dbg_axi_stat = {5'd0,
       417:         dbg_axi_bready, dbg_axi_bvalid,
       418:         (cam_s_data_valid & cam_s_data_ready),
       419:         cam_s_data_ready, cam_s_data_valid,
       420:         (dbg_axi_wvalid & dbg_axi_wready), dbg_axi_wready, dbg_axi_wvalid,
       421:         (dbg_axi_awvalid & dbg_axi_awready), dbg_axi_awready, dbg_axi_awvalid};
       422:     always @(posedge video_clk) begin
       423:         if (video_rst) dbg_axi_sticky <= 16'd0;
       424:         else           dbg_axi_sticky <= dbg_axi_sticky | dbg_axi_stat;
       425:     end
       426:     // [DIAG] frame commands issued by ov5640_ddr_w_ctrl (idle->addr transitions)
       427:     reg dbg_cmd_d;
       428:     always @(posedge video_clk) begin
       429:         if (video_rst) begin
       430:             dbg_cmd_d   <= 1'b0;
       431:             dbg_cmd_cnt <= 32'd0;
       432:         end
       433:         else begin
       434:             dbg_cmd_d <= cam_cmd_valid;
       435:             if (cam_cmd_valid & ~dbg_cmd_d)
       436:                 dbg_cmd_cnt <= dbg_cmd_cnt + 32'd1;
       437:         end
       438:     end
       439:
       440: // [DBG] clk_50m activity counter + lock/button snapshot (sampled in video_clk)
       441: reg [15:0] dbg_clk50_cnt;
       442: always @(posedge clk_50m) dbg_clk50_cnt <= dbg_clk50_cnt + 16'd1;
       443: always @(posedge video_clk) dbg_clk_status <= {dbg_clk50_cnt, dbg_locked, dbg_btn_rst_n};
       444:     ov5640_reg #(
       445:
       446:         .BASE_ADDR(BASE_ADDR),
       447:         .CAM_ADDR_1_DEF(CAM_ADDR_1_DEF),
       448:         .CAM_ADDR_2_DEF(CAM_ADDR_2_DEF),
       449:         .CAM_EN_DEF   (CAM_EN_DEF   ),
       450:         .AXI_ADDR_WIDTH(AXI_ADDR_WIDTH)
       451:     )
       452:     ov5640_reg(
       453:         .clk                   (video_clk    ),
       454:         .rst                   (video_rst    ),
       455:
       456:         .s_axi_awvalid         (s_axi_awvalid),

       459:

       461:         .s_axi_wready          (s_axi_wready ),
       462:         .s_axi_wdata           (s_axi_wdata  ),
       463:         .s_axi_wstrb           (s_axi_wstrb  ),
       464:
       465:         .s_axi_bvalid          (s_axi_bvalid ),
       466:         .s_axi_bready          (s_axi_bready ),
       467:         .s_axi_bresp           (s_axi_bresp  ),
       468:
       469:         .s_axi_arvalid         (s_axi_arvalid),
       470:         .s_axi_arready         (s_axi_arready),
       471:         .s_axi_araddr          (s_axi_araddr ),
       472:
       473:         .s_axi_rvalid          (s_axi_rvalid ),
       474:         .s_axi_rready          (s_axi_rready ),
       475:         .s_axi_rdata           (s_axi_rdata  ),
       476:         .s_axi_rresp           (s_axi_rresp  ),
       477:
       478:         .xdma_ack              (xdma_ack     ),

       480:         .cam_addr_1            (cam_addr_1   ),
       481:         .cam_addr_2            (cam_addr_2   ),
       482:         .dbg_cam_words         (dbg_cam_words),
       483:         .dbg_vsyncs            (dbg_vsyncs   ),
       484:         .dbg_hsyncs            (dbg_hsyncs   ),
       485:         .dbg_xdma_req          (xdma_req     ),
       486:         .dbg_i2c_status        (dbg_i2c_status),
       487:         .dbg_pclk_cnt          (dbg_pclk_cnt ),
       488:         .dbg_sys_status        (dbg_sys_status),
       489:         .dbg_href_raw          (dbg_href_raw ),

         1: module ov5640_ddr #(
         2:     parameter DATA_WIDTH = 16,
         3:     parameter AXI_ADDR_WIDTH = 32,
         4:     parameter AXI_LEN_WIDTH  = 32,
         5:     parameter AXI_DATA_WIDTH = 128,

         7:     parameter DEVICE = "PG"

         9:     input          axi_clk        ,
        10:     input          axi_rst        ,
        11:     input          dma_done       ,  // [LEDGER 2026-09-19] DMA transaction-done pulse
        12:     input          axi_cam_en     ,      //ï¿½ï¿½ï¿½ï¿½Í·ï¿½ï¿½ï¿½ï¿½ï¿½Åºï¿½
        13:
        14:     input  [AXI_ADDR_WIDTH-1 : 0]      cam_data_addr_1,
        15:     input  [AXI_ADDR_WIDTH-1 : 0]      cam_data_addr_2,
        16:     input  [$clog2(CAM_DATA_LEN) : 0]  cam_data_len   , //ï¿½ï¿½16ï¿½Ö½ï¿½Îªï¿½ï¿½Î»
        17:
        18:     input  [DATA_WIDTH-1 : 0]  s_data         /*synthesis PAP_MARK_DEBUG="1"*/,
        19:     input                      s_data_valid   /*synthesis PAP_MARK_DEBUG="1"*/,
        20:     input                      s_hsync        /*synthesis PAP_MARK_DEBUG="1"*/,
        21:     input                      s_vsync        /*synthesis PAP_MARK_DEBUG="1"*/,
        22:
        23:     output [AXI_DATA_WIDTH-1 : 0] axi_data       /*synthesis PAP_MARK_DEBUG="1"*/,
        24:     output                        axi_data_valid /*synthesis PAP_MARK_DEBUG="1"*/,
        25:     output                        axi_data_last  /*synthesis PAP_MARK_DEBUG="1"*/,
        26:     input                         axi_data_ready /*synthesis PAP_MARK_DEBUG="1"*/,
        27:
        28:     output [AXI_ADDR_WIDTH-1 : 0]  axi_cmd_addr   /*synthesis PAP_MARK_DEBUG="1"*/,
        29:     output [AXI_LEN_WIDTH-1 : 0]   axi_cmd_len    /*synthesis PAP_MARK_DEBUG="1"*/,
        30:     output                         axi_cmd_valid  /*synthesis PAP_MARK_DEBUG="1"*/,
        31:     input                          axi_cmd_ready  /*synthesis PAP_MARK_DEBUG="1"*/,
        32:
        33:     output [1 : 0]   xdma_req       ,
        34:     output [31:0]    dbg_axi_cnt    ,
        35:     output [31:0]    dbg_axi_num    ,
        36:     output [31:0]    dbg_zdin       ,
        37:     output [31:0]    dbg_zout       ,
        38:     output [31:0]    dbg_state      ,
        39:     output [31:0]    dbg_last_cnt   ,
        40:     output [31:0]    dbg_wd_cnt     ,
        41:     input  [1 : 0]   xdma_ack
        42: );

        19: 	//trans data in
