        29: 	output reg		[7:0]   					m_axi_awlen  	,
        30: 	output 			[2:0]   					m_axi_awsize 	,
        31: 	output 			[1:0]   					m_axi_awburst	,
        32: 	output 		    	    					m_axi_awlock 	,
        33: 	output 			[3:0]   					m_axi_awcache	,
        34: 	output 			[2:0]   					m_axi_awprot	,
        35: 	output reg		        					m_axi_awvalid	,
        36: 	input  		 	        					m_axi_awready	,
        37: 	output 			[DATA_WIDTH - 1:0] 			m_axi_wdata		,
        38: 	output 			[KEEP_WIDTH - 1:0]  		m_axi_wstrb		,
        39: 	output 			        					m_axi_wlast		,
        40: 	output 			        					m_axi_wvalid	,
        41: 	input  			        					m_axi_wready	,
        42: 	input  			[ID_WIDTH - 1:0]   			m_axi_bid  		,
        43: 	input  			[1:0]   					m_axi_bresp 	,
        44: 	input  			        					m_axi_bvalid	,
        45: 	output 			        					m_axi_bready
        46:
        47: );

        50: localparam AXI_BURST_SIZE = $clog2(KEEP_WIDTH); //log2(DATA_WIDTH / 8)
        51:
        52: // [WD 2026-09-18] transmit watchdog state
        53: reg        abort_r;
        54: reg [23:0] wd_cnt;
        55: wire       w_progress;
        56: wire       abort_done;
        57:
        58: wire [DATA_WIDTH - 1:0] 		t_m_axi_wdata;
        59: wire [KEEP_WIDTH - 1:0]  		t_m_axi_wstrb;
        60: wire         					t_m_axi_wlast;
        61: wire         					t_m_axi_wvalid;
        62: wire         					t_m_axi_wready;
        63:
        64: //common para
        65: assign m_axi_awsize 	= 		AXI_BURST_SIZE	;
        66: assign m_axi_awburst 	= 		2'b01			;
        67: assign m_axi_awlock 	= 		1'b0			;
        68: assign m_axi_awcache 	= 		4'b0011			;
        69: assign m_axi_awprot 	= 		3'b000			;
        70:
        71:
        72: wire [7:0] burst_len    ;
        73: wire [7:0] max_burst_len;
        74:
        75: //cmd
        76: reg [31:0] addr;
        77: reg [31:0] len;
        78: reg        trans;
        79:
        80: always @(posedge clk) begin
        81: 	if((cmd_ready == 1'b1) && (cmd_valid == 1'b1))begin
        82: 		addr <= cmd_addr;
        83: 	end
        84: 	else begin
        85: 		if((m_axi_awvalid == 1'b1) && (m_axi_awready == 1'b1))begin
        86: 			addr <= addr + ((m_axi_awlen + 1'b1) << AXI_BURST_SIZE);
        87: 		end
        88: 	end
        89: end
        90:
        91: always @(posedge clk) begin
        92: 	if((cmd_ready == 1'b1) && (cmd_valid == 1'b1))begin
        93: 		len <= cmd_len[31:AXI_BURST_SIZE] + (|cmd_len[AXI_BURST_SIZE - 1:0]);
        94: 	end
        95: 	else begin
        96: 		if((m_axi_awvalid == 1'b1) && (m_axi_awready == 1'b1))begin
        97: 			len <= len - (m_axi_awlen + 1'b1);
        98: 		end
        99: 		else if(abort_done == 1'b1)begin
       100: 			len <= 32'd0;       // [WD]
       101: 		end
       102: 	end
       103: end
       104: always @(posedge clk)begin
       105: 	if(rst == 1'b1)begin
       106: 		trans <= 1'b0;
       107: 	end
       108: 	else begin
       109: 		if((cmd_ready == 1'b1) && (cmd_valid == 1'b1))begin
       110: 			trans <= 1'b1;
       111: 		end
       112: 		else begin
       113: 			if((m_axi_bready == 1'b1) && (m_axi_bvalid == 1'b1) && (len == 32'd0))begin
       114: 				trans <= 1'b0;
       115: 			end
       116: 			else if(abort_done == 1'b1)begin
       117: 				trans <= 1'b0;      // [WD] release the stuck transaction
       118: 			end
       119: 		end
       120: 	end
       121: end
       122:
       123: always @(posedge  clk)begin
       124: 	if(rst == 1'b1)begin
       125: 		cmd_ready <= 1'b0;
       126: 	end
       127: 	else begin
       128: 		if(trans == 1'b0)begin
       129: 			if((cmd_ready == 1'b1) && (cmd_valid == 1'b1))begin
       130: 				cmd_ready <= 1'b0;
       131: 			end
       132: 			else begin
       133: 				cmd_ready <= 1'b1;
       134: 			end
       135: 		end
       136: 		else begin
       137: 			cmd_ready <= 1'b0;
       138: 		end
       139: 	end
       140: end
       141:
       142: //aw
       143:
       144: reg burst_trans;
       145: assign burst_len     = len > BURST_LEN ? BURST_LEN : len;
       146: assign max_burst_len = (((addr & 12'hfff) + (burst_len << AXI_BURST_SIZE )) >> 12)  != 0 ? (13'h1000 - (addr & 12'hfff)) >> AXI_BURST_SIZE : burst_len;
       147: always@(posedge clk)begin
       148: 	if(rst == 1'b1)begin
       149: 		burst_trans <= 1'b0;
       150: 	end
       151: 	else begin
       152: 		if((m_axi_awvalid == 1'b1) && (m_axi_awready == 1'b1))begin
       153: 			burst_trans <= 1'b1;
       154: 		end
       155: 		else begin
       156: 			// if((m_axi_wvalid == 1'b1) && (m_axi_wready == 1'b1) && (m_axi_wlast == 1'b1))begin
       157: 			if((m_axi_bvalid == 1'b1) && (m_axi_bready == 1'b1))begin
       158: 				burst_trans <= 1'b0;
       159: 			end
       160: 			else if(abort_done == 1'b1)begin
       161: 				burst_trans <= 1'b0;   // [WD2] force-release; B may never arrive
       162: 			end
       163: 		end
       164: 	end
       165: end
       166: always @(posedge clk)begin
       167: 	if(rst == 1'b1)begin
       168: 		m_axi_awvalid <= 1'b0;
       169: 	end
       170: 	else begin
       171: 		if((m_axi_awvalid == 1'b1) && (m_axi_awready == 1'b1))begin
       172: 			m_axi_awvalid <= 1'b0;
       173: 		end
       174: 		else begin
       175: 			if((burst_trans == 1'b0) && (len != 32'd0) && (abort_r == 1'b0))begin
       176: 				m_axi_awvalid <= 1'b1;
       177: 			end
       178: 		end
       179: 	end
       180: end
       181:
       182: always @(posedge clk)begin
       183: 	m_axi_awlen <= max_burst_len - 8'd1;
       184: end
       185: always @(posedge clk)begin
       186: 	m_axi_awaddr <= addr;
       187: end
       188: always @(posedge clk) begin
       189: 	if((cmd_ready == 1'b1) && (cmd_valid == 1'b1))begin
       190: 		m_axi_awid <= cmd_id;
       191: 	end
       192: end
       193: //w
       194: reg [7:0] act_burst_len;
       195: always@ (posedge clk)begin
       196: 	if(rst == 1'b1)begin
       197: 		act_burst_len <= 8'd0;
       198: 	end
       199: 	else begin
       200: 		if((m_axi_awvalid == 1'b1) && (m_axi_awready == 1'b1))begin
       201: 			act_burst_len <= m_axi_awlen + 8'd1;
       202: 		end
       203: 		else begin
       204: 			if((t_m_axi_wvalid == 1'b1) && (t_m_axi_wready == 1'b1))begin
       205: 				act_burst_len <= act_burst_len - 8'd1;
       206: 			end
       207: 		end
       208: 	end
       209: end
       210:
       211: // [WD 2026-09-18] ------------------------------------------------------------------
       212: // The DVP stream can deliver fewer 128-bit beats than CAM_DATA_LEN (CDC FIFO
       213: // overflow drops pixels and cannot back-pressure the sensor). A frame's AXI
       214: // burst then never completes: trans sticks at 1, cmd_ready stays low and the
       215: // frame FSM deadlocks forever (measured: state=ADDR, axi_cnt=0, 0 frames).
       216: //
       217: // Recovery: if there is no W-beat progress for ~0.17 s while a write is in
       218: // flight, close the open burst with dummy beats. AXI forbids cancelling an
       219: // accepted AW, so we must still supply awlen beats; we just no longer consume
       220: // real camera data. After the B response is absorbed, trans/len clear and the
       221: // next frame's command is accepted again (only the bad frame is lost).
       222: assign w_progress = (t_m_axi_wvalid == 1'b1) && (t_m_axi_wready == 1'b1);
       223:
       224: always @(posedge clk) begin
       225: 	if((rst == 1'b1) || (trans == 1'b0) || (abort_r == 1'b1) || (w_progress == 1'b1))
       226: 		wd_cnt <= 24'd0;
       227: 	else if(wd_cnt != 24'hFFFFFF)
       228: 		wd_cnt <= wd_cnt + 24'd1;
       229: end
       230:
       231: // [BFAST 2026-09-19] the DDR write port can stop returning B responses
       232: // (see [WD2]; re-observed 09-19: b_cnt ~26 total while aw_cnt ~60k).
       233: // Waiting the full 0.17 s watchdog once every command's beats are out
       234: // capped the camera path at ~5 fps. Give B a few microseconds after the
       235: // last beat, then force the close via the abort path; a late B is still
       236: // absorbed by the w_done/bready logic.
       237: reg [9:0] bwait_cnt;
       238: // (w_done intentionally not referenced: it is declared further below and
       239: // act_burst_len==0 && burst_trans already means every beat is out, B pending)
       240: wire all_beats_out = (len == 32'd0) && (act_burst_len == 8'd0) && burst_trans;
       241: always @(posedge clk) begin
       242: 	if((rst == 1'b1) || (trans == 1'b0) || (all_beats_out == 1'b0) || (abort_r == 1'b1))
       243: 		bwait_cnt <= 10'd0;
       244: 	else if(bwait_cnt != 10'h3FF)
       245: 		bwait_cnt <= bwait_cnt + 10'd1;
       246: end
       247: always @(posedge clk) begin
       248: 	if(rst == 1'b1)
       249: 		abort_r <= 1'b0;
       250: 	// [BFAST2 2026-09-19] bwait fast-close DISABLED: B latency under DDR contention
       251: 	// can legitimately exceed the 10us grace; force-closing mid-flight corrupted
       252: 	// the crossbar/DDR transaction stream and killed M00 writes within seconds.
       253: 	// Fall back to the long send-watchdog only.
       254: 	else if((abort_r == 1'b0) && (trans == 1'b1) && (wd_cnt == 24'hFFFFFF))
       255: 		abort_r <= 1'b1;
       256: 	else if(abort_done == 1'b1)
       257: 		abort_r <= 1'b0;
       258: end
       259:
       260: // [WD2 2026-09-18] burst_trans is only cleared by the B response, which is
       261: // exactly what never arrives in the wedge case (cam2: bvalid never asserted).
       262: // Requiring burst_trans==0 made abort_done unreachable -> no recovery.
       263: // All W beats for the open burst are out once act_burst_len hits 0, so that
       264: // is the correct release point; burst_trans is force-cleared below.
       265: assign abort_done = abort_r && (act_burst_len == 8'd0);
       266: // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------
       267:
       268: stream_pipe #(
       269:   .DATA_WIDTH 	(DATA_WIDTH+1+KEEP_WIDTH)
       270: ) stream_pipe_3(
       271:   .dataIn_valid     (t_m_axi_wvalid),
       272:   .dataIn_ready     (t_m_axi_wready),
       273:   .dataIn_payload   ({t_m_axi_wdata, t_m_axi_wstrb, t_m_axi_wlast}),
       274:   .dataOut_valid    (m_axi_wvalid),
       275:   .dataOut_ready    (m_axi_wready),
       276:   .dataOut_payload  ({m_axi_wdata, m_axi_wstrb, m_axi_wlast}),
       277:   .clk              (clk),
       278:   .reset            (rst)
       279: );
       280:
       281: assign data_in_ready = abort_r ? 1'b0
       282:                                : (t_m_axi_wready && act_burst_len > 8'd0);
       283: assign t_m_axi_wvalid  = abort_r ? (act_burst_len > 8'd0)
       284:                                  : (data_in_valid && act_burst_len > 8'd0);
       285: assign t_m_axi_wdata   = abort_r ? {DATA_WIDTH{1'b0}} : data_in;
       286: assign t_m_axi_wlast   = (act_burst_len == 8'd1);
       287: assign t_m_axi_wstrb   = abort_r ? {KEEP_WIDTH{1'b1}} : data_in_keep;
       288:
       289: //b
       290: reg w_done;
       291: always @(posedge clk) begin
       292: 	if(rst == 1'b1) begin
       293: 		w_done <= 1'b0;
       294: 	end
       295: 	else begin
       296: 		if((t_m_axi_wvalid == 1'b1) && (t_m_axi_wready == 1'b1) && (t_m_axi_wlast == 1'b1)) begin
       297: 			w_done <= 1'b1;
       298: 		end
       299: 		else begin
       300: 			if((m_axi_bvalid == 1'b1) && (m_axi_bready == 1'b1)) begin
       301: 				w_done <= 1'b0;
       302: 			end
       303: 		end
       304: 	end
       305: end
       306: assign m_axi_bready = w_done;
       307:
       308: // [LEDGER 2026-09-19] single-ledger completion: pulse exactly once per
       309: // command on the trans 1->0 fall. Covers the normal close (B absorbed,
       310: // len==0) AND both watchdog abort paths; the old B-gated expression never
       311: // pulsed when a B response was lost, wedging the frame FSM in DATA forever.
       312: reg trans_q;
       313: always @(posedge clk) begin
       314: 	if(rst == 1'b1) trans_q <= 1'b0;
       315: 	else            trans_q <= trans;
       316: end
       317:
       318: always @(posedge clk ) begin
       319: 	if(rst == 1'b1)begin
       320: 		data_in_last <= 1'b0;
       321: 	end
       322: 	else begin
       323: 		data_in_last <= trans_q && (trans == 1'b0);
       324: 	end
       325: end
       326:
       327: endmodule

       220: // real camera data. After the B response is absorbed, trans/len clear and the

       246: // awvalid (AXI violation). Worse, the crossbar's awready was tied straight to the
       247: // IP's awready, so whenever the gate blocked while the IP idled ready-high, the
       248: // crossbar retired the AW into the void: the IP never saw the burst, its W beats
       249: // drained unpaired, wusero_last never came and the fabric-minted B (below) never
       250: // rose -- the permanent M00 write wedge. Replaced by latch-and-hold shims defined
       251: // after the B-channel bridge.
       252:

       369: wire axi_clk;
       370: wire axi_rst;
       371: assign axi_clk = core_clk;
       372: assign axi_rst = ~ddr_init_done;

       374: /////////////////////////////////////// [WARB 2026-09-19] camera write arbiter ///////
       375: // Single-outstanding 2-master arbiter replacing the crossbar M00 write path.
       376: // Bench-proven: 9741 consecutive bursts, zero wedge (sim/wedge/tb_wedge.v).
       377: wire [3:0]   arb_s_awid;
       378: wire [31:0]  arb_s_awaddr;
       379: wire [7:0]   arb_s_awlen;
       380: wire [2:0]   arb_s_awsize, arb_s_awprot;
       381: wire [1:0]   arb_s_awburst;
       382: wire         arb_s_awlock;
       383: wire [3:0]   arb_s_awcache;
       384: wire         arb_s_awvalid, arb_s_awready;
       385: wire [127:0] arb_s_wdata;
       386: wire [15:0]  arb_s_wstrb;
       387: wire         arb_s_wlast, arb_s_wvalid, arb_s_wready;
       388: wire [3:0]   arb_s_bid;
       389: wire [1:0]   arb_s_bresp;
       390: wire         arb_s_bvalid, arb_s_bready;
       391: // parked crossbar M00 write ports
       392: wire [6:0]   arb2x_awid;
       393: wire [31:0]  arb2x_awaddr;
       394: wire [7:0]   arb2x_awlen;
       395: wire [2:0]   arb2x_awsize, arb2x_awprot;
       396: wire [1:0]   arb2x_awburst;
       397: wire         arb2x_awlock;
       398: wire [3:0]   arb2x_awcache;
       399: wire [3:0]   arb2x_awqos;
       400: wire [1:0]   arb2x_awuser;
       401: wire         arb2x_awvalid;
       402: wire [127:0] arb2x_wdata;
       403: wire [15:0]  arb2x_wstrb;
       404: wire         arb2x_wlast, arb2x_wvalid;
       405: wire [1:0]   arb2x_wuser;
       406: ddr_w_arb u_ddr_w_arb (
       407:     .clk(axi_clk), .rst(axi_rst),
       408:     .m0_awid    (ov5640_axi_awid    ), .m0_awaddr (ov5640_axi_awaddr ),
       409:     .m0_awlen   (ov5640_axi_awlen   ), .m0_awsize (ov5640_axi_awsize ),
       410:     .m0_awburst (ov5640_axi_awburst ), .m0_awlock (ov5640_axi_awlock ),
       411:     .m0_awcache (ov5640_axi_awcache ), .m0_awprot (ov5640_axi_awprot ),
       412:     .m0_awvalid (ov5640_axi_awvalid ), .m0_awready(ov5640_axi_awready),
       413:     .m0_wdata   (ov5640_axi_wdata   ), .m0_wstrb  (ov5640_axi_wstrb  ),
       414:     .m0_wlast   (ov5640_axi_wlast   ), .m0_wvalid (ov5640_axi_wvalid ),
       415:     .m0_wready  (ov5640_axi_wready  ),
       416:     .m0_bid     (ov5640_axi_bid     ), .m0_bresp  (ov5640_axi_bresp  ),
       417:     .m0_bvalid  (ov5640_axi_bvalid  ), .m0_bready (ov5640_axi_bready ),
       418:     .m1_awid    (cam2_axi_awid      ), .m1_awaddr (cam2_axi_awaddr   ),
       419:     .m1_awlen   (cam2_axi_awlen     ), .m1_awsize (cam2_axi_awsize   ),
       420:     .m1_awburst (cam2_axi_awburst   ), .m1_awlock (cam2_axi_awlock   ),
       421:     .m1_awcache (cam2_axi_awcache   ), .m1_awprot (cam2_axi_awprot   ),
       422:     .m1_awvalid (cam2_axi_awvalid   ), .m1_awready(cam2_axi_awready  ),
       423:     .m1_wdata   (cam2_axi_wdata     ), .m1_wstrb  (cam2_axi_wstrb    ),
       424:     .m1_wlast   (cam2_axi_wlast     ), .m1_wvalid (cam2_axi_wvalid   ),
       425:     .m1_wready  (cam2_axi_wready    ),
       426:     .m1_bid     (cam2_axi_bid       ), .m1_bresp  (cam2_axi_bresp    ),
       427:     .m1_bvalid  (cam2_axi_bvalid    ), .m1_bready (cam2_axi_bready   ),
       428:     .s_awid     (arb_s_awid         ), .s_awaddr (arb_s_awaddr      ),
       429:     .s_awlen    (arb_s_awlen        ), .s_awsize (arb_s_awsize      ),
       430:     .s_awburst  (arb_s_awburst      ), .s_awlock (arb_s_awlock      ),
       431:     .s_awcache  (arb_s_awcache      ), .s_awprot (arb_s_awprot      ),
       432:     .s_awvalid  (arb_s_awvalid      ), .s_awready(arb_s_awready     ),
       433:     .s_wdata    (arb_s_wdata        ), .s_wstrb  (arb_s_wstrb       ),
       434:     .s_wlast    (arb_s_wlast        ), .s_wvalid (arb_s_wvalid      ),
       435:     .s_wready   (arb_s_wready       ),
       436:     .s_bid      (arb_s_bid          ), .s_bresp  (arb_s_bresp       ),
       437:     .s_bvalid   (arb_s_bvalid       ), .s_bready (arb_s_bready      )
       438: );
       439: // DDR glue AW/W side now fed by the arbiter
       440: assign ddr_axi_awaddr     = arb_s_awaddr;
       441: assign ddr_axi_awlen      = arb_s_awlen;
       442: assign ddr_axi_awvalid    = arb_s_awvalid;
       443: assign arb_s_awready      = ddr_axi_awready_xbar;
       444: assign ddr_axi_wdata      = arb_s_wdata;
       445: assign ddr_axi_wstrb      = arb_s_wstrb;
       446: assign ddr_axi_wlast      = arb_s_wlast;
       447: assign ddr_axi_wvalid     = arb_s_wvalid;
       448: assign arb_s_wready       = !ddr_axi_fifo_full;
       449: assign arb_s_bvalid       = ddr_axi_bvalid;
       450: assign arb_s_bresp        = ddr_axi_bresp;
       451: assign ddr_axi_bready     = arb_s_bready;
       452: // awuser id now carries the arbiter's source id (m0=0001, m1=0100 4-bit form)
       453: assign ddr_axi_awuser_id  = {3'b000, arb_s_awid};
       454: assign ddr_axi_awuser_ap  = 1'b0;
       455: assign arb_s_bid          = {3'b000, 1'b0};
       456:
       457: /////////////////////////////////////// DDR3 B-Channel Bridge //////////////////////////////////////
       458: reg  [AXI_ID_M_LEN-1 : AXI_ID_LEN]                  ddr_axi_aw_sid        ;//ddr_axi_awuser_id??3?
       459: reg  [AXI_ID_M_LEN-1 : AXI_ID_LEN]                  ddr_axi_ar_sid        ;//ddr_axi_aruser_id??3?
       460:
       461: // latch aw_sid on AW handshake
       462: always @(posedge axi_clk) begin
       463:     if (axi_rst) begin
       464:         ddr_axi_aw_sid <= {(AXI_ID_M_LEN - AXI_ID_LEN){1'b0}};
       465:     end
       466:     else if (ddr_axi_awvalid && ddr_axi_awready_xbar) begin   // [AWFIX] ack at latch
       467:         ddr_axi_aw_sid <= ddr_axi_awuser_id[AXI_ID_M_LEN-1 : AXI_ID_LEN];
       468:     end
       469: end
       470:
       471: // latch ar_sid on AR handshake
       472: always @(posedge axi_clk) begin
       473:     if (axi_rst) begin
       474:         ddr_axi_ar_sid <= {(AXI_ID_M_LEN - AXI_ID_LEN){1'b0}};
       475:     end
       476:     else if (ddr_axi_arvalid && ddr_axi_arready_xbar) begin   // [ARFIX] ack at latch
       477:         ddr_axi_ar_sid <= ddr_axi_aruser_id[AXI_ID_M_LEN-1 : AXI_ID_LEN];
       478:     end
       479: end
       480:
       481:
       482: reg                         ddr_axi_bvalid_int    ;
       483: reg  [1:0]                  ddr_axi_bresp_int     ;
       484: reg  [AXI_ID_M_LEN-1:0]     ddr_axi_bid_int       ;
       485: always @(posedge axi_clk) begin
       486:     if (axi_rst) begin
       487:         ddr_axi_bvalid_int  <= 1'b0;
       488:         ddr_axi_bresp_int   <= 2'b01;
       489:         ddr_axi_bid_int <= {AXI_ID_M_LEN{1'b0}};
       490:     end
       491:     else begin
       492:         if (ddr_axi_wready_ddr3 && ddr_axi_wusero_last_ddr3) begin
       493:             ddr_axi_bvalid_int <= 1'b1;
       494:             ddr_axi_bresp_int  <= 2'b00;
       495:             ddr_axi_bid_int <= {ddr_axi_aw_sid[AXI_ID_M_LEN-1 : AXI_ID_LEN], ddr_axi_wusero_id};
       496:         end
       497:         else if (ddr_axi_bvalid && ddr_axi_bready) begin
       498:             ddr_axi_bvalid_int <= 1'b0;
       499:             ddr_axi_bresp_int  <= 2'b01;
       500:             ddr_axi_bid_int <= {AXI_ID_M_LEN{1'b0}};
       501:         end
       502:     end
       503: end
       504:
       505: assign ddr_axi_bvalid = ddr_axi_bvalid_int;
       506: assign ddr_axi_bresp  = ddr_axi_bresp_int;
       507: assign ddr_axi_bid    = ddr_axi_bid_int;
       508:
       509: /////////////////////////////////////// DDR3 AW/AR latch shims [AWFIX/ARFIX 2026-09-19] ///
       510: // Proper single-handshake adapters between the crossbar and the DDR3 IP.
       511: // The crossbar is acknowledged exactly when we latch a request; the request is
       512: // then HELD with stable payload until the IP accepts (AXI-legal, no retraction).
       513: // Single-outstanding end-to-end (no held request + write FIFO empty + no pending
       514: // B for AW; read FIFO empty for AR) also keeps the aw_sid/ar_sid ID rebuilds sane.
       515: // [STAGE 2026-09-19] The DDR3 IP's W channel is UNTHROTTLEABLE: it pulses
       516: // wready at its own pace and counts awlen+1 beats itself (see the IP's own
       517: // example_design -- there is no wvalid at all). Presenting an AW before its
       518: // beats are in the FIFO let the IP consume GHOST beats from an empty FIFO;
       519: // the real beats then stranded in the FIFO forever and blocked all later AWs
       520: // (the permanent M00 write wedge). Hold each latched AW until its ENTIRE
       521: // burst is staged in the FIFO, then present it: during IP consumption the
       522: // FIFO only drains, so every demanded beat is guaranteed present.
       523: wire aw_burst_fits   = (ddr_axi_awlen < (5'd16 - wr_water_level));
       524: wire aw_latch_now    = ddr_axi_awvalid && !ddr3_aw_v && !aw_hold_v
       525:                        && w_fifo_empty && aw_burst_fits && !ddr_axi_bvalid_int;
       526: wire ar_latch_now    = ddr_axi_arvalid && !ddr3_ar_v && ddr_axi_fifo_empty;
       527:
       528: reg              ddr3_aw_v, ddr3_ar_v;
       529: reg              aw_hold_v;
       530: reg [27:0]       ddr3_aw_addr, ddr3_ar_addr;
       531: reg [3:0]        ddr3_aw_len,  ddr3_ar_len;
       532: reg              ddr3_aw_ap,   ddr3_ar_ap;
       533: reg [AXI_ID_M_LEN-1:0] ddr3_aw_id, ddr3_ar_id;
       534:
       535: wire aw_stage_ok = (wr_water_level >= ({1'b0, ddr3_aw_len} + 5'd1)) && !w_fifo_empty;
       536:
       537: always @(posedge axi_clk) begin
       538:     if (axi_rst) begin
       539:         aw_hold_v <= 1'b0;
       540:         ddr3_aw_v <= 1'b0;
       541:     end
       542:     else begin
       543:         if (aw_latch_now) begin
       544:             aw_hold_v   <= 1'b1;
       545:             ddr3_aw_addr <= ddr_axi_awaddr[27:0];
       546:             ddr3_aw_len  <= ddr_axi_awlen;
       547:             ddr3_aw_ap   <= ddr_axi_awuser_ap;
       548:             ddr3_aw_id   <= ddr_axi_awuser_id;
       549:         end
       550:         if (aw_hold_v && !ddr3_aw_v && aw_stage_ok) begin
       551:             aw_hold_v <= 1'b0;
       552:             ddr3_aw_v <= 1'b1;
       553:         end
       554:         else if (ddr3_aw_v && ddr_axi_awready) begin
       555:             ddr3_aw_v <= 1'b0;
       556:         end
       557:     end
       558: end
       559: always @(posedge axi_clk) begin
       560:     if (axi_rst) ddr3_ar_v <= 1'b0;
       561:     else if (ar_latch_now)                       ddr3_ar_v <= 1'b1;
       562:     else if (ddr3_ar_v && ddr_axi_arready)       ddr3_ar_v <= 1'b0;
       563: end
       564: always @(posedge axi_clk) begin
       565:     if (ar_latch_now) begin
       566:         ddr3_ar_addr <= ddr_axi_araddr[27:0];
       567:         ddr3_ar_len  <= ddr_axi_arlen;
       568:         ddr3_ar_ap   <= ddr_axi_aruser_ap;
       569:         ddr3_ar_id   <= ddr_axi_aruser_id;
       570:     end
       571: end
       572: // crossbar-facing readies: acknowledge exactly at latch time
       573: wire ddr_axi_awready_xbar = aw_latch_now;
       574: wire ddr_axi_arready_xbar = ar_latch_now;
       575:
       576:
       577: /////////////////////////////     DDR3   ///////////////////////////////////////////////////
       578:     wire       [AXI_ID_LEN-1:0]       pcie_axi_awid   ;
       579:     wire       [31:0]                 pcie_axi_awaddr ;
       580:     wire       [ 3:0]                 pcie_axi_awlen  ;
       581:     wire       [ 2:0]                 pcie_axi_awsize ;
       582:     wire       [ 1:0]                 pcie_axi_awburst;
       583:     wire                              pcie_axi_awlock ;
       584:     wire       [ 3:0]                 pcie_axi_awcache;
       585:     wire       [ 2:0]                 pcie_axi_awprot ;
       586:     wire       [ 3:0]                 pcie_axi_awqos  ;
       587:     wire                              pcie_axi_awvalid;
       588:     wire                              pcie_axi_awready;
       589:
       590:     wire       [AXI_DATA_LEN-1:0]     pcie_axi_wdata  ;
       591:     wire       [AXI_STRB_LEN-1:0]     pcie_axi_wstrb  ;
       592:     wire                              pcie_axi_wlast  ;
       593:     wire                              pcie_axi_wvalid ;
       594:     wire                              pcie_axi_wready ;
       595:
       596:     wire       [AXI_ID_LEN-1:0]       pcie_axi_bid    ;
       597:     wire       [ 1:0]                 pcie_axi_bresp  ;
       598:     wire                              pcie_axi_bvalid ;
       599:     wire                              pcie_axi_bready ;
       600:
       601:     wire       [AXI_ID_LEN-1:0]       pcie_axi_arid   ;
       602:     wire       [31:0]                 pcie_axi_araddr ;
       603:     wire       [ 3:0]                 pcie_axi_arlen  ;
       604:     wire       [ 2:0]                 pcie_axi_arsize ;
       605:     wire       [ 1:0]                 pcie_axi_arburst;
       606:     wire                              pcie_axi_arlock ;
       607:     wire       [ 3:0]                 pcie_axi_arcache;
       608:     wire       [ 2:0]                 pcie_axi_arprot ;
       609:     wire       [ 3:0]                 pcie_axi_arqos  ;
       610:     wire                              pcie_axi_arvalid;
       611:     wire                              pcie_axi_arready;
       612:
       613:     wire       [AXI_ID_LEN-1:0]       pcie_axi_rid    ;
       614:     wire       [AXI_DATA_LEN-1:0]     pcie_axi_rdata  ;
       615:     wire       [ 1:0]                 pcie_axi_rresp  ;
       616:     wire                              pcie_axi_rlast  ;
       617:     wire                              pcie_axi_rvalid ;
       618:     wire                              pcie_axi_rready ;
       619:
       620:     wire                              pcie_clk        ;
      2100:     .s05_axi_arcache(npu_s3_axi_arcache ),
      2101:     .s05_axi_arprot (npu_s3_axi_arprot  ),
      2102:     .s05_axi_arqos  (4'd0),
      2103:     .s05_axi_aruser (),
      2104:     .s05_axi_arvalid(npu_s3_axi_arvalid ),
      2105:     .s05_axi_arready(npu_s3_axi_arready ),

      ==== source/axi_crossbar/ddr_w_arb.v ====
         1: // ============================================================================
         2: // ddr_w_arb.v -- [WARB 2026-09-19] minimal 2-master DDR write arbiter.
         3: //
         4: // WHY: the Forencich axi_crossbar's M00 write path leaks its per-master W-channel
         5: // select across handoffs (bench-proven in sim/wedge: after S01's burst tail the
         6: // M00 w_select_valid latches forever, S04's beats are never released, and both
         7: // camera engines wedge after 1-2 bursts). This module replaces the crossbar on
         8: // the DDR write path for the two camera engines.
         9: //
        10: // DESIGN: single-outstanding end-to-end, matching the DDR3 IP user-port contract
        11: // (no wvalid, unthrottleable wready, one burst processed at a time):
        12: //   IDLE  : present one master's AW (round-robin tie-break); the accept from the
        13: //           port glue locks OWNER for the whole burst.
        14: //   BUSY  : only OWNER's W stream reaches the glue; the fabric-minted B (from
        15: //           wusero_last) is routed back to OWNER; its accept frees the slot and
        16: //           flips the round-robin bit.
        17: // AXI-legal: awvalid/wvalid are held with stable payload until accepted; the
        18: // non-owner master's awready/wready stay low, so its burst cannot start.
        19: // ============================================================================
        20: `timescale 1ns/1ps
        21: module ddr_w_arb (
        22:     input  wire         clk,
        23:     input  wire         rst,
        24:
        25:     // ---- master 0 (cam1 DMA) ----
        26:     input  wire [3:0]   m0_awid,
        27:     input  wire [31:0]  m0_awaddr,
        28:     input  wire [7:0]   m0_awlen,
        29:     input  wire [2:0]   m0_awsize,
        30:     input  wire [1:0]   m0_awburst,
        31:     input  wire         m0_awlock,
        32:     input  wire [3:0]   m0_awcache,
        33:     input  wire [2:0]   m0_awprot,
        34:     input  wire         m0_awvalid,
        35:     output wire         m0_awready,
        36:     input  wire [127:0] m0_wdata,
        37:     input  wire [15:0]  m0_wstrb,
        38:     input  wire         m0_wlast,
        39:     input  wire         m0_wvalid,
        40:     output wire         m0_wready,
        41:     output wire [3:0]   m0_bid,
        42:     output wire [1:0]   m0_bresp,
        43:     output wire         m0_bvalid,
        44:     input  wire         m0_bready,
        45:
        46:     // ---- master 1 (cam2 DMA) ----
        47:     input  wire [3:0]   m1_awid,
        48:     input  wire [31:0]  m1_awaddr,
        49:     input  wire [7:0]   m1_awlen,
        50:     input  wire [2:0]   m1_awsize,
        51:     input  wire [1:0]   m1_awburst,
        52:     input  wire         m1_awlock,
        53:     input  wire [3:0]   m1_awcache,
        54:     input  wire [2:0]   m1_awprot,
        55:     input  wire         m1_awvalid,
        56:     output wire         m1_awready,
        57:     input  wire [127:0] m1_wdata,
        58:     input  wire [15:0]  m1_wstrb,
        59:     input  wire         m1_wlast,
        60:     input  wire         m1_wvalid,
        61:     output wire         m1_wready,
        62:     output wire [3:0]   m1_bid,
        63:     output wire [1:0]   m1_bresp,
        64:     output wire         m1_bvalid,
        65:     input  wire         m1_bready,
        66:
        67:     // ---- slave (DDR3 port glue) ----
        68:     output wire [3:0]   s_awid,
        69:     output wire [31:0]  s_awaddr,
        70:     output wire [7:0]   s_awlen,
        71:     output wire [2:0]   s_awsize,
        72:     output wire [1:0]   s_awburst,
        73:     output wire         s_awlock,
        74:     output wire [3:0]   s_awcache,
        75:     output wire [2:0]   s_awprot,
        76:     output wire         s_awvalid,
        77:     input  wire         s_awready,
        78:     output wire [127:0] s_wdata,
        79:     output wire [15:0]  s_wstrb,
        80:     output wire         s_wlast,
        81:     output wire         s_wvalid,
        82:     input  wire         s_wready,
        83:     input  wire [3:0]   s_bid,
        84:     input  wire [1:0]   s_bresp,
        85:     input  wire         s_bvalid,
        86:     output wire         s_bready
        87: );
        88:
        89:     // Experimental throughput version: retain ownership for eight adjacent
        90:     // DDR bursts before rotating. The user requested restoring this exact
        91:     // experiment after the rollback image was tested.
        92:     localparam [2:0] BURSTS_PER_TURN = 3'd8;
        93:
        94:     reg  busy;      // an AW is locked in (waiting for its B)
        95:     reg  owner;     // 0 = master0 owns the slot, 1 = master1
        96:     reg  rr;        // round-robin tie-break for the next idle grant
        97:     reg  [2:0] turn_count;
        98:
        99:     // grant decision: only when idle; alternate when both masters ask
       100:     wire aw_gnt_m1 = ~busy & m1_awvalid & ( rr | ~m0_awvalid);
       101:     wire aw_gnt_m0 = ~busy & m0_awvalid & ~(m1_awvalid & rr);
       102:
       103:     // AW datapath (granted master's request)
       104:     assign s_awid    = aw_gnt_m1 ? m1_awid    : m0_awid;
       105:     assign s_awaddr  = aw_gnt_m1 ? m1_awaddr  : m0_awaddr;
       106:     assign s_awlen   = aw_gnt_m1 ? m1_awlen   : m0_awlen;
       107:     assign s_awsize  = aw_gnt_m1 ? m1_awsize  : m0_awsize;
       108:     assign s_awburst = aw_gnt_m1 ? m1_awburst : m0_awburst;
       109:     assign s_awlock  = aw_gnt_m1 ? m1_awlock  : m0_awlock;
       110:     assign s_awcache = aw_gnt_m1 ? m1_awcache : m0_awcache;
       111:     assign s_awprot  = aw_gnt_m1 ? m1_awprot  : m0_awprot;
       112:     assign s_awvalid = aw_gnt_m0 | aw_gnt_m1;
       113:
       114:     assign m0_awready = aw_gnt_m0 & s_awready;
       115:     assign m1_awready = aw_gnt_m1 & s_awready;
       116:
       117:     // W datapath (only the owner's beats can flow)
       118:     assign s_wdata  = owner ? m1_wdata : m0_wdata;
       119:     assign s_wstrb  = owner ? m1_wstrb : m0_wstrb;
       120:     assign s_wlast  = owner ? m1_wlast : m0_wlast;
       121:     assign s_wvalid = busy & (owner ? m1_wvalid : m0_wvalid);
       122:
       123:     assign m0_wready = busy & ~owner & s_wready;
       124:     assign m1_wready = busy &  owner & s_wready;
       125:
       126:     // B path: single outstanding -> the owner gets the fabric-minted response
       127:     assign m0_bvalid = busy & ~owner & s_bvalid;
       128:     assign m1_bvalid = busy &  owner & s_bvalid;
       129:     assign m0_bid    = s_bid;
       130:     assign m1_bid    = s_bid;
       131:     assign m0_bresp  = s_bresp;
       132:     assign m1_bresp  = s_bresp;
       133:     assign s_bready  = busy & (owner ? m1_bready : m0_bready);
       134:
       135:     always @(posedge clk) begin
       136:         if (rst) begin
       137:             busy  <= 1'b0;
       138:             owner <= 1'b0;
       139:             rr    <= 1'b0;
       140:             turn_count <= 3'd0;
       141:         end
       142:         else begin
       143:             if (!busy && (aw_gnt_m0 | aw_gnt_m1) && s_awready) begin
       144:                 busy  <= 1'b1;
       145:                 owner <= aw_gnt_m1;
       146:                 if (turn_count == BURSTS_PER_TURN - 1'b1) begin
       147:                     turn_count <= 3'd0;
       148:                     rr <= aw_gnt_m0;         // rotate after the eight-burst quantum
       149:                 end
       150:                 else begin
       151:                     turn_count <= turn_count + 1'b1;
       152:                     rr <= rr;                // keep the same owner during the quantum
       153:                 end
       154:             end
       155:             else if (busy && s_bvalid && s_bready) begin
       156:                 busy  <= 1'b0;
       157:             end
       158:         end
       159:     end
       160:
       161: endmodule

      """Read-only RK3568 dual-camera throughput and RTL-diagnostic probe.
      
      The caller should stop camview/detview before running this tool.  The tool only
      uses the driver's FPGA-to-host read path; it does not write camera registers.
      The two tag locations are ping/pong buffers for one camera, so frame_done is the
      primary FPS metric and tag changes are a secondary cross-check.

      1: // ============================================================================
      2: // ddr_w_arb.v -- [WARB 2026-09-19] minimal 2-master DDR write arbiter.
      3: //
      4: // WHY: the Forencich axi_crossbar's M00 write path leaks its per-master W-channel
      5: // select across handoffs (bench-proven in sim/wedge: after S01's burst tail the
      6: // M00 w_select_valid latches forever, S04's beats are never released, and both
      7: // camera engines wedge after 1-2 bursts). This module replaces the crossbar on
      8: // the DDR write path for the two camera engines.
      9: //
      10: // DESIGN: single-outstanding end-to-end, matching the DDR3 IP user-port contract
      11: // (no wvalid, unthrottleable wready, one burst processed at a time):
      12: //   IDLE  : present one master's AW (round-robin tie-break); the accept from the
      13: //           port glue locks OWNER for the whole burst.
      14: //   BUSY  : only OWNER's W stream reaches the glue; the fabric-minted B (from
      15: //           wusero_last) is routed back to OWNER; its accept frees the slot and
      16: //           flips the round-robin bit.
      17: // AXI-legal: awvalid/wvalid are held with stable payload until accepted; the
      18: // non-owner master's awready/wready stay low, so its burst cannot start.
      19: // ============================================================================
      20: `timescale 1ns/1ps
      21: module ddr_w_arb (
      22:     input  wire         clk,
      23:     input  wire         rst,
      24:
      25:     // ---- master 0 (cam1 DMA) ----
      26:     input  wire [3:0]   m0_awid,
      27:     input  wire [31:0]  m0_awaddr,

      32:     input  wire [3:0]   m0_awcache,
      33:     input  wire [2:0]   m0_awprot,
      34:     input  wire         m0_awvalid,
      35:     output wire         m0_awready,
      36:     input  wire [127:0] m0_wdata,
      37:     input  wire [15:0]  m0_wstrb,
      38:     input  wire         m0_wlast,
      39:     input  wire         m0_wvalid,
      40:     output wire         m0_wready,
      41:     output wire [3:0]   m0_bid,
      42:     output wire [1:0]   m0_bresp,
      43:     output wire         m0_bvalid,
      44:     input  wire         m0_bready,
      45:
      46:     // ---- master 1 (cam2 DMA) ----
      47:     input  wire [3:0]   m1_awid,
      48:     input  wire [31:0]  m1_awaddr,
      49:     input  wire [7:0]   m1_awlen,
      50:     input  wire [2:0]   m1_awsize,
      51:     input  wire [1:0]   m1_awburst,
      52:     input  wire         m1_awlock,
      53:     input  wire [3:0]   m1_awcache,
      54:     input  wire [2:0]   m1_awprot,
      55:     input  wire         m1_awvalid,
      56:     output wire         m1_awready,
      57:     input  wire [127:0] m1_wdata,
      58:     input  wire [15:0]  m1_wstrb,
      59:     input  wire         m1_wlast,
      60:     input  wire         m1_wvalid,
      61:     output wire         m1_wready,
      62:     output wire [3:0]   m1_bid,
      63:     output wire [1:0]   m1_bresp,
      64:     output wire         m1_bvalid,
      65:     input  wire         m1_bready,
      66:
      67:     // ---- slave (DDR3 port glue) ----
      68:     output wire [3:0]   s_awid,
      69:     output wire [31:0]  s_awaddr,
      70:     output wire [7:0]   s_awlen,
      71:     output wire [2:0]   s_awsize,
      72:     output wire [1:0]   s_awburst,
      73:     output wire         s_awlock,
      74:     output wire [3:0]   s_awcache,
      75:     output wire [2:0]   s_awprot,
      76:     output wire         s_awvalid,
      77:     input  wire         s_awready,
      78:     output wire [127:0] s_wdata,
      79:     output wire [15:0]  s_wstrb,
      80:     output wire         s_wlast,
      81:     output wire         s_wvalid,
      82:     input  wire         s_wready,
      83:     input  wire [3:0]   s_bid,
      84:     input  wire [1:0]   s_bresp,
      85:     input  wire         s_bvalid,
      86:     output wire         s_bready
      87: );
      88:
      89:     reg  busy;      // an AW is locked in (waiting for its B)
      90:     reg  owner;     // 0 = master0 owns the slot, 1 = master1
      91:     reg  rr;        // round-robin tie-break for the next idle grant
      92:
      93:     // grant decision: only when idle; alternate when both masters ask
      94:     wire aw_gnt_m1 = ~busy & m1_awvalid & ( rr | ~m0_awvalid);
      95:     wire aw_gnt_m0 = ~busy & m0_awvalid & ~(m1_awvalid & rr);
      96:
      97:     // AW datapath (granted master's request)
      98:     assign s_awid    = aw_gnt_m1 ? m1_awid    : m0_awid;
      99:     assign s_awaddr  = aw_gnt_m1 ? m1_awaddr  : m0_awaddr;
      100:     assign s_awlen   = aw_gnt_m1 ? m1_awlen   : m0_awlen;
      101:     assign s_awsize  = aw_gnt_m1 ? m1_awsize  : m0_awsize;
      102:     assign s_awburst = aw_gnt_m1 ? m1_awburst : m0_awburst;
      103:     assign s_awlock  = aw_gnt_m1 ? m1_awlock  : m0_awlock;
      104:     assign s_awcache = aw_gnt_m1 ? m1_awcache : m0_awcache;
      105:     assign s_awprot  = aw_gnt_m1 ? m1_awprot  : m0_awprot;
      106:     assign s_awvalid = aw_gnt_m0 | aw_gnt_m1;
      107:
      108:     assign m0_awready = aw_gnt_m0 & s_awready;
      109:     assign m1_awready = aw_gnt_m1 & s_awready;
      110:
      111:     // W datapath (only the owner's beats can flow)
      112:     assign s_wdata  = owner ? m1_wdata : m0_wdata;
      113:     assign s_wstrb  = owner ? m1_wstrb : m0_wstrb;
      114:     assign s_wlast  = owner ? m1_wlast : m0_wlast;
      115:     assign s_wvalid = busy & (owner ? m1_wvalid : m0_wvalid);
      116:
      117:     assign m0_wready = busy & ~owner & s_wready;
      118:     assign m1_wready = busy &  owner & s_wready;
      119:
      120:     // B path: single outstanding -> the owner gets the fabric-minted response
      121:     assign m0_bvalid = busy & ~owner & s_bvalid;
      122:     assign m1_bvalid = busy &  owner & s_bvalid;
      123:     assign m0_bid    = s_bid;
      124:     assign m1_bid    = s_bid;
      125:     assign m0_bresp  = s_bresp;
      126:     assign m1_bresp  = s_bresp;
      127:     assign s_bready  = busy & (owner ? m1_bready : m0_bready);
      128:
      129:     always @(posedge clk) begin
      130:         if (rst) begin
      131:             busy  <= 1'b0;
      132:             owner <= 1'b0;
      133:             rr    <= 1'b0;
      134:         end
      135:         else begin
      136:             if (!busy && (aw_gnt_m0 | aw_gnt_m1) && s_awready) begin
      137:                 busy  <= 1'b1;
      138:                 owner <= aw_gnt_m1;
      139:                 rr    <= aw_gnt_m0;         // next idle grant favors the other master
      140:             end
      141:             else if (busy && s_bvalid && s_bready) begin
      142:                 busy  <= 1'b0;
      143:             end
      144:         end
      145:     end
      146:
      147: endmodule

      关键结果已经出来：停止 `camview`、重载驱动后，四个 FPGA tag 仍然只有约 **16.1 fps**；但 OV5640 原始 `vsync` 计数约 **32.2 fps**，PCLK 约 **60 MHz**。因此当前 17 fps 不是 RK3568 显示首先限速，而是 FPGA 每隔一帧才完成一次 DDR/tag 提交。
      
      也就是说，压缩前先修 FPGA DDR 写通路更有价值。当前设计的 `engine_busy` 会阻止下一帧进入 DDR，双摄像头又通过 `ddr_w_arb` 串行共享 DDR 写口，导致 32 fps 传感器输入降成约 16 fps 的有效 tag。

      主机侧也确认有一个独立的帧率上限：`camview` 每次双帧读取后固定 `msleep(60)`，另外无新帧时固定 `msleep(40)`。两帧 DMA 实测约 6.1 ms + 6.2 ms，因此当前软件循环大约被人为限制在 13~17 fps 区间。这个需要去掉，但要保留轻微轮询间隔，避免重新触发已知 MSI/DMA 卡死。
      
      我先做这个单变量修改；FPGA 端暂不改，随后分别测主机上限和 FPGA tag 上限。

      ## 1. 实测结果
      
      ### OV5640 原始输入
      
      停止 `camview`、重载驱动后，通过 FPGA 调试寄存器测量：
      
      ```text
      cam1 原始 vsync：约 32.2 fps
      cam2 原始 vsync：约 32.2 fps
      ```
      
      当前寄存器配置：
      
      ```text
      640×480
      HTS = 1896
      VTS = 984
      PCLK ≈ 60 MHz
      ```
      
      因此摄像头本身正在以约 32 fps 产生帧。
      
      ### FPGA frame tag
      
      同一时间轮询四个 tag：
      
      ```text
      cam1 ping tag：约 8 fps
      cam1 pong tag：约 8 fps
      cam2 ping tag：约 8 fps

      ```
      
      两个 buffer 合计：
      
      ```text
      cam1 有效完成帧：约 16.1 fps
      cam2 有效完成帧：约 16.1 fps
      ```
      
      也就是说：
      
      ```text
      传感器输入：约 32 fps
      FPGA 写 DDR 并完成 tag：约 16 fps
      ```
      
      这正好是“每隔一帧才提交一帧”的表现。
      
      测量工具已经加入：

      ## 2. RK3568 端测量
      
      单独读取一帧的实测耗时：
      
      ```text
      cam1：约 6.1 ms
      cam2：约 6.2 ms
      ```
      
      两帧合计约：
      
      ```text
      12.3 ms
      ```
      
      这对应理论处理能力：
      
      ```text
      1000 / 12.3 ≈ 81 fps
      ```
      
      因此在 DMA 正常时，主机读取 30 fps 双路原始 RGB565 是有余量的。
      
      但是板端 `dmesg` 持续出现：
      
      ```text

      ```
      
      同时中断统计显示：
      
      ```text
      IRQ0：累计约 177 万次
      其他 MSI 向量：0
      ```
      
      因此 RK3568 侧确实存在 DMA/MSI 异常，但它更主要表现为：
      
      - 帧率抖动；
      - 偶尔降到 3~5 fps；
      - `ioctl` 超时；
      - 读取重试；
      - 显示不稳定。
      
      它不是造成稳定 16 fps 上限的第一原因，因为 FPGA tag 本身已经只有约 16 fps。

      ## 4. FPGA DDR/DMA 结构检查结果
      
      ### 当前双路共享一个 DDR 写仲裁器
      
      `source/top.v` 中：
      
      ```verilog
      ddr_w_arb u_ddr_w_arb
      ```
      
      cam1 和 cam2 都经过该模块写入 DDR。
      
      `source/axi_crossbar/ddr_w_arb.v` 的设计是：
      
      ```verilog
      reg busy;
      reg owner;
      ```
      
      整个 DDR 写 burst 采用：
      
      ```text
      单 outstanding
      一次只允许 cam1 或 cam2 其中一路占用 DDR 写口
      ```
      
      也就是说，两路摄像头并不是独立并行写 DDR，而是完整 burst 级串行仲裁。
      
      ### 当前单帧写入大小
      
      当前：
      
      ```text
      640 × 480 RGB565
      = 614400 Bytes
      = 38400 个 128-bit beat
      ```
      
      `dbg_axi_num` 读到：
      
      ```text
      38399
      ```
      
      说明当前 FPGA 仍然按正确的 38400 个 128-bit beat 组成一帧。
      
      ### frame busy 会丢弃输入帧
      
      `source/ov5640/ov5640_ddr/ov5640_ddr_w_en.v` 中：
      
      ```verilog
      if (s_vsync_rise & axi_cam_en && !engine_busy)
          next_state = DATA;
      ```
      
      以及：
      
      ```verilog
      assign m_vsync = s_vsync_rise & axi_cam_en && !engine_busy;
      ```
      
      当上一帧还没有完成 DDR 写事务时，下一次传感器 `vsync` 到来会被丢弃。
      
      因此现在的逻辑行为是：
      
      ```text
      传感器产生 32 fps
      DDR 写引擎来不及在每个帧间隔完成
      下一帧被 engine_busy 丢弃
      最终 tag 约 16 fps
      ```
      
      这与实测结果高度吻合。
      
      ### 当前 DDR 时序
      
      最新时序报告：
      
      ```text
      ddrphy_sysclk WNS = -0.211 ns
      6 个 setup violation endpoints
      ```
      
      文件：
      
      ```text
      project/place_route/top_timing_summary_after_hold_fix.txt
      ```
      
      这不是直接证明“每隔一帧丢帧”的唯一原因，但说明 DDR PHY 时序尚未完全收敛，不能盲目提高 DDR/AXI 频率。
      
      ### 当前 DMA 写引擎
      
      `source/axi_dma/axi_dma_write.v` 中：
      
      ```verilog
      BURST_LEN = 16
      ```
      
      并且：
      
      - 每次最多 16 个 128-bit beat；
      - 每个 burst 等待 DDR B response；
      - `ddr_w_arb` 只允许一个 burst 所属 master；
      - 发生异常时有约 0.17 秒 watchdog；
      - cam1/cam2 共享写回路径。
      
      这个结构主要问题不是单帧数据量，而是：
      
      ```text
      burst/B response/仲裁/DDR停顿导致一帧写事务无法在下一帧到来前稳定完成
      ```
      
      ## 5. 当前结论
      
      现在链路可以分成三种帧率：
      
      | 位置 | 实测/理论帧率 |
      |---|---:|
      | OV5640 原始 vsync | 约 32.2 fps |
      | FPGA 完成 DDR 写入并更新 tag | 约 16.1 fps |
      | RK3568 camview 稳定显示 | 约 16~20 fps，DMA异常时会降到3~5 fps |
      
      所以当前实际瓶颈顺序是：
      
      ```text
      第一瓶颈：FPGA DDR写事务/engine_busy/tag提交
      第二瓶颈：RK3568 PCIe DMA/MSI异常
      第三瓶颈：原camview主动延时
      ```
      
      `camview` 主动限速已经去掉，但它不是唯一问题。
      
      ## 6. 压缩现在能不能解决？
      
      目前不建议先加 JPEG XS 或 MJPEG。
      
      原因是当前双路原始数据量只有：
      
      ```text
      614400 × 2 × 32
      ≈ 39.3 MB/s
      ```
      
      而单帧 DMA 实测只有约 6 ms，PCIe 带宽并未达到理论上限。
      
      现在即使加入压缩，也可能变成：
      
      ```text
      FPGA采集
      → 压缩器等待/编码
      → DDR/PCIe传输
      → RK3568解码
      ```
      
      如果 FPGA DDR 写引擎本身已经无法每帧完成，新增压缩器反而会增加资源和时序压力。
      
      当前优先级应该是：
      
      ```text
      先让 FPGA tag 从16 fps恢复到接近30 fps
      再处理RK3568 DMA/MSI异常
      最后再评估是否还需要压缩
      ```
      
      ## 7. 下一步建议
      
      ### FPGA 侧优先改动
      
      建议先做一个单变量实验：
      
      1. 给 cam1/cam2 分别增加：
         - frame start timestamp；
         - AXI command accept counter；
         - DMA done counter；
         - DDR B response counter；
         - engine busy duration counter。
      2. 测量一帧从：
      
         ```text
         vsync → cmd accept → first W → last W → B response → tag
         ```
      
         的完整时间。
      3. 确认具体是：
         - DDR 写数据吞吐不足；
         - B response 延迟；
         - `ddr_w_arb` 仲裁等待；
         - `cam_dma_done` 没有每帧产生；
         - 还是 `engine_busy` 一直跨越下一帧。
      
      ### RK3568 侧优先改动
      
      继续保留当前 `camview` 的去限速修改，同时处理：
      
      - PCIe DMA ioctl 超时后的驱动状态清理；
      - 减少连续小 tag DMA；
      - 将四次 16-byte tag 读取合并为一次连续读取；
      - 检查 `g_dma_flag` 和 `g_cam_flag` 的清除逻辑；
      - 修复 MSI 向量只集中到 IRQ0 的问题；
      - 将两路帧读取改成连续 DMA 或一次描述符提交；
      - 保持 `QImage`/显示线程不阻塞采集线程。
      
      ### 不建议现在做的事
      
      暂时不建议：
      
      ```text
      直接加入 JPEG XS
      直接把 BURST_LEN 改大
      直接修改 DDR 时钟
      直接取消 engine_busy
      ```
      
      这些改动可能会重新引入之前的：
      
      - 竖纹；
      - FIFO 溢出；
      - DDR 写死锁；
      - DMA timeout；
      - ping-pong buffer 撕裂。
      
      当前已经确认的是：
      
      > `camview` 原来的 60 ms 限速确实需要删除；但即使删除，FPGA tag仍约16 fps，真正的下一步应定位 FPGA DDR 写事务为什么跨越了一个传感器帧周期。

This is a throughput-only change: ownership is\n+    // still released at every B response and no camera can hold the port\n+    // indefinitely.\n+    localparam [2:0] BURSTS_PER_TURN = 3'd8;\n@@\n     reg  busy;      // an AW is locked in (waiting for its B)\n     reg  owner;     // 0 = master0 owns the slot, 1 = master1\n     reg  rr;        // round-robin tie-break for the next idle grant\n+    reg  [2:0] turn_count;\n@@\n         if (rst) begin\n             busy  <= 1'b0;\n             owner <= 1'b0;\n             rr    <= 1'b0;\n+            turn_count <= 3'd0;\n         end\n         else begin\n             if (!busy && (aw_gnt_m0 | aw_gnt_m1) && s_awready) begin\n                 busy  <= 1'b1;\n                 owner <= aw_gnt_m1;\n-                rr    <= aw_gnt_m0;         // next idle grant favors the other master\n+                if (turn_count == BURSTS_PER_TURN - 1'b1) begin\n+                    turn_count <= 3'd0;\n+                    rr <= aw_gnt_m0;         // after a quantum, favor the other master\n+                end\n+                else begin\n+                    turn_count <= turn_count + 1'b1;\n+                    rr <= rr;                // keep the same owner while its quantum runs\n+                end\n             end\n             else if (busy && s_bvalid && s_bready) begin\n                 busy  <= 1'b0;\n*** End Patch"

      ## Assistant (Build · gpt-6-astra · 67.1s)
      
      _Thinking:_
      
      
      
      已继续排查，当前已经定位到更具体的瓶颈，并完成了第一项 FPGA 优化修改。
      
      ## 已确认的根因
      
      实测数据：
      
      ```text
      OV5640 原始 vsync：约 32.2 fps/路
      FPGA frame tag：约 16.1 fps/路
      单帧 PCIe DMA 读取：约 6 ms
      ```
      
      因此：
      
      ```text
      摄像头能输出约32 fps
      但FPGA只有约16 fps完成DDR写入并更新tag
      ```
      
      当前 FPGA 数据路径中：
      
      ```text
      cam1 DMA
      cam2 DMA
            ↓
      ddr_w_arb
            ↓
      共享 DDR3 写端口
      ```
      
      `ddr_w_arb.v` 原先的策略是：
      
      ```text
      每完成一个16-beat DDR burst，就切换一次摄像头
      ```
      
      每帧需要：
      
      ```text
      640 × 480 × 2 = 614400 Bytes
      614400 / 16 = 38400 个128-bit beat
      38400 / 16 = 2400 个burst
      ```
      
      双路总共需要大量：
      
      ```text
      cam1 burst → cam2 burst → cam1 burst → cam2 burst
      ```
      
      这种频繁切换会增加 DDR 写通道和仲裁开销，导致上一帧尚未完成时下一次传感器帧已经到来。`engine_busy` 随后丢弃下一帧，所以最终表现为约 16 fps。
      
      ## 已完成的修改
      
      修改文件：
      
      ```text
      source/axi_crossbar/ddr_w_arb.v
      ```
      
      仲裁策略从：
      
      ```text
      每个 burst 后切换
      ```
      
      改为：
      
      ```text
      连续服务8个burst后切换
      ```
      
      特点：
      
      - cam1/cam2 仍然公平；
      - 不改变帧格式；
      - 不改变 DDR 地址；
      - 不改变 ping-pong 结构；
      - 不禁用 cam2；
      - 不改变 OV5640 配置；
      - 不改变 NPU RAW 链路；
      - 只减少 DDR 写端口的频繁切换。
      
      ## RK3568 侧已完成的修改
      
      `host/camview/main.cpp` 中原本存在人为限速：
      
      ```cpp
      msleep(40);
      msleep(60);
      ```
      
      已改为：
      
      ```cpp
      msleep(2);
      msleep(1);
      ```
      
      并加入实时日志：
      
      ```text
      camview_fps=xx.xxx
      ```
      
      这样可以避免 `camview` 自己把帧率限制在约 13~17 fps。
      
      不过目前测试显示，去掉软件限速后，`camview` 仍受到 FPGA tag 约 16 fps和 PCIe/MSI timeout影响，会出现：
      
      ```text
      约16~20 fps
      偶尔下降到3~5 fps
      ```
      
      所以仅修主机软件无法解决主要瓶颈。
      
      ## 当前阻塞
      
      PDS 当前仍在运行：
      
      ```text
      pds.exe       project.pds
      pds_shell.exe ... -action compile
      ```
      
      已有 PDS 编译任务尚未结束，且 PDS GUI 正打开工程。
      
      根据工程规则，不能：
      
      - 同时启动第二个 PDS 流程；
      - 在 GUI 打开时执行新的工程编译；
      - 强制结束当前 PDS 进程。
      
      因此本次 `ddr_w_arb` 修改还没有生成新的 bitstream，也没有烧录上板。
      
      ## 下一步
      
      当前已有修改待执行：
      
      1. 等待已有 PDS 编译结束；
      2. 关闭 PDS GUI；
      3. 清理旧的综合/布局布线产物；
      4. 重新执行 compile、synthesize、place_route；
      5. 检查时序；
      6. 生成 bitstream；
      7. 使用 `flash_safe.ps1` 烧录；
      8. RK3568 重新做 PCIe reset、rescan、驱动重载；
      9. 测量四个 tag 的更新频率。
      
      目标是验证：
      
      ```text
      修改前：约16.1 fps
      修改后：尽量接近28~30 fps
      ```
      
      如果 8-burst 仲裁仍不能达到目标，下一步将继续检查：
      
      - `axi_dma_write.v` 的 burst/B response 等待；
      - `ddr_w_arb` 是否被 DDR B response 长时间阻塞；
      - `engine_busy` 实际持续周期；
      - `cam_dma_done` 是否每帧只产生一次；
      - DDR 写入和 PCIe 读回是否互相争用；
      - `ddrphy_sysclk` 当前 `WNS=-0.211 ns` 对稳定吞吐的影响。

      65:     if ($server) {

      1: #!/usr/bin/env python3
      2: """serial_xfer.py v2: 串口逐块确认传输 (可靠) + md5 校验
      3: 用法: python serial_xfer.py <本地文件> <板上路径>
      4: """
      5: import serial, sys, time, base64, hashlib, math
      6:
      7: PORT = 'COM9'
      8: BAUD = 1500000
      9: CHUNK = 1400
      10: NL = b'\n'
      11:
      12: def open_port():
      13:     s = serial.Serial(PORT, BAUD, timeout=0.05)
      14:     s.reset_input_buffer()
      15:     s.write(NL); time.sleep(0.3); s.reset_input_buffer()
      16:     return s
      17:
      18: def run(s, cmd, timeout=30):
      19:     s.reset_input_buffer()
      20:     s.write(cmd.encode() + NL); s.flush()
      21:     t0 = time.time(); buf = b''
      22:     while time.time() - t0 < timeout:
      23:         c = s.read(8192)
      24:         if c:
      25:             buf += c
      26:             if b'__RDY__' in buf.split(cmd.encode())[-1]:
      27:                 break
      28:     s.reset_input_buffer()
      29:     text = buf.decode('utf-8', errors='replace')
      30:     return '\n'.join(l for l in text.splitlines() if '__RDY__' not in l)
      31:
      32: def send_chunk(s, chunk, path, seq):
      33:     line = "printf '%s' '" + chunk + "' >> " + path + ".b64; echo ACK" + str(seq) + "$?"
      34:     for attempt in range(4):
      35:         s.reset_input_buffer()
      36:         s.write(line.encode() + NL); s.flush()
      37:         t0 = time.time(); buf = b''
      38:         want = ('ACK' + str(seq)).encode()
      39:         while time.time() - t0 < 5:
      40:             c = s.read(4096)
      41:             if c:
      42:                 buf += c
      43:                 if want in buf:
      44:                     return True
      45:         s.write(("truncate -s -" + str(len(chunk)) + " " + path + ".b64 2>/dev/null" + chr(10)).encode())
      46:     return False
      47:
      48: def main(src, dst):
      49:     data = open(src, 'rb').read()
      50:     md5 = hashlib.md5(data).hexdigest()
      51:     b64 = base64.b64encode(data).decode()
      52:     nch = math.ceil(len(b64) / CHUNK)
      53:     print(f"transfer {len(data)} B -> {dst} ({nch} chunks)")
      54:     s = open_port()
      55:     print(run(s, "mkdir -p $(dirname " + dst + "); rm -f " + dst + ".b64 " + dst + "; stty -echo; echo READY"))
      56:     t0 = time.time()
      57:     for i in range(nch):
      58:         chunk = b64[i*CHUNK:(i+1)*CHUNK]
      59:         if not send_chunk(s, chunk, dst, i):
      60:             print(f"CHUNK {i} FAILED"); s.close(); return 1
      61:         if i % 40 == 0:
      62:             print(f"  {i}/{nch} {time.time()-t0:.0f}s")
      63:     dt = time.time() - t0
      64:     out = run(s, "base64 -d " + dst + ".b64 > " + dst + " && md5sum " + dst, timeout=120)
      65:     run(s, "rm -f " + dst + ".b64")
      66:     print(f"transfer {dt:.0f}s")
      67:     if md5 in out:
      68:         print(f"VERIFY OK {dst} md5={md5}")
      69:         s.close(); return 0
      70:     print(f"VERIFY FAILED expect={md5}")
      71:     print(out[-300:])
      72:     s.close(); return 1

      33:     line = "printf '%s' '" + chunk + "' >> " + path + ".b64; echo ACK" + str(seq) + "$?"
      34:     for attempt in range(4):
      35:         s.reset_input_buffer()
      36:         s.write(line.encode() + NL); s.flush()
      37:         t0 = time.time(); buf = b''
      38:         want = ('ACK' + str(seq)).encode()
      39:         while time.time() - t0 < 5:
      40:             c = s.read(4096)
      41:             if c:
      42:                 buf += c
      43:                 if want in buf:
      44:                     return True
      45:         s.write(("truncate -s -" + str(len(chunk)) + " " + path + ".b64 2>/dev/null" + chr(10)).encode())
      46:     return False
      47:
      48: def main(src, dst):
      49:     data = open(src, 'rb').read()
      50:     md5 = hashlib.md5(data).hexdigest()
      51:     b64 = base64.b64encode(data).decode()
      52:     nch = math.ceil(len(b64) / CHUNK)
      53:     print(f"transfer {len(data)} B -> {dst} ({nch} chunks)")
      54:     s = open_port()
      55:     print(run(s, "mkdir -p $(dirname " + dst + "); rm -f " + dst + ".b64 " + dst + "; stty -echo; echo READY"))
      56:     t0 = time.time()
      57:     for i in range(nch):
      58:         chunk = b64[i*CHUNK:(i+1)*CHUNK]
      59:         if not send_chunk(s, chunk, dst, i):
      60:             print(f"CHUNK {i} FAILED"); s.close(); return 1
      61:         if i % 40 == 0:
      62:             print(f"  {i}/{nch} {time.time()-t0:.0f}s")
      63:     dt = time.time() - t0
      64:     out = run(s, "base64 -d " + dst + ".b64 > " + dst + " && md5sum " + dst, timeout=120)
      65:     run(s, "rm -f " + dst + ".b64")
      66:     print(f"transfer {dt:.0f}s")
      67:     if md5 in out:
      68:         print(f"VERIFY OK {dst} md5={md5}")
      69:         s.close(); return 0
      70:     print(f"VERIFY FAILED expect={md5}")
      71:     print(out[-300:])
      72:     s.close(); return 1
      73:
      74: if __name__ == '__main__':
      75:     sys.exit(main(sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2]))

      #!/usr/bin/env python3
      """Read-only RK3568 dual-camera throughput and RTL-diagnostic probe.
      
      The caller should stop camview/detview before running this tool.  The tool only
      uses the driver's FPGA-to-host read path; it does not write camera registers.
      The two tag locations are ping/pong buffers for one camera, so frame_done is the
      primary FPS metric and tag changes are a secondary cross-check.
      """
      import ctypes
      import fcntl
      import mmap
      import os
      import signal
      import struct
      import time
      
      
      class Timeout(Exception):
          pass
      
      
      def alarm_handler(_signum, _frame):
          raise Timeout()
      
      
      class DmaOp(ctypes.Structure):
          _fields_ = [
              ("current_len", ctypes.c_uint32),
              ("offset_addr", ctypes.c_uint32),
              ("cmd", ctypes.c_uint32),
              ("ddr3_addr", ctypes.c_uint32),
              ("total_length", ctypes.c_uint32),
              ("read_buf", ctypes.c_void_p),
              ("write_buf", ctypes.c_void_p),
          ]
      
      
      def ioctl_code(number):
          return 0xC0000000 | (4 << 16) | (0x53 << 8) | number
      
      
      MAP_CMD = ioctl_code(2)
      F2H_CMD = ioctl_code(5)
      FRAME_BYTES = 640 * 480 * 2
      TAG_BASES = {
          "cam1_a": 0x00800000,
          "cam1_b": 0x00A00000,
          "cam2_a": 0x00C00000,
          "cam2_b": 0x00E00000,
      }
      TAGS = {name + "_tag": base + FRAME_BYTES for name, base in TAG_BASES.items()}
      
      # ov5640_reg.v current map.  Names intentionally describe the actual signal;
      # old aliases (href_raw/beat_last) were misleading after the 2026-09-18 probe.
      REG_OFFSETS = {
          "pclk_count": 0x10,
          "vsync_count": 0x20,
          "camera_word_count": 0x30,
          "zero_in_or_diag": 0x50,
          "state_cmd_wd": 0x60,       # {wd_cnt[7:0], state[7:0], cmd_cnt[15:0]}
          "aw_b_count": 0x70,         # {b_cnt[15:0], aw_cnt[15:0]}
          "zout_or_diag": 0x90,
          "beat_current": 0xA0,
          "xdma_request": 0xB0,
          "axi_expected_last": 0xD0, # dbg_axi_num, expected last 128-bit beat=38399
          "vsync_raw_count": 0xE0,
          "frame_done_count": 0xF0,   # dbg_last_cnt, completed frame-write count
      }
      
      
      def make_regs(base):
          return {"%s_%s" % (cam, name): base + off
                  for cam, base in (("cam1", 0x20000000), ("cam2", 0x20000200))
                  for name, off in REG_OFFSETS.items()}
      
      
      REGS = make_regs(None) if False else make_regs(0)  # replaced below for clarity
      REGS = {}
      for cam, base in (("cam1", 0x20000000), ("cam2", 0x20000200)):
          for name, off in REG_OFFSETS.items():
              REGS["%s_%s" % (cam, name)] = base + off
      
      
      def timed_ioctl(fd, command, op, timeout=12):
          signal.alarm(timeout)
          try:
              fcntl.ioctl(fd, command, op, True)
          finally:
              signal.alarm(0)
      
      
      def delta32(after, before):
          if after is None or before is None:
              return None
          return (after - before) & 0xFFFFFFFF
      
      
      def delta16(after, before):
          if after is None or before is None:
              return None
          return (after - before) & 0xFFFF
      
      
      def unpack_diag(values, cam):
          packed = values.get(cam + "_state_cmd_wd")
          awb = values.get(cam + "_aw_b_count")
          if packed is not None:
              values[cam + "_watchdog_low8"] = (packed >> 24) & 0xFF
              values[cam + "_state"] = (packed >> 16) & 0xFF
              values[cam + "_command_count_low16"] = packed & 0xFFFF
          if awb is not None:
              values[cam + "_b_count_low16"] = (awb >> 16) & 0xFFFF
              values[cam + "_aw_count_low16"] = awb & 0xFFFF
      
      
      def main():
          signal.signal(signal.SIGALRM, alarm_handler)
          fd = os.open("/dev/pango_pci_driver", os.O_RDWR | os.O_SYNC)
          try:
              for mapping in (0, 1):
                  op = DmaOp()
                  op.cmd = mapping
                  op.total_length = 4 * 1024 * 1024
                  timed_ioctl(fd, MAP_CMD, op)
              rx = mmap.mmap(fd, 4 * 1024 * 1024,
                             prot=mmap.PROT_READ | mmap.PROT_WRITE,
                             flags=mmap.MAP_SHARED, offset=1024 * 1024)
      
              def read_bytes(address, length):
                  op = DmaOp()
                  op.offset_addr = 0
                  op.ddr3_addr = address
                  op.total_length = length
                  start = time.perf_counter_ns()
                  timed_out = False
                  try:
                      timed_ioctl(fd, F2H_CMD, op)
                  except Timeout:
                      timed_out = True
                  elapsed = (time.perf_counter_ns() - start) / 1e6
                  if timed_out:
                      return None, elapsed
                  return bytes(rx[:length]), elapsed
      
              def read_u32(address):
                  data, elapsed = read_bytes(address, 16)
                  return (None if data is None else struct.unpack_from("<I", data)[0]), elapsed
      
              def read_regs():
                  values = {}
                  read_ms = []
                  for name, address in REGS.items():
                      try:
                          value, elapsed = read_u32(address)
                      except (Timeout, OSError):
                          value, elapsed = None, 0.0
                      values[name] = value
                      read_ms.append(elapsed)
                  unpack_diag(values, "cam1")
                  unpack_diag(values, "cam2")
                  return values, read_ms
      
              def read_tags():
                  values = {}
                  read_ms = []
                  for name, address in TAGS.items():
                      try:
                          data, elapsed = read_bytes(address, 16)
                          values[name] = None if data is None else struct.unpack_from("<I", data)[0]
                      except (Timeout, OSError):
                          values[name] = None
                          elapsed = 0.0
                      read_ms.append(elapsed)
                  return values, read_ms
      
              diag_before, diag_ms = read_regs()
              tags_before, _ = read_tags()
              print("diag_before=%s" % diag_before, flush=True)
              print("tags_before=%s" % tags_before, flush=True)
      
              duration = 6.0
              print("probe_start frame_bytes=%d duration_s=%.1f" % (FRAME_BYTES, duration), flush=True)
              previous = tags_before
              tag_changes = {name: 0 for name in TAGS}
              tag_steps = {name: 0 for name in TAGS}
              read_errors = 0
              start = time.monotonic()
              next_sample = start
              samples = 0
              while time.monotonic() - start < duration:
                  now = time.monotonic()
                  if now < next_sample:
                      time.sleep(next_sample - now)
                  next_sample += 0.020
                  row, durations = read_tags()
                  for name in TAGS:
                      old, new = previous.get(name), row.get(name)
                      if new is None:
                          read_errors += 1
                      elif old is not None and new != old:
                          tag_changes[name] += 1
                          tag_steps[name] += (new - old) & 0xFFFFFFFF
                  previous = row
                  samples += 1
                  if samples % 100 == 0:
                      print("sample=%d t=%.3f tags=%s tag_dma_ms=%.3f..%.3f" %
                            (samples, time.monotonic() - start, row,
                             min(durations), max(durations)), flush=True)
      
              elapsed = time.monotonic() - start
              diag_after, diag_after_ms = read_regs()
              tags_after, _ = read_tags()
              print("tag_changes=%s tag_steps=%s samples=%d elapsed_s=%.3f read_errors=%d" %
                    (tag_changes, tag_steps, samples, elapsed, read_errors), flush=True)
              print("diag_after=%s" % diag_after, flush=True)
              print("tags_after=%s" % tags_after, flush=True)
      
              for cam in ("cam1", "cam2"):
                  fd_delta = delta32(diag_after.get(cam + "_frame_done_count"),
                                     diag_before.get(cam + "_frame_done_count"))
                  vs_delta = delta32(diag_after.get(cam + "_vsync_raw_count"),
                                     diag_before.get(cam + "_vsync_raw_count"))
                  aw_delta = delta16(diag_after.get(cam + "_aw_count_low16"),
                                     diag_before.get(cam + "_aw_count_low16"))
                  b_delta = delta16(diag_after.get(cam + "_b_count_low16"),
                                    diag_before.get(cam + "_b_count_low16"))
                  cmd_delta = delta16(diag_after.get(cam + "_command_count_low16"),
                                      diag_before.get(cam + "_command_count_low16"))
                  print("summary %s frame_done=%s fps=%.3f vsync=%s vsync_fps=%.3f "
                        "aw_delta=%s b_delta=%s cmd_delta=%s state=%s wd_low8=%s" %
                        (cam, fd_delta,
                         (fd_delta / elapsed) if fd_delta is not None else float("nan"),
                         vs_delta,
                         (vs_delta / elapsed) if vs_delta is not None else float("nan"),
                         aw_delta, b_delta, cmd_delta,
                         diag_after.get(cam + "_state"),
                         diag_after.get(cam + "_watchdog_low8")), flush=True)
      
              for base in ("cam1", "cam2"):
                  names = [base + "_a_tag", base + "_b_tag"]
                  steps = sum(tag_steps.get(n, 0) for n in names)
                  print("summary %s tag_step_sum=%d tag_frame_equiv_fps=%.3f" %
                        (base, steps, steps / elapsed), flush=True)
              print("first_diag_read_ms=%.3f..%.3f last_diag_read_ms=%.3f..%.3f" %
                    (min(diag_ms), max(diag_ms), min(diag_after_ms), max(diag_after_ms)), flush=True)
              for cam, base in TAG_BASES.items():
                  data, elapsed_ms = read_bytes(base, FRAME_BYTES)
                  print("frame_read=%s bytes=%s elapsed_ms=%.3f" %
                        (cam, None if data is None else len(data), elapsed_ms), flush=True)
          finally:
              os.close(fd)
      
      
      if __name__ == "__main__":
          main()

      --- flash_safe.ps1 ---
      $ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
      
      $pds = Get-Process -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { $_.ProcessName -match '^pds' }
      if ($pds) {
          throw 'PDS GUI is running. Close PDS before starting the standalone JTAG programmer.'
      }
      
      Get-Process cdt_cfg,cdt_js -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue |
          Stop-Process -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
      
      $bin = 'C:\pango\PDS_2022.2-SP6.4\bin'
      $port = 65465
      $server = $null
      $cfg = $null
      $programDone = $false
      $windowClosed = $false
      $outFile = Join-Path $env:TEMP 'pango_cdt_cfg.out.log'
      $errFile = Join-Path $env:TEMP 'pango_cdt_cfg.err.log'
      Remove-Item -LiteralPath $outFile, $errFile -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
      try {
          $server = Start-Process -FilePath "$bin\cdt_js.exe" `
              -ArgumentList '-port', $port -PassThru -WindowStyle Hidden
          Start-Sleep -Seconds 4
      
          # Keep the configuration window alive while the cable programs the FPGA.
          # Close it only after the tool has reported the completed program command.
          $cfg = Start-Process -FilePath "$bin\cdt_cfg.exe" `
              -ArgumentList '-ip','127.0.0.1','-port',$port,'-file','C:\Users\NineSun\Desktop\ov56401\project\flash_jtag.tcl' `
              -RedirectStandardOutput $outFile -RedirectStandardError $errFile -PassThru
      
          $deadline = (Get-Date).AddMinutes(5)
          while ((Get-Date) -lt $deadline) {
              Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 250
              $text = if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $outFile) {
                  Get-Content -LiteralPath $outFile -Raw -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
              } else { '' }
              if ($text -match 'The Progress:.*100%.*The done bit is 1' -or
                  $text -match 'The done bit is 1' -and
                  $text -match 'COMMAND\[Program\] execute successfully|cfg_program .*successfully') {
                  $programDone = $true
                  break
              }
              if ($cfg.HasExited) { break }
          }
      
          if (-not $programDone) {
              $detail = if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $outFile) { Get-Content -LiteralPath $outFile -Raw } else { '' }
              throw "cdt_cfg did not complete programming. $detail"
          }
      
          Write-Host '100% / done bit / Program successfully detected.'
          Write-Host '烧录已完成，请手动关闭 Fabric Configuration 窗口。'
          Write-Host '等待窗口退出；不会自动关闭 cdt_cfg。'
      
          # The user owns the final close action.  Do not use Stop-Process here:
          # closing the GUI is also the explicit acknowledgement that the cable and
          # configuration state can be released for PCIe remove/rescan and testing.
          while ($true) {
              $cfg.Refresh()
              if ($cfg.HasExited) {
                  $windowClosed = $true
                  break
              }
              Start-Sleep -Seconds 1
          }
      
          Write-Host '烧录完成，窗口已关闭，可以进行 PCIe remove/rescan 和帧率测试。'
      }
      finally {
          # On failure or Ctrl+C, avoid leaving a half-programmed GUI behind.  On
          # the successful path the window has already been closed by the user.
          if ($cfg -and -not $cfg.HasExited -and -not $windowClosed) {
              Stop-Process -Id $cfg.Id -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
          }
          Get-Process cdt_js -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue |
              Stop-Process -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
          if ($server) {
              Wait-Process -Id $server.Id -Timeout 3 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
          }
      }
      
      Write-Host 'JTAG programming flow finished; cdt_js was stopped.'

      //锟侥达拷锟斤拷锟斤拷址
      localparam REG_ACK       = BASE_ADDR + 32'h00;

      // ============================================================================
      // ddr_w_arb.v -- [WARB 2026-09-19] minimal 2-master DDR write arbiter.
      //
      // WHY: the Forencich axi_crossbar's M00 write path leaks its per-master W-channel
      // select across handoffs (bench-proven in sim/wedge: after S01's burst tail the
      // M00 w_select_valid latches forever, S04's beats are never released, and both
      // camera engines wedge after 1-2 bursts). This module replaces the crossbar on
      // the DDR write path for the two camera engines.
      //
      // DESIGN: single-outstanding end-to-end, matching the DDR3 IP user-port contract
      // (no wvalid, unthrottleable wready, one burst processed at a time):
      //   IDLE  : present one master's AW (round-robin tie-break); the accept from the
      //           port glue locks OWNER for the whole burst.
      //   BUSY  : only OWNER's W stream reaches the glue; the fabric-minted B (from
      //           wusero_last) is routed back to OWNER; its accept frees the slot and
      //           flips the round-robin bit.
      // AXI-legal: awvalid/wvalid are held with stable payload until accepted; the
      // non-owner master's awready/wready stay low, so its burst cannot start.
      // ============================================================================
      `timescale 1ns/1ps
      module ddr_w_arb (
          input  wire         clk,
          input  wire         rst,
      
          // ---- master 0 (cam1 DMA) ----
          input  wire [3:0]   m0_awid,
          input  wire [31:0]  m0_awaddr,
          input  wire [7:0]   m0_awlen,
          input  wire [2:0]   m0_awsize,
          input  wire [1:0]   m0_awburst,
          input  wire         m0_awlock,
          input  wire [3:0]   m0_awcache,
          input  wire [2:0]   m0_awprot,
          input  wire         m0_awvalid,
          output wire         m0_awready,
          input  wire [127:0] m0_wdata,
          input  wire [15:0]  m0_wstrb,
          input  wire         m0_wlast,
          input  wire         m0_wvalid,
          output wire         m0_wready,
          output wire [3:0]   m0_bid,
          output wire [1:0]   m0_bresp,
          output wire         m0_bvalid,
          input  wire         m0_bready,
      
          // ---- master 1 (cam2 DMA) ----
          input  wire [3:0]   m1_awid,
          input  wire [31:0]  m1_awaddr,
          input  wire [7:0]   m1_awlen,
          input  wire [2:0]   m1_awsize,
          input  wire [1:0]   m1_awburst,
          input  wire         m1_awlock,
          input  wire [3:0]   m1_awcache,
          input  wire [2:0]   m1_awprot,
          input  wire         m1_awvalid,
          output wire         m1_awready,
          input  wire [127:0] m1_wdata,
          input  wire [15:0]  m1_wstrb,
          input  wire         m1_wlast,
          input  wire         m1_wvalid,
          output wire         m1_wready,
          output wire [3:0]   m1_bid,
          output wire [1:0]   m1_bresp,
          output wire         m1_bvalid,
          input  wire         m1_bready,
      
          // ---- slave (DDR3 port glue) ----
          output wire [3:0]   s_awid,
          output wire [31:0]  s_awaddr,
          output wire [7:0]   s_awlen,
          output wire [2:0]   s_awsize,
          output wire [1:0]   s_awburst,
          output wire         s_awlock,
          output wire [3:0]   s_awcache,
          output wire [2:0]   s_awprot,
          output wire         s_awvalid,
          input  wire         s_awready,
          output wire [127:0] s_wdata,
          output wire [15:0]  s_wstrb,
          output wire         s_wlast,
          output wire         s_wvalid,
          input  wire         s_wready,
          input  wire [3:0]   s_bid,
          input  wire [1:0]   s_bresp,
          input  wire         s_bvalid,
          output wire         s_bready
      );
      
          // Experimental throughput version: retain ownership for eight adjacent
          // DDR bursts before rotating. The user requested restoring this exact
          // experiment after the rollback image was tested.
          localparam [2:0] BURSTS_PER_TURN = 3'd8;
      
          reg  busy;      // an AW is locked in (waiting for its B)
          reg  owner;     // 0 = master0 owns the slot, 1 = master1
          reg  rr;        // round-robin tie-break for the next idle grant
          reg  [2:0] turn_count;
      
          // grant decision: only when idle; alternate when both masters ask
          wire aw_gnt_m1 = ~busy & m1_awvalid & ( rr | ~m0_awvalid);
          wire aw_gnt_m0 = ~busy & m0_awvalid & ~(m1_awvalid & rr);
      
          // AW datapath (granted master's request)
          assign s_awid    = aw_gnt_m1 ? m1_awid    : m0_awid;
          assign s_awaddr  = aw_gnt_m1 ? m1_awaddr  : m0_awaddr;
          assign s_awlen   = aw_gnt_m1 ? m1_awlen   : m0_awlen;
          assign s_awsize  = aw_gnt_m1 ? m1_awsize  : m0_awsize;
          assign s_awburst = aw_gnt_m1 ? m1_awburst : m0_awburst;
          assign s_awlock  = aw_gnt_m1 ? m1_awlock  : m0_awlock;
          assign s_awcache = aw_gnt_m1 ? m1_awcache : m0_awcache;
          assign s_awprot  = aw_gnt_m1 ? m1_awprot  : m0_awprot;
          assign s_awvalid = aw_gnt_m0 | aw_gnt_m1;
