          // W datapath (only the owner's beats can flow)
          assign s_wdata  = owner ? m1_wdata : m0_wdata;
          assign s_wstrb  = owner ? m1_wstrb : m0_wstrb;
          assign s_wlast  = owner ? m1_wlast : m0_wlast;
          assign s_wvalid = busy & (owner ? m1_wvalid : m0_wvalid);
      
          assign m0_wready = busy & ~owner & s_wready;
          assign m1_wready = busy &  owner & s_wready;
      
          // B path: single outstanding -> the owner gets the fabric-minted response
          assign m0_bvalid = busy & ~owner & s_bvalid;
          assign m1_bvalid = busy &  owner & s_bvalid;
          assign m0_bid    = s_bid;
          assign m1_bid    = s_bid;
          assign m0_bresp  = s_bresp;
          assign m1_bresp  = s_bresp;
          assign s_bready  = busy & (owner ? m1_bready : m0_bready);
      
          always @(posedge clk) begin
              if (rst) begin
                  busy  <= 1'b0;
                  owner <= 1'b0;
                  rr    <= 1'b0;
                  turn_count <= 3'd0;
              end
              else begin
                  if (!busy && (aw_gnt_m0 | aw_gnt_m1) && s_awready) begin
                      busy  <= 1'b1;
                      owner <= aw_gnt_m1;
                      if (turn_count == BURSTS_PER_TURN - 1'b1) begin
                          turn_count <= 3'd0;
                          rr <= aw_gnt_m0;         // rotate after the eight-burst quantum
                      end
                      else begin
                          turn_count <= turn_count + 1'b1;
                          rr <= rr;                // keep the same owner during the quantum
                      end
                  end
                  else if (busy && s_bvalid && s_bready) begin
                      busy  <= 1'b0;
                  end
              end
          end
      
      endmodule

      module ov5640_ddr_w_en #(
          parameter DATA_WIDTH = 24
      )(

      localparam DATA = 2'b10;

      reg       s_vsync_rise;

          if(axi_rst)begin

          end

      module ov5640_ddr_w_ctrl #(

          parameter AXI_LEN_WIDTH  = 32,
          parameter AXI_DATA_WIDTH = 128,
          parameter CAM_DATA_LEN   = 172800 //1280*720*3/16
      )(
          input          axi_clk        ,

          output [AXI_ADDR_WIDTH-1 : 0]  axi_cmd_addr   /*synthesis PAP_MARK_DEBUG="1"*/,
          output [AXI_LEN_WIDTH-1 : 0]   axi_cmd_len    /*synthesis PAP_MARK_DEBUG="1"*/,
          output reg                     axi_cmd_valid  /*synthesis PAP_MARK_DEBUG="1"*/,

              end

                  curr_state <= next_state;

              else if(frame_done) last_cnt <= last_cnt + 32'd1;
          end
          assign dbg_last_cnt = last_cnt;

      509: /////////////////////////////////////// DDR3 AW/AR latch shims [AWFIX/ARFIX 2026-09-19] ///
      510: // Proper single-handshake adapters between the crossbar and the DDR3 IP.
      511: // The crossbar is acknowledged exactly when we latch a request; the request is
      512: // then HELD with stable payload until the IP accepts (AXI-legal, no retraction).
      513: // Single-outstanding end-to-end (no held request + write FIFO empty + no pending
      514: // B for AW; read FIFO empty for AR) also keeps the aw_sid/ar_sid ID rebuilds sane.
      515: // [STAGE 2026-09-19] The DDR3 IP's W channel is UNTHROTTLEABLE: it pulses
      516: // wready at its own pace and counts awlen+1 beats itself (see the IP's own
      517: // example_design -- there is no wvalid at all). Presenting an AW before its
      518: // beats are in the FIFO let the IP consume GHOST beats from an empty FIFO;
      519: // the real beats then stranded in the FIFO forever and blocked all later AWs
      520: // (the permanent M00 write wedge). Hold each latched AW until its ENTIRE
      521: // burst is staged in the FIFO, then present it: during IP consumption the
      522: // FIFO only drains, so every demanded beat is guaranteed present.
      523: wire aw_burst_fits   = (ddr_axi_awlen < (5'd16 - wr_water_level));
      524: wire aw_latch_now    = ddr_axi_awvalid && !ddr3_aw_v && !aw_hold_v
      525:                        && w_fifo_empty && aw_burst_fits && !ddr_axi_bvalid_int;
      526: wire ar_latch_now    = ddr_axi_arvalid && !ddr3_ar_v && ddr_axi_fifo_empty;
      527:
      528: reg              ddr3_aw_v, ddr3_ar_v;
      529: reg              aw_hold_v;
      530: reg [27:0]       ddr3_aw_addr, ddr3_ar_addr;
      531: reg [3:0]        ddr3_aw_len,  ddr3_ar_len;
      532: reg              ddr3_aw_ap,   ddr3_ar_ap;
      533: reg [AXI_ID_M_LEN-1:0] ddr3_aw_id, ddr3_ar_id;
      534:
      535: wire aw_stage_ok = (wr_water_level >= ({1'b0, ddr3_aw_len} + 5'd1)) && !w_fifo_empty;
      536:
      537: always @(posedge axi_clk) begin
      538:     if (axi_rst) begin
      539:         aw_hold_v <= 1'b0;
      540:         ddr3_aw_v <= 1'b0;
      541:     end
      542:     else begin
      543:         if (aw_latch_now) begin
      544:             aw_hold_v   <= 1'b1;
      545:             ddr3_aw_addr <= ddr_axi_awaddr[27:0];
      546:             ddr3_aw_len  <= ddr_axi_awlen;
      547:             ddr3_aw_ap   <= ddr_axi_awuser_ap;
      548:             ddr3_aw_id   <= ddr_axi_awuser_id;
      549:         end
      550:         if (aw_hold_v && !ddr3_aw_v && aw_stage_ok) begin
      551:             aw_hold_v <= 1'b0;
      552:             ddr3_aw_v <= 1'b1;
      553:         end
      554:         else if (ddr3_aw_v && ddr_axi_awready) begin
      555:             ddr3_aw_v <= 1'b0;
      556:         end
      557:     end
      558: end
      559: always @(posedge axi_clk) begin
      560:     if (axi_rst) ddr3_ar_v <= 1'b0;
      561:     else if (ar_latch_now)                       ddr3_ar_v <= 1'b1;
      562:     else if (ddr3_ar_v && ddr_axi_arready)       ddr3_ar_v <= 1'b0;
      563: end

      570:     end

      `timescale 1 ns / 1 ps
      module ddr_fifo16_w
       (
        wr_data         ,
        wr_en           ,
      
        full            ,
        almost_full     ,
      
        wr_water_level  ,
      
        rd_data         ,
        rd_en           ,
      
        empty           ,
      
        clk             ,
        rst             ,
      
        almost_empty
      );
      
          localparam ADDR_WIDTH = 4 ; //@IPC int 4,10
      
          localparam DATA_WIDTH = 144 ; //@IPC int 1,256
      
          localparam OUT_REG = 0 ; //@IPC bool
      
          localparam RST_TYPE = "SYNC" ; //@IPC enum ASYNC,SYNC
      
          localparam FIFO_TYPE = "SYNC_FIFO" ; //@IPC enum ASYNC_FIFO,SYNC_FIFO
      
          localparam ALMOST_FULL_NUM = 11 ; //@IPC int 4,1024
      
          localparam ALMOST_EMPTY_NUM = 4 ; //@IPC int 4,1024
      
          localparam WR_WATER_LEVEL_ENABLE = 1 ; //@IPC bool
      
          localparam RD_WATER_LEVEL_ENABLE = 0 ; //@IPC bool
      
          input  wire                          clk             ;  // sync fifo clock
          input  wire                          rst             ;  // sync fifo rst
      
          input  wire  [DATA_WIDTH-1 : 0]      wr_data         ;  // input write data
          input  wire                          wr_en           ;  // input write enable 1 active
      
          output wire                          full            ;  // input write full  flag 1 active
          output wire                          almost_full     ;  // output write almost full
      
          output wire  [ADDR_WIDTH : 0]        wr_water_level  ;  // output write water level
      
      
          output wire  [DATA_WIDTH-1 : 0]      rd_data         ;  // output read data
          input  wire                          rd_en           ;  // input  read enable
      
          output wire                          empty           ;  // output read empty
          output wire                          almost_empty    ;  // output read water level

       #(

      --- 509 640 ---
      509: /////////////////////////////////////// DDR3 AW/AR latch shims [AWFIX/ARFIX 2026-09-19] ///
      510: // Proper single-handshake adapters between the crossbar and the DDR3 IP.
      511: // The crossbar is acknowledged exactly when we latch a request; the request is
      512: // then HELD with stable payload until the IP accepts (AXI-legal, no retraction).
      513: // Single-outstanding end-to-end (no held request + write FIFO empty + no pending
      514: // B for AW; read FIFO empty for AR) also keeps the aw_sid/ar_sid ID rebuilds sane.
      515: // [STAGE 2026-09-19] The DDR3 IP's W channel is UNTHROTTLEABLE: it pulses
      516: // wready at its own pace and counts awlen+1 beats itself (see the IP's own
      517: // example_design -- there is no wvalid at all). Presenting an AW before its
      518: // beats are in the FIFO let the IP consume GHOST beats from an empty FIFO;
      519: // the real beats then stranded in the FIFO forever and blocked all later AWs
      520: // (the permanent M00 write wedge). Hold each latched AW until its ENTIRE
      521: // burst is staged in the FIFO, then present it: during IP consumption the
      522: // FIFO only drains, so every demanded beat is guaranteed present.
      523: wire aw_burst_fits   = (ddr_axi_awlen < (5'd16 - wr_water_level));
      524: wire aw_latch_now    = ddr_axi_awvalid && !ddr3_aw_v && !aw_hold_v
      525:                        && w_fifo_empty && aw_burst_fits && !ddr_axi_bvalid_int;
      526: wire ar_latch_now    = ddr_axi_arvalid && !ddr3_ar_v && ddr_axi_fifo_empty;

      #!/usr/bin/env python3
      # -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
      """board_ssh.py -- RK3568 board access over the LAPTOP hotspot (192.168.137.x).
      SSH linaro/linaro; helper CLI used by the deploy/verify steps.
      
      Usage:
        python board_ssh.py run "<shell command>"
        python board_ssh.py put <local> <remote>
        python board_ssh.py get <remote> <local>
      """
      import sys, paramiko
      
      HOST = '192.168.137.4'
      USER, PW = 'linaro', 'linaro'
      
      
      def connect():
          cli = paramiko.SSHClient()
          cli.set_missing_host_key_policy(paramiko.AutoAddPolicy())
          cli.connect(HOST, 22, USER, PW, timeout=8, allow_agent=False, look_for_keys=False)
          return cli
      
      
      def run(cli, cmd, timeout=120, sudo=False):
          if sudo:
              cmd = "echo '%s' | sudo -S bash -c %s" % (PW, "'" + cmd.replace("'", "'\\''") + "'")
          stdin, stdout, stderr = cli.exec_command(cmd, timeout=timeout)
          out = stdout.read().decode('utf-8', 'replace')
          err = stderr.read().decode('utf-8', 'replace')
          rc = stdout.channel.recv_exit_status()
          return rc, out, err
      
      
      def main():
          cli = connect()
          try:
              mode = sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv) > 1 else 'run'
              if mode == 'run':
                  rc, out, err = run(cli, sys.argv[2], timeout=300, sudo=('--sudo' in sys.argv))
                  print(out)
                  if err.strip():
                      print('[stderr]', err[-1500:])
                  sys.exit(rc)
              elif mode == 'put':
                  sftp = cli.open_sftp()
                  sftp.put(sys.argv[2], sys.argv[3])
                  sftp.close()
                  print('put OK')
              elif mode == 'get':
                  sftp = cli.open_sftp()
                  sftp.get(sys.argv[2], sys.argv[3])
                  sftp.close()
                  print('get OK')
          finally:
              cli.close()
      
      
      if __name__ == '__main__':
          main()

      #!/usr/bin/env python3
      """serial_run.py : 在 RK3568 串口控制台执行命令 (COM9 @1500000)
      用法: python serial_run.py "command1" "command2" ...
      每条命令等待提示符后输出。长命令可用 -t 秒数 调整超时。
      """
      import serial, sys, time
      
      PORT = 'COM5'
      BAUD = 1500000
      
      def open_port():
          s = serial.Serial(PORT, BAUD, timeout=0.3)
          s.reset_input_buffer()
          return s
      
      def run(s, cmd, timeout=30):
          s.reset_input_buffer()
          s.write((cmd + '\n').encode())
          s.flush()
          t0 = time.time()
          buf = b''
          marker = b'__EOC__'
          s.write(b'echo __EOC__\n')  # 会在上一条执行完后排队
          while time.time() - t0 < timeout:
              chunk = s.read(4096)
              if chunk:
                  buf += chunk
                  if marker in buf.split(cmd.encode()+b'\n')[-1]:
                      break
              else:
                  # 再敲一次标记防止丢失
                  s.write(b'echo __EOC__\n')
          s.reset_input_buffer()
          # 去掉回显与标记行
          text = buf.decode('utf-8', errors='replace')
          lines = [l for l in text.splitlines() if '__EOC__' not in l]
          return '\n'.join(lines)
      
      if __name__ == '__main__':
          args = sys.argv[1:]
          timeout = 30
          if args and args[0] == '-t':
              timeout = int(args[1]); args = args[2:]
          s = open_port()
          for cmd in args:
              print(f'### {cmd}')
              print(run(s, cmd, timeout))
          s.close()

      10: // DESIGN: single-outstanding end-to-end, matching the DDR3 IP user-port contract
      11: // (no wvalid, unthrottleable wready, one burst processed at a time):
      12: //   IDLE  : present one master's AW (round-robin tie-break); the accept from the
      13: //           port glue locks OWNER for the whole burst.
      14: //   BUSY  : only OWNER's W stream reaches the glue; the fabric-minted B (from

      ## 2. RK3568 端测量
      
      单独读取一帧的实测耗时：
      
      ```text
      cam1：约 6.1 ms
      cam2：约 6.2 ms
      ```
      
      两帧合计约：
      
      ```text
      12.3 ms
      ```
      
      这对应理论处理能力：
      
      ```text
      1000 / 12.3 ≈ 81 fps
      ```
      
      因此在 DMA 正常时，主机读取 30 fps 双路原始 RGB565 是有余量的。
      
      但是板端 `dmesg` 持续出现：
      
      ```text
      PCI_DMA_WRITE Error: Timeout waiting for MSI interrupt
      ```
      
      同时中断统计显示：
      
      ```text
      IRQ0：累计约 177 万次
      其他 MSI 向量：0
      ```
      
      因此 RK3568 侧确实存在 DMA/MSI 异常，但它更主要表现为：
      
      - 帧率抖动；
      - 偶尔降到 3~5 fps；
      - `ioctl` 超时；
      - 读取重试；
      - 显示不稳定。
      
      它不是造成稳定 16 fps 上限的第一原因，因为 FPGA tag 本身已经只有约 16 fps。
      
      ## 3. 已修改并验证的 camview
      
      修改文件：
      
      ```text
      host/camview/main.cpp
      ```
      
      原代码中有两个主动限速点：
      
      ```cpp
      msleep(40);
      ```
      
      以及：
      
      ```cpp
      msleep(60);
      ```
      
      特别是：
      
      ```cpp
      msleep(60);   // [PACE] total loop period ~80ms
      ```
      
      这会让双路读取循环被人为限制在约 13~17 fps。
      
      已修改为：
      
      ```cpp
      msleep(2);
      ```
      
      用于无新 tag 时的短轮询；
      
      ```cpp
      msleep(1);
      ```
      
      用于完成一轮双帧读取后的让步。
      
      另外增加了日志：
      
      ```text
      camview_fps=xx.xxx
      ```
      
      板端已经完成：
      
      ```text
      qmake
      make -j4
      ```
      
      编译成功。
      
      修改后 `camview` 的日志可以短时间达到：
      
      ```text
      约 18~23 fps
      ```
      
      但仍会受到 FPGA tag 16 fps和 DMA/MSI timeout 的影响，期间出现：
      
      ```text
      3~5 fps 的瞬时低谷
      ```
      
      所以仅修改主机延时不能稳定达到 30 fps。
      
      ## 4. FPGA DDR/DMA 结构检查结果
      
      ### 当前双路共享一个 DDR 写仲裁器
      
      `source/top.v` 中：
      
      ```verilog
      ddr_w_arb u_ddr_w_arb
      ```
      
      cam1 和 cam2 都经过该模块写入 DDR。
      
      `source/axi_crossbar/ddr_w_arb.v` 的设计是：
      
      ```verilog
      reg busy;
      reg owner;
      ```
      
      整个 DDR 写 burst 采用：
      
      ```text
      单 outstanding
      一次只允许 cam1 或 cam2 其中一路占用 DDR 写口
      ```
      
      也就是说，两路摄像头并不是独立并行写 DDR，而是完整 burst 级串行仲裁。
      
      ### 当前单帧写入大小
      
      当前：
      
      ```text
      640 × 480 RGB565
      = 614400 Bytes
      = 38400 个 128-bit beat
      ```
      
      `dbg_axi_num` 读到：
      
      ```text
      38399
      ```
      
      说明当前 FPGA 仍然按正确的 38400 个 128-bit beat 组成一帧。
      
      ### frame busy 会丢弃输入帧
      
      `source/ov5640/ov5640_ddr/ov5640_ddr_w_en.v` 中：
      
      ```verilog
      if (s_vsync_rise & axi_cam_en && !engine_busy)
          next_state = DATA;
      ```
      
      以及：
      
      ```verilog
      assign m_vsync = s_vsync_rise & axi_cam_en && !engine_busy;
      ```
      
      当上一帧还没有完成 DDR 写事务时，下一次传感器 `vsync` 到来会被丢弃。
      
      因此现在的逻辑行为是：
      
      ```text
      传感器产生 32 fps
      DDR 写引擎来不及在每个帧间隔完成
      下一帧被 engine_busy 丢弃
      最终 tag 约 16 fps
      ```
      
      这与实测结果高度吻合。
      
      ### 当前 DDR 时序
      
      最新时序报告：
      
      ```text
      ddrphy_sysclk WNS = -0.211 ns
      6 个 setup violation endpoints
      ```
      
      文件：
      
      ```text
      project/place_route/top_timing_summary_after_hold_fix.txt
      ```
      
      这不是直接证明“每隔一帧丢帧”的唯一原因，但说明 DDR PHY 时序尚未完全收敛，不能盲目提高 DDR/AXI 频率。
      
      ### 当前 DMA 写引擎
      
      `source/axi_dma/axi_dma_write.v` 中：
      
      ```verilog
      BURST_LEN = 16
      ```
      
      并且：
      
      - 每次最多 16 个 128-bit beat；
      - 每个 burst 等待 DDR B response；
      - `ddr_w_arb` 只允许一个 burst 所属 master；
      - 发生异常时有约 0.17 秒 watchdog；
      - cam1/cam2 共享写回路径。
      
      这个结构主要问题不是单帧数据量，而是：
      
      ```text
      burst/B response/仲裁/DDR停顿导致一帧写事务无法在下一帧到来前稳定完成
      ```
      
      ## 5. 当前结论
      
      现在链路可以分成三种帧率：
      
      | 位置 | 实测/理论帧率 |
      |---|---:|
      | OV5640 原始 vsync | 约 32.2 fps |
      | FPGA 完成 DDR 写入并更新 tag | 约 16.1 fps |
      | RK3568 camview 稳定显示 | 约 16~20 fps，DMA异常时会降到3~5 fps |
      
      所以当前实际瓶颈顺序是：
      
      ```text
      第一瓶颈：FPGA DDR写事务/engine_busy/tag提交
      第二瓶颈：RK3568 PCIe DMA/MSI异常
      第三瓶颈：原camview主动延时
      ```
      
      `camview` 主动限速已经去掉，但它不是唯一问题。
      
      ## 6. 压缩现在能不能解决？
      
      目前不建议先加 JPEG XS 或 MJPEG。
      
      原因是当前双路原始数据量只有：
      
      ```text
      614400 × 2 × 32
      ≈ 39.3 MB/s
      ```
      
      而单帧 DMA 实测只有约 6 ms，PCIe 带宽并未达到理论上限。
      
      现在即使加入压缩，也可能变成：
      
      ```text
      FPGA采集
      → 压缩器等待/编码
      → DDR/PCIe传输
      → RK3568解码
      ```
      
      如果 FPGA DDR 写引擎本身已经无法每帧完成，新增压缩器反而会增加资源和时序压力。
      
      当前优先级应该是：
      
      ```text
      先让 FPGA tag 从16 fps恢复到接近30 fps
      再处理RK3568 DMA/MSI异常
      最后再评估是否还需要压缩
      ```
      
      ## 7. 下一步建议
      
      ### FPGA 侧优先改动
      
      建议先做一个单变量实验：
      
      1. 给 cam1/cam2 分别增加：
         - frame start timestamp；
         - AXI command accept counter；   - B response 延迟；
         - `ddr_w_arb` 仲裁等待；
         - `cam_dma_done` 没有每帧产生；
         - 还是 `engine_busy` 一直跨越下一帧。
      
      ### RK3568 侧优先改动
      
      继续保留当前 `camview` 的去限速修改，同时处理：
      
      - PCIe DMA ioctl 超时后的驱动状态清理；
      - 减少连续小 tag DMA；
      - 将四次 16-byte tag 读取合并为一次连续读取；
      - 检查 `g_dma_flag` 和 `g_cam_flag` 的清除逻辑；
      - 修复 MSI 向量只集中到 IRQ0 的问题；
      - 将两路帧读取改成连续 DMA 或一次描述符提交；
      - 保持 `QImage`/显示线程不阻塞采集线程。
      
      ### 不建议现在做的事
      
      暂时不建议：
      
      ```text
      直接加入 JPEG XS
      直接把 BURST_LEN 改大
      直接修改 DDR 时钟
      直接取消 engine_busy
      ```
      
      这些改动可能会重新引入之前的：
      
      - 竖纹；
      - FIFO 溢出；
      - DDR 写死锁；
      - DMA timeout；
      - ping-pong buffer 撕裂。
      
      当前已经确认的是：
      
      > `camview` 原来的 60 ms 限速确实需要删除；但即使删除，FPGA tag仍约16 fps，真正的下一步应定位 FPGA DDR 写事务为什么跨越了一个传感器帧周期。

      ## Assistant (Build · gpt-6-astra · 67.1s)

      已继续排查，当前已经定位到更具体的瓶颈，并完成了第一项 FPGA 优化修改。
      
      ## 已确认的根因
      
      实测数据：
      
      ```text
      OV5640 原始 vsync：约 32.2 fps/路
      FPGA frame tag：约 16.1 fps/路
      单帧 PCIe DMA 读取：约 6 ms
      ```
      
      因此：
      
      ```text
      摄像头能输出约32 fps
      但FPGA只有约16 fps完成DDR写入并更新tag
      ```
      
      当前 FPGA 数据路径中：
      
      ```text
      cam1 DMA
      cam2 DMA
            ↓
      ddr_w_arb
            ↓
      共享 DDR3 写端口
      ```
      
      `ddr_w_arb.v` 原先的策略是：
      
      ```text
      每完成一个16-beat DDR burst，就切换一次摄像头
      ```
      
      每帧需要：
      
      ```text
      640 × 480 × 2 = 614400 Bytes
      614400 / 16 = 38400 个128-bit beat
      38400 / 16 = 2400 个burst
      ```
      
      双路总共需要大量：
      
      ```text
      cam1 burst → cam2 burst → cam1 burst → cam2 burst
      ```
      
      这种频繁切换会增加 DDR 写通道和仲裁开销，导致上一帧尚未完成时下一次传感器帧已经到来。`engine_busy` 随后丢弃下一帧，所以最终表现为约 16 fps。
      
      ## 已完成的修改
      
      修改文件：
      
      ```text
      source/axi_crossbar/ddr_w_arb.v
      ```
      
      仲裁策略从：
      
      ```text
      每个 burst 后切换
      ```
      
      改为：
      
      ```text
      连续服务8个burst后切换
      ```
      
      特点：
      
      - cam1/cam2 仍然公平；
      - 不改变帧格式；
      - 不改变 DDR 地址；
      - 不改变 ping-pong 结构；
      - 不禁用 cam2；
      - 不改变 OV5640 配置；
      - 不改变 NPU RAW 链路；
      - 只减少 DDR 写端口的频繁切换。
      
      ## RK3568 侧已完成的修改
      
      `host/camview/main.cpp` 中原本存在人为限速：
      
      ```cpp
      msleep(40);
      msleep(60);
      ```
      
      已改为：
      
      ```cpp
      msleep(2);
      msleep(1);
      ```
      
      并加入实时日志：
      
      ```text
      camview_fps=xx.xxx
      ```
      
      这样可以避免 `camview` 自己把帧率限制在约 13~17 fps。
      
      不过目前测试显示，去掉软件限速后，`camview` 仍受到 FPGA tag 约 16 fps和 PCIe/MSI timeout影响，会出现：
      
      ```text
      约16~20 fps
      偶尔下降到3~5 fps
      ```
      
      所以仅修主机软件无法解决主要瓶颈。
      
      ## 当前阻塞
      
      PDS 当前仍在运行：
      
      ```text
      pds.exe       project.pds
      pds_shell.exe ... -action compile
      ```
      
      已有 PDS 编译任务尚未结束，且 PDS GUI 正打开工程。
      
      根据工程规则，不能：
      
      - 同时启动第二个 PDS 流程；
      - 在 GUI 打开时执行新的工程编译；
      - 强制结束当前 PDS 进程。
      
      因此本次 `ddr_w_arb` 修改还没有生成新的 bitstream，也没有烧录上板。
      
      ## 下一步
      
      当前已有修改待执行：
      
      1. 等待已有 PDS 编译结束；
      2. 关闭 PDS GUI；
      3. 清理旧的综合/布局布线产物；
      4. 重新执行 compile、synthesize、place_route；
      5. 检查时序；
      6. 生成 bitstream；
      7. 使用 `flash_safe.ps1` 烧录；
      8. RK3568 重新做 PCIe reset、rescan、驱动重载；
      9. 测量四个 tag 的更新频率。
      
      目标是验证：
      
      ```text
      修改前：约16.1 fps
      修改后：尽量接近28~30 fps
      ```
      
      如果 8-burst 仲裁仍不能达到目标，下一步将继续检查：
      
      - `axi_dma_write.v` 的 burst/B response 等待；
      - `ddr_w_arb` 是否被 DDR B response 长时间阻塞；
      - `engine_busy` 实际持续周期；
      - `cam_dma_done` 是否每帧只产生一次；
      - DDR 写入和 PCIe 读回是否互相争用；
      - `ddrphy_sysclk` 当前 `WNS=-0.211 ns` 对稳定吞吐的影响。

      #!/usr/bin/env python3
      # -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
      """board_ssh.py -- RK3568 board access over the LAPTOP hotspot (192.168.137.x).
      SSH linaro/linaro; helper CLI used by the deploy/verify steps.
      
      Usage:
        python board_ssh.py run "<shell command>"
        python board_ssh.py put <local> <remote>
        python board_ssh.py get <remote> <local>
      """
      import sys, paramiko
      
      HOST = '192.168.137.4'
      USER, PW = 'linaro', 'linaro'
      
      
      def connect():
          cli = paramiko.SSHClient()
          cli.set_missing_host_key_policy(paramiko.AutoAddPolicy())
          cli.connect(HOST, 22, USER, PW, timeout=8, allow_agent=False, look_for_keys=False)
          return cli
      
      
      def run(cli, cmd, timeout=120, sudo=False):
          if sudo:
              cmd = "echo '%s' | sudo -S bash -c %s" % (PW, "'" + cmd.replace("'", "'\\''") + "'")
          stdin, stdout, stderr = cli.exec_command(cmd, timeout=timeout)
          out = stdout.read().decode('utf-8', 'replace')
          err = stderr.read().decode('utf-8', 'replace')
          rc = stdout.channel.recv_exit_status()
          return rc, out, err
      
      
      def main():
          cli = connect()
          try:
              mode = sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv) > 1 else 'run'
              if mode == 'run':
                  rc, out, err = run(cli, sys.argv[2], timeout=300, sudo=('--sudo' in sys.argv))
                  print(out)
                  if err.strip():
                      print('[stderr]', err[-1500:])
                  sys.exit(rc)
              elif mode == 'put':
                  sftp = cli.open_sftp()
                  sftp.put(sys.argv[2], sys.argv[3])
                  sftp.close()
                  print('put OK')
              elif mode == 'get':
                  sftp = cli.open_sftp()
                  sftp.get(sys.argv[2], sys.argv[3])
                  sftp.close()
                  print('get OK')
          finally:
              cli.close()
      
      
      if __name__ == '__main__':
          main()

      #!/usr/bin/env python3
      """serial_run.py : 在 RK3568 串口控制台执行命令 (COM9 @1500000)
      用法: python serial_run.py "command1" "command2" ...
      每条命令等待提示符后输出。长命令可用 -t 秒数 调整超时。
      """
      import serial, sys, time
      
      PORT = 'COM5'
      BAUD = 1500000
      
      def open_port():
          s = serial.Serial(PORT, BAUD, timeout=0.3)
          s.reset_input_buffer()
          return s
      
      def run(s, cmd, timeout=30):
          s.reset_input_buffer()
          s.write((cmd + '\n').encode())
          s.flush()
          t0 = time.time()
          buf = b''
          marker = b'__EOC__'
          s.write(b'echo __EOC__\n')  # 会在上一条执行完后排队
          while time.time() - t0 < timeout:
              chunk = s.read(4096)
              if chunk:
                  buf += chunk
                  if marker in buf.split(cmd.encode()+b'\n')[-1]:
                      break
              else:
                  # 再敲一次标记防止丢失
                  s.write(b'echo __EOC__\n')
          s.reset_input_buffer()
          # 去掉回显与标记行
          text = buf.decode('utf-8', errors='replace')
          lines = [l for l in text.splitlines() if '__EOC__' not in l]
          return '\n'.join(lines)
      
      if __name__ == '__main__':
          args = sys.argv[1:]
          timeout = 30
          if args and args[0] == '-t':
              timeout = int(args[1]); args = args[2:]
          s = open_port()
          for cmd in args:
              print(f'### {cmd}')
              print(run(s, cmd, timeout))
          s.close()

          while ($true) {
              $cfg.Refresh()

              }

          }

          if ($cfg -and -not $cfg.HasExited -and -not $windowClosed) {

      // ============================================================================
      // ddr_w_arb.v -- [WARB 2026-09-19] minimal 2-master DDR write arbiter.
      //
      // WHY: the Forencich axi_crossbar's M00 write path leaks its per-master W-channel
      // select across handoffs (bench-proven in sim/wedge: after S01's burst tail the
      // M00 w_select_valid latches forever, S04's beats are never released, and both
      // camera engines wedge after 1-2 bursts). This module replaces the crossbar on
      // the DDR write path for the two camera engines.
      //
      // DESIGN: single-outstanding end-to-end, matching the DDR3 IP user-port contract
      // (no wvalid, unthrottleable wready, one burst processed at a time):
      //   IDLE  : present one master's AW (round-robin tie-break); the accept from the
      //           port glue locks OWNER for the whole burst.
      //   BUSY  : only OWNER's W stream reaches the glue; the fabric-minted B (from
      //           wusero_last) is routed back to OWNER; its accept frees the slot and
      //           flips the round-robin bit.
      // AXI-legal: awvalid/wvalid are held with stable payload until accepted; the
      // non-owner master's awready/wready stay low, so its burst cannot start.
      // ============================================================================
      `timescale 1ns/1ps
      module ddr_w_arb (
          input  wire         clk,
          input  wire         rst,
      
          // ---- master 0 (cam1 DMA) ----
          input  wire [3:0]   m0_awid,
          input  wire [31:0]  m0_awaddr,
          input  wire [7:0]   m0_awlen,
          input  wire [2:0]   m0_awsize,
          input  wire [1:0]   m0_awburst,
          input  wire         m0_awlock,
          input  wire [3:0]   m0_awcache,
          input  wire [2:0]   m0_awprot,
          input  wire         m0_awvalid,
          output wire         m0_awready,
          input  wire [127:0] m0_wdata,
          input  wire [15:0]  m0_wstrb,
          input  wire         m0_wlast,
          input  wire         m0_wvalid,
          output wire         m0_wready,
          output wire [3:0]   m0_bid,
          output wire [1:0]   m0_bresp,
          output wire         m0_bvalid,
          input  wire         m0_bready,
      
          // ---- master 1 (cam2 DMA) ----
          input  wire [3:0]   m1_awid,
          input  wire [31:0]  m1_awaddr,
          input  wire [7:0]   m1_awlen,
          input  wire [2:0]   m1_awsize,
          input  wire [1:0]   m1_awburst,
          input  wire         m1_awlock,
          input  wire [3:0]   m1_awcache,
          input  wire [2:0]   m1_awprot,
          input  wire         m1_awvalid,
          output wire         m1_awready,
          input  wire [127:0] m1_wdata,
          input  wire [15:0]  m1_wstrb,
          input  wire         m1_wlast,
          input  wire         m1_wvalid,
          output wire         m1_wready,
          output wire [3:0]   m1_bid,
          output wire [1:0]   m1_bresp,
          output wire         m1_bvalid,
          input  wire         m1_bready,
      
          // ---- slave (DDR3 port glue) ----
          output wire [3:0]   s_awid,
          output wire [31:0]  s_awaddr,
          output wire [7:0]   s_awlen,
          output wire [2:0]   s_awsize,
          output wire [1:0]   s_awburst,
          output wire         s_awlock,
          output wire [3:0]   s_awcache,
          output wire [2:0]   s_awprot,
          output wire         s_awvalid,
          input  wire         s_awready,
          output wire [127:0] s_wdata,
          output wire [15:0]  s_wstrb,
          output wire         s_wlast,
          output wire         s_wvalid,
          input  wire         s_wready,
          input  wire [3:0]   s_bid,
          input  wire [1:0]   s_bresp,
          input  wire         s_bvalid,
          output wire         s_bready
      );
      
          // Experimental throughput version: retain ownership for eight adjacent
          // DDR bursts before rotating. The user requested restoring this exact
          // experiment after the rollback image was tested.
          localparam [2:0] BURSTS_PER_TURN = 3'd8;
      
          reg  busy;      // an AW is locked in (waiting for its B)
          reg  owner;     // 0 = master0 owns the slot, 1 = master1
          reg  rr;        // round-robin tie-break for the next idle grant
          reg  [2:0] turn_count;
      
          // grant decision: only when idle; alternate when both masters ask
          wire aw_gnt_m1 = ~busy & m1_awvalid & ( rr | ~m0_awvalid);
          wire aw_gnt_m0 = ~busy & m0_awvalid & ~(m1_awvalid & rr);
      
          // AW datapath (granted master's request)
          assign s_awid    = aw_gnt_m1 ? m1_awid    : m0_awid;
          assign s_awaddr  = aw_gnt_m1 ? m1_awaddr  : m0_awaddr;
          assign s_awlen   = aw_gnt_m1 ? m1_awlen   : m0_awlen;
          assign s_awsize  = aw_gnt_m1 ? m1_awsize  : m0_awsize;
          assign s_awburst = aw_gnt_m1 ? m1_awburst : m0_awburst;
          assign s_awlock  = aw_gnt_m1 ? m1_awlock  : m0_awlock;
          assign s_awcache = aw_gnt_m1 ? m1_awcache : m0_awcache;
          assign s_awprot  = aw_gnt_m1 ? m1_awprot  : m0_awprot;
          assign s_awvalid = aw_gnt_m0 | aw_gnt_m1;
      
          assign m0_awready = aw_gnt_m0 & s_awready;
          assign m1_awready = aw_gnt_m1 & s_awready;
      
          // W datapath (only the owner's beats can flow)
          assign s_wdata  = owner ? m1_wdata : m0_wdata;
          assign s_wstrb  = owner ? m1_wstrb : m0_wstrb;
          assign s_wlast  = owner ? m1_wlast : m0_wlast;
          assign s_wvalid = busy & (owner ? m1_wvalid : m0_wvalid);
      
          assign m0_wready = busy & ~owner & s_wready;
          assign m1_wready = busy &  owner & s_wready;
      
          // B path: single outstanding -> the owner gets the fabric-minted response
          assign m0_bvalid = busy & ~owner & s_bvalid;
          assign m1_bvalid = busy &  owner & s_bvalid;
          assign m0_bid    = s_bid;
          assign m1_bid    = s_bid;
          assign m0_bresp  = s_bresp;
          assign m1_bresp  = s_bresp;
          assign s_bready  = busy & (owner ? m1_bready : m0_bready);
      
          always @(posedge clk) begin
              if (rst) begin
                  busy  <= 1'b0;
                  owner <= 1'b0;
                  rr    <= 1'b0;
                  turn_count <= 3'd0;
              end
              else begin
                  if (!busy && (aw_gnt_m0 | aw_gnt_m1) && s_awready) begin
                      busy  <= 1'b1;
                      owner <= aw_gnt_m1;
                      if (turn_count == BURSTS_PER_TURN - 1'b1) begin
                          turn_count <= 3'd0;
                          rr <= aw_gnt_m0;         // rotate after the eight-burst quantum
                      end
                      else begin
                          turn_count <= turn_count + 1'b1;
                          rr <= rr;                // keep the same owner during the quantum
                      end
                  end
                  else if (busy && s_bvalid && s_bready) begin
                      busy  <= 1'b0;
                  end
              end
          end
      
      endmodule
      --- ctrl ---
      //����CMD����
      module ov5640_ddr_w_ctrl #(
          parameter AXI_ADDR_WIDTH = 32,
          parameter AXI_LEN_WIDTH  = 32,
          parameter AXI_DATA_WIDTH = 128,
          parameter CAM_DATA_LEN   = 172800 //1280*720*3/16
      )(
          input          axi_clk        ,
          input          axi_rst        ,
      
          input  [AXI_ADDR_WIDTH-1 : 0]      cam_data_addr_1,
          input  [AXI_ADDR_WIDTH-1 : 0]      cam_data_addr_2,
          input  [$clog2(CAM_DATA_LEN) : 0]  cam_data_len   , //��16�ֽ�Ϊ��λ
      
          input          s_vsync        ,
      
          input          dma_done       ,  // [LEDGER 2026-09-19] DMA transaction-done pulse (authoritative beat ledger)

          output [AXI_LEN_WIDTH-1 : 0]   axi_cmd_len    /*synthesis PAP_MARK_DEBUG="1"*/,
          output reg                     axi_cmd_valid  /*synthesis PAP_MARK_DEBUG="1"*/,
          input                          axi_cmd_ready  /*synthesis PAP_MARK_DEBUG="1"*/,
      
          output [1 : 0]   xdma_req       ,
          input  [1 : 0]   xdma_ack       ,
      
          // [FRTAG 2026-09-14] frame-tag injection. After each frame's last stream beat the
          // FSM issues a SECOND 16-byte AXI command writing a 32-bit frame counter to
          // frame_base + CAM_DATA_LEN*16. The wrapper (ov5640_ddr.v) muxes tag_data onto
          // the data stream while tag_active is high. The transaction must complete:

          output                           tag_active     ,

          output                           engine_busy,     // [IDLEGATE 2026-09-19] FSM not IDLE (frame or tag in flight)
          output [31:0]                    dbg_last_cnt,

      );
      
          localparam IDLE      = 3'b001;
          localparam ADDR      = 3'b010;
          localparam DATA      = 3'b100;

          reg  [AXI_ADDR_WIDTH-1 : 0]  frame_base;

          wire [AXI_ADDR_WIDTH-1 : 0]  tag_addr;
          wire                         tag_fire;
      
          reg [1 : 0] axi_vsync_ff/*synthesis PAP_MARK_DEBUG="1"*/;
          reg axi_vsync_rise/*synthesis PAP_MARK_DEBUG="1"*/;
      
      
          reg [AXI_ADDR_WIDTH-1 : 0] cmd_addr;
      
      
          //״̬��
          always @(posedge axi_clk) begin
              if(axi_rst)begin
                  curr_state <= IDLE;
              end
              else begin
                  curr_state <= next_state;
              end
          end
      
          always @(*) begin
              case (curr_state)
                  IDLE: begin
                      if(vsync_pending)begin
                          next_state = ADDR;
                      end
                      else begin
                          next_state = IDLE;
                      end
                  end
                  ADDR: begin
                      if(axi_cmd_ready & axi_cmd_valid)begin
                          next_state = DATA;
                      end
                      else if(wd_expire)begin
                          next_state = IDLE;      // [WD2] cmd_ready stuck -> retry
                      end
                      else begin
                          next_state = ADDR;
                      end
                  end
                  DATA: begin
                      if(frame_done)begin
                          next_state = ADDR_TAG;              // [FRTAG] frame complete, go write the tag
                      end
                      else if(wd_expire)begin
                          next_state = IDLE;                  // [FIX] retry next vsync
                      end
                      else begin
                          next_state = DATA;
                      end
                  end
                  ADDR_TAG: begin
                      if(axi_cmd_ready & axi_cmd_valid)begin
                          next_state = DATA_TAG;
                      end
                      else if(wd_expire)begin
                          next_state = IDLE;                  // [FIX]
                      end
                      else begin
                          next_state = ADDR_TAG;
                      end
                  end
                  DATA_TAG: begin
                      if(tag_fire || wd_expire)begin
                          next_state = IDLE;
                      end
                      else begin
                          next_state = DATA_TAG;
                      end
                  end
                  default: begin
                      next_state = IDLE;
                  end
              endcase
          end
      
      
          always @(posedge axi_clk) begin
              if(axi_rst)begin
                  axi_vsync_ff <= 2'b0;
              end
              else begin
                  axi_vsync_ff <= {axi_vsync_ff[0], s_vsync};
              end
          end
      
          always @(posedge axi_clk) begin
              if(axi_rst)begin
                  axi_vsync_rise <= 1'b0;
              end
              else begin
                  axi_vsync_rise <= axi_vsync_ff[0] & (~axi_vsync_ff[1]);
              end
          end
      
          reg w_ping;
          always @(posedge axi_clk) begin
              if(axi_rst)begin
                  w_ping <= 1'b0;
              end
              else begin
                  if(frame_done)begin
                      w_ping <= ~w_ping;
                  end
              end
          end
      
      
          // [FRTAG 2026-09-14] sticky vsync latch: a vsync pulse arriving while the tag
          // states are running must not be lost (previously a 1-cycle rise pulse).
          always @(posedge axi_clk) begin
              if(axi_rst)begin
                  vsync_pending <= 1'b0;
              end
              else if(axi_vsync_rise)begin
                  vsync_pending <= 1'b1;
              end
              else if((curr_state == IDLE) && vsync_pending)begin
                  vsync_pending <= 1'b0;
              end
          end
      
          always @(posedge axi_clk) begin
              if(axi_rst)begin
                  axi_cmd_valid <= 1'b0;
              end
              else begin
                  if((curr_state == IDLE) && vsync_pending)begin
                      axi_cmd_valid <= 1'b1;
                  end
                  else if(frame_done)begin
                      axi_cmd_valid <= 1'b1;      // [FRTAG] frame done -> present the tag command
                  end
                  else if(axi_cmd_valid & axi_cmd_ready)begin
                      axi_cmd_valid <= 1'b0;
                  end
              end
          end
      
      
          always @(posedge axi_clk) begin
              if(w_ping)begin
                  cmd_addr <= cam_data_addr_2;
              end
              else begin
                  cmd_addr <= cam_data_addr_1;
              end
          end
      
          assign axi_cmd_addr = (curr_state == ADDR_TAG) ? tag_addr : cmd_addr;
          // [FRTAG 2026-09-14] tag command = one 16-byte beat at frame_base + frame size
          assign axi_cmd_len  = (curr_state == ADDR_TAG) ? 32'd16
                              : {{AXI_LEN_WIDTH-4-$clog2(CAM_DATA_LEN){1'd0}}, cam_data_len, 4'b0};
      
      
          // [FRTAG 2026-09-14] frame counter + tag beat generation --------------------
          // frame_base is latched when the FRAME command is accepted (cmd_addr still
          // points at the buffer being written at that moment; w_ping flips later).
          always @(posedge axi_clk) begin
              if(axi_rst)begin
                  frame_base <= {AXI_ADDR_WIDTH{1'b0}};
              end
              else if((curr_state == ADDR) && axi_cmd_valid && axi_cmd_ready)begin
                  frame_base <= cmd_addr;
              end
          end
      
          assign tag_addr = frame_base + (CAM_DATA_LEN << 4);
      
          always @(posedge axi_clk) begin
              if(axi_rst)begin
                  frame_cnt <= 32'd0;
              end
              else if(frame_done)begin
                  frame_cnt <= frame_cnt + 32'd1;
              end
          end
      
          assign tag_active  = (curr_state == DATA_TAG);
          assign tag_data    = {{(AXI_DATA_WIDTH-32){1'b0}}, frame_cnt};
          assign tag_fire    = tag_active & tag_ready;
          // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
      
      
          //XDMAƹ������
          reg [1 : 0] s_xdma_req;
          always @(posedge axi_clk) begin
              if(axi_rst)begin
                  s_xdma_req <= 2'b0;
              end
              else begin
                  if(frame_done)begin
                      if(w_ping)begin
                          s_xdma_req[1] <= 1'b1;
                      end
                      else begin
                          s_xdma_req[0] <= 1'b1;
                      end
                  end
                  else begin
                      if(xdma_ack[0]) begin
                          s_xdma_req[0] <= 1'b0;
                      end
                      if(xdma_ack[1]) begin
                          s_xdma_req[1] <= 1'b0;
                      end
                  end
              end
          end
      
          assign xdma_req = s_xdma_req;
          assign dbg_state = {29'd0, curr_state};
          assign engine_busy = (curr_state != IDLE);
      
          // [FIX 2026-09-18] frame-write watchdog: a frame that does not complete
          // (lost/short camera stream) used to wedge this FSM in DATA forever. Bail
          // back to IDLE after ~0.16 s and retry on the next vsync.
          reg [31:0] wd_cnt;
          // [WDFIX 2026-09-19] reset the budget on every state CHANGE, not only in
          // IDLE: a frame that burns the budget in DATA (slow DMA close with the B
          // path dead) used to make the immediately following ADDR_TAG/DATA_TAG
          // expire instantly, silently skipping the frame-tag write.
          reg [2:0] wd_prev_state;
          always @(posedge axi_clk) begin
              if(axi_rst) wd_prev_state <= IDLE;
              else        wd_prev_state <= curr_state;
          end
          always @(posedge axi_clk) begin
              if(axi_rst || (curr_state == IDLE) || (curr_state != wd_prev_state)) wd_cnt <= 32'd0;
              else if(wd_cnt != 32'hffffffff)     wd_cnt <= wd_cnt + 32'd1;
          end
          assign wd_expire = (wd_cnt >= 32'd20_000_000);
          assign dbg_wd_cnt = wd_cnt;
      
          reg [31:0] last_cnt;
          always @(posedge axi_clk) begin
              if(axi_rst) last_cnt <= 32'd0;
              else if(frame_done) last_cnt <= last_cnt + 32'd1;
          end
          assign dbg_last_cnt = last_cnt;
      
      
      
      
      endmodule

      #!/usr/bin/env python3
      """Read-only RK3568 dual-camera throughput and RTL-diagnostic probe.
      
      The caller should stop camview/detview before running this tool.  The tool only
      uses the driver's FPGA-to-host read path; it does not write camera registers.
      The two tag locations are ping/pong buffers for one camera, so frame_done is the
      primary FPS metric and tag changes are a secondary cross-check.
      """
      import ctypes
      import fcntl
      import mmap
      import os
      import signal
      import struct
      import time
      
      
      class Timeout(Exception):
          pass
      
      
      def alarm_handler(_signum, _frame):
          raise Timeout()
      
      
      class DmaOp(ctypes.Structure):
          _fields_ = [
              ("current_len", ctypes.c_uint32),
              ("offset_addr", ctypes.c_uint32),
              ("cmd", ctypes.c_uint32),
              ("ddr3_addr", ctypes.c_uint32),
              ("total_length", ctypes.c_uint32),
              ("read_buf", ctypes.c_void_p),
              ("write_buf", ctypes.c_void_p),
          ]
      
      
      def ioctl_code(number):
          return 0xC0000000 | (4 << 16) | (0x53 << 8) | number
      
      
      MAP_CMD = ioctl_code(2)
      F2H_CMD = ioctl_code(5)
      FRAME_BYTES = 640 * 480 * 2
      TAG_BASES = {
          "cam1_a": 0x00800000,
          "cam1_b": 0x00A00000,
          "cam2_a": 0x00C00000,
          "cam2_b": 0x00E00000,
      }

      # ov5640_reg.v current map.  Names intentionally describe the actual signal;
      # old aliases (href_raw/beat_last) were misleading after the 2026-09-18 probe.
      REG_OFFSETS = {

          "vsync_count": 0x20,
          "camera_word_count": 0x30,
          "zero_in_or_diag": 0x50,
          "state_cmd_wd": 0x60,       # {wd_cnt[7:0], state[7:0], cmd_cnt[15:0]}
          "aw_b_count": 0x70,         # {b_cnt[15:0], aw_cnt[15:0]}
          "zout_or_diag": 0x90,

      }
      
      
      def make_regs(base):

                  for cam, base in (("cam1", 0x20000000), ("cam2", 0x20000200))
                  for name, off in REG_OFFSETS.items()}
      
      
      REGS = {}

              REGS["%s_%s" % (cam, name)] = base + off
      
      
      def timed_ioctl(fd, command, op, timeout=12):
          signal.alarm(timeout)
          try:

          finally:
              signal.alarm(0)
      
      
      def delta32(after, before):
          if after is None or before is None:
              return None
          return (after - before) & 0xFFFFFFFF
      
      
      def delta16(after, before):
          if after is None or before is None:
              return None
          return (after - before) & 0xFFFF
      
      
      def unpack_diag(values, cam):

                  print("summary %s tag_step_sum=%d tag_frame_equiv_fps=%.3f" %
                        (base, steps, steps / elapsed), flush=True)
              print("first_diag_read_ms=%.3f..%.3f last_diag_read_ms=%.3f..%.3f" %
                    (min(diag_ms), max(diag_ms), min(diag_after_ms), max(diag_after_ms)), flush=True)
              for cam, base in TAG_BASES.items():

      //����CMD����
      module ov5640_ddr_w_ctrl #(
          parameter AXI_ADDR_WIDTH = 32,
          parameter AXI_LEN_WIDTH  = 32,
          parameter AXI_DATA_WIDTH = 128,
          parameter CAM_DATA_LEN   = 172800 //1280*720*3/16
      )(
          input          axi_clk        ,
          input          axi_rst        ,
      
          input  [AXI_ADDR_WIDTH-1 : 0]      cam_data_addr_1,
          input  [AXI_ADDR_WIDTH-1 : 0]      cam_data_addr_2,
          input  [$clog2(CAM_DATA_LEN) : 0]  cam_data_len   , //��16�ֽ�Ϊ��λ
      
          input          s_vsync        ,
      
          input          dma_done       ,  // [LEDGER 2026-09-19] DMA transaction-done pulse (authoritative beat ledger)
      
          output [AXI_ADDR_WIDTH-1 : 0]  axi_cmd_addr   /*synthesis PAP_MARK_DEBUG="1"*/,
          output [AXI_LEN_WIDTH-1 : 0]   axi_cmd_len    /*synthesis PAP_MARK_DEBUG="1"*/,
          output reg                     axi_cmd_valid  /*synthesis PAP_MARK_DEBUG="1"*/,
          input                          axi_cmd_ready  /*synthesis PAP_MARK_DEBUG="1"*/,
      
          output [1 : 0]   xdma_req       ,
          input  [1 : 0]   xdma_ack       ,
      
          // [FRTAG 2026-09-14] frame-tag injection. After each frame's last stream beat the
          // FSM issues a SECOND 16-byte AXI command writing a 32-bit frame counter to
          // frame_base + CAM_DATA_LEN*16. The wrapper (ov5640_ddr.v) muxes tag_data onto
          // the data stream while tag_active is high. The transaction must complete:
          // aborting it would leave a pending frame with no new tag for the host.
          output                           tag_active     ,
          output [AXI_DATA_WIDTH-1 : 0]    tag_data       ,
          input                            tag_ready,
          output [31:0]                    dbg_state,
          output                           engine_busy,     // [IDLEGATE 2026-09-19] FSM not IDLE (frame or tag in flight)
          output [31:0]                    dbg_last_cnt,
          output [31:0]                    dbg_wd_cnt
      );
      
          localparam IDLE      = 3'b001;
          localparam ADDR      = 3'b010;
          localparam DATA      = 3'b100;
          // [FRTAG 2026-09-14] tag states: second (16B) command after the frame completes
          localparam ADDR_TAG  = 3'b011;
          localparam DATA_TAG  = 3'b101;
      
          reg [2 : 0] curr_state/*synthesis PAP_MARK_DEBUG="1"*/;
          // [LEDGER 2026-09-19] both the frame command and the 16B tag command pulse
          // dma_done; only the frame command's completion may advance frame state.
          wire frame_done = dma_done && (curr_state == DATA);
          reg [2 : 0] next_state;
          wire wd_expire;
      
          // [FRTAG 2026-09-14] frame-tag declarations (forward, before first use)
          reg                          vsync_pending;
          reg  [AXI_ADDR_WIDTH-1 : 0]  frame_base;
          reg  [31 : 0]                frame_cnt;
          wire [AXI_ADDR_WIDTH-1 : 0]  tag_addr;
          wire                         tag_fire;
      
          reg [1 : 0] axi_vsync_ff/*synthesis PAP_MARK_DEBUG="1"*/;
          reg axi_vsync_rise/*synthesis PAP_MARK_DEBUG="1"*/;
      
      
          reg [AXI_ADDR_WIDTH-1 : 0] cmd_addr;
      
      
          //״̬��
          always @(posedge axi_clk) begin
              if(axi_rst)begin
                  curr_state <= IDLE;
              end
              else begin
                  curr_state <= next_state;
              end
          end
      
          always @(*) begin
              case (curr_state)
                  IDLE: begin
                      if(vsync_pending)begin
                          next_state = ADDR;
                      end
                      else begin
                          next_state = IDLE;
                      end
                  end
                  ADDR: begin
                      if(axi_cmd_ready & axi_cmd_valid)begin
                          next_state = DATA;
                      end
                      else if(wd_expire)begin
                          next_state = IDLE;      // [WD2] cmd_ready stuck -> retry
                      end
                      else begin
                          next_state = ADDR;
                      end
                  end
                  DATA: begin
                      if(frame_done)begin
                          next_state = ADDR_TAG;              // [FRTAG] frame complete, go write the tag
                      end
                      else if(wd_expire)begin
                          next_state = IDLE;                  // [FIX] retry next vsync
                      end
                      else begin
                          next_state = DATA;
                      end
                  end
                  ADDR_TAG: begin
                      if(axi_cmd_ready & axi_cmd_valid)begin
                          next_state = DATA_TAG;
                      end
                      else if(wd_expire)begin
                          next_state = IDLE;                  // [FIX]
                      end
                      else begin
                          next_state = ADDR_TAG;
                      end
                  end
                  DATA_TAG: begin
                      if(tag_fire || wd_expire)begin
                          next_state = IDLE;
                      end
                      else begin
                          next_state = DATA_TAG;
                      end
                  end
                  default: begin
                      next_state = IDLE;
                  end
              endcase
          end
      
      
          always @(posedge axi_clk) begin
              if(axi_rst)begin
                  axi_vsync_ff <= 2'b0;
              end
              else begin
                  axi_vsync_ff <= {axi_vsync_ff[0], s_vsync};
              end
          end
      
          always @(posedge axi_clk) begin
              if(axi_rst)begin
                  axi_vsync_rise <= 1'b0;
              end
              else begin
                  axi_vsync_rise <= axi_vsync_ff[0] & (~axi_vsync_ff[1]);
              end
          end
      
          reg w_ping;
          always @(posedge axi_clk) begin
              if(axi_rst)begin
                  w_ping <= 1'b0;
              end
              else begin
                  if(frame_done)begin
                      w_ping <= ~w_ping;
                  end
              end
          end
      
      
          // [FRTAG 2026-09-14] sticky vsync latch: a vsync pulse arriving while the tag
          // states are running must not be lost (previously a 1-cycle rise pulse).
          always @(posedge axi_clk) begin
              if(axi_rst)begin
                  vsync_pending <= 1'b0;
              end
              else if(axi_vsync_rise)begin
                  vsync_pending <= 1'b1;
              end
              else if((curr_state == IDLE) && vsync_pending)begin
                  vsync_pending <= 1'b0;
              end
          end
      
          always @(posedge axi_clk) begin
              if(axi_rst)begin
                  axi_cmd_valid <= 1'b0;
              end
              else begin
                  if((curr_state == IDLE) && vsync_pending)begin
                      axi_cmd_valid <= 1'b1;
                  end
                  else if(frame_done)begin
                      axi_cmd_valid <= 1'b1;      // [FRTAG] frame done -> present the tag command
                  end
                  else if(axi_cmd_valid & axi_cmd_ready)begin
                      axi_cmd_valid <= 1'b0;
                  end
              end
          end
      
      
          always @(posedge axi_clk) begin
              if(w_ping)begin
                  cmd_addr <= cam_data_addr_2;
              end
              else begin
                  cmd_addr <= cam_data_addr_1;
              end
          end
      
          assign axi_cmd_addr = (curr_state == ADDR_TAG) ? tag_addr : cmd_addr;
          // [FRTAG 2026-09-14] tag command = one 16-byte beat at frame_base + frame size
          assign axi_cmd_len  = (curr_state == ADDR_TAG) ? 32'd16
                              : {{AXI_LEN_WIDTH-4-$clog2(CAM_DATA_LEN){1'd0}}, cam_data_len, 4'b0};
      
      
          // [FRTAG 2026-09-14] frame counter + tag beat generation --------------------
          // frame_base is latched when the FRAME command is accepted (cmd_addr still
          // points at the buffer being written at that moment; w_ping flips later).
          always @(posedge axi_clk) begin
              if(axi_rst)begin
                  frame_base <= {AXI_ADDR_WIDTH{1'b0}};
              end
              else if((curr_state == ADDR) && axi_cmd_valid && axi_cmd_ready)begin
                  frame_base <= cmd_addr;
              end
          end
      
          assign tag_addr = frame_base + (CAM_DATA_LEN << 4);
      
          always @(posedge axi_clk) begin
              if(axi_rst)begin
                  frame_cnt <= 32'd0;
              end
              else if(frame_done)begin
                  frame_cnt <= frame_cnt + 32'd1;
              end
          end
      
          assign tag_active  = (curr_state == DATA_TAG);
          assign tag_data    = {{(AXI_DATA_WIDTH-32){1'b0}}, frame_cnt};
          assign tag_fire    = tag_active & tag_ready;
          // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
      
      
          //XDMAƹ������
          reg [1 : 0] s_xdma_req;
          always @(posedge axi_clk) begin
              if(axi_rst)begin
                  s_xdma_req <= 2'b0;
              end
              else begin
                  if(frame_done)begin
                      if(w_ping)begin
                          s_xdma_req[1] <= 1'b1;
                      end
                      else begin
                          s_xdma_req[0] <= 1'b1;
                      end
                  end
                  else begin
                      if(xdma_ack[0]) begin
                          s_xdma_req[0] <= 1'b0;
                      end
                      if(xdma_ack[1]) begin
                          s_xdma_req[1] <= 1'b0;
                      end
                  end
              end
          end
      
          assign xdma_req = s_xdma_req;
          assign dbg_state = {29'd0, curr_state};
          assign engine_busy = (curr_state != IDLE);
      
          // [FIX 2026-09-18] frame-write watchdog: a frame that does not complete
          // (lost/short camera stream) used to wedge this FSM in DATA forever. Bail
          // back to IDLE after ~0.16 s and retry on the next vsync.
          reg [31:0] wd_cnt;
          // [WDFIX 2026-09-19] reset the budget on every state CHANGE, not only in
          // IDLE: a frame that burns the budget in DATA (slow DMA close with the B
          // path dead) used to make the immediately following ADDR_TAG/DATA_TAG
          // expire instantly, silently skipping the frame-tag write.
          reg [2:0] wd_prev_state;
          always @(posedge axi_clk) begin
              if(axi_rst) wd_prev_state <= IDLE;
              else        wd_prev_state <= curr_state;
          end
          always @(posedge axi_clk) begin
              if(axi_rst || (curr_state == IDLE) || (curr_state != wd_prev_state)) wd_cnt <= 32'd0;
              else if(wd_cnt != 32'hffffffff)     wd_cnt <= wd_cnt + 32'd1;
          end
          assign wd_expire = (wd_cnt >= 32'd20_000_000);
          assign dbg_wd_cnt = wd_cnt;
      
          reg [31:0] last_cnt;
          always @(posedge axi_clk) begin
              if(axi_rst) last_cnt <= 32'd0;
              else if(frame_done) last_cnt <= last_cnt + 32'd1;
          end
          assign dbg_last_cnt = last_cnt;
      
      
      
      
      endmodule

      ### source/ov5640/ov5640_ddr/ov5640_ddr_w_en.v
         1: module ov5640_ddr_w_en #(
         2:     parameter DATA_WIDTH = 24
         3: )(
         4:     input          axi_clk      ,
         5:     input          axi_rst      ,
         6:
         7:     input          axi_cam_en   ,
         8:     input  [1:0]   frame_pending,
         9:     input          engine_busy,   // [IDLEGATE 2026-09-19] write engine FSM busy
        10:
        11:     input  [DATA_WIDTH-1 : 0]  s_data       ,
        12:     input                      s_data_valid ,
        13:     input                      s_hsync      ,
        14:     input                      s_vsync      ,
        15:
        16:     output [DATA_WIDTH-1 : 0]  m_data       ,
        17:     output                     m_data_valid ,
        18:     output                     m_hsync      ,
        19:     output                     m_vsync
        20: );
        21:
        22: localparam IDLE = 2'b01;
        23: localparam DATA = 2'b10;
        24:
        25: reg [1:0] curr_state;
        26: reg [1:0] next_state;
        27:
        28: reg [1:0] s_vsync_ff;
        29: reg       s_vsync_rise;
        30:
        31: always @(posedge axi_clk) begin
        32:     if(axi_rst)begin
        33:         curr_state <= IDLE;
        34:     end
        35:     else begin
        36:         curr_state <= next_state;
        37:     end
        38: end
        39:
        40: always @(*) begin
        41:     case (curr_state)
        42:         IDLE: begin
        43:                 if(s_vsync_rise & axi_cam_en && !engine_busy) begin  // [IDLEGATE 2026-09-19] admit a frame only when the engine finished the previous one
        44:                 next_state = DATA;
        45:             end
        46:             else begin
        47:                 next_state = IDLE;
        48:             end
        49:         end
        50:         DATA: begin
        51:             if(s_vsync_rise) begin
        52:                     if(axi_cam_en && !engine_busy) begin  // [IDLEGATE] engine wedged mid-frame: drop the rest at this vsync
        53:                     next_state = DATA;
        54:                 end
        55:                 else begin
        56:                     next_state = IDLE;
        57:                 end
        58:             end
        59:             else begin
        60:                 next_state = DATA;
        61:             end
        62:         end
        63:         default: begin
        64:             next_state = IDLE;
        65:         end
        66:     endcase
        67: end
        68:
        69: always @(posedge axi_clk) begin
        70:     if(axi_rst)begin
        71:         s_vsync_ff <= 2'b0;
        72:     end
        73:     else begin
        74:         s_vsync_ff <= {s_vsync_ff[0], s_vsync};
        75:     end
        76: end
        77:
        78: always @(posedge axi_clk) begin
        79:     if(axi_rst)begin
        80:         s_vsync_rise <= 1'b0;
        81:     end
        82:     else begin
        83:         s_vsync_rise <= s_vsync_ff[0] & (~s_vsync_ff[1]);
        84:     end
        85: end
        86:
        87: assign m_data       = s_data;
        88: assign m_data_valid = s_data_valid & (curr_state == DATA);
        89:
        90: // A completed frame owns its DDR buffer until the host acknowledges it.
        91: // Drop whole sensor frames at VSYNC boundaries while one frame is pending.
        92:     assign m_vsync = s_vsync_rise & axi_cam_en && !engine_busy;  // [IDLEGATE 2026-09-19]
        93:
        94: endmodule

       210:
       211: // [WD 2026-09-18] ------------------------------------------------------------------
       212: // The DVP stream can deliver fewer 128-bit beats than CAM_DATA_LEN (CDC FIFO
       213: // overflow drops pixels and cannot back-pressure the sensor). A frame's AXI
       214: // burst then never completes: trans sticks at 1, cmd_ready stays low and the
       215: // frame FSM deadlocks forever (measured: state=ADDR, axi_cnt=0, 0 frames).
       216: //
       217: // Recovery: if there is no W-beat progress for ~0.17 s while a write is in
       218: // flight, close the open burst with dummy beats. AXI forbids cancelling an
       219: // accepted AW, so we must still supply awlen beats; we just no longer consume
       220: // real camera data. After the B response is absorbed, trans/len clear and the
       221: // next frame's command is accepted again (only the bad frame is lost).
       222: assign w_progress = (t_m_axi_wvalid == 1'b1) && (t_m_axi_wready == 1'b1);
       223:
       224: always @(posedge clk) begin
       225: 	if((rst == 1'b1) || (trans == 1'b0) || (abort_r == 1'b1) || (w_progress == 1'b1))
       226: 		wd_cnt <= 24'd0;
       227: 	else if(wd_cnt != 24'hFFFFFF)
       228: 		wd_cnt <= wd_cnt + 24'd1;
       229: end
       230:
       231: // [BFAST 2026-09-19] the DDR write port can stop returning B responses
       232: // (see [WD2]; re-observed 09-19: b_cnt ~26 total while aw_cnt ~60k).
       233: // Waiting the full 0.17 s watchdog once every command's beats are out
       234: // capped the camera path at ~5 fps. Give B a few microseconds after the
       235: // last beat, then force the close via the abort path; a late B is still
       236: // absorbed by the w_done/bready logic.
       237: reg [9:0] bwait_cnt;
       238: // (w_done intentionally not referenced: it is declared further below and
       239: // act_burst_len==0 && burst_trans already means every beat is out, B pending)
       240: wire all_beats_out = (len == 32'd0) && (act_burst_len == 8'd0) && burst_trans;
       241: always @(posedge clk) begin
       242: 	if((rst == 1'b1) || (trans == 1'b0) || (all_beats_out == 1'b0) || (abort_r == 1'b1))
       243: 		bwait_cnt <= 10'd0;
       244: 	else if(bwait_cnt != 10'h3FF)
       245: 		bwait_cnt <= bwait_cnt + 10'd1;
       246: end
       247: always @(posedge clk) begin
       248: 	if(rst == 1'b1)
       249: 		abort_r <= 1'b0;
       250: 	// [BFAST2 2026-09-19] bwait fast-close DISABLED: B latency under DDR contention
       251: 	// can legitimately exceed the 10us grace; force-closing mid-flight corrupted
       252: 	// the crossbar/DDR transaction stream and killed M00 writes within seconds.
       253: 	// Fall back to the long send-watchdog only.
       254: 	else if((abort_r == 1'b0) && (trans == 1'b1) && (wd_cnt == 24'hFFFFFF))
       255: 		abort_r <= 1'b1;
       256: 	else if(abort_done == 1'b1)
       257: 		abort_r <= 1'b0;
       258: end
       259:
       260: // [WD2 2026-09-18] burst_trans is only cleared by the B response, which is
       261: // exactly what never arrives in the wedge case (cam2: bvalid never asserted).
       262: // Requiring burst_trans==0 made abort_done unreachable -> no recovery.
       263: // All W beats for the open burst are out once act_burst_len hits 0, so that
       264: // is the correct release point; burst_trans is force-cleared below.
       265: assign abort_done = abort_r && (act_burst_len == 8'd0);
       266: // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------
       267:
       268: stream_pipe #(
       269:   .DATA_WIDTH 	(DATA_WIDTH+1+KEEP_WIDTH)
       270: ) stream_pipe_3(
       271:   .dataIn_valid     (t_m_axi_wvalid),
       272:   .dataIn_ready     (t_m_axi_wready),
       273:   .dataIn_payload   ({t_m_axi_wdata, t_m_axi_wstrb, t_m_axi_wlast}),
       274:   .dataOut_valid    (m_axi_wvalid),
       275:   .dataOut_ready    (m_axi_wready),
       276:   .dataOut_payload  ({m_axi_wdata, m_axi_wstrb, m_axi_wlast}),
       277:   .clk              (clk),
       278:   .reset            (rst)
       279: );
       280:
       281: assign data_in_ready = abort_r ? 1'b0
       282:                                : (t_m_axi_wready && act_burst_len > 8'd0);
       283: assign t_m_axi_wvalid  = abort_r ? (act_burst_len > 8'd0)
       284:                                  : (data_in_valid && act_burst_len > 8'd0);
       285: assign t_m_axi_wdata   = abort_r ? {DATA_WIDTH{1'b0}} : data_in;
       286: assign t_m_axi_wlast   = (act_burst_len == 8'd1);
       287: assign t_m_axi_wstrb   = abort_r ? {KEEP_WIDTH{1'b1}} : data_in_keep;
       288:
       289: //b
       290: reg w_done;
       291: always @(posedge clk) begin
       292: 	if(rst == 1'b1) begin
       293: 		w_done <= 1'b0;
       294: 	end
       295: 	else begin
       296: 		if((t_m_axi_wvalid == 1'b1) && (t_m_axi_wready == 1'b1) && (t_m_axi_wlast == 1'b1)) begin
       297: 			w_done <= 1'b1;
       298: 		end
       299: 		else begin
       300: 			if((m_axi_bvalid == 1'b1) && (m_axi_bready == 1'b1)) begin
       301: 				w_done <= 1'b0;
       302: 			end
       303: 		end
       304: 	end
       305: end
       306: assign m_axi_bready = w_done;
       307:
       308: // [LEDGER 2026-09-19] single-ledger completion: pulse exactly once per
       309: // command on the trans 1->0 fall. Covers the normal close (B absorbed,
       310: // len==0) AND both watchdog abort paths; the old B-gated expression never
       311: // pulsed when a B response was lost, wedging the frame FSM in DATA forever.
       312: reg trans_q;
       313: always @(posedge clk) begin
       314: 	if(rst == 1'b1) trans_q <= 1'b0;
       315: 	else            trans_q <= trans;
       316: end
       317:
       318: always @(posedge clk ) begin
       319: 	if(rst == 1'b1)begin
       320: 		data_in_last <= 1'b0;
       321: 	end
       322: 	else begin
       323: 		data_in_last <= trans_q && (trans == 1'b0);
       324: 	end
       325: end
       326:
       327: endmodule
      
      ### source/axi_crossbar/ddr_w_arb.v
         1: // ============================================================================
         2: // ddr_w_arb.v -- [WARB 2026-09-19] minimal 2-master DDR write arbiter.
         3: //
         4: // WHY: the Forencich axi_crossbar's M00 write path leaks its per-master W-channel
         5: // select across handoffs (bench-proven in sim/wedge: after S01's burst tail the
         6: // M00 w_select_valid latches forever, S04's beats are never released, and both
         7: // camera engines wedge after 1-2 bursts). This module replaces the crossbar on
         8: // the DDR write path for the two camera engines.
         9: //
        10: // DESIGN: single-outstanding end-to-end, matching the DDR3 IP user-port contract
        11: // (no wvalid, unthrottleable wready, one burst processed at a time):
        12: //   IDLE  : present one master's AW (round-robin tie-break); the accept from the
        13: //           port glue locks OWNER for the whole burst.
        14: //   BUSY  : only OWNER's W stream reaches the glue; the fabric-minted B (from
        15: //           wusero_last) is routed back to OWNER; its accept frees the slot and
        16: //           flips the round-robin bit.
        17: // AXI-legal: awvalid/wvalid are held with stable payload until accepted; the
        18: // non-owner master's awready/wready stay low, so its burst cannot start.
        19: // ============================================================================
        20: `timescale 1ns/1ps
        21: module ddr_w_arb (
        22:     input  wire         clk,
        23:     input  wire         rst,
        24:
        25:     // ---- master 0 (cam1 DMA) ----
        26:     input  wire [3:0]   m0_awid,
        27:     input  wire [31:0]  m0_awaddr,
        28:     input  wire [7:0]   m0_awlen,
        29:     input  wire [2:0]   m0_awsize,
        30:     input  wire [1:0]   m0_awburst,
        31:     input  wire         m0_awlock,
        32:     input  wire [3:0]   m0_awcache,
        33:     input  wire [2:0]   m0_awprot,
        34:     input  wire         m0_awvalid,
        35:     output wire         m0_awready,
        36:     input  wire [127:0] m0_wdata,
        37:     input  wire [15:0]  m0_wstrb,
        38:     input  wire         m0_wlast,
        39:     input  wire         m0_wvalid,
        40:     output wire         m0_wready,
        41:     output wire [3:0]   m0_bid,
        42:     output wire [1:0]   m0_bresp,
        43:     output wire         m0_bvalid,
        44:     input  wire         m0_bready,
        45:
        46:     // ---- master 1 (cam2 DMA) ----
        47:     input  wire [3:0]   m1_awid,
        48:     input  wire [31:0]  m1_awaddr,
        49:     input  wire [7:0]   m1_awlen,
        50:     input  wire [2:0]   m1_awsize,
        51:     input  wire [1:0]   m1_awburst,
        52:     input  wire         m1_awlock,
        53:     input  wire [3:0]   m1_awcache,
        54:     input  wire [2:0]   m1_awprot,
        55:     input  wire         m1_awvalid,
        56:     output wire         m1_awready,
        57:     input  wire [127:0] m1_wdata,
        58:     input  wire [15:0]  m1_wstrb,
        59:     input  wire         m1_wlast,
        60:     input  wire         m1_wvalid,
        61:     output wire         m1_wready,
        62:     output wire [3:0]   m1_bid,
        63:     output wire [1:0]   m1_bresp,
        64:     output wire         m1_bvalid,
        65:     input  wire         m1_bready,
        66:
        67:     // ---- slave (DDR3 port glue) ----
        68:     output wire [3:0]   s_awid,
        69:     output wire [31:0]  s_awaddr,
        70:     output wire [7:0]   s_awlen,
        71:     output wire [2:0]   s_awsize,
        72:     output wire [1:0]   s_awburst,
        73:     output wire         s_awlock,
        74:     output wire [3:0]   s_awcache,
        75:     output wire [2:0]   s_awprot,
        76:     output wire         s_awvalid,
        77:     input  wire         s_awready,
        78:     output wire [127:0] s_wdata,
        79:     output wire [15:0]  s_wstrb,
        80:     output wire         s_wlast,
        81:     output wire         s_wvalid,
        82:     input  wire         s_wready,
        83:     input  wire [3:0]   s_bid,
        84:     input  wire [1:0]   s_bresp,
        85:     input  wire         s_bvalid,
        86:     output wire         s_bready
        87: );
        88:
        89:     // Experimental throughput version: retain ownership for eight adjacent
        90:     // DDR bursts before rotating. The user requested restoring this exact
        91:     // experiment after the rollback image was tested.
        92:     localparam [2:0] BURSTS_PER_TURN = 3'd8;
        93:
        94:     reg  busy;      // an AW is locked in (waiting for its B)
        95:     reg  owner;     // 0 = master0 owns the slot, 1 = master1
        96:     reg  rr;        // round-robin tie-break for the next idle grant
        97:     reg  [2:0] turn_count;
        98:
        99:     // grant decision: only when idle; alternate when both masters ask
       100:     wire aw_gnt_m1 = ~busy & m1_awvalid & ( rr | ~m0_awvalid);
       101:     wire aw_gnt_m0 = ~busy & m0_awvalid & ~(m1_awvalid & rr);
       102:
       103:     // AW datapath (granted master's request)
       104:     assign s_awid    = aw_gnt_m1 ? m1_awid    : m0_awid;
       105:     assign s_awaddr  = aw_gnt_m1 ? m1_awaddr  : m0_awaddr;
       106:     assign s_awlen   = aw_gnt_m1 ? m1_awlen   : m0_awlen;
       107:     assign s_awsize  = aw_gnt_m1 ? m1_awsize  : m0_awsize;
       108:     assign s_awburst = aw_gnt_m1 ? m1_awburst : m0_awburst;
       109:     assign s_awlock  = aw_gnt_m1 ? m1_awlock  : m0_awlock;
       110:     assign s_awcache = aw_gnt_m1 ? m1_awcache : m0_awcache;
       111:     assign s_awprot  = aw_gnt_m1 ? m1_awprot  : m0_awprot;
       112:     assign s_awvalid = aw_gnt_m0 | aw_gnt_m1;
       113:
       114:     assign m0_awready = aw_gnt_m0 & s_awready;
       115:     assign m1_awready = aw_gnt_m1 & s_awready;
       116:
       117:     // W datapath (only the owner's beats can flow)
       118:     assign s_wdata  = owner ? m1_wdata : m0_wdata;
       119:     assign s_wstrb  = owner ? m1_wstrb : m0_wstrb;
       120:     assign s_wlast  = owner ? m1_wlast : m0_wlast;
       121:     assign s_wvalid = busy & (owner ? m1_wvalid : m0_wvalid);
       122:
       123:     assign m0_wready = busy & ~owner & s_wready;
       124:     assign m1_wready = busy &  owner & s_wready;
       125:
       126:     // B path: single outstanding -> the owner gets the fabric-minted response
       127:     assign m0_bvalid = busy & ~owner & s_bvalid;
       128:     assign m1_bvalid = busy &  owner & s_bvalid;
       129:     assign m0_bid    = s_bid;
       130:     assign m1_bid    = s_bid;
       131:     assign m0_bresp  = s_bresp;
       132:     assign m1_bresp  = s_bresp;
       133:     assign s_bready  = busy & (owner ? m1_bready : m0_bready);
       134:
       135:     always @(posedge clk) begin
       136:         if (rst) begin
       137:             busy  <= 1'b0;
       138:             owner <= 1'b0;
       139:             rr    <= 1'b0;
       140:             turn_count <= 3'd0;
       141:         end
       142:         else begin
       143:             if (!busy && (aw_gnt_m0 | aw_gnt_m1) && s_awready) begin
       144:                 busy  <= 1'b1;
       145:                 owner <= aw_gnt_m1;
       146:                 if (turn_count == BURSTS_PER_TURN - 1'b1) begin
       147:                     turn_count <= 3'd0;
       148:                     rr <= aw_gnt_m0;         // rotate after the eight-burst quantum
       149:                 end
       150:                 else begin
       151:                     turn_count <= turn_count + 1'b1;
       152:                     rr <= rr;                // keep the same owner during the quantum
       153:                 end
       154:             end
       155:             else if (busy && s_bvalid && s_bready) begin
       156:                 busy  <= 1'b0;
       157:             end
       158:         end
       159:     end
       160:
       161: endmodule

       509: /////////////////////////////////////// DDR3 AW/AR latch shims [AWFIX/ARFIX 2026-09-19] ///
       510: // Proper single-handshake adapters between the crossbar and the DDR3 IP.
       511: // The crossbar is acknowledged exactly when we latch a request; the request is
       512: // then HELD with stable payload until the IP accepts (AXI-legal, no retraction).
       513: // Single-outstanding end-to-end (no held request + write FIFO empty + no pending
       514: // B for AW; read FIFO empty for AR) also keeps the aw_sid/ar_sid ID rebuilds sane.
       515: // [STAGE 2026-09-19] The DDR3 IP's W channel is UNTHROTTLEABLE: it pulses
       516: // wready at its own pace and counts awlen+1 beats itself (see the IP's own
       517: // example_design -- there is no wvalid at all). Presenting an AW before its
       518: // beats are in the FIFO let the IP consume GHOST beats from an empty FIFO;
       519: // the real beats then stranded in the FIFO forever and blocked all later AWs
       520: // (the permanent M00 write wedge). Hold each latched AW until its ENTIRE
       521: // burst is staged in the FIFO, then present it: during IP consumption the
       522: // FIFO only drains, so every demanded beat is guaranteed present.
       523: wire aw_burst_fits   = (ddr_axi_awlen < (5'd16 - wr_water_level));
       524: wire aw_latch_now    = ddr_axi_awvalid && !ddr3_aw_v && !aw_hold_v
       525:                        && w_fifo_empty && aw_burst_fits && !ddr_axi_bvalid_int;
       526: wire ar_latch_now    = ddr_axi_arvalid && !ddr3_ar_v && ddr_axi_fifo_empty;
       527:

       529: reg              aw_hold_v;

       532: reg              ddr3_aw_ap,   ddr3_ar_ap;
       533: reg [AXI_ID_M_LEN-1:0] ddr3_aw_id, ddr3_ar_id;
       534:
       535: wire aw_stage_ok = (wr_water_level >= ({1'b0, ddr3_aw_len} + 5'd1)) && !w_fifo_empty;
       536:
       537: always @(posedge axi_clk) begin
       538:     if (axi_rst) begin

       540:         ddr3_aw_v <= 1'b0;
