      当前 8-burst 实验版本不能继续用于帧率测试。它需要先修复 PCIe BAR 配置，否则驱动无法正常映射 FPGA BAR，也无法建立 MSI。
      
      后续应先检查：
      
      ```text
      PCIe IP BAR0 配置

      在修复前不应启动：
      
      ```text
      pango_pci_driver
      camview
      measure_dualcam.py
      ```
      
      以免再次触发 RK3568 内核异常。

      ## 当前结果
      
      8-burst 版本已烧录，但串口检查发现它的 PCIe 配置异常：
      
      ```text
      BAR0：64 KB
      ```
      
      而稳定版本此前是：
      
      ```text

      导致 RK3568 驱动初始化失败：
      
      ```text

      probe of 0002:21:00.0 failed
      ```
      
      因此刚才 3568 死机/驱动异常不是 `camview` 造成的，而是当前 8-burst bitstream 的 PCIe BAR/MSI 配置已经不兼容驱动。
      
      ## 已完成处理
      
      通过串口执行：
      
      ```bash
      rmmod pango_pci_driver
      ```

      ## 重要结论
      
      当前 8-burst 实验版本不能继续用于帧率测试。它需要先修复 PCIe BAR 配置，否则驱动无法正常映射 FPGA BAR，也无法建立 MSI。
      
      后续应先检查：
      
      ```text
      PCIe IP BAR0 配置
      project.pds 中 PCIe IP 参数
      稳定 bitstream 与 8-burst bitstream 的 PCIe 配置差异

      在修复前不应启动：
      
      ```text

      ```
      
      以免再次触发 RK3568 内核异常。

       184:         tag_steps = {name: 0 for name in TAGS}

       201:                     tag_steps[name] += (new - old) & 0xFFFFFFFF
       202:             previous = row

        87: // probes (kept inside the addr[9:8]=00 CAM1 segment; 0x100+ routes to prep).
        88: localparam REG_DBG_ZDIN      = BASE_ADDR + 32'h50;
        89: localparam REG_DBG_ZOUT      = BASE_ADDR + 32'h90;
        90:
        91:     reg bvalid        ;
        92:     reg data_out_valid;
        93:
        94:     reg rvalid;
        95:     reg [AXI_ADDR_WIDTH-1 : 0] rdata ;
        96:
        97:     //XDAM应锟斤拷
        98:     always @(posedge clk) begin
        99:         if(rst)begin
       100:             xdma_ack <= 2'b0;
       101:         end
       102:         else if((s_axi_awvalid & s_axi_awready) && (s_axi_wvalid & s_axi_wready) && (s_axi_awaddr == REG_ACK))begin
       103:             xdma_ack <= s_axi_wdata[1 : 0];
       104:         end
       105:         else begin
       106:             xdma_ack <= 2'b0;
       107:         end
       108:     end
       109:
       110:     //锟斤拷锟斤拷头使锟斤拷
       111:     always @(posedge clk) begin
       112:         if(rst)begin
       113:             cam_en <= CAM_EN_DEF;
       114:         end
       115:         else if((s_axi_awvalid & s_axi_awready) && (s_axi_wvalid & s_axi_wready) && (s_axi_awaddr == REG_CAM_EN))begin
       116:             cam_en <= s_axi_wdata[0];
       117:         end
       118:     end
       119:
       120:     //图片锟斤拷址1
       121:     always @(posedge clk) begin
       122:         if(rst)begin
       123:             cam_addr_1 <= CAM_ADDR_1_DEF;
       124:         end
       125:         else if((s_axi_awvalid & s_axi_awready) && (s_axi_wvalid & s_axi_wready) && (s_axi_awaddr == REG_CAM_ADDR_1))begin
       126:             cam_addr_1 <= s_axi_wdata;
       127:         end
       128:     end
       129:
       130:     //图片锟斤拷址2
       131:     always @(posedge clk) begin
       132:         if(rst)begin
       133:             cam_addr_2 <= CAM_ADDR_2_DEF;
       134:         end
       135:         else if((s_axi_awvalid & s_axi_awready) && (s_axi_wvalid & s_axi_wready) && (s_axi_awaddr == REG_CAM_ADDR_2))begin
       136:             cam_addr_2 <= s_axi_wdata;
       137:         end
       138:     end
       139:
       140:     //锟斤拷为锟斤拷一锟斤拷锟斤拷锟侥达拷锟斤拷锟斤拷锟斤拷锟斤拷锟斤拷锟斤拷锟矫伙拷锟斤拷卸隙锟斤拷锟街�
       141:     reg r_state;
       142:     always @(posedge clk) begin
       143:         if(rst)begin
       144:             r_state <= 1'b0;
       145:         end
       146:         else begin
       147:             if(s_axi_arvalid & s_axi_arready) begin
       148:                 r_state <= 1'b1;
       149:             end
       150:             else if(s_axi_rvalid & s_axi_rready) begin
       151:                 r_state <= 1'b0;
       152:             end
       153:         end
       154:     end
       155:
       156:     always @(posedge clk) begin
       157:         if(rst)begin
       158:             data_out_valid <= 1'b0;
       159:         end
       160:         else begin
       161:             if(s_axi_arvalid & s_axi_arready)begin
       162:                 data_out_valid <= 1'b1;
       163:             end
       164:             else begin
       165:                 data_out_valid <= 1'b0;
       166:             end
       167:         end
       168:     end
       169:
       170:
       171:     // 锟斤拷锟斤拷一锟斤拷锟捷达拷锟斤拷锟街凤拷募拇锟斤拷锟�
       172:     reg [AXI_ADDR_WIDTH-1:0] raddr_reg;
       173:     always @(posedge clk) begin
       174:         if (s_axi_arvalid & s_axi_arready) begin
       175:             raddr_reg <= s_axi_araddr; // 锟斤拷锟街成癸拷瞬锟戒，锟斤拷锟斤拷锟斤拷锟斤拷锟斤拷锟斤拷锟侥讹拷锟斤拷址
       176:         end
       177:     end
       178:
       179:
       180:     always @(posedge clk) begin
       181:         if(rst)begin
       182:             rvalid <= 1'b0;
       183:             rdata  <= {AXI_ADDR_WIDTH{1'b0}}; // 注锟解：rdata 位锟斤拷应锟斤拷锟斤拷 32锟斤拷锟斤拷锟斤拷 1
       184:         end
       185:         else begin
       186:             if(data_out_valid) begin
       187:                 rvalid <= 1'b1;
       188:                 // 锟斤拷锟捷刚诧拷锟斤拷锟斤拷亩锟斤拷锟街凤拷锟斤拷锟斤拷囟锟接︼拷拇锟斤拷锟斤拷锟斤拷锟绞抵�
       189:                 case(raddr_reg)
       190:                     REG_ACK:        rdata <= {{AXI_ADDR_WIDTH-2{1'b0}}, xdma_ack};
       191:                     REG_CAM_EN:     rdata <= {{AXI_ADDR_WIDTH-1{1'b0}}, cam_en};
       192:                     REG_CAM_ADDR_1: rdata <= cam_addr_1;
       193:                     REG_CAM_ADDR_2: rdata <= cam_addr_2;
       194:                     REG_DBG_CAM_WORDS: rdata <= dbg_cam_words;
       195:                     REG_DBG_VSYNCS:    rdata <= dbg_vsyncs;
       196:                     REG_DBG_ZDIN:      rdata <= dbg_zdin;
       197:                     REG_DBG_ZOUT:      rdata <= dbg_zout;
       198:                     REG_DBG_BEAT_CNT:  rdata <= dbg_beat_cnt;
       199:                     REG_DBG_BEAT_LAST: rdata <= dbg_last_cnt;
       200:                     REG_DBG_XDMA_REQ:  rdata <= {{(AXI_ADDR_WIDTH-2){1'b0}}, dbg_xdma_req};
       201:                     REG_DBG_VSYNC_RAW: rdata <= dbg_vsync_raw;
       202:                     REG_DBG_I2C_ID:    rdata <= {dbg_wd_cnt[7:0], dbg_state[7:0], dbg_cmd_cnt[15:0]};
       203:                     REG_DBG_PCLK_CNT:  rdata <= dbg_pclk_cnt;
       204:                     REG_DBG_SYS:       rdata <= {dbg_b_cnt[15:0], dbg_aw_cnt[15:0]};
       205:                     REG_DBG_AXI_NOW:   rdata <= dbg_axi_num;
       206:                     default:        rdata <= {AXI_ADDR_WIDTH{1'b1}}; // 锟斤拷锟斤拷锟角凤拷锟斤拷址锟斤拷锟斤拷锟斤拷锟斤拷锟角ｏ拷锟斤拷锟斤拷 debug
       207:                 endcase
       208:             end
       209:             else if(s_axi_rvalid & s_axi_rready)begin
       210:                 rvalid <= 1'b0;
       211:                 // rdata 锟斤拷锟街诧拷锟戒即锟缴ｏ拷直锟斤拷锟斤拷一锟轿讹拷锟斤拷锟斤拷
       212:             end
       213:         end
       214:     end
       215:
       216:
       217:     always @(posedge clk) begin
       218:         if(rst)begin
       219:             bvalid <= 1'b0;
       220:         end
       221:         else begin
       222:             if((s_axi_awvalid & s_axi_awready) && (s_axi_wvalid & s_axi_wready))begin
       223:                 bvalid <= 1'b1;
       224:             end
       225:             else if(bvalid & s_axi_bready)begin
       226:                 bvalid <= 1'b0;
       227:             end
       228:         end
       229:     end
       230:
       231:     assign s_axi_awready = s_axi_awvalid & s_axi_wvalid;
       232:     assign s_axi_wready  = s_axi_awvalid & s_axi_wvalid;
       233:
       234:     assign s_axi_arready = s_axi_arvalid & (r_state == 1'b0);
       235:     assign s_axi_rvalid  = rvalid        ;
       236:     assign s_axi_rdata   = rdata         ;
       237:     assign s_axi_rresp   = 2'b00         ;
       238:
       239:     assign s_axi_bvalid = bvalid;
       240:     assign s_axi_bresp  = 2'b00 ;
       241:
       242:
       243: endmodule

         1: module ov5640_top #(

        60:     output        cam_scl               ,  //cmos SCCB_SCL

       149: // ---------------- 锟斤拷锟斤拷锟睫革拷锟斤拷锟斤拷使锟斤拷 GTP_IODELAY_E2 锟斤拷锟叫撅拷细锟接迟碉拷锟斤拷 ----------------
       150:
       151:     // 锟斤拷锟斤拷锟斤拷锟斤拷锟接迟碉拷锟斤拷锟斤拷锟斤拷藕锟�
       152:     wire         cam_vsync_dly;
       153:     wire         cam_href_dly;
       154:     wire [7 : 0] cam_data_dly;
       155:
       156:     // 锟斤拷锟斤拷锟接迟诧拷锟斤拷值 (0~255)
       157:     // IODELAY_STEP is a header parameter now (overridable per instance)
       158:
       159:     // --- 锟斤拷锟斤拷锟脚猴拷锟接筹拷锟斤拷锟斤拷 ---
       160:     GTP_IODELAY_E2 #(
       161:         .DELAY_STEP_VALUE(IODELAY_STEP),
       162:         .DELAY_STEP_SEL("PARAMETER"),
       163:         .TDELAY_EN("FALSE")
       164:     ) u_iodelay_vsync (
       165:         .DO         (cam_vsync_dly),
       166:         .DELAY_SEL  (1'b0),
       167:         .DI         (cam_vsync),
       168:         .EN_N       (1'b0),
       169:         .DELAY_STEP (8'b0)
       170:     );
       171:
       172:     GTP_IODELAY_E2 #(
       173:         .DELAY_STEP_VALUE(IODELAY_STEP),
       174:         .DELAY_STEP_SEL("PARAMETER"),
       175:         .TDELAY_EN("FALSE")
       176:     ) u_iodelay_href (
       177:         .DO         (cam_href_dly),
       178:         .DELAY_SEL  (1'b0),
       179:         .DI         (cam_href),
       180:         .EN_N       (1'b0),
       181:         .DELAY_STEP (8'b0)
       182:     );
       183:
       184:     // --- 锟斤拷锟斤拷锟脚猴拷(cam_data)锟接筹拷锟斤拷锟斤拷 ---
       185:     genvar i;
       186:     generate
       187:         for (i = 0; i < 8; i = i + 1) begin : cam_data_iodelay
       188:             GTP_IODELAY_E2 #(
       189:                 .DELAY_STEP_VALUE(IODELAY_STEP),
       190:                 .DELAY_STEP_SEL("PARAMETER"),
       191:                 .TDELAY_EN("FALSE")
       192:             ) u_iodelay_data (
       193:                 .DO         (cam_data_dly[i]),
       194:                 .DELAY_SEL  (1'b0),
       195:                 .DI         (cam_data[i]),
       196:                 .EN_N       (1'b0),
       197:                 .DELAY_STEP (8'b0)
       198:             );
       199:         end
       200:     endgenerate

       210:         .CLK_FREQ  (CLK_FREQ)     ,      //模锟斤拷锟斤拷锟斤拷锟绞憋拷锟狡碉拷锟�
       211:         .I2C_FREQ  (I2C_FREQ)     ,      //IIC_SCL锟斤拷时锟斤拷频锟斤拷
       212:
       213:         //锟斤拷锟斤拷
       214:         .H_CMOS_DISP(H_CMOS_DISP), //CMOS锟街憋拷锟斤拷--锟斤拷
       215:         .V_CMOS_DISP(V_CMOS_DISP), //CMOS锟街憋拷锟斤拷--锟斤拷
       216:         .TOTAL_H_PIXEL(TOTAL_H_PIXEL), //水平锟斤拷锟斤拷锟截达拷小
       217:         .TOTAL_V_PIXEL(TOTAL_V_PIXEL), //锟斤拷直锟斤拷锟斤拷锟截达拷小
       218:
       219:         //锟藉卡锟借备
       220:         .DEVICE(DEVICE)
       221:     )
       222:     ov5640(

       225:
       226:         .ov_rst_n           (ov_rst_n ),
       227:         .cam_pclk           (cam_pclk ),  //cmos 锟斤拷锟斤拷锟斤拷锟斤拷时锟斤拷
       228:         // 使锟矫撅拷锟斤拷锟接迟达拷锟斤拷锟斤拷锟脚猴拷锟芥换原始锟杰斤拷锟脚猴拷
       229:         .cam_vsync          (cam_vsync_dly),  //cmos 锟斤拷同锟斤拷锟脚猴拷
       230:         .cam_href           (cam_href_dly ),  //cmos 锟斤拷同锟斤拷锟脚猴拷
       231:         .cam_data           (cam_data_dly ),  //cmos 锟斤拷锟斤拷
       232:
       233:         .cam_rst_n          (cam_rst_n),  //cmos 锟斤拷位锟脚号ｏ拷锟酵碉拷平锟斤拷效
       234:         .cam_pwdn           (cam_pwdn ),  //锟斤拷源锟斤拷锟斤拷模式选锟斤拷 0锟斤拷锟斤拷锟斤拷模式 1锟斤拷锟斤拷源锟斤拷锟斤拷模式
       235:         .cam_scl            (cam_scl  ),  //cmos SCCB_SCL锟斤拷
       236:         .cam_sda            (cam_sda  ),  //cmos SCCB_SDA锟斤拷
       237:
       238:         .video_clk          (video_clk  ),  // 锟斤拷锟较猴拷锟絉GB锟斤拷取时锟斤拷
       239:         .video_rst          (video_rst  ),
       240:         .video_vsync        (video_vsync),  //帧锟斤拷效锟脚猴拷
       241:         .video_hsync        (video_hsync),  //锟斤拷锟斤拷效锟脚猴拷
       242:         .video_valid        (video_valid),  //锟斤拷锟斤拷锟斤拷效使锟斤拷锟脚猴拷
       243:         .video_data         (video_data ),  //锟斤拷效锟斤拷锟斤拷
       244:         .dbg_i2c_status     (dbg_i2c_status),
       245:         .dbg_pclk_cnt       (dbg_pclk_cnt ),
       246:         .dbg_sys_status     (dbg_sys_status),
       247:         .dbg_href_raw       (dbg_href_raw  ),
       248:         .dbg_vsync_raw      (dbg_vsync_raw )
       249:
       250:     );
       251:
       252:     // ------------- VIP: RGB565 3x3 median filter, cam1 only -------------
       253:     // Taps the 16-bit RGB565 stream produced by the capture block and hands it to
       254:     // the DDR write packer. The module owns 2 line buffers (~2 lines of latency),
       255:     // re-times vsync and drops the camera tail dummy beat, so ov5640_ddr still sees
       256:     // exactly W*H pixels per frame. MEDIAN_EN=0 selects a pure wire bypass, so a
       257:     // camera without filtering keeps its original timing and uses no BRAM.
       258:     wire                    sh_video_valid;
       259:     wire [DATA_WIDTH-1 : 0] sh_video_data ;
       260:     wire                    sh_video_vsync;
       261:
       262:     generate
       263:         if (MEDIAN_EN) begin : g_median
       264:             vip #(
       265:                 .W       (H_CMOS_DISP),
       266:                 .H       (V_CMOS_DISP),
       267:                 .STRIDE  (1024),
       268:                 .AW      (10),
       269:                 // Keep the retimed frame marker separate from data without
       270:                 // creating a large producer/consumer backlog at frame end.
       271:                 .GAP_LEN (8)
       272:             ) u_vip (
       273:                 .clk       (video_clk      ),
       274:                 .rst       (video_rst      ),
       275:                 .en        (1'b1           ),
       276:                 .strength  (MEDIAN_RSVD    ),
       277:                 .in_valid  (video_valid    ),
       278:                 .in_pixel  (video_data     ),
       279:                 .in_vsync  (video_vsync    ),
       280:                 .out_valid (sh_video_valid ),
       281:                 .out_pixel (sh_video_data  ),
       282:                 .out_vsync (sh_video_vsync )
       283:             );
       284:         end
       285:         else begin : g_bypass
       286:             assign sh_video_valid = video_valid;
       287:             assign sh_video_data  = video_data ;
       288:             assign sh_video_vsync = video_vsync;
       289:         end
       290:     endgenerate
       291:
       292:     // wire video_rst = !locked;
       293:
       294:     wire                        cam_en    /*synthesis PAP_MARK_DEBUG="1"*/;
       295:     wire [AXI_ADDR_WIDTH-1 : 0] cam_addr_1/*synthesis PAP_MARK_DEBUG="1"*/;
       296:     wire [AXI_ADDR_WIDTH-1 : 0] cam_addr_2/*synthesis PAP_MARK_DEBUG="1"*/;
       297:     wire [1 : 0]  xdma_req  ;
       298:     reg  [31:0]   dbg_beat_cnt;
       299:     reg  [31:0]   dbg_beat_last;
       300:     reg  [31:0]   dbg_cmd_cnt;
       301: wire [31:0]   dbg_axi_cnt;
       302: wire [31:0]   dbg_axi_num;
       303: wire [31:0]   dbg_zdin;
       304: wire [31:0]   dbg_zout;
       305:     wire [31:0]   dbg_state;
       306:     wire [31:0]   dbg_last_cnt;
       307:     wire [31:0]   dbg_wd_cnt;
       308:     reg  [15:0]   dbg_axi_sticky;
       309:     reg  [15:0]   dbg_b_cnt;
       310:     reg  [15:0]   dbg_aw_cnt;
       311:     reg  [15:0]   dbg_w_cnt;
       312:     wire [15:0]   dbg_axi_stat;
       313:     reg  [31:0]   dbg_clk_status;
       314:     wire [1 : 0]  xdma_ack  ;
       315:     ov5640_ddr #(
       316:         .DATA_WIDTH(DATA_WIDTH),
       317:         .AXI_ADDR_WIDTH(AXI_ADDR_WIDTH),
       318:         .AXI_LEN_WIDTH(AXI_LEN_WIDTH),
       319:         .AXI_DATA_WIDTH(AXI_DATA_WIDTH),
       320:         .CAM_DATA_LEN(CAM_DATA_LEN),     //1280*720*3/16
       321:         .DEVICE(DEVICE)
       322:     )
       323:     ov5640_ddr(
       324:         .axi_clk        (video_clk),
       325:         .axi_rst        (video_rst),
       326:
       327:         .axi_cam_en     (cam_en    ),
       328:         .dma_done       (cam_dma_done),  // [LEDGER 2026-09-19]
       329:         .cam_data_addr_1(cam_addr_1),
       330:         .cam_data_addr_2(cam_addr_2),
       331:         .cam_data_len   (CAM_DATA_LEN), //锟斤拷16锟街斤拷为锟斤拷位
       332:
       333:         .s_data         (sh_video_data ),
       334:         .s_data_valid   (sh_video_valid),
       335:         .s_hsync        (video_hsync),
       336:         .s_vsync        (sh_video_vsync),
       337:
       338:         //AXI协锟斤拷锟�
       339:         .axi_data       (cam_s_data      ),
       340:         .axi_data_valid (cam_s_data_valid),
       341:         .axi_data_last  (cam_s_data_last ),
       342:         .axi_data_ready (cam_s_data_ready),
       343:
       344:         .axi_cmd_addr   (cam_cmd_addr  ),
       345:         .axi_cmd_len    (cam_cmd_len   ),
       346:         .axi_cmd_valid  (cam_cmd_valid ),
       347:         .axi_cmd_ready  (cam_cmd_ready ),
       348:
       349:         .dbg_axi_cnt    (dbg_axi_cnt   ),
       350:         .dbg_axi_num    (dbg_axi_num   ),
       351:         .dbg_zdin       (dbg_zdin      ),
       352:         .dbg_zout       (dbg_zout      ),
       353:         .dbg_state      (dbg_state     ),
       354:         .dbg_last_cnt   (dbg_last_cnt  ),
       355:         .dbg_wd_cnt     (dbg_wd_cnt    ),
       356:         .xdma_req       (xdma_req      ),
       357:         .xdma_ack       (xdma_ack      )
       358:     );

       362:
       363:     // [DBG] camera activity counters (read via ov5640_reg +0x30/+0x34)
       364:     reg [31:0] dbg_cam_words;
       365:     always @(posedge video_clk) begin
       366:         if (video_rst) dbg_cam_words <= 32'd0;
       367:         else if (cam_s_data_valid) dbg_cam_words <= dbg_cam_words + 32'd1;
       368:     end
       369:     reg [31:0] dbg_vsyncs;
       370:     reg [2:0]  dbg_vs_ff;
       371:     always @(posedge video_clk) dbg_vs_ff <= {dbg_vs_ff[1:0], video_vsync};
       372:     always @(posedge video_clk) begin
       373:         if (video_rst) dbg_vsyncs <= 32'd0;
       374:         else if (dbg_vs_ff[2:1] == 2'b01) dbg_vsyncs <= dbg_vsyncs + 32'd1;
       375:     end
       376:     // [DBG] href (hsync) activity counter -> ov5640_reg +0x50
       377:     reg [31:0] dbg_hsyncs;
       378:     reg [2:0]  dbg_hs_ff;
       379:     always @(posedge video_clk) dbg_hs_ff <= {dbg_hs_ff[1:0], video_hsync};
       380:     always @(posedge video_clk) begin
       381:         if (video_rst) dbg_hsyncs <= 32'd0;
       382:         else if (dbg_hs_ff[2:1] == 2'b01) dbg_hsyncs <= dbg_hsyncs + 32'd1;
       383:     end
       384:     // [DIAG] AXI beat accounting: how many beats does the engine actually see
       385:     // per camera frame? If this != CAM_DATA_LEN the write FSM deadlocks.
       386:     reg [2:0] dbg_fs_ff;
       387:     always @(posedge video_clk) dbg_fs_ff <= {dbg_fs_ff[1:0], video_vsync};
       388:     wire dbg_frame_edge = (dbg_fs_ff[2:1] == 2'b01);
       389:     always @(posedge video_clk) begin
       390:         if (video_rst) begin
       391:             dbg_beat_cnt  <= 32'd0;
       392:             dbg_beat_last <= 32'd0;
       393:         end
       394:         else if (dbg_frame_edge) begin
       395:             dbg_beat_last <= dbg_beat_cnt;
       396:             dbg_beat_cnt  <= 32'd0;
       397:         end
       398:         else if (cam_s_data_valid & cam_s_data_ready) begin
       399:             dbg_beat_cnt <= dbg_beat_cnt + 32'd1;
       400:         end
       401:     end
       402:     // [DIAG] AXI write handshake visibility (which stage ever happened?)
       403:     // [DIAG2] numeric handshake counters (sticky only says "ever", not "how many")
       404:     always @(posedge video_clk) begin
       405:         if (video_rst) begin
       406:             dbg_b_cnt  <= 16'd0;
       407:             dbg_aw_cnt <= 16'd0;
       408:             dbg_w_cnt  <= 16'd0;
       409:         end
       410:         else begin
       411:             if (dbg_axi_bvalid & dbg_axi_bready) dbg_b_cnt  <= dbg_b_cnt  + 16'd1;
       412:             if (dbg_axi_awvalid & dbg_axi_awready) dbg_aw_cnt <= dbg_aw_cnt + 16'd1;
       413:             if (dbg_axi_wvalid & dbg_axi_wready)  dbg_w_cnt  <= dbg_w_cnt  + 16'd1;
       414:         end
       415:     end
       416:     assign dbg_axi_stat = {5'd0,
       417:         dbg_axi_bready, dbg_axi_bvalid,
       418:         (cam_s_data_valid & cam_s_data_ready),
       419:         cam_s_data_ready, cam_s_data_valid,
       420:         (dbg_axi_wvalid & dbg_axi_wready), dbg_axi_wready, dbg_axi_wvalid,
       421:         (dbg_axi_awvalid & dbg_axi_awready), dbg_axi_awready, dbg_axi_awvalid};
       422:     always @(posedge video_clk) begin
       423:         if (video_rst) dbg_axi_sticky <= 16'd0;
       424:         else           dbg_axi_sticky <= dbg_axi_sticky | dbg_axi_stat;
       425:     end
       426:     // [DIAG] frame commands issued by ov5640_ddr_w_ctrl (idle->addr transitions)
       427:     reg dbg_cmd_d;
       428:     always @(posedge video_clk) begin
       429:         if (video_rst) begin
       430:             dbg_cmd_d   <= 1'b0;
       431:             dbg_cmd_cnt <= 32'd0;
       432:         end
       433:         else begin
       434:             dbg_cmd_d <= cam_cmd_valid;
       435:             if (cam_cmd_valid & ~dbg_cmd_d)
       436:                 dbg_cmd_cnt <= dbg_cmd_cnt + 32'd1;
       437:         end
       438:     end
       439:
       440: // [DBG] clk_50m activity counter + lock/button snapshot (sampled in video_clk)
       441: reg [15:0] dbg_clk50_cnt;
       442: always @(posedge clk_50m) dbg_clk50_cnt <= dbg_clk50_cnt + 16'd1;
       443: always @(posedge video_clk) dbg_clk_status <= {dbg_clk50_cnt, dbg_locked, dbg_btn_rst_n};
       444:     ov5640_reg #(
       445:
       446:         .BASE_ADDR(BASE_ADDR),
       447:         .CAM_ADDR_1_DEF(CAM_ADDR_1_DEF),
       448:         .CAM_ADDR_2_DEF(CAM_ADDR_2_DEF),
       449:         .CAM_EN_DEF   (CAM_EN_DEF   ),
       450:         .AXI_ADDR_WIDTH(AXI_ADDR_WIDTH)
       451:     )
       452:     ov5640_reg(
       453:         .clk                   (video_clk    ),
       454:         .rst                   (video_rst    ),
       455:
       456:         .s_axi_awvalid         (s_axi_awvalid),
       457:         .s_axi_awready         (s_axi_awready),
       458:         .s_axi_awaddr          (s_axi_awaddr ),
       459:
       460:         .s_axi_wvalid          (s_axi_wvalid ),
       461:         .s_axi_wready          (s_axi_wready ),
       462:         .s_axi_wdata           (s_axi_wdata  ),
       463:         .s_axi_wstrb           (s_axi_wstrb  ),
       464:
       465:         .s_axi_bvalid          (s_axi_bvalid ),
       466:         .s_axi_bready          (s_axi_bready ),
       467:         .s_axi_bresp           (s_axi_bresp  ),
       468:
       469:         .s_axi_arvalid         (s_axi_arvalid),
       470:         .s_axi_arready         (s_axi_arready),
       471:         .s_axi_araddr          (s_axi_araddr ),
       472:
       473:         .s_axi_rvalid          (s_axi_rvalid ),
       474:         .s_axi_rready          (s_axi_rready ),
       475:         .s_axi_rdata           (s_axi_rdata  ),
       476:         .s_axi_rresp           (s_axi_rresp  ),
       477:
       478:         .xdma_ack              (xdma_ack     ),
       479:         .cam_en                (cam_en       ),
       480:         .cam_addr_1            (cam_addr_1   ),
       481:         .cam_addr_2            (cam_addr_2   ),
       482:         .dbg_cam_words         (dbg_cam_words),
       483:         .dbg_vsyncs            (dbg_vsyncs   ),
       484:         .dbg_hsyncs            (dbg_hsyncs   ),
       485:         .dbg_xdma_req          (xdma_req     ),
       486:         .dbg_i2c_status        (dbg_i2c_status),
       487:         .dbg_pclk_cnt          (dbg_pclk_cnt ),
       488:         .dbg_sys_status        (dbg_sys_status),
       489:         .dbg_href_raw          (dbg_href_raw ),
       490:         .dbg_beat_cnt          (dbg_beat_cnt ),
       491:         .dbg_axi_sticky        (dbg_axi_sticky),
       492:         .dbg_b_cnt             (dbg_b_cnt     ),
       493:         .dbg_aw_cnt            (dbg_aw_cnt    ),
       494:         .dbg_w_cnt             (dbg_w_cnt     ),
       495:     .dbg_axi_cnt           (dbg_axi_cnt   ),
       496:     .dbg_axi_num           (dbg_axi_num   ),
       497:     .dbg_zdin              (dbg_zdin      ),
       498:     .dbg_zout              (dbg_zout      ),
       499:         .dbg_state             (dbg_state     ),
       500:         .dbg_last_cnt          (dbg_last_cnt  ),
       501:         .dbg_wd_cnt            (dbg_wd_cnt    ),
       502:         .dbg_axi_stat          (dbg_axi_stat  ),
       503:         .dbg_beat_last         (dbg_beat_last),
       504:         .dbg_cmd_cnt           (dbg_cmd_cnt  ),
       505:         .dbg_vsync_raw         (dbg_vsync_raw),
       506:         .dbg_clk_status        (dbg_clk_status)
       507:     );

       512:     // RGB锟斤拷锟斤拷取时锟斤拷video_clk 锟斤拷 xdma时锟斤拷锟斤拷
       513:     pipe_cdc #(
       514:         .DATA_WIDTH   (2), // 锟斤拷锟斤拷锟斤拷锟睫改★拷锟斤拷锟斤拷锟斤拷锟斤拷锟矫碉拷锟斤拷锟斤拷位锟斤拷
       515:         .DEST_SYNC_FF (4), // 目锟斤拷时锟斤拷锟斤拷同锟斤拷锟斤拷锟斤拷锟斤拷锟斤拷锟斤拷 (锟斤拷围: 2-10)
       516:         .INIT_SYNC_FF (0), // 锟斤拷锟斤拷锟斤拷锟较碉拷锟绞贾� (0锟斤拷1)
       517:         .SRC_INPUT_REG(1)  // 源时锟斤拷锟斤拷锟斤拷锟斤拷锟角凤拷锟饺达拷一锟侥寄达拷 (0=锟斤拷, 1=锟斤拷)
       518:     )

       522:         .dest_clk(xdma_clk), // 目锟斤拷时锟斤拷
       523:         .dest_out(xdma_irq)  // 锟斤拷锟斤拷锟侥帮拷全锟斤拷锟斤拷锟斤拷锟斤拷锟�
       524:     );

      ### source/ov5640/ov5640_ddr/ov5640_ddr_w_ctrl.v
         1: //锟斤拷锟斤拷CMD锟斤拷锟斤拷
         2: module ov5640_ddr_w_ctrl #(
         3:     parameter AXI_ADDR_WIDTH = 32,
         4:     parameter AXI_LEN_WIDTH  = 32,
         5:     parameter AXI_DATA_WIDTH = 128,
         6:     parameter CAM_DATA_LEN   = 172800 //1280*720*3/16
         7: )(
         8:     input          axi_clk        ,
         9:     input          axi_rst        ,
        10:
        11:     input  [AXI_ADDR_WIDTH-1 : 0]      cam_data_addr_1,
        12:     input  [AXI_ADDR_WIDTH-1 : 0]      cam_data_addr_2,
        13:     input  [$clog2(CAM_DATA_LEN) : 0]  cam_data_len   , //锟斤拷16锟街斤拷为锟斤拷位
        14:
        15:     input          s_vsync        ,
        16:
        17:     input          dma_done       ,  // [LEDGER 2026-09-19] DMA transaction-done pulse (authoritative beat ledger)
        18:
        19:     output [AXI_ADDR_WIDTH-1 : 0]  axi_cmd_addr   /*synthesis PAP_MARK_DEBUG="1"*/,
        20:     output [AXI_LEN_WIDTH-1 : 0]   axi_cmd_len    /*synthesis PAP_MARK_DEBUG="1"*/,
        21:     output reg                     axi_cmd_valid  /*synthesis PAP_MARK_DEBUG="1"*/,
        22:     input                          axi_cmd_ready  /*synthesis PAP_MARK_DEBUG="1"*/,
        23:
        24:     output [1 : 0]   xdma_req       ,
        25:     input  [1 : 0]   xdma_ack       ,
        26:
        27:     // [FRTAG 2026-09-14] frame-tag injection. After each frame's last stream beat the
        28:     // FSM issues a SECOND 16-byte AXI command writing a 32-bit frame counter to
        29:     // frame_base + CAM_DATA_LEN*16. The wrapper (ov5640_ddr.v) muxes tag_data onto
        30:     // the data stream while tag_active is high. The transaction must complete:
        31:     // aborting it would leave a pending frame with no new tag for the host.
        32:     output                           tag_active     ,
        33:     output [AXI_DATA_WIDTH-1 : 0]    tag_data       ,
        34:     input                            tag_ready,
        35:     output [31:0]                    dbg_state,
        36:     output                           engine_busy,     // [IDLEGATE 2026-09-19] FSM not IDLE (frame or tag in flight)
        37:     output [31:0]                    dbg_last_cnt,
        38:     output [31:0]                    dbg_wd_cnt
        39: );
        40:
        41:     localparam IDLE      = 3'b001;
        42:     localparam ADDR      = 3'b010;
        43:     localparam DATA      = 3'b100;
        44:     // [FRTAG 2026-09-14] tag states: second (16B) command after the frame completes
        45:     localparam ADDR_TAG  = 3'b011;
        46:     localparam DATA_TAG  = 3'b101;
        47:
        48:     reg [2 : 0] curr_state/*synthesis PAP_MARK_DEBUG="1"*/;
        49:     // [LEDGER 2026-09-19] both the frame command and the 16B tag command pulse
        50:     // dma_done; only the frame command's completion may advance frame state.
        51:     wire frame_done = dma_done && (curr_state == DATA);
        52:     reg [2 : 0] next_state;
        53:     wire wd_expire;
        54:
        55:     // [FRTAG 2026-09-14] frame-tag declarations (forward, before first use)
        56:     reg                          vsync_pending;
        57:     reg  [AXI_ADDR_WIDTH-1 : 0]  frame_base;
        58:     reg  [31 : 0]                frame_cnt;
        59:     wire [AXI_ADDR_WIDTH-1 : 0]  tag_addr;
        60:     wire                         tag_fire;
        61:
        62:     reg [1 : 0] axi_vsync_ff/*synthesis PAP_MARK_DEBUG="1"*/;
        63:     reg axi_vsync_rise/*synthesis PAP_MARK_DEBUG="1"*/;
        64:
        65:
        66:     reg [AXI_ADDR_WIDTH-1 : 0] cmd_addr;
        67:
        68:
        69:     //状态锟斤拷
        70:     always @(posedge axi_clk) begin
        71:         if(axi_rst)begin
        72:             curr_state <= IDLE;
        73:         end
        74:         else begin
        75:             curr_state <= next_state;
        76:         end
        77:     end
        78:
        79:     always @(*) begin
        80:         case (curr_state)
        81:             IDLE: begin
        82:                 if(vsync_pending)begin
        83:                     next_state = ADDR;
        84:                 end
        85:                 else begin
        86:                     next_state = IDLE;
        87:                 end
        88:             end
        89:             ADDR: begin
        90:                 if(axi_cmd_ready & axi_cmd_valid)begin
        91:                     next_state = DATA;
        92:                 end
        93:                 else if(wd_expire)begin
        94:                     next_state = IDLE;      // [WD2] cmd_ready stuck -> retry
        95:                 end
        96:                 else begin
        97:                     next_state = ADDR;
        98:                 end
        99:             end
       100:             DATA: begin
       101:                 if(frame_done)begin
       102:                     next_state = ADDR_TAG;              // [FRTAG] frame complete, go write the tag
       103:                 end
       104:                 else if(wd_expire)begin
       105:                     next_state = IDLE;                  // [FIX] retry next vsync
       106:                 end
       107:                 else begin
       108:                     next_state = DATA;
       109:                 end
       110:             end
       111:             ADDR_TAG: begin
       112:                 if(axi_cmd_ready & axi_cmd_valid)begin
       113:                     next_state = DATA_TAG;
       114:                 end
       115:                 else if(wd_expire)begin
       116:                     next_state = IDLE;                  // [FIX]
       117:                 end
       118:                 else begin
       119:                     next_state = ADDR_TAG;
       120:                 end
       121:             end
       122:             DATA_TAG: begin
       123:                 if(tag_fire || wd_expire)begin
       124:                     next_state = IDLE;
       125:                 end
       126:                 else begin
       127:                     next_state = DATA_TAG;
       128:                 end
       129:             end
       130:             default: begin
       131:                 next_state = IDLE;
       132:             end
       133:         endcase
       134:     end
       135:
       136:
       137:     always @(posedge axi_clk) begin
       138:         if(axi_rst)begin
       139:             axi_vsync_ff <= 2'b0;
       140:         end
       141:         else begin
       142:             axi_vsync_ff <= {axi_vsync_ff[0], s_vsync};
       143:         end
       144:     end
       145:
       146:     always @(posedge axi_clk) begin
       147:         if(axi_rst)begin
       148:             axi_vsync_rise <= 1'b0;
       149:         end
       150:         else begin
       151:             axi_vsync_rise <= axi_vsync_ff[0] & (~axi_vsync_ff[1]);
       152:         end
       153:     end
       154:
       155:     reg w_ping;
       156:     always @(posedge axi_clk) begin
       157:         if(axi_rst)begin
       158:             w_ping <= 1'b0;
       159:         end
       160:         else begin
       161:             if(frame_done)begin
       162:                 w_ping <= ~w_ping;
       163:             end
       164:         end
       165:     end
       166:
       167:
       168:     // [FRTAG 2026-09-14] sticky vsync latch: a vsync pulse arriving while the tag
       169:     // states are running must not be lost (previously a 1-cycle rise pulse).
       170:     always @(posedge axi_clk) begin
       171:         if(axi_rst)begin
       172:             vsync_pending <= 1'b0;
       173:         end
       174:         else if(axi_vsync_rise)begin
       175:             vsync_pending <= 1'b1;
       176:         end
       177:         else if((curr_state == IDLE) && vsync_pending)begin
       178:             vsync_pending <= 1'b0;
       179:         end
       180:     end
       181:
       182:     always @(posedge axi_clk) begin
       183:         if(axi_rst)begin
       184:             axi_cmd_valid <= 1'b0;
       185:         end
       186:         else begin
       187:             if((curr_state == IDLE) && vsync_pending)begin
       188:                 axi_cmd_valid <= 1'b1;
       189:             end
       190:             else if(frame_done)begin
       191:                 axi_cmd_valid <= 1'b1;      // [FRTAG] frame done -> present the tag command
       192:             end
       193:             else if(axi_cmd_valid & axi_cmd_ready)begin
       194:                 axi_cmd_valid <= 1'b0;
       195:             end
       196:         end
       197:     end
       198:
       199:
       200:     always @(posedge axi_clk) begin
       201:         if(w_ping)begin
       202:             cmd_addr <= cam_data_addr_2;
       203:         end
       204:         else begin
       205:             cmd_addr <= cam_data_addr_1;
       206:         end
       207:     end
       208:
       209:     assign axi_cmd_addr = (curr_state == ADDR_TAG) ? tag_addr : cmd_addr;
       210:     // [FRTAG 2026-09-14] tag command = one 16-byte beat at frame_base + frame size
       211:     assign axi_cmd_len  = (curr_state == ADDR_TAG) ? 32'd16
       212:                         : {{AXI_LEN_WIDTH-4-$clog2(CAM_DATA_LEN){1'd0}}, cam_data_len, 4'b0};
       213:
       214:
       215:     // [FRTAG 2026-09-14] frame counter + tag beat generation --------------------
       216:     // frame_base is latched when the FRAME command is accepted (cmd_addr still
       217:     // points at the buffer being written at that moment; w_ping flips later).
       218:     always @(posedge axi_clk) begin
       219:         if(axi_rst)begin
       220:             frame_base <= {AXI_ADDR_WIDTH{1'b0}};
       221:         end
       222:         else if((curr_state == ADDR) && axi_cmd_valid && axi_cmd_ready)begin
       223:             frame_base <= cmd_addr;
       224:         end
       225:     end
       226:
       227:     assign tag_addr = frame_base + (CAM_DATA_LEN << 4);
       228:
       229:     always @(posedge axi_clk) begin
       230:         if(axi_rst)begin
       231:             frame_cnt <= 32'd0;
       232:         end
       233:         else if(frame_done)begin
       234:             frame_cnt <= frame_cnt + 32'd1;
       235:         end
       236:     end
       237:
       238:     assign tag_active  = (curr_state == DATA_TAG);
       239:     assign tag_data    = {{(AXI_DATA_WIDTH-32){1'b0}}, frame_cnt};
       240:     assign tag_fire    = tag_active & tag_ready;
       241:     // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
       242:
       243:
       244:     //XDMA乒锟斤拷锟斤拷锟斤拷
       245:     reg [1 : 0] s_xdma_req;
       246:     always @(posedge axi_clk) begin
       247:         if(axi_rst)begin
       248:             s_xdma_req <= 2'b0;
       249:         end
       250:         else begin
       251:             if(frame_done)begin
       252:                 if(w_ping)begin
       253:                     s_xdma_req[1] <= 1'b1;
       254:                 end
       255:                 else begin
       256:                     s_xdma_req[0] <= 1'b1;
       257:                 end
       258:             end
       259:             else begin
       260:                 if(xdma_ack[0]) begin
       261:                     s_xdma_req[0] <= 1'b0;
       262:                 end
       263:                 if(xdma_ack[1]) begin
       264:                     s_xdma_req[1] <= 1'b0;
       265:                 end
       266:             end
       267:         end
       268:     end
       269:
       270:     assign xdma_req = s_xdma_req;
       271:     assign dbg_state = {29'd0, curr_state};
       272:     assign engine_busy = (curr_state != IDLE);
       273:
       274:     // [FIX 2026-09-18] frame-write watchdog: a frame that does not complete
       275:     // (lost/short camera stream) used to wedge this FSM in DATA forever. Bail
       276:     // back to IDLE after ~0.16 s and retry on the next vsync.
       277:     reg [31:0] wd_cnt;
       278:     // [WDFIX 2026-09-19] reset the budget on every state CHANGE, not only in
       279:     // IDLE: a frame that burns the budget in DATA (slow DMA close with the B
       280:     // path dead) used to make the immediately following ADDR_TAG/DATA_TAG
       281:     // expire instantly, silently skipping the frame-tag write.
       282:     reg [2:0] wd_prev_state;
       283:     always @(posedge axi_clk) begin
       284:         if(axi_rst) wd_prev_state <= IDLE;
       285:         else        wd_prev_state <= curr_state;
       286:     end
       287:     always @(posedge axi_clk) begin
       288:         if(axi_rst || (curr_state == IDLE) || (curr_state != wd_prev_state)) wd_cnt <= 32'd0;
       289:         else if(wd_cnt != 32'hffffffff)     wd_cnt <= wd_cnt + 32'd1;
       290:     end
       291:     assign wd_expire = (wd_cnt >= 32'd20_000_000);
       292:     assign dbg_wd_cnt = wd_cnt;
       293:
       294:     reg [31:0] last_cnt;
       295:     always @(posedge axi_clk) begin
       296:         if(axi_rst) last_cnt <= 32'd0;
       297:         else if(frame_done) last_cnt <= last_cnt + 32'd1;
       298:     end
       299:     assign dbg_last_cnt = last_cnt;
       300:
       301:
       302:
       303:
       304: endmodule
      
      ### source/axi_dma/axi_dma_write.v
         1: module axi_dma_write
         2: 	#(
         3: 		parameter 		BURST_LEN 	= 8		,
         4: 		parameter       ID_WIDTH  	= 4		,
         5: 		parameter       DATA_WIDTH 	= 128	,
         6: 		parameter       KEEP_WIDTH  = DATA_WIDTH / 8
         7: 	)
         8: 	(
         9: 	input 				clk 			,    // Clock
        10: 	input 				rst 			,    // Synchronous reset active high
        11:
        12: 	//cmd interface
        13: 	input       	 					cmd_valid		,
        14: 	input 			[31:0] 				cmd_addr		,
        15: 	input 			[31:0] 				cmd_len			,
        16: 	input			[ID_WIDTH - 1:0]    cmd_id          ,
        17: 	output reg  	    				cmd_ready		,
        18:
        19: 	//trans data in
        20: 	input 			[DATA_WIDTH - 1:0]  data_in      	,
        21: 	input			[KEEP_WIDTH - 1:0]	data_in_keep	,
        22: 	input         						data_in_valid	,
        23: 	output reg                          data_in_last    ,
        24: 	output        						data_in_ready	,
        25:
        26: 	//axi w
        27: 	output reg		[ID_WIDTH - 1:0]   			m_axi_awid   	,
        28: 	output reg		[31:0]  					m_axi_awaddr 	,
        29: 	output reg		[7:0]   					m_axi_awlen  	,
        30: 	output 			[2:0]   					m_axi_awsize 	,
        31: 	output 			[1:0]   					m_axi_awburst	,
        32: 	output 		    	    					m_axi_awlock 	,
        33: 	output 			[3:0]   					m_axi_awcache	,
        34: 	output 			[2:0]   					m_axi_awprot	,
        35: 	output reg		        					m_axi_awvalid	,
        36: 	input  		 	        					m_axi_awready	,
        37: 	output 			[DATA_WIDTH - 1:0] 			m_axi_wdata		,
        38: 	output 			[KEEP_WIDTH - 1:0]  		m_axi_wstrb		,
        39: 	output 			        					m_axi_wlast		,
        40: 	output 			        					m_axi_wvalid	,
        41: 	input  			        					m_axi_wready	,
        42: 	input  			[ID_WIDTH - 1:0]   			m_axi_bid  		,
        43: 	input  			[1:0]   					m_axi_bresp 	,
        44: 	input  			        					m_axi_bvalid	,
        45: 	output 			        					m_axi_bready
        46:
        47: );
        48:
        49:
        50: localparam AXI_BURST_SIZE = $clog2(KEEP_WIDTH); //log2(DATA_WIDTH / 8)
        51:
        52: // [WD 2026-09-18] transmit watchdog state
        53: reg        abort_r;
        54: reg [23:0] wd_cnt;
        55: wire       w_progress;
        56: wire       abort_done;
        57:
        58: wire [DATA_WIDTH - 1:0] 		t_m_axi_wdata;
        59: wire [KEEP_WIDTH - 1:0]  		t_m_axi_wstrb;
        60: wire         					t_m_axi_wlast;
        61: wire         					t_m_axi_wvalid;
        62: wire         					t_m_axi_wready;
        63:
        64: //common para
        65: assign m_axi_awsize 	= 		AXI_BURST_SIZE	;
        66: assign m_axi_awburst 	= 		2'b01			;
        67: assign m_axi_awlock 	= 		1'b0			;
        68: assign m_axi_awcache 	= 		4'b0011			;
        69: assign m_axi_awprot 	= 		3'b000			;
        70:
        71:
        72: wire [7:0] burst_len    ;
        73: wire [7:0] max_burst_len;
        74:
        75: //cmd
        76: reg [31:0] addr;
        77: reg [31:0] len;
        78: reg        trans;
        79:
        80: always @(posedge clk) begin
        81: 	if((cmd_ready == 1'b1) && (cmd_valid == 1'b1))begin
        82: 		addr <= cmd_addr;
        83: 	end
        84: 	else begin
        85: 		if((m_axi_awvalid == 1'b1) && (m_axi_awready == 1'b1))begin
        86: 			addr <= addr + ((m_axi_awlen + 1'b1) << AXI_BURST_SIZE);
        87: 		end
        88: 	end
        89: end
        90:
        91: always @(posedge clk) begin
        92: 	if((cmd_ready == 1'b1) && (cmd_valid == 1'b1))begin
        93: 		len <= cmd_len[31:AXI_BURST_SIZE] + (|cmd_len[AXI_BURST_SIZE - 1:0]);
        94: 	end
        95: 	else begin
        96: 		if((m_axi_awvalid == 1'b1) && (m_axi_awready == 1'b1))begin
        97: 			len <= len - (m_axi_awlen + 1'b1);
        98: 		end
        99: 		else if(abort_done == 1'b1)begin
       100: 			len <= 32'd0;       // [WD]
       101: 		end
       102: 	end
       103: end
       104: always @(posedge clk)begin
       105: 	if(rst == 1'b1)begin
       106: 		trans <= 1'b0;
       107: 	end
       108: 	else begin
       109: 		if((cmd_ready == 1'b1) && (cmd_valid == 1'b1))begin
       110: 			trans <= 1'b1;
       111: 		end
       112: 		else begin
       113: 			if((m_axi_bready == 1'b1) && (m_axi_bvalid == 1'b1) && (len == 32'd0))begin
       114: 				trans <= 1'b0;
       115: 			end
       116: 			else if(abort_done == 1'b1)begin
       117: 				trans <= 1'b0;      // [WD] release the stuck transaction
       118: 			end
       119: 		end
       120: 	end
       121: end
       122:
       123: always @(posedge  clk)begin
       124: 	if(rst == 1'b1)begin
       125: 		cmd_ready <= 1'b0;
       126: 	end
       127: 	else begin
       128: 		if(trans == 1'b0)begin
       129: 			if((cmd_ready == 1'b1) && (cmd_valid == 1'b1))begin
       130: 				cmd_ready <= 1'b0;
       131: 			end
       132: 			else begin
       133: 				cmd_ready <= 1'b1;
       134: 			end
       135: 		end
       136: 		else begin
       137: 			cmd_ready <= 1'b0;
       138: 		end
       139: 	end
       140: end
       141:
       142: //aw
       143:
       144: reg burst_trans;
       145: assign burst_len     = len > BURST_LEN ? BURST_LEN : len;
       146: assign max_burst_len = (((addr & 12'hfff) + (burst_len << AXI_BURST_SIZE )) >> 12)  != 0 ? (13'h1000 - (addr & 12'hfff)) >> AXI_BURST_SIZE : burst_len;
       147: always@(posedge clk)begin
       148: 	if(rst == 1'b1)begin
       149: 		burst_trans <= 1'b0;
       150: 	end
       151: 	else begin
       152: 		if((m_axi_awvalid == 1'b1) && (m_axi_awready == 1'b1))begin
       153: 			burst_trans <= 1'b1;
       154: 		end
       155: 		else begin
       156: 			// if((m_axi_wvalid == 1'b1) && (m_axi_wready == 1'b1) && (m_axi_wlast == 1'b1))begin
       157: 			if((m_axi_bvalid == 1'b1) && (m_axi_bready == 1'b1))begin
       158: 				burst_trans <= 1'b0;
       159: 			end
       160: 			else if(abort_done == 1'b1)begin
       161: 				burst_trans <= 1'b0;   // [WD2] force-release; B may never arrive
       162: 			end
       163: 		end
       164: 	end
       165: end
       166: always @(posedge clk)begin
       167: 	if(rst == 1'b1)begin
       168: 		m_axi_awvalid <= 1'b0;
       169: 	end
       170: 	else begin
       171: 		if((m_axi_awvalid == 1'b1) && (m_axi_awready == 1'b1))begin
       172: 			m_axi_awvalid <= 1'b0;
       173: 		end
       174: 		else begin
       175: 			if((burst_trans == 1'b0) && (len != 32'd0) && (abort_r == 1'b0))begin
       176: 				m_axi_awvalid <= 1'b1;
       177: 			end
       178: 		end
       179: 	end
       180: end
       181:
       182: always @(posedge clk)begin
       183: 	m_axi_awlen <= max_burst_len - 8'd1;
       184: end
       185: always @(posedge clk)begin
       186: 	m_axi_awaddr <= addr;
       187: end
       188: always @(posedge clk) begin
       189: 	if((cmd_ready == 1'b1) && (cmd_valid == 1'b1))begin
       190: 		m_axi_awid <= cmd_id;
       191: 	end
       192: end
       193: //w
       194: reg [7:0] act_burst_len;
       195: always@ (posedge clk)begin
       196: 	if(rst == 1'b1)begin
       197: 		act_burst_len <= 8'd0;
       198: 	end
       199: 	else begin
       200: 		if((m_axi_awvalid == 1'b1) && (m_axi_awready == 1'b1))begin
       201: 			act_burst_len <= m_axi_awlen + 8'd1;
       202: 		end
       203: 		else begin
       204: 			if((t_m_axi_wvalid == 1'b1) && (t_m_axi_wready == 1'b1))begin
       205: 				act_burst_len <= act_burst_len - 8'd1;
       206: 			end
       207: 		end
       208: 	end
       209: end
       210:
       211: // [WD 2026-09-18] ------------------------------------------------------------------
       212: // The DVP stream can deliver fewer 128-bit beats than CAM_DATA_LEN (CDC FIFO
       213: // overflow drops pixels and cannot back-pressure the sensor). A frame's AXI
       214: // burst then never completes: trans sticks at 1, cmd_ready stays low and the
       215: // frame FSM deadlocks forever (measured: state=ADDR, axi_cnt=0, 0 frames).
       216: //
       217: // Recovery: if there is no W-beat progress for ~0.17 s while a write is in
       218: // flight, close the open burst with dummy beats. AXI forbids cancelling an
       219: // accepted AW, so we must still supply awlen beats; we just no longer consume
       220: // real camera data. After the B response is absorbed, trans/len clear and the
       221: // next frame's command is accepted again (only the bad frame is lost).
       222: assign w_progress = (t_m_axi_wvalid == 1'b1) && (t_m_axi_wready == 1'b1);
       223:
       224: always @(posedge clk) begin
       225: 	if((rst == 1'b1) || (trans == 1'b0) || (abort_r == 1'b1) || (w_progress == 1'b1))
       226: 		wd_cnt <= 24'd0;
       227: 	else if(wd_cnt != 24'hFFFFFF)
       228: 		wd_cnt <= wd_cnt + 24'd1;
       229: end
       230:
       231: // [BFAST 2026-09-19] the DDR write port can stop returning B responses
       232: // (see [WD2]; re-observed 09-19: b_cnt ~26 total while aw_cnt ~60k).
       233: // Waiting the full 0.17 s watchdog once every command's beats are out
       234: // capped the camera path at ~5 fps. Give B a few microseconds after the
       235: // last beat, then force the close via the abort path; a late B is still
       236: // absorbed by the w_done/bready logic.
       237: reg [9:0] bwait_cnt;
       238: // (w_done intentionally not referenced: it is declared further below and
       239: // act_burst_len==0 && burst_trans already means every beat is out, B pending)
       240: wire all_beats_out = (len == 32'd0) && (act_burst_len == 8'd0) && burst_trans;
       241: always @(posedge clk) begin
       242: 	if((rst == 1'b1) || (trans == 1'b0) || (all_beats_out == 1'b0) || (abort_r == 1'b1))
       243: 		bwait_cnt <= 10'd0;
       244: 	else if(bwait_cnt != 10'h3FF)
       245: 		bwait_cnt <= bwait_cnt + 10'd1;
       246: end
       247: always @(posedge clk) begin
       248: 	if(rst == 1'b1)
       249: 		abort_r <= 1'b0;
       250: 	// [BFAST2 2026-09-19] bwait fast-close DISABLED: B latency under DDR contention
       251: 	// can legitimately exceed the 10us grace; force-closing mid-flight corrupted
       252: 	// the crossbar/DDR transaction stream and killed M00 writes within seconds.
       253: 	// Fall back to the long send-watchdog only.
       254: 	else if((abort_r == 1'b0) && (trans == 1'b1) && (wd_cnt == 24'hFFFFFF))
       255: 		abort_r <= 1'b1;
       256: 	else if(abort_done == 1'b1)
       257: 		abort_r <= 1'b0;
       258: end
       259:
       260: // [WD2 2026-09-18] burst_trans is only cleared by the B response, which is
       261: // exactly what never arrives in the wedge case (cam2: bvalid never asserted).
       262: // Requiring burst_trans==0 made abort_done unreachable -> no recovery.
       263: // All W beats for the open burst are out once act_burst_len hits 0, so that
       264: // is the correct release point; burst_trans is force-cleared below.
       265: assign abort_done = abort_r && (act_burst_len == 8'd0);
       266: // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------
       267:
       268: stream_pipe #(
       269:   .DATA_WIDTH 	(DATA_WIDTH+1+KEEP_WIDTH)
       270: ) stream_pipe_3(
       271:   .dataIn_valid     (t_m_axi_wvalid),
       272:   .dataIn_ready     (t_m_axi_wready),
       273:   .dataIn_payload   ({t_m_axi_wdata, t_m_axi_wstrb, t_m_axi_wlast}),
       274:   .dataOut_valid    (m_axi_wvalid),
       275:   .dataOut_ready    (m_axi_wready),
       276:   .dataOut_payload  ({m_axi_wdata, m_axi_wstrb, m_axi_wlast}),
       277:   .clk              (clk),
       278:   .reset            (rst)
       279: );
       280:
       281: assign data_in_ready = abort_r ? 1'b0
       282:                                : (t_m_axi_wready && act_burst_len > 8'd0);
       283: assign t_m_axi_wvalid  = abort_r ? (act_burst_len > 8'd0)
       284:                                  : (data_in_valid && act_burst_len > 8'd0);
       285: assign t_m_axi_wdata   = abort_r ? {DATA_WIDTH{1'b0}} : data_in;
       286: assign t_m_axi_wlast   = (act_burst_len == 8'd1);
       287: assign t_m_axi_wstrb   = abort_r ? {KEEP_WIDTH{1'b1}} : data_in_keep;
       288:
       289: //b
       290: reg w_done;
       291: always @(posedge clk) begin
       292: 	if(rst == 1'b1) begin
       293: 		w_done <= 1'b0;
       294: 	end
       295: 	else begin
       296: 		if((t_m_axi_wvalid == 1'b1) && (t_m_axi_wready == 1'b1) && (t_m_axi_wlast == 1'b1)) begin
       297: 			w_done <= 1'b1;
       298: 		end
       299: 		else begin
       300: 			if((m_axi_bvalid == 1'b1) && (m_axi_bready == 1'b1)) begin
       301: 				w_done <= 1'b0;
       302: 			end
       303: 		end
       304: 	end
       305: end

        18:     parameter  V_CMOS_DISP = 11'd480    , //CMOS锟街憋拷锟斤拷--锟斤拷
        19:     parameter  TOTAL_H_PIXEL = 12'd1896, //水平锟斤拷锟斤拷锟截达拷小 (28.58帧)
        20:     parameter  TOTAL_V_PIXEL = 12'd984 , // [56M/30fps]锟斤拷直锟斤拷锟斤拷锟截达拷小 (28.58帧)
        21:     parameter  CAM_DATA_LEN  = H_CMOS_DISP * V_CMOS_DISP * DATA_WIDTH/8 / 16, //1280*720 * 2 /16
        22:
        23:     //锟斤拷锟斤拷头锟斤拷锟斤拷锟斤拷苹锟斤拷锟街�
        24:     parameter BASE_ADDR = 32'h2000_0000,

        37:     //   MEDIAN_EN=1 -> 3x3 median independently on R/G/B, with replicated
        38:     //                  image boundaries and one pixel accepted per clock.
        39:     parameter        MEDIAN_EN      = 1'b0,

        41: )(

        50:     input         dbg_axi_bvalid        ,

        59:     output        cam_pwdn              ,  //锟斤拷源锟斤拷锟斤拷模式选锟斤拷 0锟斤拷锟斤拷锟斤拷模 1锟斤拷锟斤拷源锟斤拷锟斤拷模
        60:     output        cam_scl               ,  //cmos SCCB_SCL

        73:

        75:     input                             s_axi_bready          /*synthesis PAP_MARK_DEBUG="1"*/,

        79:     output                            s_axi_arready         /*synthesis PAP_MARK_DEBUG="1"*/,

        81:

        84:     output [AXI_ADDR_WIDTH-1 : 0]     s_axi_rdata           /*synthesis PAP_MARK_DEBUG="1"*/,
        85:     output [ 1 : 0]                   s_axi_rresp           /*synthesis PAP_MARK_DEBUG="1"*/,
        86:

        90:     input                          video_clk      /*synthesis PAP_MARK_DEBUG="1"*/,

        93:     output [AXI_ADDR_WIDTH-1 : 0]  cam_cmd_addr    /*synthesis PAP_MARK_DEBUG="1"*/,
        94:     output [AXI_LEN_WIDTH-1 : 0]   cam_cmd_len     /*synthesis PAP_MARK_DEBUG="1"*/,
        95:     output                         cam_cmd_valid   /*synthesis PAP_MARK_DEBUG="1"*/,

       100:     output                        cam_s_data_last  /*synthesis PAP_MARK_DEBUG="1"*/,

       139:     wire                    video_vsync ;

       144:     wire [31:0]   dbg_pclk_cnt;

       148:
       149: // ---------------- 锟斤拷锟斤拷锟睫革拷锟斤拷锟斤拷使锟斤拷 GTP_IODELAY_E2 锟斤拷锟叫撅拷细锟接迟碉拷锟斤拷 ----------------
       150:
       151:     // 锟斤拷锟斤拷锟斤拷锟斤拷锟接迟碉拷锟斤拷锟斤拷锟斤拷藕锟�
       152:     wire         cam_vsync_dly;
       153:     wire         cam_href_dly;
       154:     wire [7 : 0] cam_data_dly;
       155:
       156:     // 锟斤拷锟斤拷锟接迟诧拷锟斤拷值 (0~255)
       157:     // IODELAY_STEP is a header parameter now (overridable per instance)
       158:
       159:     // --- 锟斤拷锟斤拷锟脚猴拷锟接筹拷锟斤拷锟斤拷 ---
       160:     GTP_IODELAY_E2 #(
       161:         .DELAY_STEP_VALUE(IODELAY_STEP),
       162:         .DELAY_STEP_SEL("PARAMETER"),
       163:         .TDELAY_EN("FALSE")
       164:     ) u_iodelay_vsync (
       165:         .DO         (cam_vsync_dly),
       166:         .DELAY_SEL  (1'b0),
       167:         .DI         (cam_vsync),
       168:         .EN_N       (1'b0),
       169:         .DELAY_STEP (8'b0)
       170:     );
       171:
       172:     GTP_IODELAY_E2 #(
       173:         .DELAY_STEP_VALUE(IODELAY_STEP),
       174:         .DELAY_STEP_SEL("PARAMETER"),
       175:         .TDELAY_EN("FALSE")
       176:     ) u_iodelay_href (
       177:         .DO         (cam_href_dly),
       178:         .DELAY_SEL  (1'b0),
       179:         .DI         (cam_href),
       180:         .EN_N       (1'b0),
       181:         .DELAY_STEP (8'b0)
       182:     );
       183:
       184:     // --- 锟斤拷锟斤拷锟脚猴拷(cam_data)锟接筹拷锟斤拷锟斤拷 ---
       185:     genvar i;
       186:     generate
       187:         for (i = 0; i < 8; i = i + 1) begin : cam_data_iodelay
       188:             GTP_IODELAY_E2 #(
       189:                 .DELAY_STEP_VALUE(IODELAY_STEP),
       190:                 .DELAY_STEP_SEL("PARAMETER"),
       191:                 .TDELAY_EN("FALSE")
       192:             ) u_iodelay_data (
       193:                 .DO         (cam_data_dly[i]),
       194:                 .DELAY_SEL  (1'b0),
       195:                 .DI         (cam_data[i]),
       196:                 .EN_N       (1'b0),
       197:                 .DELAY_STEP (8'b0)
       198:             );
       199:         end
       200:     endgenerate
       201: // ---------------- 锟斤拷锟斤拷锟睫革拷锟斤拷锟斤拷 锟斤拷锟斤拷 ----------------
       202:
       203:
       204:     ov5640 #(
       205:         //DVP锟斤拷锟斤拷
       206:         .DATA_WIDTH(DATA_WIDTH),
       207:         //I2C
       208:         .SLAVE_ADDR(SLAVE_ADDR)   ,      //I2C锟接伙拷锟斤拷址
       209:         .BIT_CTRL  (BIT_CTRL)     ,      //OV5640锟斤拷锟街节碉拷址为16位  0:8位 1:16位
       210:         .CLK_FREQ  (CLK_FREQ)     ,      //模锟斤拷锟斤拷锟斤拷锟绞憋拷锟狡碉拷锟�
       211:         .I2C_FREQ  (I2C_FREQ)     ,      //IIC_SCL锟斤拷时锟斤拷频锟斤拷
       212:
       213:         //锟斤拷锟斤拷
       214:         .H_CMOS_DISP(H_CMOS_DISP), //CMOS锟街憋拷锟斤拷--锟斤拷
       215:         .V_CMOS_DISP(V_CMOS_DISP), //CMOS锟街憋拷锟斤拷--锟斤拷
       216:         .TOTAL_H_PIXEL(TOTAL_H_PIXEL), //水平锟斤拷锟斤拷锟截达拷小
       217:         .TOTAL_V_PIXEL(TOTAL_V_PIXEL), //锟斤拷直锟斤拷锟斤拷锟截达拷小
       218:
       219:         //锟藉卡锟借备
       220:         .DEVICE(DEVICE)
       221:     )
       222:     ov5640(
       223:         .clk_50m            (clk_50m      ),  // i2c锟侥参匡拷时锟斤拷Clock
       224:         .rst_n              (clk_50m_rst_n),  // Asynchronous reset active low
       225:
       226:         .ov_rst_n           (ov_rst_n ),
       227:         .cam_pclk           (cam_pclk ),  //cmos 锟斤拷锟斤拷锟斤拷锟斤拷时锟斤拷
       228:         // 使锟矫撅拷锟斤拷锟接迟达拷锟斤拷锟斤拷锟脚猴拷锟芥换原始锟杰斤拷锟脚猴拷
       229:         .cam_vsync          (cam_vsync_dly),  //cmos 锟斤拷同锟斤拷锟脚猴拷
       230:         .cam_href           (cam_href_dly ),  //cmos 锟斤拷同锟斤拷锟脚猴拷
       231:         .cam_data           (cam_data_dly ),  //cmos 锟斤拷锟斤拷
       232:
       233:         .cam_rst_n          (cam_rst_n),  //cmos 锟斤拷位锟脚号ｏ拷锟酵碉拷平锟斤拷效
       234:         .cam_pwdn           (cam_pwdn ),  //锟斤拷源锟斤拷锟斤拷模式选锟斤拷 0锟斤拷锟斤拷锟斤拷模式 1锟斤拷锟斤拷源锟斤拷锟斤拷模式
       235:         .cam_scl            (cam_scl  ),  //cmos SCCB_SCL锟斤拷
       236:         .cam_sda            (cam_sda  ),  //cmos SCCB_SDA锟斤拷
       237:
       238:         .video_clk          (video_clk  ),  // 锟斤拷锟较猴拷锟絉GB锟斤拷取时锟斤拷
       239:         .video_rst          (video_rst  ),
       240:         .video_vsync        (video_vsync),  //帧锟斤拷效锟脚猴拷
       241:         .video_hsync        (video_hsync),  //锟斤拷锟斤拷效锟脚猴拷
       242:         .video_valid        (video_valid),  //锟斤拷锟斤拷锟斤拷效使锟斤拷锟脚猴拷
       243:         .video_data         (video_data ),  //锟斤拷效锟斤拷锟斤拷
       244:         .dbg_i2c_status     (dbg_i2c_status),
       245:         .dbg_pclk_cnt       (dbg_pclk_cnt ),
       246:         .dbg_sys_status     (dbg_sys_status),
       247:         .dbg_href_raw       (dbg_href_raw  ),
       248:         .dbg_vsync_raw      (dbg_vsync_raw )
       249:
       250:     );
       251:
       252:     // ------------- VIP: RGB565 3x3 median filter, cam1 only -------------
       253:     // Taps the 16-bit RGB565 stream produced by the capture block and hands it to
       254:     // the DDR write packer. The module owns 2 line buffers (~2 lines of latency),
       255:     // re-times vsync and drops the camera tail dummy beat, so ov5640_ddr still sees
       256:     // exactly W*H pixels per frame. MEDIAN_EN=0 selects a pure wire bypass, so a
       257:     // camera without filtering keeps its original timing and uses no BRAM.
       258:     wire                    sh_video_valid;
       259:     wire [DATA_WIDTH-1 : 0] sh_video_data ;
       260:     wire                    sh_video_vsync;
      
      ### source/ov5640/ov5640_ddr/ov5640_ddr_w_ctrl.v
         1: //锟斤拷锟斤拷CMD锟斤拷锟斤拷
         2: module ov5640_ddr_w_ctrl #(
         3:     parameter AXI_ADDR_WIDTH = 32,
         4:     parameter AXI_LEN_WIDTH  = 32,
         5:     parameter AXI_DATA_WIDTH = 128,
         6:     parameter CAM_DATA_LEN   = 172800 //1280*720*3/16
         7: )(
         8:     input          axi_clk        ,
         9:     input          axi_rst        ,
        10:
        11:     input  [AXI_ADDR_WIDTH-1 : 0]      cam_data_addr_1,
        12:     input  [AXI_ADDR_WIDTH-1 : 0]      cam_data_addr_2,
        13:     input  [$clog2(CAM_DATA_LEN) : 0]  cam_data_len   , //锟斤拷16锟街斤拷为锟斤拷位
        14:
        15:     input          s_vsync        ,
        16:
        17:     input          dma_done       ,  // [LEDGER 2026-09-19] DMA transaction-done pulse (authoritative beat ledger)
        18:
        19:     output [AXI_ADDR_WIDTH-1 : 0]  axi_cmd_addr   /*synthesis PAP_MARK_DEBUG="1"*/,
        20:     output [AXI_LEN_WIDTH-1 : 0]   axi_cmd_len    /*synthesis PAP_MARK_DEBUG="1"*/,
        21:     output reg                     axi_cmd_valid  /*synthesis PAP_MARK_DEBUG="1"*/,
        22:     input                          axi_cmd_ready  /*synthesis PAP_MARK_DEBUG="1"*/,
        23:
        24:     output [1 : 0]   xdma_req       ,
        25:     input  [1 : 0]   xdma_ack       ,
        26:
        27:     // [FRTAG 2026-09-14] frame-tag injection. After each frame's last stream beat the
        28:     // FSM issues a SECOND 16-byte AXI command writing a 32-bit frame counter to
        29:     // frame_base + CAM_DATA_LEN*16. The wrapper (ov5640_ddr.v) muxes tag_data onto
        30:     // the data stream while tag_active is high. The transaction must complete:
        31:     // aborting it would leave a pending frame with no new tag for the host.
        32:     output                           tag_active     ,
        33:     output [AXI_DATA_WIDTH-1 : 0]    tag_data       ,
        34:     input                            tag_ready,
        35:     output [31:0]                    dbg_state,
        36:     output                           engine_busy,     // [IDLEGATE 2026-09-19] FSM not IDLE (frame or tag in flight)
        37:     output [31:0]                    dbg_last_cnt,
        38:     output [31:0]                    dbg_wd_cnt
        39: );
        40:
        41:     localparam IDLE      = 3'b001;
        42:     localparam ADDR      = 3'b010;
        43:     localparam DATA      = 3'b100;
        44:     // [FRTAG 2026-09-14] tag states: second (16B) command after the frame completes
        45:     localparam ADDR_TAG  = 3'b011;
        46:     localparam DATA_TAG  = 3'b101;
        47:
        48:     reg [2 : 0] curr_state/*synthesis PAP_MARK_DEBUG="1"*/;
        49:     // [LEDGER 2026-09-19] both the frame command and the 16B tag command pulse
        50:     // dma_done; only the frame command's completion may advance frame state.
        51:     wire frame_done = dma_done && (curr_state == DATA);
        52:     reg [2 : 0] next_state;
        53:     wire wd_expire;
        54:
        55:     // [FRTAG 2026-09-14] frame-tag declarations (forward, before first use)
        56:     reg                          vsync_pending;
        57:     reg  [AXI_ADDR_WIDTH-1 : 0]  frame_base;
        58:     reg  [31 : 0]                frame_cnt;
        59:     wire [AXI_ADDR_WIDTH-1 : 0]  tag_addr;
        60:     wire                         tag_fire;
        61:
        62:     reg [1 : 0] axi_vsync_ff/*synthesis PAP_MARK_DEBUG="1"*/;
        63:     reg axi_vsync_rise/*synthesis PAP_MARK_DEBUG="1"*/;
        64:
        65:
        66:     reg [AXI_ADDR_WIDTH-1 : 0] cmd_addr;
        67:
        68:
        69:     //状态锟斤拷
        70:     always @(posedge axi_clk) begin
        71:         if(axi_rst)begin
        72:             curr_state <= IDLE;
        73:         end
        74:         else begin
        75:             curr_state <= next_state;
        76:         end
        77:     end
        78:
        79:     always @(*) begin
        80:         case (curr_state)
        81:             IDLE: begin
        82:                 if(vsync_pending)begin
        83:                     next_state = ADDR;
        84:                 end
        85:                 else begin
        86:                     next_state = IDLE;
        87:                 end
        88:             end
        89:             ADDR: begin
        90:                 if(axi_cmd_ready & axi_cmd_valid)begin
        91:                     next_state = DATA;
        92:                 end
        93:                 else if(wd_expire)begin
        94:                     next_state = IDLE;      // [WD2] cmd_ready stuck -> retry
        95:                 end
        96:                 else begin
        97:                     next_state = ADDR;
        98:                 end
        99:             end
       100:             DATA: begin
       101:                 if(frame_done)begin
       102:                     next_state = ADDR_TAG;              // [FRTAG] frame complete, go write the tag
       103:                 end
       104:                 else if(wd_expire)begin
       105:                     next_state = IDLE;                  // [FIX] retry next vsync
       106:                 end
       107:                 else begin
       108:                     next_state = DATA;
       109:                 end
       110:             end
       111:             ADDR_TAG: begin
       112:                 if(axi_cmd_ready & axi_cmd_valid)begin
       113:                     next_state = DATA_TAG;
       114:                 end
       115:                 else if(wd_expire)begin
       116:                     next_state = IDLE;                  // [FIX]
       117:                 end
       118:                 else begin
       119:                     next_state = ADDR_TAG;
       120:                 end
       121:             end
       122:             DATA_TAG: begin
       123:                 if(tag_fire || wd_expire)begin
       124:                     next_state = IDLE;
       125:                 end
       126:                 else begin
       127:                     next_state = DATA_TAG;
       128:                 end
       129:             end
       130:             default: begin
       131:                 next_state = IDLE;
       132:             end
       133:         endcase
       134:     end
       135:
       136:
       137:     always @(posedge axi_clk) begin
       138:         if(axi_rst)begin
       139:             axi_vsync_ff <= 2'b0;
       140:         end
       141:         else begin
       142:             axi_vsync_ff <= {axi_vsync_ff[0], s_vsync};
       143:         end
       144:     end
       145:
       146:     always @(posedge axi_clk) begin
       147:         if(axi_rst)begin
       148:             axi_vsync_rise <= 1'b0;
       149:         end
       150:         else begin
       151:             axi_vsync_rise <= axi_vsync_ff[0] & (~axi_vsync_ff[1]);
       152:         end
       153:     end
       154:
       155:     reg w_ping;
       156:     always @(posedge axi_clk) begin
       157:         if(axi_rst)begin
       158:             w_ping <= 1'b0;
       159:         end
       160:         else begin

      1422: // ===================== preprocess datapath (PREP, batch-2) =====================

      1426:         prep_frame_cnt <= 8'd0;
      1427:     else if (prep_out_frame_start)
      1428:         prep_frame_cnt <= prep_frame_cnt + 8'd1;
      1429: end

      --250-460--
       250:     );
       251:
       252:     // ------------- VIP: RGB565 3x3 median filter, cam1 only -------------
       253:     // Taps the 16-bit RGB565 stream produced by the capture block and hands it to
       254:     // the DDR write packer. The module owns 2 line buffers (~2 lines of latency),
       255:     // re-times vsync and drops the camera tail dummy beat, so ov5640_ddr still sees
       256:     // exactly W*H pixels per frame. MEDIAN_EN=0 selects a pure wire bypass, so a
       257:     // camera without filtering keeps its original timing and uses no BRAM.
       258:     wire                    sh_video_valid;
       259:     wire [DATA_WIDTH-1 : 0] sh_video_data ;
       260:     wire                    sh_video_vsync;
       261:
       262:     generate
       263:         if (MEDIAN_EN) begin : g_median
       264:             vip #(
       265:                 .W       (H_CMOS_DISP),
       266:                 .H       (V_CMOS_DISP),
       267:                 .STRIDE  (1024),
       268:                 .AW      (10),
       269:                 // Keep the retimed frame marker separate from data without
       270:                 // creating a large producer/consumer backlog at frame end.
       271:                 .GAP_LEN (8)
       272:             ) u_vip (
       273:                 .clk       (video_clk      ),
       274:                 .rst       (video_rst      ),
       275:                 .en        (1'b1           ),
       276:                 .strength  (MEDIAN_RSVD    ),
       277:                 .in_valid  (video_valid    ),
       278:                 .in_pixel  (video_data     ),
       279:                 .in_vsync  (video_vsync    ),
       280:                 .out_valid (sh_video_valid ),
       281:                 .out_pixel (sh_video_data  ),
       282:                 .out_vsync (sh_video_vsync )
       283:             );
       284:         end
       285:         else begin : g_bypass
       286:             assign sh_video_valid = video_valid;
       287:             assign sh_video_data  = video_data ;
       288:             assign sh_video_vsync = video_vsync;
       289:         end
       290:     endgenerate
       291:
       292:     // wire video_rst = !locked;
       293:
       294:     wire                        cam_en    /*synthesis PAP_MARK_DEBUG="1"*/;
       295:     wire [AXI_ADDR_WIDTH-1 : 0] cam_addr_1/*synthesis PAP_MARK_DEBUG="1"*/;
       296:     wire [AXI_ADDR_WIDTH-1 : 0] cam_addr_2/*synthesis PAP_MARK_DEBUG="1"*/;
       297:     wire [1 : 0]  xdma_req  ;
       298:     reg  [31:0]   dbg_beat_cnt;
       299:     reg  [31:0]   dbg_beat_last;
       300:     reg  [31:0]   dbg_cmd_cnt;
       301: wire [31:0]   dbg_axi_cnt;
       302: wire [31:0]   dbg_axi_num;
       303: wire [31:0]   dbg_zdin;
       304: wire [31:0]   dbg_zout;
       305:     wire [31:0]   dbg_state;
       306:     wire [31:0]   dbg_last_cnt;
       307:     wire [31:0]   dbg_wd_cnt;
       308:     reg  [15:0]   dbg_axi_sticky;
       309:     reg  [15:0]   dbg_b_cnt;
       310:     reg  [15:0]   dbg_aw_cnt;
       311:     reg  [15:0]   dbg_w_cnt;
       312:     wire [15:0]   dbg_axi_stat;
       313:     reg  [31:0]   dbg_clk_status;
       314:     wire [1 : 0]  xdma_ack  ;
       315:     ov5640_ddr #(
       316:         .DATA_WIDTH(DATA_WIDTH),
       317:         .AXI_ADDR_WIDTH(AXI_ADDR_WIDTH),
       318:         .AXI_LEN_WIDTH(AXI_LEN_WIDTH),
       319:         .AXI_DATA_WIDTH(AXI_DATA_WIDTH),
       320:         .CAM_DATA_LEN(CAM_DATA_LEN),     //1280*720*3/16
       321:         .DEVICE(DEVICE)
       322:     )
       323:     ov5640_ddr(
       324:         .axi_clk        (video_clk),

       326:
       327:         .axi_cam_en     (cam_en    ),

       329:         .cam_data_addr_1(cam_addr_1),
       330:         .cam_data_addr_2(cam_addr_2),
       331:         .cam_data_len   (CAM_DATA_LEN), //锟斤拷16锟街斤拷为锟斤拷位
       332:
       333:         .s_data         (sh_video_data ),
       334:         .s_data_valid   (sh_video_valid),
       335:         .s_hsync        (video_hsync),
       336:         .s_vsync        (sh_video_vsync),
       337:
       338:         //AXI协锟斤拷锟�
       339:         .axi_data       (cam_s_data      ),
       340:         .axi_data_valid (cam_s_data_valid),
       341:         .axi_data_last  (cam_s_data_last ),
       342:         .axi_data_ready (cam_s_data_ready),
       343:
       344:         .axi_cmd_addr   (cam_cmd_addr  ),
       345:         .axi_cmd_len    (cam_cmd_len   ),
       346:         .axi_cmd_valid  (cam_cmd_valid ),
       347:         .axi_cmd_ready  (cam_cmd_ready ),
       348:
       349:         .dbg_axi_cnt    (dbg_axi_cnt   ),
       350:         .dbg_axi_num    (dbg_axi_num   ),
       351:         .dbg_zdin       (dbg_zdin      ),
       352:         .dbg_zout       (dbg_zout      ),
       353:         .dbg_state      (dbg_state     ),
       354:         .dbg_last_cnt   (dbg_last_cnt  ),
       355:         .dbg_wd_cnt     (dbg_wd_cnt    ),
       356:         .xdma_req       (xdma_req      ),
       357:         .xdma_ack       (xdma_ack      )
       358:     );

       362:
       363:     // [DBG] camera activity counters (read via ov5640_reg +0x30/+0x34)
       364:     reg [31:0] dbg_cam_words;
       365:     always @(posedge video_clk) begin
       366:         if (video_rst) dbg_cam_words <= 32'd0;
       367:         else if (cam_s_data_valid) dbg_cam_words <= dbg_cam_words + 32'd1;
       368:     end
       369:     reg [31:0] dbg_vsyncs;
       370:     reg [2:0]  dbg_vs_ff;
       371:     always @(posedge video_clk) dbg_vs_ff <= {dbg_vs_ff[1:0], video_vsync};
       372:     always @(posedge video_clk) begin
       373:         if (video_rst) dbg_vsyncs <= 32'd0;
       374:         else if (dbg_vs_ff[2:1] == 2'b01) dbg_vsyncs <= dbg_vsyncs + 32'd1;
       375:     end
       376:     // [DBG] href (hsync) activity counter -> ov5640_reg +0x50
       377:     reg [31:0] dbg_hsyncs;
       378:     reg [2:0]  dbg_hs_ff;
       379:     always @(posedge video_clk) dbg_hs_ff <= {dbg_hs_ff[1:0], video_hsync};
       380:     always @(posedge video_clk) begin
       381:         if (video_rst) dbg_hsyncs <= 32'd0;
       382:         else if (dbg_hs_ff[2:1] == 2'b01) dbg_hsyncs <= dbg_hsyncs + 32'd1;
       383:     end
       384:     // [DIAG] AXI beat accounting: how many beats does the engine actually see
       385:     // per camera frame? If this != CAM_DATA_LEN the write FSM deadlocks.
       386:     reg [2:0] dbg_fs_ff;
       387:     always @(posedge video_clk) dbg_fs_ff <= {dbg_fs_ff[1:0], video_vsync};
       388:     wire dbg_frame_edge = (dbg_fs_ff[2:1] == 2'b01);
       389:     always @(posedge video_clk) begin
       390:         if (video_rst) begin
       391:             dbg_beat_cnt  <= 32'd0;
       392:             dbg_beat_last <= 32'd0;
       393:         end
       394:         else if (dbg_frame_edge) begin
       395:             dbg_beat_last <= dbg_beat_cnt;
       396:             dbg_beat_cnt  <= 32'd0;
       397:         end
       398:         else if (cam_s_data_valid & cam_s_data_ready) begin
       399:             dbg_beat_cnt <= dbg_beat_cnt + 32'd1;
       400:         end
       401:     end
       402:     // [DIAG] AXI write handshake visibility (which stage ever happened?)
       403:     // [DIAG2] numeric handshake counters (sticky only says "ever", not "how many")
       404:     always @(posedge video_clk) begin
       405:         if (video_rst) begin
       406:             dbg_b_cnt  <= 16'd0;
       407:             dbg_aw_cnt <= 16'd0;
       408:             dbg_w_cnt  <= 16'd0;
       409:         end
       410:         else begin
       411:             if (dbg_axi_bvalid & dbg_axi_bready) dbg_b_cnt  <= dbg_b_cnt  + 16'd1;
       412:             if (dbg_axi_awvalid & dbg_axi_awready) dbg_aw_cnt <= dbg_aw_cnt + 16'd1;
       413:             if (dbg_axi_wvalid & dbg_axi_wready)  dbg_w_cnt  <= dbg_w_cnt  + 16'd1;
       414:         end
       415:     end
       416:     assign dbg_axi_stat = {5'd0,
       417:         dbg_axi_bready, dbg_axi_bvalid,
       418:         (cam_s_data_valid & cam_s_data_ready),
       419:         cam_s_data_ready, cam_s_data_valid,
       420:         (dbg_axi_wvalid & dbg_axi_wready), dbg_axi_wready, dbg_axi_wvalid,
       421:         (dbg_axi_awvalid & dbg_axi_awready), dbg_axi_awready, dbg_axi_awvalid};
       422:     always @(posedge video_clk) begin
       423:         if (video_rst) dbg_axi_sticky <= 16'd0;
       424:         else           dbg_axi_sticky <= dbg_axi_sticky | dbg_axi_stat;
       425:     end
       426:     // [DIAG] frame commands issued by ov5640_ddr_w_ctrl (idle->addr transitions)
       427:     reg dbg_cmd_d;
       428:     always @(posedge video_clk) begin
       429:         if (video_rst) begin
       430:             dbg_cmd_d   <= 1'b0;
       431:             dbg_cmd_cnt <= 32'd0;
       432:         end
       433:         else begin
       434:             dbg_cmd_d <= cam_cmd_valid;
       435:             if (cam_cmd_valid & ~dbg_cmd_d)
       436:                 dbg_cmd_cnt <= dbg_cmd_cnt + 32'd1;
       437:         end
       438:     end
       439:
       440: // [DBG] clk_50m activity counter + lock/button snapshot (sampled in video_clk)
       441: reg [15:0] dbg_clk50_cnt;
       442: always @(posedge clk_50m) dbg_clk50_cnt <= dbg_clk50_cnt + 16'd1;
       443: always @(posedge video_clk) dbg_clk_status <= {dbg_clk50_cnt, dbg_locked, dbg_btn_rst_n};
       444:     ov5640_reg #(
       445:
       446:         .BASE_ADDR(BASE_ADDR),
       447:         .CAM_ADDR_1_DEF(CAM_ADDR_1_DEF),
       448:         .CAM_ADDR_2_DEF(CAM_ADDR_2_DEF),
       449:         .CAM_EN_DEF   (CAM_EN_DEF   ),
       450:         .AXI_ADDR_WIDTH(AXI_ADDR_WIDTH)
       451:     )
       452:     ov5640_reg(
       453:         .clk                   (video_clk    ),
