        41:     case (curr_state)
        42:         IDLE: begin
        43:                 if(s_vsync_rise & axi_cam_en && !engine_busy) begin  // [IDLEGATE 2026-09-19] admit a frame only when the engine finished the previous one
        44:                 next_state = DATA;
        45:             end
        46:             else begin
        47:                 next_state = IDLE;
        48:             end
        49:         end
        50:         DATA: begin
        51:             if(s_vsync_rise) begin
        52:                     if(axi_cam_en && !engine_busy) begin  // [IDLEGATE] engine wedged mid-frame: drop the rest at this vsync
        53:                     next_state = DATA;
        54:                 end
        55:                 else begin
        56:                     next_state = IDLE;
        57:                 end
        58:             end
        59:             else begin
        60:                 next_state = DATA;
        61:             end
        62:         end
        63:         default: begin
        64:             next_state = IDLE;
        65:         end
        66:     endcase
        67: end
        68:
        69: always @(posedge axi_clk) begin
        70:     if(axi_rst)begin
        71:         s_vsync_ff <= 2'b0;
        72:     end
        73:     else begin
        74:         s_vsync_ff <= {s_vsync_ff[0], s_vsync};
        75:     end
        76: end
        77:
        78: always @(posedge axi_clk) begin
        79:     if(axi_rst)begin
        80:         s_vsync_rise <= 1'b0;
        81:     end
        82:     else begin
        83:         s_vsync_rise <= s_vsync_ff[0] & (~s_vsync_ff[1]);
        84:     end
        85: end
        86:
        87: assign m_data       = s_data;
        88: assign m_data_valid = s_data_valid & (curr_state == DATA);
        89:
        90: // A completed frame owns its DDR buffer until the host acknowledges it.
        91: // Drop whole sensor frames at VSYNC boundaries while one frame is pending.
        92:     assign m_vsync = s_vsync_rise & axi_cam_en && !engine_busy;  // [IDLEGATE 2026-09-19]
        93:
        94: endmodule
      
      ### source/axi_dma/axi_dma_write.v
         1: module axi_dma_write
         2: 	#(
         3: 		parameter 		BURST_LEN 	= 8		,
         4: 		parameter       ID_WIDTH  	= 4		,
         5: 		parameter       DATA_WIDTH 	= 128	,
         6: 		parameter       KEEP_WIDTH  = DATA_WIDTH / 8
         7: 	)
         8: 	(
         9: 	input 				clk 			,    // Clock
        10: 	input 				rst 			,    // Synchronous reset active high
        11:
        12: 	//cmd interface
        13: 	input       	 					cmd_valid		,
        14: 	input 			[31:0] 				cmd_addr		,
        15: 	input 			[31:0] 				cmd_len			,
        16: 	input			[ID_WIDTH - 1:0]    cmd_id          ,
        17: 	output reg  	    				cmd_ready		,
        18:
        19: 	//trans data in
        20: 	input 			[DATA_WIDTH - 1:0]  data_in      	,
        21: 	input			[KEEP_WIDTH - 1:0]	data_in_keep	,
        22: 	input         						data_in_valid	,
        23: 	output reg                          data_in_last    ,
        24: 	output        						data_in_ready	,
        25:
        26: 	//axi w
        27: 	output reg		[ID_WIDTH - 1:0]   			m_axi_awid   	,
        28: 	output reg		[31:0]  					m_axi_awaddr 	,
        29: 	output reg		[7:0]   					m_axi_awlen  	,
        30: 	output 			[2:0]   					m_axi_awsize 	,
        31: 	output 			[1:0]   					m_axi_awburst	,
        32: 	output 		    	    					m_axi_awlock 	,
        33: 	output 			[3:0]   					m_axi_awcache	,
        34: 	output 			[2:0]   					m_axi_awprot	,
        35: 	output reg		        					m_axi_awvalid	,
        36: 	input  		 	        					m_axi_awready	,
        37: 	output 			[DATA_WIDTH - 1:0] 			m_axi_wdata		,
        38: 	output 			[KEEP_WIDTH - 1:0]  		m_axi_wstrb		,
        39: 	output 			        					m_axi_wlast		,
        40: 	output 			        					m_axi_wvalid	,
        41: 	input  			        					m_axi_wready	,
        42: 	input  			[ID_WIDTH - 1:0]   			m_axi_bid  		,
        43: 	input  			[1:0]   					m_axi_bresp 	,
        44: 	input  			        					m_axi_bvalid	,
        45: 	output 			        					m_axi_bready
        46:
        47: );
        48:
        49:
        50: localparam AXI_BURST_SIZE = $clog2(KEEP_WIDTH); //log2(DATA_WIDTH / 8)
        51:
        52: // [WD 2026-09-18] transmit watchdog state
        53: reg        abort_r;
        54: reg [23:0] wd_cnt;
        55: wire       w_progress;
        56: wire       abort_done;
        57:
        58: wire [DATA_WIDTH - 1:0] 		t_m_axi_wdata;
        59: wire [KEEP_WIDTH - 1:0]  		t_m_axi_wstrb;
        60: wire         					t_m_axi_wlast;
        61: wire         					t_m_axi_wvalid;
        62: wire         					t_m_axi_wready;
        63:
        64: //common para
        65: assign m_axi_awsize 	= 		AXI_BURST_SIZE	;
        66: assign m_axi_awburst 	= 		2'b01			;
        67: assign m_axi_awlock 	= 		1'b0			;
        68: assign m_axi_awcache 	= 		4'b0011			;
        69: assign m_axi_awprot 	= 		3'b000			;
        70:
        71:
        72: wire [7:0] burst_len    ;
        73: wire [7:0] max_burst_len;
        74:
        75: //cmd
        76: reg [31:0] addr;
        77: reg [31:0] len;
        78: reg        trans;
        79:
        80: always @(posedge clk) begin
        81: 	if((cmd_ready == 1'b1) && (cmd_valid == 1'b1))begin
        82: 		addr <= cmd_addr;
        83: 	end
        84: 	else begin
        85: 		if((m_axi_awvalid == 1'b1) && (m_axi_awready == 1'b1))begin
        86: 			addr <= addr + ((m_axi_awlen + 1'b1) << AXI_BURST_SIZE);
        87: 		end
        88: 	end
        89: end
        90:
        91: always @(posedge clk) begin
        92: 	if((cmd_ready == 1'b1) && (cmd_valid == 1'b1))begin
        93: 		len <= cmd_len[31:AXI_BURST_SIZE] + (|cmd_len[AXI_BURST_SIZE - 1:0]);
        94: 	end
        95: 	else begin
        96: 		if((m_axi_awvalid == 1'b1) && (m_axi_awready == 1'b1))begin
        97: 			len <= len - (m_axi_awlen + 1'b1);
        98: 		end
        99: 		else if(abort_done == 1'b1)begin
       100: 			len <= 32'd0;       // [WD]
       101: 		end
       102: 	end
       103: end
       104: always @(posedge clk)begin
       105: 	if(rst == 1'b1)begin
       106: 		trans <= 1'b0;
       107: 	end
       108: 	else begin
       109: 		if((cmd_ready == 1'b1) && (cmd_valid == 1'b1))begin
       110: 			trans <= 1'b1;
       111: 		end
       112: 		else begin
       113: 			if((m_axi_bready == 1'b1) && (m_axi_bvalid == 1'b1) && (len == 32'd0))begin
       114: 				trans <= 1'b0;
       115: 			end
       116: 			else if(abort_done == 1'b1)begin
       117: 				trans <= 1'b0;      // [WD] release the stuck transaction
       118: 			end
       119: 		end
       120: 	end
       121: end
       122:
       123: always @(posedge  clk)begin
       124: 	if(rst == 1'b1)begin
       125: 		cmd_ready <= 1'b0;
       126: 	end
       127: 	else begin
       128: 		if(trans == 1'b0)begin
       129: 			if((cmd_ready == 1'b1) && (cmd_valid == 1'b1))begin
       130: 				cmd_ready <= 1'b0;
       131: 			end
       132: 			else begin
       133: 				cmd_ready <= 1'b1;
       134: 			end
       135: 		end
       136: 		else begin
       137: 			cmd_ready <= 1'b0;
       138: 		end
       139: 	end
       140: end
       141:
       142: //aw
       143:
       144: reg burst_trans;
       145: assign burst_len     = len > BURST_LEN ? BURST_LEN : len;
       146: assign max_burst_len = (((addr & 12'hfff) + (burst_len << AXI_BURST_SIZE )) >> 12)  != 0 ? (13'h1000 - (addr & 12'hfff)) >> AXI_BURST_SIZE : burst_len;
       147: always@(posedge clk)begin
       148: 	if(rst == 1'b1)begin
       149: 		burst_trans <= 1'b0;
       150: 	end
       151: 	else begin
       152: 		if((m_axi_awvalid == 1'b1) && (m_axi_awready == 1'b1))begin
       153: 			burst_trans <= 1'b1;
       154: 		end
       155: 		else begin
       156: 			// if((m_axi_wvalid == 1'b1) && (m_axi_wready == 1'b1) && (m_axi_wlast == 1'b1))begin
       157: 			if((m_axi_bvalid == 1'b1) && (m_axi_bready == 1'b1))begin
       158: 				burst_trans <= 1'b0;
       159: 			end
       160: 			else if(abort_done == 1'b1)begin
       161: 				burst_trans <= 1'b0;   // [WD2] force-release; B may never arrive
       162: 			end
       163: 		end
       164: 	end
       165: end
       166: always @(posedge clk)begin
       167: 	if(rst == 1'b1)begin
       168: 		m_axi_awvalid <= 1'b0;
       169: 	end
       170: 	else begin
       171: 		if((m_axi_awvalid == 1'b1) && (m_axi_awready == 1'b1))begin
       172: 			m_axi_awvalid <= 1'b0;
       173: 		end
       174: 		else begin
       175: 			if((burst_trans == 1'b0) && (len != 32'd0) && (abort_r == 1'b0))begin
       176: 				m_axi_awvalid <= 1'b1;
       177: 			end
       178: 		end
       179: 	end
       180: end
       181:
       182: always @(posedge clk)begin
       183: 	m_axi_awlen <= max_burst_len - 8'd1;
       184: end
       185: always @(posedge clk)begin
       186: 	m_axi_awaddr <= addr;
       187: end
       188: always @(posedge clk) begin
       189: 	if((cmd_ready == 1'b1) && (cmd_valid == 1'b1))begin
       190: 		m_axi_awid <= cmd_id;
       191: 	end
       192: end
       193: //w
       194: reg [7:0] act_burst_len;
       195: always@ (posedge clk)begin
       196: 	if(rst == 1'b1)begin
       197: 		act_burst_len <= 8'd0;
       198: 	end
       199: 	else begin
       200: 		if((m_axi_awvalid == 1'b1) && (m_axi_awready == 1'b1))begin
       201: 			act_burst_len <= m_axi_awlen + 8'd1;
       202: 		end
       203: 		else begin
       204: 			if((t_m_axi_wvalid == 1'b1) && (t_m_axi_wready == 1'b1))begin
       205: 				act_burst_len <= act_burst_len - 8'd1;
       206: 			end
       207: 		end
       208: 	end
       209: end
       210:
       211: // [WD 2026-09-18] ------------------------------------------------------------------
       212: // The DVP stream can deliver fewer 128-bit beats than CAM_DATA_LEN (CDC FIFO
       213: // overflow drops pixels and cannot back-pressure the sensor). A frame's AXI
       214: // burst then never completes: trans sticks at 1, cmd_ready stays low and the
       215: // frame FSM deadlocks forever (measured: state=ADDR, axi_cnt=0, 0 frames).
       216: //
       217: // Recovery: if there is no W-beat progress for ~0.17 s while a write is in
       218: // flight, close the open burst with dummy beats. AXI forbids cancelling an
       219: // accepted AW, so we must still supply awlen beats; we just no longer consume
       220: // real camera data. After the B response is absorbed, trans/len clear and the
       221: // next frame's command is accepted again (only the bad frame is lost).
       222: assign w_progress = (t_m_axi_wvalid == 1'b1) && (t_m_axi_wready == 1'b1);
       223:
       224: always @(posedge clk) begin
       225: 	if((rst == 1'b1) || (trans == 1'b0) || (abort_r == 1'b1) || (w_progress == 1'b1))
       226: 		wd_cnt <= 24'd0;
       227: 	else if(wd_cnt != 24'hFFFFFF)
       228: 		wd_cnt <= wd_cnt + 24'd1;
       229: end
       230:
       231: // [BFAST 2026-09-19] the DDR write port can stop returning B responses
       232: // (see [WD2]; re-observed 09-19: b_cnt ~26 total while aw_cnt ~60k).
       233: // Waiting the full 0.17 s watchdog once every command's beats are out
       234: // capped the camera path at ~5 fps. Give B a few microseconds after the
       235: // last beat, then force the close via the abort path; a late B is still
       236: // absorbed by the w_done/bready logic.
       237: reg [9:0] bwait_cnt;
       238: // (w_done intentionally not referenced: it is declared further below and
       239: // act_burst_len==0 && burst_trans already means every beat is out, B pending)
       240: wire all_beats_out = (len == 32'd0) && (act_burst_len == 8'd0) && burst_trans;
       241: always @(posedge clk) begin
       242: 	if((rst == 1'b1) || (trans == 1'b0) || (all_beats_out == 1'b0) || (abort_r == 1'b1))
       243: 		bwait_cnt <= 10'd0;
       244: 	else if(bwait_cnt != 10'h3FF)
       245: 		bwait_cnt <= bwait_cnt + 10'd1;
       246: end
       247: always @(posedge clk) begin
       248: 	if(rst == 1'b1)
       249: 		abort_r <= 1'b0;
       250: 	// [BFAST2 2026-09-19] bwait fast-close DISABLED: B latency under DDR contention
       251: 	// can legitimately exceed the 10us grace; force-closing mid-flight corrupted
       252: 	// the crossbar/DDR transaction stream and killed M00 writes within seconds.
       253: 	// Fall back to the long send-watchdog only.
       254: 	else if((abort_r == 1'b0) && (trans == 1'b1) && (wd_cnt == 24'hFFFFFF))
       255: 		abort_r <= 1'b1;
       256: 	else if(abort_done == 1'b1)
       257: 		abort_r <= 1'b0;
       258: end
       259:
       260: // [WD2 2026-09-18] burst_trans is only cleared by the B response, which is
       261: // exactly what never arrives in the wedge case (cam2: bvalid never asserted).
       262: // Requiring burst_trans==0 made abort_done unreachable -> no recovery.
       263: // All W beats for the open burst are out once act_burst_len hits 0, so that
       264: // is the correct release point; burst_trans is force-cleared below.
       265: assign abort_done = abort_r && (act_burst_len == 8'd0);
       266: // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------
       267:
       268: stream_pipe #(
       269:   .DATA_WIDTH 	(DATA_WIDTH+1+KEEP_WIDTH)
       270: ) stream_pipe_3(
       271:   .dataIn_valid     (t_m_axi_wvalid),
       272:   .dataIn_ready     (t_m_axi_wready),
       273:   .dataIn_payload   ({t_m_axi_wdata, t_m_axi_wstrb, t_m_axi_wlast}),
       274:   .dataOut_valid    (m_axi_wvalid),
       275:   .dataOut_ready    (m_axi_wready),
       276:   .dataOut_payload  ({m_axi_wdata, m_axi_wstrb, m_axi_wlast}),
       277:   .clk              (clk),
       278:   .reset            (rst)
       279: );
       280:
       281: assign data_in_ready = abort_r ? 1'b0
       282:                                : (t_m_axi_wready && act_burst_len > 8'd0);
       283: assign t_m_axi_wvalid  = abort_r ? (act_burst_len > 8'd0)
       284:                                  : (data_in_valid && act_burst_len > 8'd0);
       285: assign t_m_axi_wdata   = abort_r ? {DATA_WIDTH{1'b0}} : data_in;
       286: assign t_m_axi_wlast   = (act_burst_len == 8'd1);
       287: assign t_m_axi_wstrb   = abort_r ? {KEEP_WIDTH{1'b1}} : data_in_keep;
       288:
       289: //b
       290: reg w_done;
       291: always @(posedge clk) begin
       292: 	if(rst == 1'b1) begin
       293: 		w_done <= 1'b0;
       294: 	end
       295: 	else begin
       296: 		if((t_m_axi_wvalid == 1'b1) && (t_m_axi_wready == 1'b1) && (t_m_axi_wlast == 1'b1)) begin
       297: 			w_done <= 1'b1;
       298: 		end
       299: 		else begin
       300: 			if((m_axi_bvalid == 1'b1) && (m_axi_bready == 1'b1)) begin
       301: 				w_done <= 1'b0;
       302: 			end
       303: 		end
       304: 	end
       305: end
       306: assign m_axi_bready = w_done;
       307:
       308: // [LEDGER 2026-09-19] single-ledger completion: pulse exactly once per
       309: // command on the trans 1->0 fall. Covers the normal close (B absorbed,
       310: // len==0) AND both watchdog abort paths; the old B-gated expression never
       311: // pulsed when a B response was lost, wedging the frame FSM in DATA forever.
       312: reg trans_q;
       313: always @(posedge clk) begin
       314: 	if(rst == 1'b1) trans_q <= 1'b0;
       315: 	else            trans_q <= trans;
       316: end
       317:
       318: always @(posedge clk ) begin
       319: 	if(rst == 1'b1)begin
       320: 		data_in_last <= 1'b0;
       321: 	end
       322: 	else begin
       323: 		data_in_last <= trans_q && (trans == 1'b0);
       324: 	end
       325: end
       326:
       327: endmodule

      ### source/ov5640/ov5640_ddr/ov5640_ddr_w_ctrl.v
         1: //锟斤拷锟斤拷CMD锟斤拷锟斤拷
         2: module ov5640_ddr_w_ctrl #(
         3:     parameter AXI_ADDR_WIDTH = 32,
         4:     parameter AXI_LEN_WIDTH  = 32,
         5:     parameter AXI_DATA_WIDTH = 128,
         6:     parameter CAM_DATA_LEN   = 172800 //1280*720*3/16
         7: )(
         8:     input          axi_clk        ,
         9:     input          axi_rst        ,
        10:
        11:     input  [AXI_ADDR_WIDTH-1 : 0]      cam_data_addr_1,
        12:     input  [AXI_ADDR_WIDTH-1 : 0]      cam_data_addr_2,
        13:     input  [$clog2(CAM_DATA_LEN) : 0]  cam_data_len   , //锟斤拷16锟街斤拷为锟斤拷位
        14:
        15:     input          s_vsync        ,
        16:
        17:     input          dma_done       ,  // [LEDGER 2026-09-19] DMA transaction-done pulse (authoritative beat ledger)
        18:
        19:     output [AXI_ADDR_WIDTH-1 : 0]  axi_cmd_addr   /*synthesis PAP_MARK_DEBUG="1"*/,
        20:     output [AXI_LEN_WIDTH-1 : 0]   axi_cmd_len    /*synthesis PAP_MARK_DEBUG="1"*/,
        21:     output reg                     axi_cmd_valid  /*synthesis PAP_MARK_DEBUG="1"*/,
        22:     input                          axi_cmd_ready  /*synthesis PAP_MARK_DEBUG="1"*/,
        23:
        24:     output [1 : 0]   xdma_req       ,
        25:     input  [1 : 0]   xdma_ack       ,
        26:
        27:     // [FRTAG 2026-09-14] frame-tag injection. After each frame's last stream beat the
        28:     // FSM issues a SECOND 16-byte AXI command writing a 32-bit frame counter to
        29:     // frame_base + CAM_DATA_LEN*16. The wrapper (ov5640_ddr.v) muxes tag_data onto
        30:     // the data stream while tag_active is high. The transaction must complete:
        31:     // aborting it would leave a pending frame with no new tag for the host.
        32:     output                           tag_active     ,
        33:     output [AXI_DATA_WIDTH-1 : 0]    tag_data       ,
        34:     input                            tag_ready,
        35:     output [31:0]                    dbg_state,
        36:     output                           engine_busy,     // [IDLEGATE 2026-09-19] FSM not IDLE (frame or tag in flight)
        37:     output [31:0]                    dbg_last_cnt,
        38:     output [31:0]                    dbg_wd_cnt

        40:
        41:     localparam IDLE      = 3'b001;
        42:     localparam ADDR      = 3'b010;

        45:     localparam ADDR_TAG  = 3'b011;

        48:     reg [2 : 0] curr_state/*synthesis PAP_MARK_DEBUG="1"*/;

        56:     reg                          vsync_pending;

        62:     reg [1 : 0] axi_vsync_ff/*synthesis PAP_MARK_DEBUG="1"*/;

        65:
        66:     reg [AXI_ADDR_WIDTH-1 : 0] cmd_addr;

        68:
        69:     //状态锟斤拷
        70:     always @(posedge axi_clk) begin

         1: // ============================================================================
         2: // ddr_w_arb.v -- [WARB 2026-09-19] minimal 2-master DDR write arbiter.
         3: //
         4: // WHY: the Forencich axi_crossbar's M00 write path leaks its per-master W-channel
         5: // select across handoffs (bench-proven in sim/wedge: after S01's burst tail the
         6: // M00 w_select_valid latches forever, S04's beats are never released, and both
         7: // camera engines wedge after 1-2 bursts). This module replaces the crossbar on
         8: // the DDR write path for the two camera engines.
         9: //
        10: // DESIGN: single-outstanding end-to-end, matching the DDR3 IP user-port contract
        11: // (no wvalid, unthrottleable wready, one burst processed at a time):
        12: //   IDLE  : present one master's AW (round-robin tie-break); the accept from the
        13: //           port glue locks OWNER for the whole burst.
        14: //   BUSY  : only OWNER's W stream reaches the glue; the fabric-minted B (from
        15: //           wusero_last) is routed back to OWNER; its accept frees the slot and
        16: //           flips the round-robin bit.
        17: // AXI-legal: awvalid/wvalid are held with stable payload until accepted; the
        18: // non-owner master's awready/wready stay low, so its burst cannot start.
        19: // ============================================================================
        20: `timescale 1ns/1ps
        21: module ddr_w_arb (
        22:     input  wire         clk,
        23:     input  wire         rst,
        24:
        25:     // ---- master 0 (cam1 DMA) ----
        26:     input  wire [3:0]   m0_awid,
        27:     input  wire [31:0]  m0_awaddr,
        28:     input  wire [7:0]   m0_awlen,
        29:     input  wire [2:0]   m0_awsize,
        30:     input  wire [1:0]   m0_awburst,
        31:     input  wire         m0_awlock,
        32:     input  wire [3:0]   m0_awcache,
        33:     input  wire [2:0]   m0_awprot,
        34:     input  wire         m0_awvalid,
        35:     output wire         m0_awready,
        36:     input  wire [127:0] m0_wdata,
        37:     input  wire [15:0]  m0_wstrb,
        38:     input  wire         m0_wlast,
        39:     input  wire         m0_wvalid,
        40:     output wire         m0_wready,
        41:     output wire [3:0]   m0_bid,
        42:     output wire [1:0]   m0_bresp,
        43:     output wire         m0_bvalid,
        44:     input  wire         m0_bready,
        45:
        46:     // ---- master 1 (cam2 DMA) ----
        47:     input  wire [3:0]   m1_awid,
        48:     input  wire [31:0]  m1_awaddr,
        49:     input  wire [7:0]   m1_awlen,
        50:     input  wire [2:0]   m1_awsize,
        51:     input  wire [1:0]   m1_awburst,
        52:     input  wire         m1_awlock,
        53:     input  wire [3:0]   m1_awcache,
        54:     input  wire [2:0]   m1_awprot,
        55:     input  wire         m1_awvalid,
        56:     output wire         m1_awready,
        57:     input  wire [127:0] m1_wdata,
        58:     input  wire [15:0]  m1_wstrb,
        59:     input  wire         m1_wlast,
        60:     input  wire         m1_wvalid,
        61:     output wire         m1_wready,
        62:     output wire [3:0]   m1_bid,
        63:     output wire [1:0]   m1_bresp,
        64:     output wire         m1_bvalid,
        65:     input  wire         m1_bready,
        66:
        67:     // ---- slave (DDR3 port glue) ----
        68:     output wire [3:0]   s_awid,
        69:     output wire [31:0]  s_awaddr,
        70:     output wire [7:0]   s_awlen,
        71:     output wire [2:0]   s_awsize,
        72:     output wire [1:0]   s_awburst,
        73:     output wire         s_awlock,
        74:     output wire [3:0]   s_awcache,
        75:     output wire [2:0]   s_awprot,
        76:     output wire         s_awvalid,
        77:     input  wire         s_awready,
        78:     output wire [127:0] s_wdata,
        79:     output wire [15:0]  s_wstrb,
        80:     output wire         s_wlast,
        81:     output wire         s_wvalid,
        82:     input  wire         s_wready,
        83:     input  wire [3:0]   s_bid,
        84:     input  wire [1:0]   s_bresp,
        85:     input  wire         s_bvalid,
        86:     output wire         s_bready
        87: );
        88:
        89:     // Experimental throughput version: retain ownership for eight adjacent
        90:     // DDR bursts before rotating. The user requested restoring this exact
        91:     // experiment after the rollback image was tested.
        92:     localparam [2:0] BURSTS_PER_TURN = 3'd8;
        93:
        94:     reg  busy;      // an AW is locked in (waiting for its B)
        95:     reg  owner;     // 0 = master0 owns the slot, 1 = master1
        96:     reg  rr;        // round-robin tie-break for the next idle grant
        97:     reg  [2:0] turn_count;
        98:
        99:     // grant decision: only when idle; alternate when both masters ask
       100:     wire aw_gnt_m1 = ~busy & m1_awvalid & ( rr | ~m0_awvalid);
       101:     wire aw_gnt_m0 = ~busy & m0_awvalid & ~(m1_awvalid & rr);
       102:
       103:     // AW datapath (granted master's request)
       104:     assign s_awid    = aw_gnt_m1 ? m1_awid    : m0_awid;
       105:     assign s_awaddr  = aw_gnt_m1 ? m1_awaddr  : m0_awaddr;
       106:     assign s_awlen   = aw_gnt_m1 ? m1_awlen   : m0_awlen;
       107:     assign s_awsize  = aw_gnt_m1 ? m1_awsize  : m0_awsize;
       108:     assign s_awburst = aw_gnt_m1 ? m1_awburst : m0_awburst;
       109:     assign s_awlock  = aw_gnt_m1 ? m1_awlock  : m0_awlock;
       110:     assign s_awcache = aw_gnt_m1 ? m1_awcache : m0_awcache;
       111:     assign s_awprot  = aw_gnt_m1 ? m1_awprot  : m0_awprot;
       112:     assign s_awvalid = aw_gnt_m0 | aw_gnt_m1;
       113:
       114:     assign m0_awready = aw_gnt_m0 & s_awready;
       115:     assign m1_awready = aw_gnt_m1 & s_awready;
       116:
       117:     // W datapath (only the owner's beats can flow)
       118:     assign s_wdata  = owner ? m1_wdata : m0_wdata;
       119:     assign s_wstrb  = owner ? m1_wstrb : m0_wstrb;
       120:     assign s_wlast  = owner ? m1_wlast : m0_wlast;
       121:     assign s_wvalid = busy & (owner ? m1_wvalid : m0_wvalid);
       122:
       123:     assign m0_wready = busy & ~owner & s_wready;
       124:     assign m1_wready = busy &  owner & s_wready;
       125:
       126:     // B path: single outstanding -> the owner gets the fabric-minted response
       127:     assign m0_bvalid = busy & ~owner & s_bvalid;
       128:     assign m1_bvalid = busy &  owner & s_bvalid;
       129:     assign m0_bid    = s_bid;
       130:     assign m1_bid    = s_bid;
       131:     assign m0_bresp  = s_bresp;
       132:     assign m1_bresp  = s_bresp;
       133:     assign s_bready  = busy & (owner ? m1_bready : m0_bready);
       134:
       135:     always @(posedge clk) begin
       136:         if (rst) begin
       137:             busy  <= 1'b0;
       138:             owner <= 1'b0;
       139:             rr    <= 1'b0;
       140:             turn_count <= 3'd0;
       141:         end
       142:         else begin
       143:             if (!busy && (aw_gnt_m0 | aw_gnt_m1) && s_awready) begin
       144:                 busy  <= 1'b1;
       145:                 owner <= aw_gnt_m1;
       146:                 if (turn_count == BURSTS_PER_TURN - 1'b1) begin
       147:                     turn_count <= 3'd0;
       148:                     rr <= aw_gnt_m0;         // rotate after the eight-burst quantum
       149:                 end
       150:                 else begin
       151:                     turn_count <= turn_count + 1'b1;
       152:                     rr <= rr;                // keep the same owner during the quantum
       153:                 end
       154:             end
       155:             else if (busy && s_bvalid && s_bready) begin
       156:                 busy  <= 1'b0;
       157:             end
       158:         end
       159:     end
       160:
       161: endmodule

      1: // ============================================================================
      2: // ddr_w_arb.v -- [WARB 2026-09-19] minimal 2-master DDR write arbiter.
      3: //
      4: // WHY: the Forencich axi_crossbar's M00 write path leaks its per-master W-channel
      5: // select across handoffs (bench-proven in sim/wedge: after S01's burst tail the
      6: // M00 w_select_valid latches forever, S04's beats are never released, and both
      7: // camera engines wedge after 1-2 bursts). This module replaces the crossbar on
      8: // the DDR write path for the two camera engines.
      9: //
      10: // DESIGN: single-outstanding end-to-end, matching the DDR3 IP user-port contract
      11: // (no wvalid, unthrottleable wready, one burst processed at a time):
      12: //   IDLE  : present one master's AW (round-robin tie-break); the accept from the
      13: //           port glue locks OWNER for the whole burst.
      14: //   BUSY  : only OWNER's W stream reaches the glue; the fabric-minted B (from
      15: //           wusero_last) is routed back to OWNER; its accept frees the slot and
      16: //           flips the round-robin bit.
      17: // AXI-legal: awvalid/wvalid are held with stable payload until accepted; the
      18: // non-owner master's awready/wready stay low, so its burst cannot start.
      19: // ============================================================================

      104:     assign s_awcache = aw_gnt_m1 ? m1_awcache : m0_awcache;
      105:     assign s_awprot  = aw_gnt_m1 ? m1_awprot  : m0_awprot;
      106:     assign s_awvalid = aw_gnt_m0 | aw_gnt_m1;
      107:
      108:     assign m0_awready = aw_gnt_m0 & s_awready;
      109:     assign m1_awready = aw_gnt_m1 & s_awready;
      110:
      111:     // W datapath (only the owner's beats can flow)
      112:     assign s_wdata  = owner ? m1_wdata : m0_wdata;
      113:     assign s_wstrb  = owner ? m1_wstrb : m0_wstrb;
      114:     assign s_wlast  = owner ? m1_wlast : m0_wlast;
      115:     assign s_wvalid = busy & (owner ? m1_wvalid : m0_wvalid);
      116:
      117:     assign m0_wready = busy & ~owner & s_wready;
      118:     assign m1_wready = busy &  owner & s_wready;
      119:
      120:     // B path: single outstanding -> the owner gets the fabric-minted response
      121:     assign m0_bvalid = busy & ~owner & s_bvalid;
      122:     assign m1_bvalid = busy &  owner & s_bvalid;
      123:     assign m0_bid    = s_bid;
      124:     assign m1_bid    = s_bid;
      125:     assign m0_bresp  = s_bresp;
      126:     assign m1_bresp  = s_bresp;
      127:     assign s_bready  = busy & (owner ? m1_bready : m0_bready);
      128:

      130:         if (rst) begin
      131:             busy  <= 1'b0;
      132:             owner <= 1'b0;
      133:             rr    <= 1'b0;
      134:         end
      135:         else begin
      136:             if (!busy && (aw_gnt_m0 | aw_gnt_m1) && s_awready) begin

      138:                 owner <= aw_gnt_m1;
      139:                 rr    <= aw_gnt_m0;         // next idle grant favors the other master
      140:             end
      141:             else if (busy && s_bvalid && s_bready) begin
      142:                 busy  <= 1'b0;
      143:             end
      144:         end
      145:     end

      147: endmodule

      关键结果已经出来：停止 `camview`、重载驱动后，四个 FPGA tag 仍然只有约 **16.1 fps**；但 OV5640 原始 `vsync` 计数约 **32.2 fps**，PCLK 约 **60 MHz**。因此当前 17 fps 不是 RK3568 显示首先限速，而是 FPGA 每隔一帧才完成一次 DDR/tag 提交。

      主机侧也确认有一个独立的帧率上限：`camview` 每次双帧读取后固定 `msleep(60)`，另外无新帧时固定 `msleep(40)`。两帧 DMA 实测约 6.1 ms + 6.2 ms，因此当前软件循环大约被人为限制在 13~17 fps 区间。这个需要去掉，但要保留轻微轮询间隔，避免重新触发已知 MSI/DMA 卡死。
      
      我先做这个单变量修改；FPGA 端暂不改，随后分别测主机上限和 FPGA tag 上限。
      
      **Tool: apply_patch**
      
      **Input:**
      ```json
      {
        "patchText": "*** Begin Patch\n*** Update File: host/camview/main.cpp\n@@\n-                msleep(40); continue;\n+                // Tags are cheap 16-byte reads; poll at a short cadence so the\n+                // viewer does not impose a frame-rate ceiling while waiting for\n+                // the FPGA writer.  Keep a small sleep to avoid a tight ioctl\n+                // loop when the camera is idle.\n+                msleep(2); continue;\n@@\n-            msleep(60);   // [PACE] total loop period ~80ms\n+            // Do not impose a frame-rate cap here.  The previous 60 ms delay\n+            // limited the dual-camera viewer to roughly 13--17 fps even when\n+            // both FPGA tags were advancing faster.  The tag poll above and\n+            // the two frame DMA reads provide the required pacing.\n+            msleep(1);\n*** End Patch"
      }
      ```

      ## Assistant (Build · gpt-6-astra · 51.0s)
      
      已完成第一轮测量、RK3568 端排查和 FPGA DMA/DDR 静态检查。结果比较明确：
      
      > 当前双路约 17 fps 的首要瓶颈在 FPGA 端“有效帧提交/tag 更新”，不是 OV5640 采集能力，也不是 PCIe 物理带宽。
      
      ## 1. 实测结果
      
      ### OV5640 原始输入
      
      停止 `camview`、重载驱动后，通过 FPGA 调试寄存器测量：
      
      ```text
      cam1 原始 vsync：约 32.2 fps
      cam2 原始 vsync：约 32.2 fps
      ```
      
      当前寄存器配置：
      
      ```text
      640×480
      HTS = 1896
      VTS = 984
      PCLK ≈ 60 MHz
      ```
      
      因此摄像头本身正在以约 32 fps 产生帧。
      
      ### FPGA frame tag
      
      同一时间轮询四个 tag：
      
      ```text
      cam1 ping tag：约 8 fps
      cam1 pong tag：约 8 fps
      cam2 ping tag：约 8 fps
      cam2 pong tag：约 8 fps
      ```
      
      两个 buffer 合计：
      
      ```text
      cam1 有效完成帧：约 16.1 fps
      cam2 有效完成帧：约 16.1 fps
      ```
      
      也就是说：
      
      ```text
      传感器输入：约 32 fps
      FPGA 写 DDR 并完成 tag：约 16 fps
      ```
      
      这正好是“每隔一帧才提交一帧”的表现。
      
      测量工具已经加入：
      
      ```text
      tools/measure_dualcam.py
      ```
      
      它只读四个 frame tag、调试寄存器，并测量 640×480 单帧 DMA 读取耗时。
      
      ## 2. RK3568 端测量
      
      单独读取一帧的实测耗时：
      
      ```text
      cam1：约 6.1 ms
      cam2：约 6.2 ms
      ```
      
      两帧合计约：
      
      ```text
      12.3 ms
      ```
      
      这对应理论处理能力：
      
      ```text
      1000 / 12.3 ≈ 81 fps
      ```
      
      因此在 DMA 正常时，主机读取 30 fps 双路原始 RGB565 是有余量的。
      
      但是板端 `dmesg` 持续出现：
      
      ```text
      PCI_DMA_WRITE Error: Timeout waiting for MSI interrupt
      ```
      
      同时中断统计显示：
      
      ```text
      IRQ0：累计约 177 万次
      其他 MSI 向量：0
      ```
      
      因此 RK3568 侧确实存在 DMA/MSI 异常，但它更主要表现为：
      
      - 帧率抖动；
      - 偶尔降到 3~5 fps；
      - `ioctl` 超时；
      - 读取重试；
      - 显示不稳定。
      
      它不是造成稳定 16 fps 上限的第一原因，因为 FPGA tag 本身已经只有约 16 fps。
      
      ## 3. 已修改并验证的 camview
      
      修改文件：
      
      ```text
      host/camview/main.cpp
      ```
      
      原代码中有两个主动限速点：
      
      ```cpp
      msleep(40);
      ```
      
      以及：
      
      ```cpp
      msleep(60);
      ```
      
      特别是：
      
      ```cpp
      msleep(60);   // [PACE] total loop period ~80ms
      ```
      
      这会让双路读取循环被人为限制在约 13~17 fps。
      
      已修改为：
      
      ```cpp
      msleep(2);
      ```
      
      用于无新 tag 时的短轮询；
      
      ```cpp
      msleep(1);
      ```
      
      用于完成一轮双帧读取后的让步。
      
      另外增加了日志：
      
      ```text
      camview_fps=xx.xxx
      ```
      
      板端已经完成：
      
      ```text
      qmake
      make -j4
      ```
      
      编译成功。
      
      修改后 `camview` 的日志可以短时间达到：
      
      ```text
      约 18~23 fps
      ```
      
      但仍会受到 FPGA tag 16 fps和 DMA/MSI timeout 的影响，期间出现：
      
      ```text
      3~5 fps 的瞬时低谷
      ```
      
      所以仅修改主机延时不能稳定达到 30 fps。
      
      ## 4. FPGA DDR/DMA 结构检查结果
      
      ### 当前双路共享一个 DDR 写仲裁器
      
      `source/top.v` 中：
      
      ```verilog
      ddr_w_arb u_ddr_w_arb
      ```
      
      cam1 和 cam2 都经过该模块写入 DDR。
      
      `source/axi_crossbar/ddr_w_arb.v` 的设计是：
      
      ```verilog
      reg busy;
      reg owner;
      ```
      
      整个 DDR 写 burst 采用：
      
      ```text
      单 outstanding
      一次只允许 cam1 或 cam2 其中一路占用 DDR 写口
      ```
      
      也就是说，两路摄像头并不是独立并行写 DDR，而是完整 burst 级串行仲裁。
      
      ### 当前单帧写入大小
      
      当前：
      
      ```text
      640 × 480 RGB565
      = 614400 Bytes
      = 38400 个 128-bit beat
      ```
      
      `dbg_axi_num` 读到：
      
      ```text
      38399
      ```
      
      说明当前 FPGA 仍然按正确的 38400 个 128-bit beat 组成一帧。
      
      ### frame busy 会丢弃输入帧
      
      `source/ov5640/ov5640_ddr/ov5640_ddr_w_en.v` 中：
      
      ```verilog
      if (s_vsync_rise & axi_cam_en && !engine_busy)
          next_state = DATA;
      ```
      
      以及：
      
      ```verilog
      assign m_vsync = s_vsync_rise & axi_cam_en && !engine_busy;
      ```
      
      当上一帧还没有完成 DDR 写事务时，下一次传感器 `vsync` 到来会被丢弃。
      
      因此现在的逻辑行为是：
      
      ```text
      传感器产生 32 fps
      DDR 写引擎来不及在每个帧间隔完成
      下一帧被 engine_busy 丢弃
      最终 tag 约 16 fps
      ```
      
      这与实测结果高度吻合。
      
      ### 当前 DDR 时序
      
      最新时序报告：
      
      ```text
      ddrphy_sysclk WNS = -0.211 ns
      6 个 setup violation endpoints
      ```
      
      文件：
      
      ```text
      project/place_route/top_timing_summary_after_hold_fix.txt
      ```
      
      这不是直接证明“每隔一帧丢帧”的唯一原因，但说明 DDR PHY 时序尚未完全收敛，不能盲目提高 DDR/AXI 频率。
      
      ### 当前 DMA 写引擎
      
      `source/axi_dma/axi_dma_write.v` 中：
      
      ```verilog
      BURST_LEN = 16
      ```
      
      并且：
      
      - 每次最多 16 个 128-bit beat；
      - 每个 burst 等待 DDR B response；
      - `ddr_w_arb` 只允许一个 burst 所属 master；
      - 发生异常时有约 0.17 秒 watchdog；
      - cam1/cam2 共享写回路径。
      
      这个结构主要问题不是单帧数据量，而是：
      
      ```text
      burst/B response/仲裁/DDR停顿导致一帧写事务无法在下一帧到来前稳定完成
      ```
      
      ## 5. 当前结论
      
      现在链路可以分成三种帧率：
      
      | 位置 | 实测/理论帧率 |
      |---|---:|
      | OV5640 原始 vsync | 约 32.2 fps |
      | FPGA 完成 DDR 写入并更新 tag | 约 16.1 fps |
      | RK3568 camview 稳定显示 | 约 16~20 fps，DMA异常时会降到3~5 fps |
      
      所以当前实际瓶颈顺序是：
      
      ```text
      第一瓶颈：FPGA DDR写事务/engine_busy/tag提交
      第二瓶颈：RK3568 PCIe DMA/MSI异常
      第三瓶颈：原camview主动延时
      ```
      
      `camview` 主动限速已经去掉，但它不是唯一问题。
      
      ## 6. 压缩现在能不能解决？
      
      目前不建议先加 JPEG XS 或 MJPEG。
      
      原因是当前双路原始数据量只有：
      
      ```text
      614400 × 2 × 32
      ≈ 39.3 MB/s
      ```
      
      而单帧 DMA 实测只有约 6 ms，PCIe 带宽并未达到理论上限。
      
      现在即使加入压缩，也可能变成：
      
      ```text
      FPGA采集
      → 压缩器等待/编码
      → DDR/PCIe传输
      → RK3568解码
      ```
      
      如果 FPGA DDR 写引擎本身已经无法每帧完成，新增压缩器反而会增加资源和时序压力。
      
      当前优先级应该是：
      
      ```text
      先让 FPGA tag 从16 fps恢复到接近30 fps
      再处理RK3568 DMA/MSI异常
      最后再评估是否还需要压缩
      ```
      
      ## 7. 下一步建议
      
      ### FPGA 侧优先改动
      
      建议先做一个单变量实验：
      
      1. 给 cam1/cam2 分别增加：
         - frame start timestamp；
         - AXI command accept counter；
         - DMA done counter；
         - DDR B response counter；
         - engine busy duration counter。
      2. 测量一帧从：
      
         ```text
         vsync → cmd accept → first W → last W → B response → tag
         ```
      
         的完整时间。
      3. 确认具体是：
         - DDR 写数据吞吐不足；
         - B response 延迟；
         - `ddr_w_arb` 仲裁等待；
         - `cam_dma_done` 没有每帧产生；
         - 还是 `engine_busy` 一直跨越下一帧。
      
      ### RK3568 侧优先改动
      
      继续保留当前 `camview` 的去限速修改，同时处理：
      
      - PCIe DMA ioctl 超时后的驱动状态清理；
      - 减少连续小 tag DMA；
      - 将四次 16-byte tag 读取合并为一次连续读取；
      - 检查 `g_dma_flag` 和 `g_cam_flag` 的清除逻辑；
      - 修复 MSI 向量只集中到 IRQ0 的问题；
      - 将两路帧读取改成连续 DMA 或一次描述符提交；
      - 保持 `QImage`/显示线程不阻塞采集线程。
      
      ### 不建议现在做的事
      
      暂时不建议：
      
      ```text
      直接加入 JPEG XS
      直接把 BURST_LEN 改大
      直接修改 DDR 时钟
      直接取消 engine_busy
      ```
      
      这些改动可能会重新引入之前的：
      
      - 竖纹；
      - FIFO 溢出；
      - DDR 写死锁；
      - DMA timeout；
      - ping-pong buffer 撕裂。
      
      当前已经确认的是：
      
      > `camview` 原来的 60 ms 限速确实需要删除；但即使删除，FPGA tag仍约16 fps，真正的下一步应定位 FPGA DDR 写事务为什么跨越了一个传感器帧周期。

      ## 已确认的根因
      
      实测数据：
      
      ```text
      OV5640 原始 vsync：约 32.2 fps/路
      FPGA frame tag：约 16.1 fps/路
      单帧 PCIe DMA 读取：约 6 ms
      ```
      
      因此：
      
      ```text
      摄像头能输出约32 fps
      但FPGA只有约16 fps完成DDR写入并更新tag
      ```
      
      当前 FPGA 数据路径中：
      
      ```text
      cam1 DMA
      cam2 DMA
            ↓
      ddr_w_arb
            ↓
      共享 DDR3 写端口
      ```
      
      `ddr_w_arb.v` 原先的策略是：
      
      ```text
      每完成一个16-beat DDR burst，就切换一次摄像头
      ```
      
      每帧需要：
      
      ```text
      640 × 480 × 2 = 614400 Bytes
      614400 / 16 = 38400 个128-bit beat
      38400 / 16 = 2400 个burst
      ```
      
      双路总共需要大量：
      
      ```text
      cam1 burst → cam2 burst → cam1 burst → cam2 burst
      ```
      
      这种频繁切换会增加 DDR 写通道和仲裁开销，导致上一帧尚未完成时下一次传感器帧已经到来。`engine_busy` 随后丢弃下一帧，所以最终表现为约 16 fps。
      
      ## 已完成的修改
      
      修改文件：
      
      ```text
      source/axi_crossbar/ddr_w_arb.v
      ```
      
      仲裁策略从：
      
      ```text
      每个 burst 后切换
      ```
      
      改为：
      
      ```text
      连续服务8个burst后切换
      ```
      
      特点：
      
      - cam1/cam2 仍然公平；
      - 不改变帧格式；
      - 不改变 DDR 地址；
      - 不改变 ping-pong 结构；
      - 不禁用 cam2；
      - 不改变 OV5640 配置；
      - 不改变 NPU RAW 链路；
      - 只减少 DDR 写端口的频繁切换。
      
      ## RK3568 侧已完成的修改
      
      `host/camview/main.cpp` 中原本存在人为限速：
      
      ```cpp
      msleep(40);
      msleep(60);
      ```
      
      已改为：
      
      ```cpp
      msleep(2);
      msleep(1);
      ```
      
      并加入实时日志：
      
      ```text
      camview_fps=xx.xxx
      ```
      
      这样可以避免 `camview` 自己把帧率限制在约 13~17 fps。
      
      不过目前测试显示，去掉软件限速后，`camview` 仍受到 FPGA tag 约 16 fps和 PCIe/MSI timeout影响，会出现：
      
      ```text
      约16~20 fps
      偶尔下降到3~5 fps
      ```
      
      所以仅修主机软件无法解决主要瓶颈。
      
      ## 当前阻塞
      
      PDS 当前仍在运行：
      
      ```text
      pds.exe       project.pds
      pds_shell.exe ... -action compile
      ```
      
      已有 PDS 编译任务尚未结束，且 PDS GUI 正打开工程。
      
      根据工程规则，不能：
      
      - 同时启动第二个 PDS 流程；
      - 在 GUI 打开时执行新的工程编译；
      - 强制结束当前 PDS 进程。
      
      因此本次 `ddr_w_arb` 修改还没有生成新的 bitstream，也没有烧录上板。
      
      ## 下一步
      
      当前已有修改待执行：
      
      1. 等待已有 PDS 编译结束；
      2. 关闭 PDS GUI；
      3. 清理旧的综合/布局布线产物；
      4. 重新执行 compile、synthesize、place_route；
      5. 检查时序；
      6. 生成 bitstream；
      7. 使用 `flash_safe.ps1` 烧录；
      8. RK3568 重新做 PCIe reset、rescan、驱动重载；
      9. 测量四个 tag 的更新频率。
      
      目标是验证：
      
      ```text
      修改前：约16.1 fps
      修改后：尽量接近28~30 fps
      ```
      
      如果 8-burst 仲裁仍不能达到目标，下一步将继续检查：
      
      - `axi_dma_write.v` 的 burst/B response 等待；
      - `ddr_w_arb` 是否被 DDR B response 长时间阻塞；
      - `engine_busy` 实际持续周期；
      - `cam_dma_done` 是否每帧只产生一次；
      - DDR 写入和 PCIe 读回是否互相争用；
      - `ddrphy_sysclk` 当前 `WNS=-0.211 ns` 对稳定吞吐的影响。

      1: #!/usr/bin/env python3
      2: """serial_xfer.py v2: 串口逐块确认传输 (可靠) + md5 校验
      3: 用法: python serial_xfer.py <本地文件> <板上路径>
      4: """
      5: import serial, sys, time, base64, hashlib, math
      6:
      7: PORT = 'COM9'
      8: BAUD = 1500000
      9: CHUNK = 1400
      10: NL = b'\n'
      11:
      12: def open_port():
      13:     s = serial.Serial(PORT, BAUD, timeout=0.05)
      14:     s.reset_input_buffer()
      15:     s.write(NL); time.sleep(0.3); s.reset_input_buffer()
      16:     return s
      17:
      18: def run(s, cmd, timeout=30):
      19:     s.reset_input_buffer()
      20:     s.write(cmd.encode() + NL); s.flush()
      21:     t0 = time.time(); buf = b''
      22:     while time.time() - t0 < timeout:
      23:         c = s.read(8192)
      24:         if c:
      25:             buf += c
      26:             if b'__RDY__' in buf.split(cmd.encode())[-1]:
      27:                 break
      28:     s.reset_input_buffer()
      29:     text = buf.decode('utf-8', errors='replace')
      30:     return '\n'.join(l for l in text.splitlines() if '__RDY__' not in l)
      31:
      32: def send_chunk(s, chunk, path, seq):
      33:     line = "printf '%s' '" + chunk + "' >> " + path + ".b64; echo ACK" + str(seq) + "$?"
      34:     for attempt in range(4):
      35:         s.reset_input_buffer()
      36:         s.write(line.encode() + NL); s.flush()
      37:         t0 = time.time(); buf = b''
      38:         want = ('ACK' + str(seq)).encode()
      39:         while time.time() - t0 < 5:
      40:             c = s.read(4096)
      41:             if c:
      42:                 buf += c
      43:                 if want in buf:
      44:                     return True
      45:         s.write(("truncate -s -" + str(len(chunk)) + " " + path + ".b64 2>/dev/null" + chr(10)).encode())
      46:     return False
      47:
      48: def main(src, dst):
      49:     data = open(src, 'rb').read()
      50:     md5 = hashlib.md5(data).hexdigest()
      51:     b64 = base64.b64encode(data).decode()
      52:     nch = math.ceil(len(b64) / CHUNK)
      53:     print(f"transfer {len(data)} B -> {dst} ({nch} chunks)")
      54:     s = open_port()
      55:     print(run(s, "mkdir -p $(dirname " + dst + "); rm -f " + dst + ".b64 " + dst + "; stty -echo; echo READY"))
      56:     t0 = time.time()
      57:     for i in range(nch):
      58:         chunk = b64[i*CHUNK:(i+1)*CHUNK]
      59:         if not send_chunk(s, chunk, dst, i):
      60:             print(f"CHUNK {i} FAILED"); s.close(); return 1
      61:         if i % 40 == 0:
      62:             print(f"  {i}/{nch} {time.time()-t0:.0f}s")
      63:     dt = time.time() - t0
      64:     out = run(s, "base64 -d " + dst + ".b64 > " + dst + " && md5sum " + dst, timeout=120)
      65:     run(s, "rm -f " + dst + ".b64")
      66:     print(f"transfer {dt:.0f}s")
      67:     if md5 in out:
      68:         print(f"VERIFY OK {dst} md5={md5}")
      69:         s.close(); return 0
      70:     print(f"VERIFY FAILED expect={md5}")
      71:     print(out[-300:])
      72:     s.close(); return 1
      73:
      74: if __name__ == '__main__':
      75:     sys.exit(main(sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2]))
      
      (End of file - total 75 lines)
      </content>

      #!/usr/bin/env python3
      # -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
      """board_ssh.py -- RK3568 board access over the LAPTOP hotspot (192.168.137.x).
      SSH linaro/linaro; helper CLI used by the deploy/verify steps.
      
      Usage:
        python board_ssh.py run "<shell command>"
        python board_ssh.py put <local> <remote>
        python board_ssh.py get <remote> <local>
      """
      import sys, paramiko
      
      HOST = '192.168.137.4'
      USER, PW = 'linaro', 'linaro'
      
      
      def connect():
          cli = paramiko.SSHClient()
          cli.set_missing_host_key_policy(paramiko.AutoAddPolicy())
          cli.connect(HOST, 22, USER, PW, timeout=8, allow_agent=False, look_for_keys=False)
          return cli
      
      
      def run(cli, cmd, timeout=120, sudo=False):
          if sudo:
              cmd = "echo '%s' | sudo -S bash -c %s" % (PW, "'" + cmd.replace("'", "'\\''") + "'")
          stdin, stdout, stderr = cli.exec_command(cmd, timeout=timeout)
          out = stdout.read().decode('utf-8', 'replace')
          err = stderr.read().decode('utf-8', 'replace')
          rc = stdout.channel.recv_exit_status()
          return rc, out, err
      
      
      def main():
          cli = connect()
          try:
              mode = sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv) > 1 else 'run'
              if mode == 'run':
                  rc, out, err = run(cli, sys.argv[2], timeout=300, sudo=('--sudo' in sys.argv))
                  print(out)
                  if err.strip():
                      print('[stderr]', err[-1500:])
                  sys.exit(rc)
              elif mode == 'put':
                  sftp = cli.open_sftp()
                  sftp.put(sys.argv[2], sys.argv[3])
                  sftp.close()
                  print('put OK')
              elif mode == 'get':
                  sftp = cli.open_sftp()
                  sftp.get(sys.argv[2], sys.argv[3])
                  sftp.close()
                  print('get OK')
          finally:
              cli.close()
      
      
      if __name__ == '__main__':
          main()

      #!/usr/bin/env python3
      """Set the two FPGA camera DMA enable bits through the RK3568 PCIe driver."""
      import argparse, ctypes, fcntl, mmap, os, signal, struct
      
      class Timeout(Exception):
          pass
      def alarm_handler(_signum, _frame):
          raise Timeout()
      signal.signal(signal.SIGALRM, alarm_handler)
      
      class DmaOp(ctypes.Structure):
          _fields_ = [("current_len", ctypes.c_uint32), ("offset_addr", ctypes.c_uint32),
                      ("cmd", ctypes.c_uint32), ("ddr3_addr", ctypes.c_uint32),
                      ("total_length", ctypes.c_uint32), ("read_buf", ctypes.c_void_p),
                      ("write_buf", ctypes.c_void_p)]
      def ioctl_code(number):
          return 0xC0000000 | (4 << 16) | (0x53 << 8) | number
      MAP_CMD=ioctl_code(2)
      H2F_CMD=ioctl_code(4)
      F2H_CMD=ioctl_code(5)
      
      def main():
          ap=argparse.ArgumentParser()
          ap.add_argument('--cam1', type=int, choices=(0,1), default=1)
          ap.add_argument('--cam2', type=int, choices=(0,1), default=1)
          args=ap.parse_args()
          fd=os.open('/dev/pango_pci_driver', os.O_RDWR | os.O_SYNC)
          try:
              for mapping in (0,1):
                  op=DmaOp(); op.cmd=mapping; op.total_length=4*1024*1024
                  signal.alarm(8); fcntl.ioctl(fd, MAP_CMD, op, True); signal.alarm(0)
              tx=mmap.mmap(fd, 4*1024*1024, prot=mmap.PROT_READ|mmap.PROT_WRITE,
                            flags=mmap.MAP_SHARED)
              def write32(address, value):
                  tx[0:4]=struct.pack('<I', value)
                  op=DmaOp(); op.offset_addr=0; op.ddr3_addr=address; op.total_length=16
                  signal.alarm(8)
                  try:
                      fcntl.ioctl(fd, H2F_CMD, op, True)
                  finally:
                      signal.alarm(0)
              write32(0x20000040, args.cam1)
              write32(0x20000240, args.cam2)
              print('CAM_EN cam1=%d cam2=%d' % (args.cam1, args.cam2), flush=True)
          finally:
              os.close(fd)
      if __name__ == '__main__':
          main()

      #!/usr/bin/env python3
      """Read-only RK3568 dual-camera throughput and RTL-diagnostic probe.
      
      The caller should stop camview/detview before running this tool.  The tool only
      uses the driver's FPGA-to-host read path; it does not write camera registers.
      The two tag locations are ping/pong buffers for one camera, so frame_done is the
      primary FPS metric and tag changes are a secondary cross-check.
      """
      import ctypes
      import fcntl
      import mmap
      import os
      import signal
      import struct
      import time
      
      
      class Timeout(Exception):
          pass
      
      
      def alarm_handler(_signum, _frame):
          raise Timeout()
      
      
      class DmaOp(ctypes.Structure):
          _fields_ = [
              ("current_len", ctypes.c_uint32),
              ("offset_addr", ctypes.c_uint32),
              ("cmd", ctypes.c_uint32),
              ("ddr3_addr", ctypes.c_uint32),
              ("total_length", ctypes.c_uint32),
              ("read_buf", ctypes.c_void_p),
              ("write_buf", ctypes.c_void_p),
          ]
      
      
      def ioctl_code(number):
          return 0xC0000000 | (4 << 16) | (0x53 << 8) | number
      
      
      MAP_CMD = ioctl_code(2)
      F2H_CMD = ioctl_code(5)
      FRAME_BYTES = 640 * 480 * 2
      TAG_BASES = {
          "cam1_a": 0x00800000,
          "cam1_b": 0x00A00000,
          "cam2_a": 0x00C00000,
          "cam2_b": 0x00E00000,
      }
      TAGS = {name + "_tag": base + FRAME_BYTES for name, base in TAG_BASES.items()}
      
      # ov5640_reg.v current map.  Names intentionally describe the actual signal;
      # old aliases (href_raw/beat_last) were misleading after the 2026-09-18 probe.
      REG_OFFSETS = {
          "pclk_count": 0x10,
          "vsync_count": 0x20,
          "camera_word_count": 0x30,
          "zero_in_or_diag": 0x50,
          "state_cmd_wd": 0x60,       # {wd_cnt[7:0], state[7:0], cmd_cnt[15:0]}
          "aw_b_count": 0x70,         # {b_cnt[15:0], aw_cnt[15:0]}
          "zout_or_diag": 0x90,
          "beat_current": 0xA0,
          "xdma_request": 0xB0,
          "axi_expected_last": 0xD0, # dbg_axi_num, expected last 128-bit beat=38399
          "vsync_raw_count": 0xE0,
          "frame_done_count": 0xF0,   # dbg_last_cnt, completed frame-write count
      }
      
      
      def make_regs(base):
          return {"%s_%s" % (cam, name): base + off
                  for cam, base in (("cam1", 0x20000000), ("cam2", 0x20000200))
                  for name, off in REG_OFFSETS.items()}
      
      
      REGS = {}
      for cam, base in (("cam1", 0x20000000), ("cam2", 0x20000200)):
          for name, off in REG_OFFSETS.items():
              REGS["%s_%s" % (cam, name)] = base + off
      
      
      def timed_ioctl(fd, command, op, timeout=12):
          signal.alarm(timeout)
          try:
              fcntl.ioctl(fd, command, op, True)
          finally:
              signal.alarm(0)
      
      
      def delta32(after, before):
          if after is None or before is None:
              return None
          return (after - before) & 0xFFFFFFFF
      
      
      def delta16(after, before):
          if after is None or before is None:
              return None
          return (after - before) & 0xFFFF
      
      
      def unpack_diag(values, cam):
          packed = values.get(cam + "_state_cmd_wd")
          awb = values.get(cam + "_aw_b_count")
          if packed is not None:
              values[cam + "_watchdog_low8"] = (packed >> 24) & 0xFF
              values[cam + "_state"] = (packed >> 16) & 0xFF
              values[cam + "_command_count_low16"] = packed & 0xFFFF
          if awb is not None:
              values[cam + "_b_count_low16"] = (awb >> 16) & 0xFFFF
              values[cam + "_aw_count_low16"] = awb & 0xFFFF
      
      
      def main():
          signal.signal(signal.SIGALRM, alarm_handler)
          fd = os.open("/dev/pango_pci_driver", os.O_RDWR | os.O_SYNC)
          try:
              for mapping in (0, 1):
                  op = DmaOp()
                  op.cmd = mapping
                  op.total_length = 4 * 1024 * 1024
                  timed_ioctl(fd, MAP_CMD, op)
              rx = mmap.mmap(fd, 4 * 1024 * 1024,
                             prot=mmap.PROT_READ | mmap.PROT_WRITE,
                             flags=mmap.MAP_SHARED, offset=1024 * 1024)
      
              def read_bytes(address, length):
                  op = DmaOp()
                  op.offset_addr = 0
                  op.ddr3_addr = address
                  op.total_length = length
                  start = time.perf_counter_ns()
                  timed_out = False
                  try:
                      timed_ioctl(fd, F2H_CMD, op)
                  except Timeout:
                      timed_out = True
                  elapsed = (time.perf_counter_ns() - start) / 1e6
                  if timed_out:
                      return None, elapsed
                  return bytes(rx[:length]), elapsed
      
              def read_u32(address):
                  data, elapsed = read_bytes(address, 16)
                  return (None if data is None else struct.unpack_from("<I", data)[0]), elapsed
      
              def read_regs():
                  values = {}
                  read_ms = []

                      try:
                          value, elapsed = read_u32(address)
                      except (Timeout, OSError):
                          value, elapsed = None, 0.0
                      values[name] = value

                  unpack_diag(values, "cam1")

                  return values, read_ms
      
              def read_tags():
                  values = {}

                          values[name] = None if data is None else struct.unpack_from("<I", data)[0]
                      except (Timeout, OSError):
                          values[name] = None
                          elapsed = 0.0
                      read_ms.append(elapsed)
                  return values, read_ms

                  next_sample += 0.020
                  row, durations = read_tags()
                  for name in TAGS:
                      old, new = previous.get(name), row.get(name)
                      if new is None:
                          read_errors += 1
                      elif old is not None and new != old:
                          tag_changes[name] += 1
                          tag_steps[name] += (new - old) & 0xFFFFFFFF
                  previous = row
                  samples += 1
                  if samples % 100 == 0:
                      print("sample=%d t=%.3f tags=%s tag_dma_ms=%.3f..%.3f" %
                            (samples, time.monotonic() - start, row,
                             min(durations), max(durations)), flush=True)
      
              elapsed = time.monotonic() - start
              diag_after, diag_after_ms = read_regs()
              tags_after, _ = read_tags()
              print("tag_changes=%s tag_steps=%s samples=%d elapsed_s=%.3f read_errors=%d" %
                    (tag_changes, tag_steps, samples, elapsed, read_errors), flush=True)
              print("diag_after=%s" % diag_after, flush=True)
              print("tags_after=%s" % tags_after, flush=True)
      
              for cam in ("cam1", "cam2"):
                  fd_delta = delta32(diag_after.get(cam + "_frame_done_count"),
                                     diag_before.get(cam + "_frame_done_count"))
                  vs_delta = delta32(diag_after.get(cam + "_vsync_raw_count"),
                                     diag_before.get(cam + "_vsync_raw_count"))
                  aw_delta = delta16(diag_after.get(cam + "_aw_count_low16"),
                                     diag_before.get(cam + "_aw_count_low16"))
                  b_delta = delta16(diag_after.get(cam + "_b_count_low16"),
                                    diag_before.get(cam + "_b_count_low16"))
                  cmd_delta = delta16(diag_after.get(cam + "_command_count_low16"),
                                      diag_before.get(cam + "_command_count_low16"))
                  print("summary %s frame_done=%s fps=%.3f vsync=%s vsync_fps=%.3f "
                        "aw_delta=%s b_delta=%s cmd_delta=%s state=%s wd_low8=%s" %
                        (cam, fd_delta,
                         (fd_delta / elapsed) if fd_delta is not None else float("nan"),
                         vs_delta,
                         (vs_delta / elapsed) if vs_delta is not None else float("nan"),
                         aw_delta, b_delta, cmd_delta,
                         diag_after.get(cam + "_state"),
                         diag_after.get(cam + "_watchdog_low8")), flush=True)
      
              for base in ("cam1", "cam2"):
                  names = [base + "_a_tag", base + "_b_tag"]
                  steps = sum(tag_steps.get(n, 0) for n in names)
                  print("summary %s tag_step_sum=%d tag_frame_equiv_fps=%.3f" %
                        (base, steps, steps / elapsed), flush=True)
              print("first_diag_read_ms=%.3f..%.3f last_diag_read_ms=%.3f..%.3f" %
                    (min(diag_ms), max(diag_ms), min(diag_after_ms), max(diag_after_ms)), flush=True)
              for cam, base in TAG_BASES.items():
                  data, elapsed_ms = read_bytes(base, FRAME_BYTES)
                  print("frame_read=%s bytes=%s elapsed_ms=%.3f" %
                        (cam, None if data is None else len(data), elapsed_ms), flush=True)
          finally:
              os.close(fd)
      
      
      if __name__ == "__main__":
          main()

          1: //锟斤拷锟斤拷CMD锟斤拷锟斤拷
          2: module ov5640_ddr_w_ctrl #(
          3:     parameter AXI_ADDR_WIDTH = 32,
          4:     parameter AXI_LEN_WIDTH  = 32,
          5:     parameter AXI_DATA_WIDTH = 128,
          6:     parameter CAM_DATA_LEN   = 172800 //1280*720*3/16
          7: )(
          8:     input          axi_clk        ,
          9:     input          axi_rst        ,
         10:
         11:     input  [AXI_ADDR_WIDTH-1 : 0]      cam_data_addr_1,
         12:     input  [AXI_ADDR_WIDTH-1 : 0]      cam_data_addr_2,
         13:     input  [$clog2(CAM_DATA_LEN) : 0]  cam_data_len   , //锟斤拷16锟街斤拷为锟斤拷位
         14:
         15:     input          s_vsync        ,
         16:
         17:     input          dma_done       ,  // [LEDGER 2026-09-19] DMA transaction-done pulse (authoritative beat ledger)
         18:
         19:     output [AXI_ADDR_WIDTH-1 : 0]  axi_cmd_addr   /*synthesis PAP_MARK_DEBUG="1"*/,
         20:     output [AXI_LEN_WIDTH-1 : 0]   axi_cmd_len    /*synthesis PAP_MARK_DEBUG="1"*/,
         21:     output reg                     axi_cmd_valid  /*synthesis PAP_MARK_DEBUG="1"*/,
         22:     input                          axi_cmd_ready  /*synthesis PAP_MARK_DEBUG="1"*/,
         23:
         24:     output [1 : 0]   xdma_req       ,
         25:     input  [1 : 0]   xdma_ack       ,
         26:
         27:     // [FRTAG 2026-09-14] frame-tag injection. After each frame's last stream beat the
         28:     // FSM issues a SECOND 16-byte AXI command writing a 32-bit frame counter to
         29:     // frame_base + CAM_DATA_LEN*16. The wrapper (ov5640_ddr.v) muxes tag_data onto
         30:     // the data stream while tag_active is high. The transaction must complete:
         31:     // aborting it would leave a pending frame with no new tag for the host.
         32:     output                           tag_active     ,
         33:     output [AXI_DATA_WIDTH-1 : 0]    tag_data       ,
         34:     input                            tag_ready,
         35:     output [31:0]                    dbg_state,
         36:     output                           engine_busy,     // [IDLEGATE 2026-09-19] FSM not IDLE (frame or tag in flight)
         37:     output [31:0]                    dbg_last_cnt,
         38:     output [31:0]                    dbg_wd_cnt
         39: );
         40:
         41:     localparam IDLE      = 3'b001;
         42:     localparam ADDR      = 3'b010;
         43:     localparam DATA      = 3'b100;
         44:     // [FRTAG 2026-09-14] tag states: second (16B) command after the frame completes
         45:     localparam ADDR_TAG  = 3'b011;
         46:     localparam DATA_TAG  = 3'b101;
         47:
         48:     reg [2 : 0] curr_state/*synthesis PAP_MARK_DEBUG="1"*/;
         49:     // [LEDGER 2026-09-19] both the frame command and the 16B tag command pulse
         50:     // dma_done; only the frame command's completion may advance frame state.
         51:     wire frame_done = dma_done && (curr_state == DATA);
         52:     reg [2 : 0] next_state;
         53:     wire wd_expire;
         54:
         55:     // [FRTAG 2026-09-14] frame-tag declarations (forward, before first use)
         56:     reg                          vsync_pending;
         57:     reg  [AXI_ADDR_WIDTH-1 : 0]  frame_base;
         58:     reg  [31 : 0]                frame_cnt;
         59:     wire [AXI_ADDR_WIDTH-1 : 0]  tag_addr;
         60:     wire                         tag_fire;
         61:
         62:     reg [1 : 0] axi_vsync_ff/*synthesis PAP_MARK_DEBUG="1"*/;
         63:     reg axi_vsync_rise/*synthesis PAP_MARK_DEBUG="1"*/;
         64:
         65:
         66:     reg [AXI_ADDR_WIDTH-1 : 0] cmd_addr;
         67:
         68:
         69:     //状态锟斤拷
         70:     always @(posedge axi_clk) begin
         71:         if(axi_rst)begin
         72:             curr_state <= IDLE;
         73:         end
         74:         else begin
         75:             curr_state <= next_state;
         76:         end
         77:     end
         78:
         79:     always @(*) begin
         80:         case (curr_state)
         81:             IDLE: begin
         82:                 if(vsync_pending)begin
         83:                     next_state = ADDR;
         84:                 end
         85:                 else begin
         86:                     next_state = IDLE;
         87:                 end
         88:             end
         89:             ADDR: begin
         90:                 if(axi_cmd_ready & axi_cmd_valid)begin
         91:                     next_state = DATA;
         92:                 end
         93:                 else if(wd_expire)begin
         94:                     next_state = IDLE;      // [WD2] cmd_ready stuck -> retry
         95:                 end
         96:                 else begin
         97:                     next_state = ADDR;
         98:                 end
         99:             end
        100:             DATA: begin
        101:                 if(frame_done)begin
        102:                     next_state = ADDR_TAG;              // [FRTAG] frame complete, go write the tag
        103:                 end
        104:                 else if(wd_expire)begin
        105:                     next_state = IDLE;                  // [FIX] retry next vsync
        106:                 end
        107:                 else begin
        108:                     next_state = DATA;
        109:                 end
        110:             end
        111:             ADDR_TAG: begin
        112:                 if(axi_cmd_ready & axi_cmd_valid)begin
        113:                     next_state = DATA_TAG;
        114:                 end
        115:                 else if(wd_expire)begin
        116:                     next_state = IDLE;                  // [FIX]
        117:                 end
        118:                 else begin
        119:                     next_state = ADDR_TAG;
        120:                 end
        121:             end
        122:             DATA_TAG: begin
        123:                 if(tag_fire || wd_expire)begin
        124:                     next_state = IDLE;
        125:                 end
        126:                 else begin
        127:                     next_state = DATA_TAG;
        128:                 end
        129:             end
        130:             default: begin
        131:                 next_state = IDLE;
        132:             end
        133:         endcase
        134:     end
        135:
        136:
        137:     always @(posedge axi_clk) begin
        138:         if(axi_rst)begin
        139:             axi_vsync_ff <= 2'b0;
        140:         end
        141:         else begin
        142:             axi_vsync_ff <= {axi_vsync_ff[0], s_vsync};
        143:         end
        144:     end
        145:
        146:     always @(posedge axi_clk) begin
        147:         if(axi_rst)begin
        148:             axi_vsync_rise <= 1'b0;
        149:         end
        150:         else begin
        151:             axi_vsync_rise <= axi_vsync_ff[0] & (~axi_vsync_ff[1]);
        152:         end
        153:     end
        154:
        155:     reg w_ping;
        156:     always @(posedge axi_clk) begin
        157:         if(axi_rst)begin
        158:             w_ping <= 1'b0;
        159:         end
        160:         else begin
        161:             if(frame_done)begin
        162:                 w_ping <= ~w_ping;
        163:             end
        164:         end
        165:     end
        166:
        167:
        168:     // [FRTAG 2026-09-14] sticky vsync latch: a vsync pulse arriving while the tag
        169:     // states are running must not be lost (previously a 1-cycle rise pulse).
        170:     always @(posedge axi_clk) begin
        171:         if(axi_rst)begin
        172:             vsync_pending <= 1'b0;
        173:         end
        174:         else if(axi_vsync_rise)begin
        175:             vsync_pending <= 1'b1;
        176:         end
        177:         else if((curr_state == IDLE) && vsync_pending)begin
        178:             vsync_pending <= 1'b0;
        179:         end
        180:     end
        181:
        182:     always @(posedge axi_clk) begin
        183:         if(axi_rst)begin
        184:             axi_cmd_valid <= 1'b0;
        185:         end
        186:         else begin
        187:             if((curr_state == IDLE) && vsync_pending)begin
        188:                 axi_cmd_valid <= 1'b1;
        189:             end
        190:             else if(frame_done)begin
        191:                 axi_cmd_valid <= 1'b1;      // [FRTAG] frame done -> present the tag command
        192:             end
        193:             else if(axi_cmd_valid & axi_cmd_ready)begin
        194:                 axi_cmd_valid <= 1'b0;
        195:             end
        196:         end
        197:     end
        198:
        199:
        200:     always @(posedge axi_clk) begin
        201:         if(w_ping)begin
        202:             cmd_addr <= cam_data_addr_2;
        203:         end
        204:         else begin
        205:             cmd_addr <= cam_data_addr_1;
        206:         end
        207:     end
        208:
        209:     assign axi_cmd_addr = (curr_state == ADDR_TAG) ? tag_addr : cmd_addr;
        210:     // [FRTAG 2026-09-14] tag command = one 16-byte beat at frame_base + frame size
        211:     assign axi_cmd_len  = (curr_state == ADDR_TAG) ? 32'd16
        212:                         : {{AXI_LEN_WIDTH-4-$clog2(CAM_DATA_LEN){1'd0}}, cam_data_len, 4'b0};
        213:
        214:
        215:     // [FRTAG 2026-09-14] frame counter + tag beat generation --------------------
        216:     // frame_base is latched when the FRAME command is accepted (cmd_addr still
        217:     // points at the buffer being written at that moment; w_ping flips later).
        218:     always @(posedge axi_clk) begin
        219:         if(axi_rst)begin
        220:             frame_base <= {AXI_ADDR_WIDTH{1'b0}};
        221:         end
        222:         else if((curr_state == ADDR) && axi_cmd_valid && axi_cmd_ready)begin
        223:             frame_base <= cmd_addr;
        224:         end
        225:     end
        226:
        227:     assign tag_addr = frame_base + (CAM_DATA_LEN << 4);
        228:
        229:     always @(posedge axi_clk) begin
        230:         if(axi_rst)begin
        231:             frame_cnt <= 32'd0;
        232:         end
        233:         else if(frame_done)begin
        234:             frame_cnt <= frame_cnt + 32'd1;
        235:         end
        236:     end
        237:
        238:     assign tag_active  = (curr_state == DATA_TAG);
        239:     assign tag_data    = {{(AXI_DATA_WIDTH-32){1'b0}}, frame_cnt};
        240:     assign tag_fire    = tag_active & tag_ready;
        241:     // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
        242:
        243:
        244:     //XDMA乒锟斤拷锟斤拷锟斤拷
        245:     reg [1 : 0] s_xdma_req;
        246:     always @(posedge axi_clk) begin
        247:         if(axi_rst)begin
        248:             s_xdma_req <= 2'b0;
        249:         end
        250:         else begin
        251:             if(frame_done)begin
        252:                 if(w_ping)begin
        253:                     s_xdma_req[1] <= 1'b1;
        254:                 end
        255:                 else begin
        256:                     s_xdma_req[0] <= 1'b1;
        257:                 end
        258:             end
        259:             else begin
        260:                 if(xdma_ack[0]) begin
        261:                     s_xdma_req[0] <= 1'b0;
        262:                 end
        263:                 if(xdma_ack[1]) begin
        264:                     s_xdma_req[1] <= 1'b0;
        265:                 end
        266:             end
        267:         end
        268:     end
        269:
        270:     assign xdma_req = s_xdma_req;
        271:     assign dbg_state = {29'd0, curr_state};
        272:     assign engine_busy = (curr_state != IDLE);
        273:
        274:     // [FIX 2026-09-18] frame-write watchdog: a frame that does not complete
        275:     // (lost/short camera stream) used to wedge this FSM in DATA forever. Bail
        276:     // back to IDLE after ~0.16 s and retry on the next vsync.
        277:     reg [31:0] wd_cnt;
        278:     // [WDFIX 2026-09-19] reset the budget on every state CHANGE, not only in
        279:     // IDLE: a frame that burns the budget in DATA (slow DMA close with the B
        280:     // path dead) used to make the immediately following ADDR_TAG/DATA_TAG
        281:     // expire instantly, silently skipping the frame-tag write.
        282:     reg [2:0] wd_prev_state;
        283:     always @(posedge axi_clk) begin
        284:         if(axi_rst) wd_prev_state <= IDLE;
        285:         else        wd_prev_state <= curr_state;
        286:     end
        287:     always @(posedge axi_clk) begin
        288:         if(axi_rst || (curr_state == IDLE) || (curr_state != wd_prev_state)) wd_cnt <= 32'd0;
        289:         else if(wd_cnt != 32'hffffffff)     wd_cnt <= wd_cnt + 32'd1;
        290:     end
        291:     assign wd_expire = (wd_cnt >= 32'd20_000_000);
        292:     assign dbg_wd_cnt = wd_cnt;
        293:
        294:     reg [31:0] last_cnt;
        295:     always @(posedge axi_clk) begin
        296:         if(axi_rst) last_cnt <= 32'd0;
        297:         else if(frame_done) last_cnt <= last_cnt + 32'd1;
        298:     end
        299:     assign dbg_last_cnt = last_cnt;
        300:
        301:
        302:
        303:
        304: endmodule
      
      ====source/ov5640/ov5640_ddr/ov5640_ddr_w_en.v====
          1: module ov5640_ddr_w_en #(
          2:     parameter DATA_WIDTH = 24
          3: )(
          4:     input          axi_clk      ,
          5:     input          axi_rst      ,
          6:
          7:     input          axi_cam_en   ,
          8:     input  [1:0]   frame_pending,
          9:     input          engine_busy,   // [IDLEGATE 2026-09-19] write engine FSM busy
         10:
         11:     input  [DATA_WIDTH-1 : 0]  s_data       ,
         12:     input                      s_data_valid ,
         13:     input                      s_hsync      ,
         14:     input                      s_vsync      ,
         15:
         16:     output [DATA_WIDTH-1 : 0]  m_data       ,
         17:     output                     m_data_valid ,
         18:     output                     m_hsync      ,
         19:     output                     m_vsync
         20: );
         21:
         22: localparam IDLE = 2'b01;
         23: localparam DATA = 2'b10;
         24:
         25: reg [1:0] curr_state;
         26: reg [1:0] next_state;
         27:
         28: reg [1:0] s_vsync_ff;
         29: reg       s_vsync_rise;
         30:
         31: always @(posedge axi_clk) begin
         32:     if(axi_rst)begin
         33:         curr_state <= IDLE;
         34:     end
         35:     else begin
         36:         curr_state <= next_state;
         37:     end
         38: end
         39:
         40: always @(*) begin
         41:     case (curr_state)
         42:         IDLE: begin
         43:                 if(s_vsync_rise & axi_cam_en && !engine_busy) begin  // [IDLEGATE 2026-09-19] admit a frame only when the engine finished the previous one
         44:                 next_state = DATA;
         45:             end
         46:             else begin
         47:                 next_state = IDLE;
         48:             end
         49:         end
         50:         DATA: begin
         51:             if(s_vsync_rise) begin
         52:                     if(axi_cam_en && !engine_busy) begin  // [IDLEGATE] engine wedged mid-frame: drop the rest at this vsync
         53:                     next_state = DATA;
         54:                 end
         55:                 else begin
         56:                     next_state = IDLE;
         57:                 end
         58:             end
         59:             else begin
         60:                 next_state = DATA;
         61:             end
         62:         end
         63:         default: begin
         64:             next_state = IDLE;
         65:         end
         66:     endcase
         67: end
         68:
         69: always @(posedge axi_clk) begin
         70:     if(axi_rst)begin
         71:         s_vsync_ff <= 2'b0;
         72:     end
         73:     else begin
         74:         s_vsync_ff <= {s_vsync_ff[0], s_vsync};
         75:     end
         76: end
         77:
         78: always @(posedge axi_clk) begin
         79:     if(axi_rst)begin
         80:         s_vsync_rise <= 1'b0;
         81:     end
         82:     else begin
         83:         s_vsync_rise <= s_vsync_ff[0] & (~s_vsync_ff[1]);
         84:     end
         85: end
         86:
         87: assign m_data       = s_data;
         88: assign m_data_valid = s_data_valid & (curr_state == DATA);
         89:
         90: // A completed frame owns its DDR buffer until the host acknowledges it.
         91: // Drop whole sensor frames at VSYNC boundaries while one frame is pending.
         92:     assign m_vsync = s_vsync_rise & axi_cam_en && !engine_busy;  // [IDLEGATE 2026-09-19]
         93:
         94: endmodule

         47: );
